The endless blue and the salty scent in the air were not much different from his memories of his past life.

However, the horizon before him seemed unusually distant, and the scale of the fortress and harbor built along the coastline was difficult to compare with anything he had seen in his past life.

Lee Hyun took out the maps of the mundane world that he had purchased along the way.

After leaving Yunze Kingdom, he had crossed the borders of four mortal kingdoms and reached the southernmost edge of Hailing Kingdom. By the standards of the cultivation world, he should already have left Kun Kingdom, a Tier-4 cultivation nation.

He did not know which cultivation nation Hailing Kingdom belonged to, nor did he particularly care to find out. Once he crossed the strait before him, he would leave that cultivation nation behind as well.

“Let’s cross the sea too.”

One of the Azure Cloud Sect cultivators he had killed might have had some powerful senior within the sect backing him. If possible, Lee Hyun wanted to go even farther away so he could live with peace of mind.

...

Haimen City, at the southern end of Hailing Kingdom.

Even outside the city walls, the broad highway split into several branches, with an endless stream of ox- and horse-drawn carts heading toward the harbor.

The carts were piled high with silk, porcelain, timber, and medicinal ingredients. The carts coming from the harbor, meanwhile, carried dried fish, salt, enormous seashells, and exotic spices, giving off scents that were both fishy and pungent.

Beyond them, hundreds of masts filled the harbor like a leafless forest.

Before entering the city, Lee Hyun activated the Seven-Aspect Disguise Method.

He lowered his eyelids slightly and let the corners of his mouth droop. He darkened his complexion as though it had been tanned by the sun and attached a beard he had prepared in advance to his chin.

He hunched his shoulders slightly and shortened his stride.

He also divided the seven storage pouches among his clothes and concealed them inside his broad belt.

Finally, he pushed both the Spirit-Concealing Art and Aura-Concealing Art to their limits.

...

The scenery inside Haimen City was unfamiliar.

There were bronze-skinned merchants, sailors with white cloth wrapped around their heads, and foreigners with pale-colored eyes.

Hard-to-understand dialects could be heard in shops everywhere.

Lee Hyun wandered the streets for several shichen (two hours each), familiarizing himself with the unfamiliar accents and frequently used words.

...

At the end of the main road, the harbor spread out before him.

Dozens of docks extended far into the sea, and ships constantly came and went, ranging from small fishing boats to enormous sailing vessels that looked capable of carrying hundreds of passengers.

Laborers walked back and forth across planks with huge timbers and jars strapped to their backs. Whenever heavily loaded carts passed, the stone paving beneath them rumbled.

“Looking for a ship to Haiwu Kingdom?”

Lee Hyun stopped at the tout’s call.

“Is there a ship going to Haiwu Kingdom?”

“Of course. The Haiyan departs tomorrow morning for Qingjin Port in Haiwu Kingdom, across the strait. It takes about forty days.”

“That’s faster than I expected.”

“It’s a narrow strait compared to the outer ocean, and the Haiyan sails directly without stopping at any ports along the way. In bad weather, it can sometimes take more than three months, but the winds have been favorable lately.”

The tout quickly looked over Lee Hyun’s clothing.

“A shared cabin costs two liang of silver, a second-class cabin shared by six people costs five liang, and a private room costs fifteen liang.”

“I’ll take a private room.”

“You’re fortunate. The Haiyan is one of the largest and safest ships in all of Haimen City.”

Lee Hyun followed the tout toward a pavilion at one side of the docks.

...

The Haiyan was an enormous sailing ship nearly a hundred zhang long.

Its hull was built of black timber, and it had seven masts. A swallow with its wings spread wide was carved into the bow.

Below deck were the cargo holds and the crew’s quarters, while the three-story deckhouse near the stern contained cabins for passengers.

‘Hm?’

There were cultivators among the passengers waiting to depart.

A robed old man and a young man stood at one side of the dock.

The two gave off auras corresponding to Qi Refining Stage 5 and Stage 3, respectively.

The old cultivator surveyed his surroundings, his gaze briefly passing over Lee Hyun as well.

“.......”

But he soon looked away as though he had no interest whatsoever.

Judging from the old cultivator’s reaction, the Spirit-Concealing Art and Aura-Concealing Art were working properly.

Lee Hyun boarded the Haiyan while keeping a suitable distance from the two cultivators.

...

The next morning.

Boom―

A deep drumbeat echoed across the harbor.

The sailors released the ropes, and dozens of laborers used long poles to push the ship away from the dock.

As the wind began to blow, the enormous furled sails unfurled one after another.

Whump! Whump!

The white sails billowed full with wind.

The Haiyan slowly began to move.

Standing on deck, Lee Hyun watched Haimen City recede into the distance.

The towering walls and hundreds of masts gradually shrank, while the voices of the crowds that had filled the harbor were swallowed by the sound of waves and wind.

Lee Hyun leaned against the railing and gazed across the endless water. The sunlit waves glittered like tens of thousands of silver scales, and the salty wind brushed against his face.

White foam parted to either side along the hull, and several seabirds followed behind the ship.

Screee―

Splat.

“...?”

The bird dropping was headed straight for Lee Hyun’s shoulder, but the Square-Inch Step inherited from Liu Baichuan, a Profound Realm martial artist who had made a name for himself in Qianyang Kingdom, was not so easily bested.

...

The morning of the fifteenth day.

A commotion broke out on one side of the deck.

“Look over there!”

“A whale!”

The passengers surged toward the railing. Lee Hyun also looked where everyone was pointing.

At first, he thought an island had risen from the sea.

But it was slowly moving.

Whoooosh―

A thick jet of water shot high into the sky.

A gigantic whale was passing far from the ship. Faint silver stripes ran across its dark blue back, and its body appeared to be more than fifty zhang long.

‘Why is it so huge?’

A short while later, two smaller whales appeared beside it.

A sailor laughed and said,

“It’s a Silverback Whale! They’re gentle creatures, so there’s nothing to worry about!”

The passengers relaxed and watched the whales.

Lee Hyun examined the whale with the Farsight Art and Aura-Reading Art.

He could sense a tiny amount of spiritual qi from it, but nowhere near enough for it to qualify as a demon beast.

...

On the afternoon of the forty-fifth day after departure.

A port city built along the distant coastline began to come into view. Large and small sailing ships crossed the waters in front of it, while the docks were packed with people.

Boooooom―

The Haiyan sounded a long horn announcing its arrival.

“Qingjin Port!”

“We’re finally here!”

The passengers gathered their belongings in relief.

...

Qingjin Port, Haiwu Kingdom.

After disembarking, Lee Hyun heard speech with an accent slightly different from that of Haimen City. Even so, it was not different enough to make conversation difficult, and they used the same script, allowing him to read most of the signs along the streets.

Lee Hyun passed through customs and purchased a map.

After taking a room at an inn, he immediately spread the map across the floor.

Haiwu Kingdom was a mortal kingdom facing Hailing Kingdom across the sea, with Qinglu Kingdom and Nanli Kingdom extending southward in succession.

“Hmm....”

Judging by the area shown on the map, this continent appeared narrower from north to south than the continent he had traveled from.

Lee Hyun was rolling up the map when his gaze fell on one of the storage pouches beside him. He suddenly remembered the pill bottles he had obtained from the Azure Cloud Sect disciples.

‘They aren’t pills I’ll use, and some are mixed in that I can’t even identify. Is there any point in keeping them? I’d be better off turning them into spirit stones.’

...

The next day.

Disguised as someone else, Lee Hyun visited Qingjin Market, a little over seventy li west of Qingjin Port. After selling some of the pills there, he changed his appearance again two days later and headed for Wusong Market.

After selling the remaining pills among several shops in Wusong Market, Lee Hyun’s holdings had risen to 670 low-grade spirit stones.

He unfolded a map of the cultivation world that he had purchased in Wusong Market.

According to the map, Haiwu Kingdom lay within the territory of Lan Kingdom, a Tier-4 cultivation nation, while Hailing Kingdom and the kingdoms he had passed through on the far side of the sea were marked as belonging to Cang Kingdom.

‘So I came from Kun Kingdom, passed through Cang Kingdom, and reached Lan Kingdom.’

There were now two cultivation nations and a sea between him and the Azure Cloud Sect. Having come this far, it seemed reasonable to consider himself considerably safer.

‘There’s no reason to stay long near the places where I sold the Azure Cloud Sect cultivators’ pills. Should I go a little farther south? I have plenty of time anyway.’

About twenty days later.

Southern Lan Kingdom, sixty thousand li south of Qingjin Port.

The southernmost edge of Nanli Kingdom.

Lee Hyun stood atop a cliff and gazed at the scenery before him.

It was the sea again.

Whenever the fierce waves below the cliff crashed against the rocks, white foam burst across the dark blue surface.

Rooooar―

After leaving Qingjin Port, Lee Hyun had traveled through Haiwu Kingdom and Qinglu Kingdom before reaching the southernmost edge of Nanli Kingdom. Qinglu Kingdom had been filled with blue-feathered waterbirds and broad reed fields, while after entering Nanli Kingdom he had often seen reddish hills and broad-leaved trees.

‘How far have I come?’

Lee Hyun layered several maps together and marked the location of Tunnel No. 1, where he had first set out.

From there to Haimen City was 65,000 li.

From Haimen City across the sea to Qingjin Port was 30,000 li.

And from Qingjin Port to here was another roughly 60,000 li.

“A total of 155,000 li....”

The actual distance he had traveled was longer, but that was the total straight-line distance he had moved south.

‘At this point, I should be able to forget about the Azure Cloud Sect and sleep soundly. Should I build Tunnel No. 2 somewhere around here? Whenever I feel cooped up, I could come out and look at the sea.’

‘Before that... I should learn about the cultivation world in southern Nanli Kingdom.’

Before deciding on the location of Tunnel No. 2, he needed to investigate the nearby cultivator markets, cultivation factions, and the spirit plants traded there. In particular, if he wanted to perform alchemy on Barrier-Breaking Pills in large quantities, he needed to determine whether the spirit plants required by the pill recipe could all grow properly in underground spirit fields.

If any varieties could not be cultivated there, he would have to buy them from cultivator markets.

...

Fifteen days later.

Nanya Market, southern Nanli Kingdom.

Lee Hyun was walking along a mountain path covered in faint mist.

Before entering the mountain, Lee Hyun had changed his face with the Seven-Aspect Disguise Method.

He now appeared to be a thin rogue cultivator in his mid-forties.

At the end of the mountain path stood a sheer cliff. To an ordinary mortal, it appeared to be a dead end with no way forward.

When Lee Hyun revealed the aura of Qi Refining Stage 3, the mist before him parted to either side.

The scenery he had thought was a cliff rippled like water, revealing the entrance to the cultivator market.

Two Qi Refining Stage 6 cultivators stood at the entrance.

After receiving a brief explanation, Lee Hyun entered the market.

Nanya Market was larger than any cultivator market he had seen before.

‘Wow...’

Even at a rough estimate, hundreds of cultivators were coming and going.

Three-story pavilions and shops lined both sides of the road, while hundreds of stalls filled a broad open square.

He saw all manner of exotic goods.

The carcass of a demon fish covered in sharp scales.

A pearl taken from a shell as large as a human head.

Dried spirit herbs from beneath the sea and coral saturated with dense water qi.

Some stalls even sold small living demon fish inside water-filled jars.

At a bookstore in the market, Lee Hyun purchased a thin volume titled Brief Guide to Cultivation in Southern Lan Kingdom, along with maps of the surrounding area.

The book provided a concise overview of the major cultivator markets, cultivation clans, and sea routes of southern Lan Kingdom.

There were no large sects in the south.

Because decent spirit veins were scarce, the powerful sects and clans of Lan Kingdom were concentrated mainly in the central and northern regions, while the south was primarily home to Foundation Establishment clans occupying small spirit veins and groups of Qi Refining rogue cultivators.

One name among them caught Lee Hyun’s attention.

「Qingchao Merchant Alliance.

A merchant alliance formed by eight merchant groups operating between Nanli Kingdom and the southern archipelago. It jointly manages spirit ships and sea routes, and primarily trades spirit materials, pills, and demon-beast materials.

Fifteen Foundation Establishment cultivators serve as alliance elders, with all major and minor affairs of the merchant alliance decided by the Council of Alliance Elders.」

‘Fifteen Foundation Establishment cultivators....’

That was not a force Lee Hyun could handle personally, but viewed in the context of Lan Kingdom as a whole, it was merely a regional merchant alliance without any Golden Core cultivators. As long as he concealed his identity properly, they would be easier to deal with than a great sect.

According to the book, the Qingchao Merchant Alliance did not directly control Nanya Market, but it maintained several shops and warehouses within the market and operated branches in other southern cultivator markets and mortal cities as well.

...

The central district of Nanya Market.

Lee Hyun was walking along the road when he suddenly stopped.

Across the street stood a large shop marked with a blue wave emblem.

「Qingchao Pill Pavilion」

A wooden board outside the shop listed the pills currently for sale.

Lee Hyun’s gaze stopped on one name.

「Tier-1 Bone-Forging Powder.

One low-grade dose packet: 18 low-grade spirit stones.

One mid-grade dose packet: 30 low-grade spirit stones.」

‘Bone-Forging Powder?’

Bone-Forging Powder was a spirit medicine that permanently strengthened a cultivator’s skeleton in proportion to the medicinal strength absorbed.

And its main ingredient was....

‘Bone-Rot Flower.’

Lee Hyun’s eyes sharpened.

He immediately entered the Qingchao Pill Pavilion.

“Welcome.”

A young clerk in blue robes approached him.

The wave emblem of the Qingchao Merchant Alliance was embroidered on his sleeve.

“I came to see the Bone-Forging Powder.”

“You’ve come to the right place. Our Qingchao Pill Pavilion’s Bone-Forging Powder has an excellent reputation even throughout the southern archipelago. Are you a body refiner, fellow Daoist?”

“I am not.”

“That doesn’t matter. Stronger bones allow you to better withstand the backlash of techniques and external impacts as well. Even an ordinary cultivator will clearly feel the effects from the first three or four dose packets.”

“How different are the effects of the low grade and mid grade?”

“The medicinal strength of the mid grade is about thirty percent greater than that of the low grade. It also contains fewer pill toxins. But if this is your first time taking it, the low grade will be more than sufficient.”

“How is it taken?”

“Dissolve it in spirit spring water and consume it in portions over three days. If you take the entire dose at once, your bones may ache and you may develop a fever.”

“I see.”

Lee Hyun examined the displayed Bone-Forging Powder.

A small sealing talisman was attached to every palm-sized medicine packet.

Lee Hyun asked,

“Does the Qingchao Merchant Alliance produce this directly?”

“That is correct. It is made by Tier-1 alchemists affiliated with our alliance.”

“Do you happen to sell the pill recipe as well?”

“We do not sell pill recipes.”

The clerk firmly shook his head.

“Bone-Forging Powder is not monopolized by our alliance, but its pill recipe is taught only to our alliance’s alchemists or guest alchemists who have maintained a long-standing relationship with us.”

“What is required to become a guest alchemist?”

“You must prove that you are a Tier-1 alchemist and build trust by carrying out work for our alliance. For the details, you would need to inquire at the General Affairs Pavilion.”

Lee Hyun nodded.

He had no intention of joining the Qingchao Merchant Alliance immediately, but he was pleased to have discovered a legitimate way to obtain a pill recipe that used Bone-Rot Flower.

After establishing Tunnel No. 2 and raising his realm sufficiently, approaching them as a guest alchemist might be worth considering.

Lee Hyun was about to ask whether the Qingchao Pill Pavilion purchased Bone-Rot Flowers, but stopped himself.

‘Come to think of it, the fact that Bone-Rot Flower is used in Bone-Forging Powder might not be common knowledge here.’

After leaving the Qingchao Pill Pavilion, Lee Hyun continued looking around the nearby shops and stalls.

...

The eastern stall district of the cultivator market.

Dozens of flowerpots of various sizes stood beneath a black canopy.

Each pot was covered with a thin sheet of oiled paper to block the poisonous pollen. Inside grew spirit plants with layer upon layer of ivory-colored petals.

‘Those are Bone-Rot Flowers!’

Pretending he had never seen the spirit plant before, Lee Hyun squatted in front of the pots.

“What kind of spirit plant is this?”

“Bone-Rot Flower.”

The middle-aged cultivator tending the stall answered.

“What is it used for?”

“It’s an ingredient in Bone-Forging Powder. If you raise it well, you can harvest seeds from it too.”

‘I see. So it looks like everyone around here knows Bone-Rot Flower is used in Bone-Forging Powder.’

“What is their medicine age?”

“The smaller ones over here are twelve years old. The larger ones are thirty-one years old.”

“And the price?”

“One low-grade spirit stone for a twelve-year plant. Six for a thirty-one-year plant.”

Lee Hyun pretended to inspect the pots closely. The medicine ages stated by the seller roughly matched their actual ages.

“Did you grow them yourself?”

“They were grown in my family’s spirit fields. Spirit-plant cultivators who raise Bone-Rot Flowers aren’t uncommon around here.”

“It must be a widely used spirit plant.”

“The Qingchao Merchant Alliance keeps making Bone-Forging Powder, so there’s always a market for them.”

The middle-aged cultivator pointed to one of the larger pots beside him.

“If you’re confident you can raise them properly, buy a young one. Once its medicine age passes a hundred years, the Qingchao Merchant Alliance will buy it for a good price.”

“A hundred years....”

Lee Hyun wore a subtle expression.

For a single Qi Refining cultivator, a hundred years was hardly a short amount of time.

But if an entire family passed down its spirit fields from one generation to the next, it seemed possible to produce spirit plants over a hundred years old.

‘In that case, even if I put one or two of my Bone-Rot Flowers with medicine ages over 160 years up for sale, they probably won’t immediately become suspicious of where they came from.’

Lee Hyun rose from the stall and looked around some more. The stall was not the only place selling Bone-Rot Flowers.

Another spirit-plant shop sold Bone-Rot Flowers between forty and sixty years old as medicinal ingredients after detoxification.

...

Qingchao Merchant Alliance Spirit Materials Hall.

The interior of the pavilion was spacious.

Tables for purchasing spirit plants were lined up along one side, while cultivators waiting for appraisal sat on the other.

Wooden plaques listing purchase prices for various spirit plants hung on the wall.

Lee Hyun examined the plaques one by one until he found the purchase prices for Bone-Rot Flowers near the bottom.

「Purchase Prices for Bone-Rot Flower Mother Plants.

Final appraisal based on medicine age and condition.

The following are approximate standards for reference only.

Medicine age of 100 years: 30 low-grade spirit stones.

Medicine age of 200 years: 120 low-grade spirit stones.

Price reduced if the roots or growing points are damaged, or if medicinal potency is insufficient.」

“.......”

Lee Hyun’s gaze remained fixed on the wooden plaque.

He read it again to make sure he had not seen it wrong.

‘Thirty for a hundred-year plant, but a hundred and twenty for a two-hundred-year plant?’

At that moment, a cultivator entered through the pavilion doorway carrying a flowerpot.

“I’ve come to sell a Bone-Rot Flower mother plant.”

Chapter 29

The man who appeared carrying a flowerpot was an old man who seemed to be in late Qi Refining.

A clerk from the Spirit Materials Hall immediately led him to a table farther inside.

"Please set it down here."

Thud.

The old man removed the cloth wrapped around the pot.

Whoosh–

A dense medicinal fragrance billowed out along with poisonous pollen like a thin mist. Several cultivators standing nearby stiffened and backed away, while the clerk immediately activated a small formation to contain the poisonous pollen.

Beyond the formation bloomed layer upon layer of ivory petals. It was the same species of Bone-Rot Flower that Lee Hyun was growing, but the concentration of poisonous pollen streaming from its stamens was incomparable to any Bone-Rot Flower he had seen before.

The steward in charge of the appraisal carefully examined the color and luster of the petals, the thickness of the stem, and the patterns on the roots. He took a little pollen and singed it over a flame, then examined the spiritual qi seeping from the roots as well.

After quite some time, the steward spoke.

"I would estimate its medicine age at around 220 years."

"My family has cultivated it for 247 years."

"Then there must have been a period when it lacked spiritual qi, causing its medicinal potency to accumulate somewhat more slowly."

The old man frowned.

"Are you saying my family's records are wrong?"

"Its actual age and medicine age can differ. Even if it has grown for 247 years, if its accumulated medicinal potency is only equivalent to 220 years, transactions are based on the latter."

"That isn't much of a difference, is it?"

"Three of the fine roots are damaged as well. It can still be replanted as a mother plant without issue, but it will need time to recover."

The steward worked his abacus for a moment.

"We can offer you 158 low-grade spirit stones."

"I must have at least 170."

"I'm afraid that will be difficult."

"It isn't as though mother plants of this size come in every day, is it?"

"We can offer 160. Any more would be difficult."

The old man hesitated briefly before finally nodding. When the clerk counted out the spirit stones, his expression brightened.

"If you bring us another well-aged mother plant in the future, we'll make sure to give you a good price."

"That is unlikely to happen before I die."

The old man took the pouch containing his spirit stones and left the Spirit Materials Hall.

Lee Hyun quietly watched him go, then asked a nearby clerk.

"Bone-Rot Flower mother plants are quite expensive. If ingredients for Tier 1 spirit medicines cost that much, is there any profit left?"

"Ha ha, it isn't an ingredient for a Tier 1 spirit medicine."

The clerk replied.

"A Bone-Rot Flower with more than 200 years of accumulated medicinal potency is an ingredient for Tier 2 Bone-Forging Powder."

"There is Tier 2 Bone-Forging Powder? Is it a spirit medicine for Foundation Establishment cultivators?"

"That's right. Its medicinal potency is so strong that it would actually be dangerous for a Qi Refining cultivator to take."

The clerk pointed toward the Bone-Rot Flower inside the formation.

"Besides, that one doesn't have to be used as a medicinal ingredient right away. It can be kept and cultivated as a mother plant."

"Is there someone capable of refining Tier 2 Bone-Forging Powder?"

"There is only one in our alliance. He is an alliance elder, a Tier 2 alchemist, and a Foundation Establishment cultivator."

"I see. Then does Tier 3 Bone-Forging Powder exist as well?"

The clerk smiled and shook his head.

"I've heard that it does. But for Tier 3 Bone-Forging Powder, the Bone-Rot Flower used as an ingredient would need a medicine age of at least 500 years. Something of that caliber isn't even traded at publicly quoted prices, and in the first place, it isn't the sort of item our Qingchao Merchant Alliance could handle."

"I see."

Lee Hyun looked back at the wooden placard on the wall.

Medicine age 200 years, 120 low-grade spirit stones.

His storage pouch contained nearly six hundred Bone-Rot Flowers with medicine ages exceeding 135 years. Of those, the 116 he had dug up from Spirit Field No. 1-1 had medicine ages approaching 170 years.

'If I assume that just five hundred of the six hundred reach a medicine age of 200 years before I sell them, that alone comes to sixty thousand low-grade spirit stones!'

Sixty thousand low-grade spirit stones were roughly equivalent in value to six hundred mid-grade spirit stones. That surpassed not only the wealth of a Qi Refining cultivator, but even that of an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator.

And Lee Hyun also had Yin Soul Grass, Purple Poison Orchids, and Earth Vein Flowers.

He still did not know whether there was any demand for Earth Vein Flowers, but at the very least, Yin Soul Grass and Purple Poison Orchids would fetch high prices somewhere in the cultivation world.

'More importantly, there's no reason to sell them all the moment they reach 200 years. I only need to sell a few whenever I need money, while the rest keep accumulating medicinal potency. There's no reason to dump everything on the market at once, drive down the price, or invite people to tail me.'

'The Bone-Rot Flowers, Purple Poison Orchids, and Yin Soul Grass are basically my Qinghe Valley retirement pension. The living principal accumulates medicine age on its own, and even after I sell part of it, the value of what remains keeps rising.'

The corners of Lee Hyun's mouth rose on their own.

'But a great retirement pension alone isn't enough. My retirement has no end... I'll have to invest in new spirit plants too. I still don't know what the Yin Water Lotus or Stone Honey Peach can be used for, but... if I come across any promising planting stock, I'll try planting a little at a time.'

...

Lee Hyun stayed another day at Nanya Market and visited a number of medicinal ingredient shops.

Perhaps because the cultivator market was so large, six of the eight ingredients used in the Barrier-Breaking Pill were actively traded there: Essence-Condensing Fruit, Clear Void Seed, Meridian-Piercing Flower, Origin-Returning Vine, Triple-Layer Leaf, and Spirit-Stabilizing Stone Milk.

However, he could not find a single merchant selling Spirit-Storing Ginseng or Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi, so he would have to pray that those two spirit plants grew well in Tunnel No. 2.

Of course, Nanli Kingdom likely had other cultivator markets besides Nanya Market, so there was no need to start worrying already.

'Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi is a mushroom, in other words a fungus, so there's a good chance it won't have much trouble growing underground. Spirit-Storing Ginseng is a type of ginseng too, so it should probably be fine in a sunless, shaded environment....'

For now, Lee Hyun carefully memorized the merchants and shops that dealt in the six ingredients used in the Barrier-Breaking Pill recipe. He also checked the market prices of ingredients that met the conditions specified by the pill recipe.

He took out a small wooden tablet and recorded the prices he had investigated that day. He wrote in Korean from his past life, so no one would be able to understand it even if they looked.

「At age 573.

Nanya Market, prices for one furnace batch of Barrier-Breaking Pills.

In low-grade spirit stones.

Meridian-Piercing Flower, 3 blooms: 15

Essence-Condensing Fruit, 3 fruits: 18

Origin-Returning Vine, 3 nodes: 8

Triple-Layer Leaf, 9 leaves: 6

Clear Void Seed, 12 seeds: 4

Spirit-Stabilizing Stone Milk, 3 drops: 10」

'The prices of those six ingredients add up to sixty-one low-grade spirit stones... If I add Spirit-Storing Ginseng and Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi of the proper medicine age....'

Lee Hyun suddenly remembered Wen Shenghe's words.

– If you were to buy all the ingredients needed for one furnace batch, you should expect to spend around seventy to one hundred and twenty low-grade spirit stones.

'Adding the remaining two ingredients would put it around the same price I heard in Yunze Kingdom. If I'm short on anything, buying it here won't mean I'm getting ripped off.'

'To secure fifty low-grade Barrier-Breaking Pills, I'd need to refine at least twenty-five furnace batches... If I bought every ingredient, that would come to roughly twenty-five hundred low-grade spirit stones... Huh? That's not that much.'

'I'll try cultivating the spirit plants in Tunnel No. 2 first, and if that doesn't work, I can simply buy whatever ingredients I'm missing.'

Until recently, twenty-five hundred low-grade spirit stones had seemed like an astronomical sum to Lee Hyun. But after discovering the value of the spirit plants he already possessed, it suddenly felt like a manageable expense.

...

After finishing his tour of the cultivator market, Lee Hyun emerged onto a secluded cliff and gazed out at the sea.

'It's time to build Tunnel No. 2!'

He spread out a map of southern Nanli Kingdom.

First, he crossed off areas containing well-known spirit veins or mines. He also excluded places near mortal highways or cities, strategically important gorges, and lowlands at risk of river flooding.

The site needed to be utterly worthless to cultivators and somewhere even mortals had no reason to visit, while still having soil and water underground for cultivating spirit fields, along with solid bedrock capable of supporting the facilities. A suitable aquifer would make it perfect.

"Shall I start choosing a site?"

Lee Hyun's finger stopped over an unnamed mountain range stretching north from Nanya Market.

165 years later.

Five thousand li (about 1,960 km) north of Nanya Market.

There was a small mountain range there that did not even have a name marked on maps of Nanli Kingdom.

It had no famous spirit veins or mines. It was of little use even to mortals, and one had to travel all the way to the riverside beyond the mountain range to find the nearest village. Even herb gatherers entered only occasionally to collect wild greens and never ventured far into the depths.

Among that small mountain range stood one peak lower and more unremarkable than all the rest.

Rustle–

Something swept through the undergrowth.

It moved so quickly that only the surrounding blades of grass swayed as though a gust of wind had passed through. A tiny insect clinging to a grass stalk raised its antennae, then soon resumed moving as though nothing had happened.

...

Fifteen li underground.

Tap.

Lee Hyun's foot touched the smoothly polished floor of a stone chamber.

On the wall before him were characters he had carved himself.

「Tunnel No. 2」

"Phew... It feels good to be home."

Tunnel No. 2 had been constructed far more systematically than the old Tunnel No. 1.

Along the central passage were separate chambers for resting, cultivation, training, experiments, and storage, with thick stone doors installed between them.

The walls of the training cavern bore marks left by technique tests, while the shelves of the laboratory were packed with jars containing samples of soil and medicinal ingredients.

Beyond the residential area lay Spirit Fields No. 1-1 through No. 1-7.

One hundred and sixty-five years ago, Lee Hyun had hurriedly built those seven spirit fields first, before the spirit plants he had brought in his storage pouch could spoil. Afterward, he gradually expanded the passages and facilities outward one by one so that he would not disturb the existing spirit fields, eventually completing Tunnel No. 2 in its current form.

Drip.

The sound of a water droplet falling echoed through the silent underground.

Drip. Drip.

Each spirit field had watering vessels connected to an axle. One level above the spirit-field area was a wide, shallow reservoir as large as all the fields combined, and droplets flowed from it through bamboo pipes into each watering vessel.

One of the differences between Tunnel No. 2 and Tunnel No. 1 was that Lee Hyun used bamboo pipes instead of bronze ones.

Lee Hyun had realized there was no reason for him to insist on bronze pipes. The automatic irrigation device merely used gravity to move water, so bamboo pipes were more than sufficient.

If he hollowed out the bamboo with techniques, fired it, and coated it with lacquer, it could serve as piping for decades.

By varying the height of the pipe openings and the diameter of the holes, he could also adjust the watering intervals for each spirit field. In many respects, it was a more advanced version of the automatic irrigation device in Tunnel No. 1.

After filling the reservoir again with the Spirit Rain Art, Lee Hyun headed toward Spirit Field No. 1-1.

Grrrk.

As the stone door opened, a dense medicinal fragrance and toxic qi flowed out.

Ivory Bone-Rot Flowers, violet Purple Poison Orchids, and deep blue-black Yin Soul Grass filled the field. Between them, the slender stems of Earth Vein Flowers crept along the ground.

Buzz, buzz–

Several fuzzbees flew over and landed on Lee Hyun's shoulder and sleeves.

Lee Hyun lightly stroked the back of one fuzzbee with a finger, then examined the Bone-Rot Flowers.

Most of the spirit plants moved from Tunnel No. 1 had survived without issue. However, Tunnel No. 2 also had no spirit vein to speak of, so their medicinal potency was still accumulating slowly.

Although 165 years had passed in the outside world, their medicine ages had increased by only around fifty-five years on average.

The Bone-Rot Flowers growing in the oldest field, Spirit Field No. 1-1, had reached medicine ages of around 225 years.

Lee Hyun inspected the other spirit fields in turn. The Yin Water Lotus had flowered several times and produced lotus seed pods, while all three Stone Honey Peach trees had completely taken root in their new home.

...

Beyond the original seven spirit fields stretched the newly constructed Spirit Fields No. 2-1 through No. 2-5.

Spirit Fields No. 2-1 and No. 2-2 each contained three hundred roots of Spirit-Storing Ginseng, for a total of six hundred. Spirit-Storing Ginseng was a spirit plant that died once its root was harvested. For that reason, Lee Hyun had allocated fields twice as large as those of his other spirit plants.

Spirit Field No. 2-3 contained six hundred Triple-Layer Leaf plants. The pill recipe required the leaves, but medicine age was measured by the age of the underground rhizome. As long as the roots and young shoots were left untouched, the leaves would grow back, though the plant needed several years of rest to recover the medicinal strength it had expended.

Spirit Field No. 2-4 contained two hundred logs Lee Hyun had acquired. Each log had been inoculated with Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi spawn, and mature caps had sprouted from them. The medicine age of Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi was determined not by its cap, but by how long the mycelium within the spirit tree had lived. If he cut a mature fruiting body off at the base and harvested only the cap, the mycelium would survive and push up new caps several years later.

In Spirit Field No. 2-5, three hundred Origin-Returning Vine mother plants wound around stone pillars and wooden trellises. If he cut no more than two nodes from a single mother plant and sealed the cut with clean mud, new shoots could sprout again from the remaining vine.

The Triple-Layer Leaf, Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi, and Origin-Returning Vine he had originally planted had already exceeded the upper limits of the medicine ages required by the pill recipe. For that reason, Lee Hyun staggered their propagation times so that he would always have plants within the proper medicine-age range for the recipe. He planned to let everything beyond what he needed for Barrier-Breaking Pills continue aging.

Earth Vein Flowers had been planted around the borders of every spirit field to draw in the faint spiritual qi from outside. With the fuzzbees around, there were no problems with controlling spirit insects either.

The results of 165 years of experimentation were clear. Spirit-Storing Ginseng, Triple-Layer Leaf, Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi, and Origin-Returning Vine could all grow underground without issue.

On the other hand, Meridian-Piercing Flowers, the Clear Void Grass needed to obtain Clear Void Seeds, and the Essence-Condensing Trees that bore Essence-Condensing Fruit had ultimately failed to adapt to the underground spirit fields. Including the mineral spirit liquid, Spirit-Stabilizing Stone Milk, four ingredients still had to be purchased from cultivator markets.

Because of that, over the past few months Lee Hyun had altered his appearance and traveled between different cultivator markets, selling ten Bone-Rot Flower mother plants with medicine ages exceeding 220 years in separate transactions. In total, he had obtained sixteen hundred low-grade spirit stones.

When he returned to Nanya Market this time, he purchased thirty-five furnace batches' worth of Meridian-Piercing Flower, Essence-Condensing Fruit, Clear Void Seed, and Spirit-Stabilizing Stone Milk, allowing extra for failed alchemy attempts and the breakthrough itself. Even after 165 years, market prices had barely changed, and the purchase cost sixteen hundred and fifty low-grade spirit stones.

The low-grade spirit stones he had on hand fell from 670 to 620.

"Now it's time to harvest the other four ingredients in the pill recipe."

...

Lee Hyun returned to Spirit Field No. 2-1.

He dug up thirty-five Spirit-Storing Ginseng roots, then transplanted young seedlings he had raised in advance into the empty spots.

He also took out 315 Triple-Layer Leaf leaves, thirty-five Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi caps, and 105 nodes of Origin-Returning Vine that he had harvested and stored away in stages recently.

He divided the four harvested ingredients and the four ingredients bought at the cultivator market into portions for one furnace batch each, placed them into thirty-five medicine boxes, and stored them inside his storage pouch.

"Done."

Lee Hyun left the spirit fields and activated the Earth Escape Art, descending another ten li beneath Tunnel No. 2.

...

Twenty-five li underground.

A small, artificially carved cavern appeared between layers of solid bedrock. Waves of hot air flowed from within.

It was Tunnel No. 2's alchemy chamber.

A bronze pill furnace stood in the center of the cavern, with nine red formation stones embedded beneath it. The Nine-Fire Flame-Storing Formation was connected to an earth-fire vein running below the floor.

Lee Hyun took the thirty-five medicine boxes out of his storage pouch, opened them, and once again checked whether the medicinal ingredients inside matched the conditions recorded in the pill recipe.

"Let's do this."

Humm–

Primordial True Qi flowed into the Nine-Fire Flame-Storing Formation.

Whoomph!

Earth fire surged from the nine burners.

...

Two full days later.

The earth fire beneath the pill furnace slowly died away after the thirty-fifth alchemy attempt.

"Phew..."

Three kinds of jade bottles stood before him.

One high-grade Barrier-Breaking Pill.

Ten mid-grade Barrier-Breaking Pills.

Seventy-seven low-grade Barrier-Breaking Pills.

Eighty-eight pills in total.

Over the course of the thirty-five alchemy attempts, he had obtained only two pills per furnace batch at first. But as he learned through trial and error, his pill-refining success rate improved, and from the middle onward, some batches produced three pills or more.

'If my guess that I have around fifty times as much spiritual power as other people is right, eighty-eight pills should be enough for the breakthrough. Besides, I'm already at the very edge of Qi Refining Stage 3, so I should only need a small push.'

Lee Hyun cleaned up the pill furnace and cavern, then returned to the cultivation chamber in Tunnel No. 2.

He closed the stone door and lay down, resting until the focus drained by the alchemy had recovered.

Once his breathing grew calm and the Primordial True Qi throughout his body stabilized, he opened his eyes.

From then on, Lee Hyun began taking the Barrier-Breaking Pills one at a time and refining their medicinal strength. Since he would have to consume dozens in succession, he started with the high-grade and mid-grade pills, which contained fewer pill toxins.

...

Several days later.

He had absorbed all the medicinal strength from one high-grade pill, ten mid-grade pills, and thirty-nine low-grade pills, but the wall of his realm remained.

Lee Hyun took out another low-grade Barrier-Breaking Pill.

Gulp.

The instant the pill dissolved and its released medicinal strength mingled with the Primordial True Qi throughout his body...

Crack.

Along with the sensation of an invisible wall splitting open, the spiritual power throughout his body surged violently.

A moment later.

Boom!

A wave of spiritual power erupted from Lee Hyun's body and spread in every direction.

Whoooom–

At last, Lee Hyun opened his eyes.

"I did it!"

His voice could not conceal his joy.

Lee Hyun brought over the wooden tablet resting at one side of the cultivation chamber. As he performed inner inspection and contemplated his essence, qi and spirit, he revised the numbers on his handmade status screen.

【Age: 738】

【Realm: Qi Refining Stage 4】

【Spiritual Power: 206 → 233】

【Constitution: Primordial Body, 4th Stage】

The increase in his spiritual power might have looked small, but that was because the original value of 206 had not represented the midpoint of Qi Refining Stage 3. It had already been close to the limit of the stage.

His current value of 233 was still clearly more than fifty times the amount of spiritual power possessed by a cultivator who had just entered Qi Refining Stage 4.

Moreover, the spiritual power value on his handmade status screen had been converted based on how many times he could use the same technique. Since the quality of his spiritual power had changed along with his breakthrough, the increase in his actual combat strength could not be expressed by numbers alone.

'Come to think of it, I haven't updated the proficiency levels of my techniques in a long time either.'

【Techniques (Minor Attainment): Telekinesis Art, ...】

【Techniques (Major Attainment): Sword Control Art, Poison-Discerning Art, Wood Binding Art, Earth Spike Art, ...】

【Techniques (Perfection): Aura-Concealing Art, Fireball Art, Lightness Art, Distance-Shrinking Step, Spirit Rain Art, Soil-Turning Art, Yang Metal Art, Germination Art, Earth Escape Art, Qi Sphere Barrier, Spirit Light Shield, Aura-Reading Art, Night Vision Art, Ground-Sense Art, Keen Hearing Art, Cleansing Art, Air-Clearing Art, Breath-Sealing Art, Detoxification Art, Faint Light Art, ...】

Most of his basic techniques had reached a level of proficiency where there was hardly any room left for improvement.

'Listing every technique I've learned is starting to make this wooden tablet feel cramped. From now on, I probably don't need to record every basic technique.'

'Still, I didn't expect to have thirty-seven low-grade Barrier-Breaking Pills left over. I could make a decent amount selling these too....'

'Anyway... now all I need is time, and I can reach Qi Refining Stage 6!'

Chapter 30

After reaching Qi Refining Stage 4, Lee Hyun spent several days examining the changes in himself.

The training cavern in Tunnel No. 2.

Hummm―

Twenty Spirit Light Shields blossomed around him all at once.

With a movement of his fingers, the Spirit Light Shields overlapped and separated, shifting back and forth to form an ever-changing cube.

Next, he drew his iron sword, and the mysterious glow of Spirit Aura quietly enveloped the blade.

“I see...”

Once Lee Hyun had grown accustomed to his new strength, he immediately resumed cultivation.

...

Three days later.

Lee Hyun stopped circulating the Primordial One-Qi Art.

“...That's strange.”

The cultivation art was operating normally, but the upper limit of his spiritual power, which would once have increased little by little, had barely changed.

Perhaps his body simply needed time to adjust after the breakthrough. Lee Hyun rested from cultivation for several days to stabilize his body, then circulated the cultivation art again for fifteen days, but the result was the same.

“What's going on?”

No matter how many times he performed inner inspection, he found nothing wrong with his body. In fact, the condition of his essence, qi and spirit was better than ever.

To narrow down the cause, Lee Hyun tested the ‘recovery’ and ‘growth’ of his spiritual power separately.

He nearly exhausted his spiritual power using techniques, then circulated his cultivation art. Four shichen (eight hours) later, his spiritual power was full again.

“Recovery isn't the problem....”

The problem came afterward. When he tried to refine his full spiritual power further and raise its upper limit, almost none of the surrounding spiritual qi entered his body. No matter how much his realm had risen, it was strange for his cultivation to slow down this drastically.

...

Several days later.

Lee Hyun finally discovered the cause of the problem.

“I see. From mid Qi Refining onward, I need at least a Tier 1 mid grade spirit vein. If the ambient spiritual pressure is too low, I can recover my spiritual power, but I can't raise my realm.”

At his current pace, he could not even guess how long it would take to reach Qi Refining Stage 6.

It would be possible if he obtained a Qi-Gathering Formation, inserted spirit stones into it, and raised the spiritual pressure inside his cultivation chamber.

But Lee Hyun soon shook his head.

‘My spiritual power is fifty times greater than everyone else's. If I use a Qi-Gathering Formation, it'll probably consume dozens of times as many spirit stones too.’

Lee Hyun's greatest advantage in the first place was that he had plenty of time. There was no reason to spend dozens of times more spirit stones just to save that time.

“Hmm... What should I do? I don't exactly want to blindly join a sect just because it controls a good spirit vein...”

After pondering for a while, Lee Hyun moved to the lounge for a change of pace.

Thousands of books were piled haphazardly along one side of the room.

They were popular novels he had bought over the past 165 years whenever he traveled between cultivator markets and mortal cities.

《The South Sea Dragon King's Live-In Son-in-Law》

《My Grain Barge Can Submerge》

《The Salt Merchant's Concubine-Born Daughter Is Too Pretty》

《My Father-in-Law Was the Pirate King》

The Nanli Kingdom bordered the sea.

Perhaps because of that, popular novels here frequently featured merchant ships and grain barges, salt merchants and pirates, and sailors who vanished after encountering storms.

At first, he had enjoyed reading about unfamiliar customs, but after more than a hundred years, he had begun to notice how often the same stories repeated themselves.

The pirate chief's daughter always fell in love with a scholar hiding his identity, and every merchant ship caught in a storm somehow discovered royalty from a fallen kingdom. The South Sea Dragon King had far too many sons-in-law.

“Ah... There's nothing to read. What are authors these days even doing...?”

He rummaged through the books and picked up one novel.

《Ten Years Beneath a Great Salt Merchant's Wall》.

It was the story of a poor scholar in the Nanli Kingdom who built a shack against the wall of a great salt merchant's estate and lived there. The protagonist survived the winters on heat seeping over from the kitchen and grew a small vegetable patch with water flowing from a drain beneath the wall.

Lee Hyun flipped through a few pages.

「Pressing your back against a rich man's wall would keep you warm even in the depths of winter.」

His finger stopped as he was about to turn the next page.

“...Wait.”

He looked again at the sentence he had just read.

‘Could the same apply to spirit veins?’

Just because a cultivation clan controlled a spirit vein did not mean the heaven-and-earth spiritual qi stopped dead at the clan's walls.

Even without entering the core of the spirit vein, if he approached close enough, he should be able to make use of at least some of the qi spilling outward.

‘I'd be discovered if I approached aboveground, but underground...’

What if he slowly approached from deep underground, found a safe distance, and made a small cultivation chamber there?

‘It's not like I'd be stealing a cultivation clan's spirit plants or spirit beasts. Wouldn't it be fine to share a little of nature's qi? Well, I suppose they'd see it differently if they caught me...’

Lee Hyun immediately took out 《Brief Guide to Cultivation in Southern Lan Kingdom》 and a map of the surrounding region.

There were several Foundation Establishment cultivation clans controlling Tier 2 spirit veins in southern Nanli Kingdom, and many of them were based on islands in the archipelago off the Nanli coast.

‘Islands are inconvenient to travel to and from, and it'd be difficult to escape if something happened. Unlike the Earth Escape Art, I've never learned the Water Escape Art...’

Lee Hyun eliminated the island factions and narrowed his choices down to clans based on the mainland.

Of those, the closest to Tunnel No. 2 was...

The Yin clan of Qingluo Mountain. It controlled the Tier 2 low grade Qingluo Spirit Vein, and the guide stated that its clan head was a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

“Maybe I'll try leaning against a rich man's wall.”

...

Fifteen days later.

Southern Nanli Kingdom, Qingluo Mountain.

Qingluo Mountain was a low, gently sloping mountain situated inland from the coast.

It was said to have been named for the long curve of its ridge toward the sea, which resembled a blue conch shell.

The Yin clan's estate stood halfway up the mountain.

Blue-tiled halls and cultivation cave abodes lined the slopes, while below them, spirit fields spanning hundreds of mu (1 mu is about 666.6 square meters) spread out like terraces.

...

Ten li (about 3.9 km) underground.

Rustle―

Lee Hyun's body moved silently through soil and bedrock.

He had entered the earth dozens of li from Qingluo Mountain and cautiously approached while maintaining both the Spirit-Concealing Art and Aura-Concealing Art.

The heaven-and-earth spiritual qi was certainly somewhat denser than in Tunnel No. 2, but the difference was not nearly as great as he had expected.

‘Am I still too shallow?’

Moving along the outskirts of Qingluo Mountain, he descended to twenty-five li underground, where the common soil stratum met the earth-vein stratum.

He could sense the flow of an earth vein between the layers of bedrock, but its qi was heavy and turbid, and not particularly dense.

“Strange.”

Lee Hyun changed direction and ascended.

Then the qi changed.

At ten li underground, the Five Elements gradually began to balance. At five li, the density of the spiritual qi noticeably increased.

By the time he reached three li underground, the earth qi and water qi of the earth vein had mixed with wood qi and wind qi from the surface. He could even faintly sense the sea breeze and the life force of the vegetation covering Qingluo Mountain.

Only then did Lee Hyun realize that he had misunderstood spirit veins.

‘A spirit vein isn't like an ore vein buried underground.’

An earth vein was only one component of a spirit vein. A spirit vein seemed to form only when earth veins and water veins, the terrain and vegetation, and the qi of the surface and sky all interlocked and circulated together. Perhaps the Yin clan's estate and spirit fields were themselves part of what maintained that circulation.

‘So controlling a spirit vein means controlling the center of a completed flow.’

‘Come to think of it, if earth veins alone formed spirit veins, every cultivator would've started by digging tunnels. But most great sects are actually situated on high mountains.’

By the time Lee Hyun finished organizing his thoughts, he had ascended to two li underground.

He was not directly beneath the Yin clan estate, but roughly two li away horizontally as well.

The spiritual qi was so dense that it could hardly be compared with Tunnel No. 2.

Lee Hyun circulated his cultivation art ever so slightly.

Ssssss―

The surrounding spiritual qi flowed into him through his skin.

His already-full Primordial True Qi compressed ever so slightly, and new spiritual qi entered the space it created.

Lee Hyun's eyes brightened.

‘Is this the kind of spiritual pressure you'd find near a Tier 1 mid grade spirit vein? Cultivation should go well here!’

A change that had been difficult to feel even after circulating his cultivation art for fifteen days in Tunnel No. 2 occurred in mere moments.

The spiritual qi would become even denser if he moved closer, but Lee Hyun stopped there. Even if the strata interfered with divine sense, approaching any farther would be dangerous when he did not know the detection range of a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

‘I should find somewhere nearby where I can stay for long periods.’

Lee Hyun's divine sense spread through the soil and rock. Before long, he detected a fairly spacious natural cavern nearby.

“Perfect.”

Lee Hyun used the Earth Escape Art and headed toward the cavern.

Rustle―

The instant Lee Hyun fully entered, a fluctuation of spiritual power erupted from one corner of the cavern.

Lee Hyun immediately deployed his Spirit Light Shields. At the same time, a yellow protective barrier blossomed in front of the opposite rock wall.

In the dim light stood a somewhat thin man who appeared to be in his late forties, holding a small bronze bell.

‘Qi Refining Stage 3?’

The man's face had gone deathly pale.

Lee Hyun was only revealing the aura of an ordinary Qi Refining Stage 4 cultivator, but apparently that alone was enough to threaten the man.

[Wait! Don't attack! I'm not from the Yin clan!]

[Then who are you? Why are you in a place like this?]

[That's what I want to ask. This place is my....]

The man stopped speaking.

His gaze swept over Lee Hyun.

[Fellow Daoist, aren't you a fellow practitioner of the Qutian Society?]

[Qutian Society?]

The man seemed to realize that he had slipped up and shut his mouth.

Lee Hyun asked,

[What is that?]

[Nothing.]

[You clearly said Qutian Society just now.]

[You misheard me.]

[We're speaking through voice transmission.]

The man's expression turned awkward.

After hesitating for a moment, he withdrew his protective barrier.

He still held the bronze bell, but he did not seem inclined to attack first.

[Are you a rogue cultivator, fellow Daoist?]

[I am.]

[So am I. I have nothing to do with the Yin clan.]

[What were you doing here?]

[Probably the same thing as you.]

[How do you know what I came here to do?]

The man pointed toward one of the cavern's rock walls.

[Didn't you follow the spiritual qi here? This is where qi leaking from the Qingluo Mountain spirit vein gets blocked by the rock wall and pools for a while. It's a good place to cultivate without being discovered by the Yin clan. If you had some other purpose, there'd be no reason for you to find this exact cavern.]

The man was right.

Lee Hyun surveyed the surroundings again.

Four small stone pillars had been embedded at regular intervals near the cavern walls. He could also see formation inscriptions concealed beneath a thin coating of dirt.

One section of the floor had been polished smooth, as though someone had sat there for a long time.

[So you were using this place first.]

[That's right. This vein seat was assigned to me for this month.]

[Vein seat?]

[That's what we call our cultivation spots.]

The man studied Lee Hyun for a moment, then sighed.

[Now that you've already discovered this place, there's nothing to be done.]

[Are you planning to settle it with a fight?]

[What exactly do you expect me to settle by fighting you?]

The man pointed at himself.

[I hate fighting. I'm not confident in it either.]

[Then what do you suggest?]

[For now, you can't cultivate here today.]

[Why not?]

[Starting at the Hour of the Dragon (approximately 7–9 a.m.) tomorrow, the Yin clan will activate its detection formation.]

Lee Hyun's gaze sharpened.

[Detection formation?]

[A formation that sweeps the underground area around the spirit vein. It'll be active for several shichen starting from the Hour of the Dragon tomorrow.]

[How do you know that?]

[There's a place where we share that sort of information.]

He was clearly talking about the Qutian Society.

[Will this cavern be discovered once the formation activates?]

[If you circulate your cultivation art here, you'll almost certainly be caught.]

The man walked to a corner of the cavern and pulled out the stone pillars.

Apparently, he had come to dismantle the formation.

[You can find out things like that too?]

[We didn't know from the beginning either.]

The man answered as he placed one of the stone pillars into his storage pouch.

[We learned because people were caught, killed, or taken prisoner.]

Lee Hyun fell silent for a moment.

[It looks like this is your first time approaching the Yin clan's spirit vein.]

[That's right.]

[You were lucky. If I hadn't come here today, you might have been dragged out by Yin clan cultivators tomorrow.]

After hesitating for a moment, the man took a black wooden token from inside his clothes.

There were no characters carved into it.

[Come to Baipu Market three days from now at the Hour of the Horse (approximately 11 a.m.–1 p.m.). There's an old shop called Gumu Studio in the northeastern corner. Show this to the clerk.]

Lee Hyun did not immediately accept the token.

[What's there?]

[What you want to know.]

[The Qutian Society?]

The man nodded.

[It's a gathering created so rogue cultivators without spirit veins, like us, can help one another. You can decide whether to join after hearing us out. No one's going to force you into anything.]

[Why are you helping me? We only met today.]

The man was silent for a moment.

[Because you remind me of myself when I first came here. I also liked that even though your realm is higher than mine, you didn't immediately attack me or try to seize the spot. More importantly, if you wander around knowing nothing, you'll eventually run into another member. It's better to tell you the rules and share the place.]

Lee Hyun accepted the wooden token. He examined it, but sensed no unusual spiritual power or markings.

[What's your name, fellow Daoist?]

[In the Qutian Society, we don't ask for real names.]

The man entered a narrow passage hidden along one side of the cavern.

[Then I'll see you in three days. And from the Hour of the Dragon until the Hour of the Horse tomorrow, don't circulate a cultivation art beneath Qingluo Mountain. If you're wondering whether I'm lying, you can watch from a distance.]

A short while later, the man's presence faded into the distance.

Left alone, Lee Hyun stared at the black wooden token.

“The Qutian Society....”

...

The next day, at the Hour of the Dragon.

Lee Hyun hid on a peak more than ten li from Qingluo Mountain and used the Aura-Reading Art.

Hummmm―

A short while later, a massive wave spread outward from Qingluo Mountain. It swept through the soil and bedrock like an invisible net.

On the surface of Qingluo Mountain, several cultivators moved along the flow of the formation.

‘He wasn't lying.’

...

Two days later.

Southern Nanli Kingdom, Baipu Market.

Baipu Market was a small cultivator market located more than three thousand li northeast of Nanya Market.

It did not attract nearly as many cultivators as Nanya Market. There were only a few dozen shops and stalls in total, and most of the goods traded there were of fairly low quality.

Lee Hyun had visited a few times in the past.

Decent goods were rare, so he had hardly visited in recent years.

Lee Hyun arrived half a day before the agreed time. He changed his face with the Seven-Aspect Disguise Method and circulated the Spirit-Concealing Art and Aura-Concealing Art, making several circuits of the market to confirm that no one was following him.

After examining the inside and outside of Gumu Studio, he even swept the underground area with his divine sense. There was one late Qi Refining cultivator and the man he had met several days earlier in an underground stone chamber, but he found no other ambushes or dangerous formations.

Baipu Market also had cultivators responsible for maintaining order. Even if this was a trap, the forces inside Gumu Studio alone would have difficulty threatening him.

When the appointed time arrived, Lee Hyun entered Gumu Studio.

Faded formation flags and fragments of magic tools that had nearly lost all their spiritual qi were displayed inside the shop.

A clerk approached.

“Are you looking for something?”

Lee Hyun held out the black wooden token. The clerk checked it once, then nodded.

“They're waiting for you inside.”

The clerk led Lee Hyun to a storeroom at the back of the shop.

When the floorboards were moved aside, a narrow staircase leading downward appeared.

...

An underground stone chamber.

Only two small oil lamps burned on the walls.

Beyond a table in the center of the chamber sat a figure wearing a brown cicada mask.

Narrow slits had been cut for the mask's eyes, while patterns resembling cicada wings were carved across its forehead and cheeks.

The figure gave off an aura that seemed to be around Qi Refining Stage 7.

Standing to one side of the chamber was a man wearing a gray field-mouse mask.

It was the man Lee Hyun had met in the underground cavern beneath Qingluo Mountain several days earlier.

The man in the field-mouse mask bowed his head to Lee Hyun.

“We meet again.”

Lee Hyun gave a slight nod in return.

The figure in the cicada mask spoke from across the table.

“Sit.”

Once Lee Hyun sat down, the cultivator in the cicada mask took out a small stone plate, fitted a low-grade spirit stone into a groove, and touched a formation inscription.

Hummm―

The Sound-Isolating Formation carved into the chamber walls activated.

The sounds outside instantly receded, while sounds from within the chamber could no longer leak out.

“I am Cicada Shell, society head of the Qutian Society. It isn't my real name, so just call me that.”

The cultivator in the cicada mask continued.

“The fellow practitioner beside me is called Gray Mouse. In the Qutian Society, we do not ask about one another's faces, names, or origins.”

The cultivator in the field-mouse mask clasped his hands.

“Gray Mouse.”

Lee Hyun clasped his hands as well.

“I don't have a name yet.”

“You'll choose one together with a mask after you join.”

Cicada Shell studied Lee Hyun for a moment.

“Qi Refining Stage 4. Breaking through a minor realm couldn't have been easy for a rogue cultivator. You've done well to advance.”

“I was lucky.”

“May I ask why you want to join the Qutian Society?”

“I haven't decided that I will join yet.”

“Haha. There's nothing wrong with being cautious. In that case, I should first explain what kind of organization the Qutian Society is.”

Cicada Shell took a rolled leather map from beneath the table.

When they spread it open, it showed the coastline and mountain ranges of southern Nanli Kingdom, along with the territories of several cultivation clans.

Dozens of dots and lines were marked on the map in addition to the place names Lee Hyun already knew.

Several dots had also been marked around the Yin clan of Qingluo Mountain.

“There are seven Foundation Establishment clans in southern Nanli Kingdom that control Tier 2 spirit veins. There are even more Qi Refining clans and factions with smaller Tier 1 spirit veins.”

Cicada Shell pointed to Qingluo Mountain on the map.

“The core of a spirit vein and its spirit nexus all belong to them. But as you saw at Qingluo Mountain, fellow Daoist, they cannot confine every branch and every trace of qi that spills outward within their walls.”

“So the Qutian Society is a group that secretly makes use of that?”

“That's right. We find places where qi that spills outward gathers and share them safely. Of course, cultivation clans call us thieves or vermin. They often call us vein vermin as well.”

Gray Mouse grumbled quietly.

“As if they created the heaven-and-earth spiritual qi themselves.”

Cicada Shell stopped Gray Mouse and continued.

“Still, there are lines we must not cross. Approaching the core of a spirit vein or interfering with a clan's formations and spirit fields is forbidden. We only use qi that flows beyond the clan's territory.”

“I doubt the cultivation clans acknowledge that distinction.”

“Of course they don't.”

Cicada Shell laughed.

“That's why we mustn't get caught.”

They pointed to the dots on the map one by one.

“The dots on this map are residual-vein pockets we've confirmed. They're places where branches of spirit veins pass through, or where spiritual qi flowing outward is blocked by the terrain and gathers. We call the good cultivation spots within them vein seats.”

“So the cavern I found at Qingluo Mountain was one of them.”

“Qingluo Vein Seat No. 3. It has a good location and a decent balance of spiritual qi, but it becomes dangerous when the Yin clan activates its detection formation.”

“Why don't they keep the formation active at all times?”

“Very few factions keep formations deployed constantly. Maintaining them continuously consumes an enormous number of spirit stones.”

Cicada Shell opened a small ledger beside the map. It was densely filled with dates, times, and clan names.

“The Yin clan usually activates its detection formation once every three months. The date sometimes changes, however, depending on things like the spirit-field harvest or visits from outsiders.”

“How do you obtain that information?”

“We buy information from mortals who work for the clans and merchants who supply formation materials, and sometimes we observe the formation's fluctuations ourselves. We've accumulated records like this for decades. Information like this is the Qutian Society's real capital.”

Cicada Shell pointed to the entry beside Qingluo Mountain.

「Yin clan.

Earth-Scanning Spirit-Detecting Formation.

Normally activated once every three months.

Operating period approximately from the Hour of the Dragon until the Hour of the Horse.

Detects spiritual-power fluctuations and traces of spiritual qi consumption up to three li underground.

Vacate Qingluo Vein Seat No. 1 and Qingluo Vein Seat No. 2 before activation.

For Qingluo Vein Seat No. 3, move behind the black iron ore layer fifty zhang (about 165 m) to the east. Cultivation art use prohibited.

Qingluo Vein Seat No. 4 can remain concealed in place because the flow of the lower water vein counteracts the formation.」

“What do you mean by counteracts the formation?”

“A detection formation is ultimately still a technique deployed using a formation plate and formation flags. It can be obscured by strata rich in metal qi or by the flows of water veins and earth veins. Different formations also detect different things. No single formation can observe everything.”

Lee Hyun looked again at the map and ledger.

“I suppose coordinating the members so their vein-seat usage doesn't overlap is also part of the Qutian Society's role.”

“That's right. If several cultivators absorb spiritual qi from the same residual-vein pocket at once, the flow becomes unstable and the clan is more likely to notice something unusual. So we assign each vein seat a user and a period of use, and we also regulate the total amount of spiritual qi absorbed from each residual-vein pocket. Qingluo Vein Seat No. 3 was assigned to fellow Daoist Gray Mouse this month.”

Gray Mouse nodded.

“You have no idea how startled I was when you suddenly appeared, fellow Daoist. You'd been wandering underground alone and somehow found that exact cavern. I thought you were a mole demon beast.”

Cicada Shell asked,

“Are you skilled with the Earth Escape Art?”

“I've merely used it for a long time.”

“You're exactly the sort of talent our Qutian Society needs. Will you become a member?”

“I'll decide after hearing all the rules and costs.”

Cicada Shell seemed pleased rather than offended and nodded.

“It's simple. The Qutian Society cannot protect its members. Our information may be wrong, or a clan's circumstances may suddenly change. Even if you're discovered and killed while cultivating in a residual-vein pocket, there will be no one you can hold responsible.”

“Naturally.”

“Those who shift danger onto other members, monopolize vein seats, or deliberately lure clan cultivators toward us are expelled. If the offense is severe, we may even hunt them down and kill them. The same applies to anyone who pries into another member's identity or sells Qutian Society information to outsiders. Maps and ledgers of residual-vein pockets may not be taken outside. Members are only told about the vein seat assigned to them and how to use it. That way, even if one person is captured, the entire Qutian Society will not be exposed.”

Cicada Shell placed both hands on the table.

“The Heavenly Dao takes from what has excess and makes up what is lacking. Cultivation clans have spirit veins with qi to spare, while we rogue cultivators lack it. We merely take a little of the qi that would otherwise disperse into heaven and earth.”

“What is required to join?”

“Thirty low-grade spirit stones as an entrance fee. After that, ten low-grade spirit stones every ten years as membership dues. The dues are used to obtain the latest information.”

‘That's not bad...?’

Lee Hyun was about to take spirit stones from his storage pouch when his hand stopped.

‘Thirty low-grade spirit stones... This works out perfectly.’

Instead, he took out a small jade bottle.

Tap.

The jade bottle landed on the table.

Cicada Shell and Gray Mouse both looked toward it.

“Would you accept this for the entrance fee instead of spirit stones?”

“What is it?”

“A pill.”

Lee Hyun opened the jade bottle and took out a Barrier-Breaking Pill.

“It's used when advancing from Qi Refining Stage 3 to Stage 4.”

“What?”

Gray Mouse raised his voice without realizing it.

Cicada Shell took the pill and examined it carefully. They placed it on their palm to inspect its color and sheen, then brought it close to their nose to smell its medicinal fragrance. They even extended their divine sense in an extremely fine thread to inspect the pill's interior.

After a long while, Cicada Shell spoke with a cautious expression.

“I've never seen this pill before, but a considerable amount of medicinal strength has been condensed within it. What is the pill called?”

“That's a secret.”

Cicada Shell looked back and forth between the pill and Lee Hyun before finally nodding.

“If its effects are as you say, it's certainly worth thirty low-grade spirit stones. Very well. From this moment onward, fellow Daoist, you are also a member of the Qutian Society.”

Cicada Shell walked toward the stone chamber wall.

Masks of various sizes hung there.

There were masks resembling a red fox, a black turtle, a white goat, and even a one-eyed bird. Most showed signs of long use, while several had gathered dust.

Cicada Shell took down a mask hanging in the farthest corner.

It had a broad, round face with short ears. Black markings surrounded the eyes, while the muzzle was long and white.

“It seems we have a mask without an owner.”

Lee Hyun accepted the mask.

“From now on, fellow Daoist, you are Badger.”

Lee Hyun stared at the badger mask for a moment before putting it on.

“Welcome to the Qutian Society, our new fellow practitioner, fellow Daoist Badger.”

Gray Mouse also clasped his hands.

“I look forward to working with you, fellow Daoist Badger.”

“Likewise. Fellow Daoist Gray Mouse, fellow Daoist Cicada Shell.”

350 years later.

Southern Nanli Kingdom, Baipu Market.

An old shop called Gumu Studio stood in the northeastern corner.

Creak.

A cultivator dressed in black robes and wearing a badger mask entered Gumu Studio.

His aura had reached the very limit of Qi Refining Stage 5.

He removed the innermost plank in the storeroom and descended the stairs.

Several branching passages stretched out below. He familiarly chose one and headed toward the bedrock at its end. When he stopped before it, the wall rotated, revealing a stone chamber.

The moment he stepped inside, the dozen or so masked cultivators gathered within all rose to their feet at once.

“Greetings, Society Head!”

Chapter 31

“Sit.”

At Lee Hyun’s brief command, the members straightened their backs again and perched on the various large and small boxes scattered around the room.

Cicada Shell had reached the end of his lifespan long ago, and Gray Mouse had passed away even before him. Over the past 350 years, each seat in the meeting room had changed hands an average of six or seven times.

Some masks had found new owners, while others remained on the walls of the meeting room, never to be used again.

The Badger mask, however, had appeared without interruption in ledgers dating back more than 300 years, all the way to the present. Because of this, even the current members did not know whether Badger was a single person or a position passed down from one generation to the next.

Some members believed that the position of society head was passed down together with its cultivation art and techniques, while others suspected that Badger had mastered some strange secret art for extending his lifespan.

But under the rules of the Qutian Society, no one asked about another member’s identity. Some were curious, but none voiced that curiosity aloud.

Lee Hyun received reports in turn on changes in spiritual pressure observed at vein seats throughout the region, the movements of cultivation clans operating detection formations to locate rogue cultivators, and the assignment of newly joined members.

The member wearing a white otter mask opened a ledger and finished the final report. Lee Hyun nodded.

“Good. Make sure the new members are properly instructed.”

“Understood.”

Once all the reports were finished, one member placed a booklet on the table.

“This is the manual for the Water Escape Art you requested.”

“Mm, good.”

Lee Hyun accepted the booklet and quickly skimmed through it.

‘Hmm... Nothing here is outside my expectations. There’s no need to research it any further.’

Over the years, he had acquired several Water Escape Art technique manuals and cross-checked them against one another. Unlike technique manuals maintained by sects, those circulating on the open market could not be trusted.

Even so, after spending many years extracting the portions common to multiple versions and comparing them against the results of actual use, he had grasped the true principles of the Water Escape Art and reached Perfection.

He had learned the Soil-Softening Art in much the same way.

Thanks to that, his Reclining Escape Art had advanced another step as well.

Lee Hyun’s current Reclining Escape Art had become a bizarre escape art that fused the principles of the Earth Escape Art, Water Escape Art, Soil-Turning Art, Soil-Softening Art, Distance-Shrinking Step, Qi Sphere Barrier, and more. It no longer mattered whether he was on land or at sea.

Lee Hyun slipped the booklet into his storage pouch and said,

“I’ll award you fifty contribution points.”

“Thank you.”

Once the member who had brought the technique manual withdrew, a member wearing a monkey mask held out a long sword case with both hands.

“The magic tool you commissioned has been completed.”

Lee Hyun opened the sword case.

Inside lay a long sword with a black sheen. Its blade was slightly broader and thicker than an ordinary long sword’s, but it was not as crude as the Earth Shovel Sword.

“This is the Mountain-Suppressing Sword, a masterpiece at the very pinnacle of mid-grade magic tools. It was crafted to meet every condition you requested.”

The Mountain-Suppressing Sword contained no restrictions designed to assist the Sword Control Art.

Instead, several layers of the Adamantine Form-Fixing Restriction had been engraved into it to reinforce the blade’s shape and durability.

In particular, its primary material, Spirit-Conducting Mystic Iron, was a Tier-1 supreme-grade spirit material that resisted warping even when an enormous amount of spiritual power surged through it all at once.

Thanks to this, although the Mountain-Suppressing Sword was a mid-grade magic tool, when wielded directly in the hand, its performance approached that of a high-grade magic tool.

Lee Hyun accepted the Mountain-Suppressing Sword and gave it a light swing.

Whoosh.

A mysterious glow then quietly enveloped the blade.

Hummmm–

“Ooh....”

The members’ admiration was tinged with tension. Although the sword was not pointed at anyone, several long-standing members reflexively lifted themselves off their boxes, bowed their heads, and clasped their hands together.

At that moment, a late Qi Refining cultivator wearing a black wildcat mask, who had joined the Qutian Society only recently, hurriedly copied the others without knowing why. Still looking puzzled, he sent a voice transmission to the member beside him.

[What’s so impressive about that? Doesn’t everyone have at least one mid-grade magic tool? Most of the fellow Daoists here seem to be late Qi Refining cultivators... while the society head appears to be only at Qi Refining Stage 5.]

[Don’t say things like that so carelessly! You only think that because you’ve never seen that Badger fight.]

[He’s that formidable...?]

[Take my advice. Don’t cross the Mad Badger.]

The cultivator in the black wildcat mask still looked doubtful, but obediently lowered his head.

Lee Hyun returned the Mountain-Suppressing Sword to its case.

“Good. To produce a magic tool of this caliber... that mysterious artifact refiner who deals exclusively with you certainly knows his craft.”

“You flatter me.”

“Pay for the magic tool from the spirit stones I left with you in advance. As compensation for arranging the deal, I’ll give you fifteen low-grade spirit stones and thirty Qutian Society contribution points.”

“Thank you!”

Over the years, Lee Hyun had continuously sought ways to increase the density and strength of his Spirit Aura while studying martial arts manuals left behind by Profound Realm masters.
