Compared to the Qi-Controlled Sword Art spoken of by martial artists, or the Sword Control Art cultivators used to manipulate swords from a distance, he felt somewhat more secure fighting with a weapon held directly in his hand.

This was partly because Lee Hyun had experienced far more battles in which he fought defensively against those attacking him than battles in which he pursued someone with the intent to kill.

He was not the type to nurse a grudge and hunt someone down to the bitter end.

After long years of research, Lee Hyun had come to realize that the most important requirement for a close-combat weapon was that it not break when colliding with an enemy’s weapon or defensive magic tool.

If a magic tool shattered at a critical moment, it could create an unexpected opening and cost its user their life. If that was the risk, it would be better not to use a magic tool at all.

In fact, while experimenting with compressing his Spirit Aura to an extreme degree, he had once caused a low-grade magic tool to burst apart.

That was why Lee Hyun had abandoned the Sword Control Art restriction and commissioned the Mountain-Suppressing Sword, devoting all the freed capacity to strength, durability, and spiritual-power conductivity.

...

After finishing all his work for the Qutian Society, Lee Hyun left Baipu Market.

He changed his appearance several times and confirmed that no one was following him before heading toward the vein seat with the highest spiritual pressure among those managed by the Qutian Society.

...

Southern Nanli Kingdom, Qianhe Valley.

Qianhe Valley was a unique region where a river flowing across the surface vanished underground midway through the valley. The Tan clan, a Foundation Establishment cultivation clan that controlled the Tier-2 mid-grade Qianhe Spirit Vein, was based there.

At a point fifteen li (about 5.9 km) from Qianhe Valley, Lee Hyun entered the earth and descended with the Earth Escape Art until he reached an underground water vein.

Swoosh–

Lee Hyun’s body slipped into the underground waterway as though becoming one with the current. As his long black robe fluttered in the water, something resembling chainmail beneath it was revealed.

The armor that smoothly covered him from below his neck to his wrists and ankles was a mid-grade defensive magic tool known as the Force-Dispersing Inner Armor.

Woven primarily from spirit-metal thread, a Tier-1 supreme-grade spirit material, the inner armor was flexible due to its chain-like construction, but the material itself was exceedingly hard.

The Force-Dispersing Restriction engraved into the inner armor could disperse an impact concentrated in one place throughout the wearer’s entire body by channeling it through the woven threads and restriction.

Lee Hyun had acquired this Force-Dispersing Inner Armor thirty years earlier from a Qutian Society member in exchange for a fair price.

...

After traveling upstream through the underground river for quite some time, he reached a small natural cavern that rose above the water. This was where Qianhe Vein Seat No. 1 of the Qutian Society was located.

Four small stone pillars bearing the Qutian Society’s mark were hidden inside the cavern. When Lee Hyun inserted a low-grade spirit stone between the pillars, a simple concealment formation activated.

The spiritual-power fluctuations leaking from the cavern blended into the flow of the groundwater and disappeared.

After checking his surroundings repeatedly, Lee Hyun lay comfortably on the bedrock and circulated the Primordial One-Qi Art.

Ssssss–

Dense spiritual qi flowed into his entire body.

His Primordial True Qi, already refined to the absolute limit of Qi Refining Stage 5, absorbed the newly entering spiritual qi and gradually condensed further.

...

Two days later.

The sound of the groundwater flowing outside the cavern suddenly seemed to recede into the distance.

With Lee Hyun at the center, the surrounding spiritual pressure appeared to collapse inward.

Thoom.

The entire rock-walled cavern vibrated with a low rumble, and Lee Hyun opened his eyes.

‘Finally!’

Lee Hyun had broken through to Qi Refining Stage 6!

He stared at his hand, then swiftly clenched it into a fist.

Pop.

The air between his fingers compressed and burst outward.

...

Lee Hyun circulated his cultivation art for a full day to stabilize his new realm. Afterward, he took out a wooden board and updated his handmade status screen.

【Age: 1,088】

【Realm: Qi Refining Stage 6】

【Spiritual Power: 233 → 517】

【Constitution: Primordial Body, 6th Stage】

【Techniques (Perfection): Water Escape Art, Soil-Softening Art, Azure Steel Sword Art, Sword Control Art, Telekinesis Art, Poison-Discerning Art, ...】

‘By sheer quantity alone, I think I have more than ten times the spiritual power of a cultivator at Qi Refining Great Perfection...’

Lee Hyun felt that if he faced a single early Foundation Establishment cultivator head-on, he would have a chance of winning.

...

Lee Hyun returned to Tunnel No. 2.

With 350 years having passed, the composition of the spirit fields had changed considerably.

Spirit Fields No. 2-1 through No. 2-5 had all been converted into Spirit-Storing Ginseng plots. He had stopped cultivating the Triple-Layer Leaf, Meridian-Protecting Lingzhi, and Origin-Returning Vine that had once occupied Spirit Fields No. 2-3 through No. 2-5.

The reason was that the medicinal potency of the leaves, caps, and stem nodes produced by those three spirit plants did not increase even as the medicine age of their mother plants rose.

Once they were old enough to be used in Barrier-Breaking Pills, there was no benefit in keeping them any longer.

Even so, Lee Hyun had spent a long time periodically replanting and harvesting all three varieties so he could continue selling Barrier-Breaking Pills.

But ninety years ago, he had grown tired of harvesting and storing the eight ingredients at their proper medicine ages, separately procuring Spirit-Stabilizing Stone Milk, and obtaining whatever other medicinal ingredients he still lacked.

In the end, he stopped refining and selling Barrier-Breaking Pills altogether and converted all five spirit fields to Spirit-Storing Ginseng.

Once he stopped, he felt liberated. The spirit stones he earned from selling Barrier-Breaking Pills were no longer enough to justify all that effort.

Even without selling off most of his aged spirit plants, Lee Hyun had become incomparably wealthier than before.

The commissions he received for brokering trades between Qutian Society members, the payments for requests he personally carried out, and the proceeds from occasionally selling pills had accumulated over time. Before he knew it, he possessed thirty mid-grade spirit stones and two thousand low-grade spirit stones.

Although the Qutian Society’s membership dues and communal assets were used solely to operate the organization, the passage of so much time had naturally allowed his personal fortune to accumulate.

He had already disposed of the seven storage pouches and spirit-insect pouch he once used.

Lee Hyun now carried only three storage pouches at his waist. Each one had more internal space than all seven of his former storage pouches combined and was no worse than the sort used by an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator.

He had likewise replaced his spirit-insect pouch with a better one capable of holding several thousand fuzzbees.

There was a reason he had kept the Spirit-Storing Ginseng among the ingredients for the Barrier-Breaking Pill. Spirit-Storing Ginseng was a spirit plant whose value reliably increased with its medicine age.

After the spirit plants he had brought from Qinghe Valley, it had a good chance of becoming another major asset for Lee Hyun.

At present, the five Spirit Fields No. 2 contained 552 Spirit-Storing Ginseng roots with a medicine age of 172 years and 916 roots with a medicine age of thirty years.

The Spirit Fields No. 1 were also being managed well.

Spirit Field No. 1-1, the oldest of them, contained 101 Bone-Rot Flower plants, 283 clumps of Yin Soul Grass, 73 Purple Poison Orchid bulbs, and 52 Earth Vein Flower plants, all with an average medicine age of 341 years.

Spirit Fields No. 1-2 through No. 1-5 still contained 433 Bone-Rot Flower plants, 1,105 clumps of Yin Soul Grass, 293 Purple Poison Orchid bulbs, and 205 Earth Vein Flower plants with an average medicine age of 307 years.

The Yin Water Lotuses in Spirit Field No. 1-6 and the Stone Honey Peaches in Spirit Field No. 1-7 had reached a medicine age of 287 years. Lee Hyun had yet to find the relevant pill recipes, but he enjoyed eating the lotus seeds and Stone Honey Peaches, and both spirit plants also attracted spirit insects that served as food for the fuzzbees.

...

Buzz, buzz, buzz–

As Lee Hyun walked between the spirit fields, fuzzbees flew over to him.

Their population had grown dramatically over the years as well, reaching several hundred.

One fuzzbee landed on Lee Hyun’s shoulder, while another fellow flung itself onto a patch of dry soil at the edge of a spirit field.

The fuzzbee lay on its back and kicked its short legs in the air. It wriggled from side to side, shaking the slime and dust caught in its golden fur loose.

Another fuzzbee beside it promptly threw itself onto the dirt as well.

Roll, roll.

The two fellows bumped into each other and rolled around together for a moment before getting back up as though nothing had happened.

“Do you really like that so much?”

Chirp.

As if in reply, one fuzzbee raised its antennae and promptly pooped.

Lee Hyun flicked a finger. The tiny dropping crumbled into powder before catching fire and disappearing.

After their numbers increased, Lee Hyun began keeping some of them separately inside his spirit-insect pouch. He also connected natural fissures and caverns outside the spirit fields to create a separate hunting burrow. The fuzzbees preyed there on naturally reproducing spirit insects and their eggs.

He always kept a number of docile individuals inside the spirit-insect pouch so that even if something unexpected happened, he would still be able to establish a new colony.

...

A few days later.

After fully bonding the newly acquired Mountain-Suppressing Sword and making it his own, Lee Hyun emerged into a quiet valley on the surface.

He first took the opening stance of One Ultimate, Six Swords.

Flash!

A slender streak of sword light pierced the cliff face opposite him.

Without lowering his sword, Lee Hyun changed his stance.

After Square-Inch Step and One Ultimate, Six Swords, there was another supreme art Lee Hyun had studied recently.

《Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art》.

It was a saber art left behind long ago by Lu Zhi, a man from Qianyang Kingdom who had reached the Profound Realm.

In his youth, Lu Zhi had been a stonecutter working in a vast quarry. After countless repetitions of splitting rocks into two smooth faces, he had grasped a certain principle, and later generations came to call the martial art he left behind the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art.

Though it had originally been a saber art, its essence did not lie in the shape of the blade, but in cleaving a boundary along a single line. The broad and heavy Mountain-Suppressing Sword was more than sufficient to perform it.

Lee Hyun had learned this supreme art because he lacked a method corresponding to a line.

For a plane, he had the Spirit Light Shield and Qi Sphere Barrier. For a point, he had One Ultimate, Six Swords. Wanting a method corresponding to a line, he had learned the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art.

Lee Hyun raised the Mountain-Suppressing Sword diagonally above his shoulder.

Swish!

A slender streak of sword light slashed diagonally across the cliff face.

Lee Hyun’s wrist moved twice more. Several more streaks of sword light, offset from the first line, sliced through the air in rapid succession.

Rumble–

A portion of the cliff split into several pieces along the lines traced by the sword light and slowly slid downward.

When Lee Hyun inspected the Mountain-Suppressing Sword, there was not a single nick on its blade.

“Not bad. It’s well made.”

Lee Hyun put away the Mountain-Suppressing Sword and sat beside the flowing stream on one side of the valley.

‘Being society head is starting to get tiresome. Should I retire....’

Without a pill that could help him break through a minor realm, advancing his cultivation realm any further would now be difficult.

Of course, since he had only just reached Qi Refining Stage 6, he could still accumulate more spiritual power.

But obtaining the pill recipe for a breakthrough pill and preparing its ingredients could take years, or even centuries. It was not too early to begin preparing now.

It was difficult to replace a pill with a superior spirit vein.

He was already using the best vein seat known to the Qutian Society, but even there, he could not break through to Qi Refining Stage 7.

There truly was a wall between minor realms.

If a spirit vein alone were enough to break through the walls between realms, cultivators at Qi Refining Great Perfection could simply borrow the use of a Tier-2 or Tier-3 spirit vein for a short while and break through to Foundation Establishment.

The great cultivation sects possessed no shortage of spirit veins of that level, so lending their Qi Refining Great Perfection disciples a cultivation cave abode atop such a vein for a short time would have posed no difficulty at all.

If that were the case, there would be no reason for Foundation Establishment Pills to be so expensive.

Yet in reality, even sects with Nascent Soul cultivators regarded Foundation Establishment Pills as important pills and constantly worked to refine or acquire them.

Of course, the wall between Qi Refining Stages 6 and 7 was nothing compared with the barrier of a major realm. But in the present age, when heaven-and-earth spiritual qi had grown thin, it was still a boundary that was difficult to cross naturally without a pill.

‘Like with the Barrier-Breaking Pill, I’ll have to join a faction that possesses the pill recipe. Before that... I only need to obtain the pill recipe for Tier-1 Bone-Forging Powder.’

Every Bone-Rot Flower in Lee Hyun’s spirit fields had already surpassed 300 years of medicine age and had become a spirit plant meant to be used as an ingredient for Tier-2 Bone-Forging Powder.

Even so, a Tier-1 pill recipe would still provide an important foundation for understanding better recipes in the future, since it would teach him the detoxification method for Bone-Rot Flowers, the changes in their medicinal potency, and the principles by which they conflicted and harmonized with other medicinal ingredients.

If he obtained seeds or young seedlings from the existing mother plants and raised them anew, he could also refine Tier-1 Bone-Forging Powder himself in the future.

Five years later.

Qingchao Merchant Alliance’s Southern Archipelago, Chiyao Island.

Chiyao Island was a small volcanic island located two thousand li out to sea from the coast of Nanli Kingdom. Its rocks were red, trees were sparse, and hot steam rose from fissures scattered across the island. The Qingchao Merchant Alliance had built twenty-eight alchemy chambers over the island’s earth-fire vein so alchemists could use them whenever needed.

Inside an alchemy chamber fed by earth fire, Lee Hyun was wrapping the final dose packet of Bone-Forging Powder in medicine paper.

Over the past five years, he had passed the examination to become a guest alchemist and occasionally carried out commissions for the Qingchao Merchant Alliance. At first, he refined ordinary Tier-1 pills from publicly available pill recipes. Once he had built sufficient trust, he was finally taught the pill recipe for Tier-1 Bone-Forging Powder, after which he delivered Bone-Forging Powder several times.

Guest Alchemist Li Mo.

Outwardly, he appeared to be in his early fifties. He was taciturn by nature, but unfailingly punctual when it came to deadlines. Thus far, no one had paid him any particular attention.

He stared at the medicinal residue left inside the pill furnace and sank into thought.

‘It’s easy now... Next time, I might even produce high-grade Bone-Forging Powder.’

At that moment, he sensed two powerful auras outside the alchemy chamber.

‘Both early Foundation Establishment?’

The thick stone door opened.

Two alliance elders dressed in the Qingchao Merchant Alliance’s robes entered the alchemy chamber.

“So it was you!”

“Senior, what are you talking about?”

“Don’t play dumb!”

The alliance elder in front swept his sleeve, and from behind him stepped a cultivator wearing a black wildcat mask.

“This man infiltrated the Qutian Society for five years and earned your trust. At the gathering held in Baipu Market a few days ago, he used a Tier-1 high-grade Spirit-Tracking Talisman to record your spiritual-power signature. Just now, when you refined Bone-Forging Powder, the Spirit-Tracking Talisman reacted to it perfectly. To think the society head of the Qutian Society was hiding as a guest alchemist of our Merchant Alliance.”

“Mm...”

When the cultivator in the black wildcat mask met Lee Hyun’s gaze, he quietly took half a step back and hid himself behind the alliance elders.

“I was planning to leave soon anyway. There is no need for concern.”

“And who gave a spiritual qi thief like you permission to leave? Do you think only one or two cultivation clans have suffered because of you people? Hand over the complete list of Qutian Society members. If you do, we may spare your life.”

“Heaven-and-earth spiritual qi has no owner to begin with. And the Qutian Society does not keep any list recording its members’ names.”

“Shameless bastard! If you want to live, summon every member and help us capture them.”

“As society head, that is a difficult demand for me to accept.”

“Whether it is difficult or not is for us to decide.”

The spiritual power and divine sense of the two Foundation Establishment alliance elders bore down on Lee Hyun simultaneously.

Light shimmered around Lee Hyun’s body, and the Qi Sphere Barrier, body-protecting spirit light, and Primordial True Qi filling his entire body protected him from head to toe.

Lee Hyun let out a short sigh.

Shrring–

The Mountain-Suppressing Sword slowly slid from his waist as a mysterious glow wrapped around its blade.

As the imposing aura radiating from the shining Mountain-Suppressing Sword filled the alchemy chamber, the expressions of the two Foundation Establishment alliance elders stiffened, and they each retreated half a step.

Lee Hyun held the Mountain-Suppressing Sword upright at a slant.

“Have you ever heard of the Mad Badger?”

Chapter 32

The moment Black Leopard Cat saw the sword in Badger's hand, he wondered if he had misjudged him.

As the beautiful light coiling around Badger's sword drove back the darkness of the alchemy chamber, a single straight white line cut across the dark stone room.

Spiritual pressure erupted from the two alliance elders facing him as well.

Black Leopard Cat hurriedly slapped his storage pouch, trying to pull out a defensive magic tool. But before the magic tool had even fully emerged from the storage pouch, the light extending from Badger's sword split into six.

For a moment, Black Leopard Cat thought he was witnessing a work of art.

A snow-white flower was blooming inside the dark stone room.

The enchanted robe of the alliance elder in front tore open in a long gash, and blood spurted from his shoulder. A thin cut appeared on the second alliance elder's cheek as well.

But Black Leopard Cat had neither the strength to block the sword light nor the time to evade it.

'Ah...'

Shhk.

Black Leopard Cat felt his body become strangely light. His vision tilted.

By the time he realized Badger's sword light had passed through him, his limbs and torso were already sliding away in different directions.

'What a beautiful sword...'

At the instant Black Leopard Cat breathed his last, the sword light that had split the floor also severed the formation inscriptions of the earth-fire formation carved into it. Red earth fire began surging backward through the broken inscriptions.

...

BOOOOM!

One of Chiyao Island's alchemy chambers exploded with a deafening blast.

Chunks of red rock and fragments of the pill furnace shot high into the sky amid the flames. The entire roof was blown away, and one side of Chiyao Island was engulfed in a massive inferno.

Shouts of alarm erupted across the island.

"What happened?!"

"An alchemy chamber exploded!"

The two alliance elders shot into the air through the flames and dust, wreathed in spirit light. Lee Hyun descended onto the red rocks behind them.

The two alliance elders could not immediately counterattack. They looked back and forth between the shattered alchemy chamber and the wounds on their bodies. The afterimage of the snow-white flower that had bloomed moments ago still seemed to linger in the air.

"The sword light... formed an entire scene?"

"Impossible...."

The sword arts practiced by Qi Refining and Foundation Establishment cultivators were generally closer to techniques that condensed spiritual power into sword light and fired it outward. With the proper method of circulation and sufficient spiritual power, even someone with only a shallow understanding of the sword could produce a certain degree of power.

But the six streams of sword light Badger had just unleashed each traced a different trajectory, yet intertwined and separated to form a single vista.

This was a profound skill separate from the conventional realm distinctions of cultivators, something only a person who had devoted long years to the sword as a weapon could display.

"How could a thief possess such peerless martial learning...?"

At that moment, Lee Hyun kicked off the red rock, and his figure slid away and vanished.

"Don't let him escape!"

The alliance elder bleeding from the shoulder pressed his palm downward. Blue light gathered in the air and transformed into a giant's right arm, roaring like crashing waves.

RUMBLE!

A blue palm three zhang (about 9.9 m) long descended upon Lee Hyun as he raced across the red rocks.

Hummm!

More than ten Spirit Light Shields bloomed beneath the palm.

BOOM! BOOM! BOOM!

The first five shattered one after another. Even the sixth Spirit Light Shield bent violently, and the impact punched through the Qi Sphere Barrier and into Lee Hyun's body.

Fortunately, the Force-Dispersing Inner Armor distributed the impact throughout his entire body.

Lee Hyun angled the remaining Spirit Light Shields to deflect the force and used the recoil to his advantage.

BOOM!

His body shot forward even faster than before.

'That alliance elder isn't at early Foundation Establishment!'

Lee Hyun realized he had let his guard down. He was not the only one who knew the Aura-Concealing Art.

At that moment, the other alliance elder formed a hand seal in midair. Six bronze flying swords shot out from his sleeve.

Swish! Swish! Swish!

The flying swords scattered in different directions before converging on Lee Hyun all at once.

Lee Hyun swung the Mountain-Suppressing Sword diagonally backward, and the light surrounding its blade once again bloomed into six branches.

The six streams of sword light struck the flats of the bronze flying swords with perfect precision. The flying swords crossed past Lee Hyun by a hair, then ricocheted separately toward the sea, the sky, and the red rocks.

The alliance elder controlling the bronze flying swords shouted.

"What a formidable fellow! If he gets away, he'll become a serious future threat!"

Lee Hyun's figure shot explosively forward.

'Let's get out of here before more of them arrive.'

Lee Hyun formed several fireballs above his palm and launched them in every direction.

Whoooosh!

The two alliance elders split left and right.

As the exploding fireballs dyed the sky red, Lee Hyun swung the Mountain-Suppressing Sword.

Shhk! Shhk! Shhk!

More than ten streaks of sword light burst through the flames.

The wounded alliance elder flicked his sleeve, causing a round blue curtain of water to bloom outward and push back the fireballs' flames. The scattered bronze flying swords also returned to circle the other alliance elder, spinning like a wagon wheel as they knocked away the sword light one streak after another.

The water curtain and flying swords shook violently, but neither alliance elder suffered serious damage.

"How does a mere Qi Refining cultivator have that much spiritual power?"

"He must be hiding his true realm!"

"But have you ever seen a Foundation Establishment cultivator who can't fly?"

The wounded alliance elder pressed his palm downward again. This time, blue ripples flowed from his fingertips and spread rapidly across the red rocks.

On the opposite side, the six bronze flying swords took up positions in different directions. Thin bronze lines connected between them, forming a massive hexagonal sword net.

"Close the net! He can't fly!"

As the blue ripples passed beneath Lee Hyun's feet, his body grew heavy as though he had been submerged in deep water. At the same time, the hexagonal sword net rapidly began closing around him from all directions.

Lee Hyun burst the Qi Sphere Barrier outward from his entire body, driving away the clinging water qi. He moved as though fleeing, then abruptly changed direction.

Thump!

With successive Square-Inch Steps, Lee Hyun shot off in the opposite direction.

That was where the alliance elder controlling the bronze flying swords stood. With his attention focused on maintaining the sword formation, he had never expected Lee Hyun to turn back toward him.

'...!'

The alliance elder hurriedly raised three layers of yellow protective barriers around himself while sending the bronze flying swords shooting at Lee Hyun.

At that moment, all the Spirit Aura surrounding Lee Hyun's Mountain-Suppressing Sword surged toward its tip.

The light at the sword tip spread like a round halo, then contracted into a single dazzling point.

Fourth Move of One Ultimate, Six Swords.

White Rainbow Pierces the Sun.

The sword light pierced straight through all three layers of yellow barriers.

"Urgh!"

The alliance elder's right flank was pierced through and burst open. Blood and fragments of his shattered enchanted robe scattered through the air.

The bronze flying swords also lost direction for an instant and flew past Lee Hyun.

At that moment, Lee Hyun sensed a terrifying wave of spiritual power above his head.

BOOOOM!

The blue giant's palm shattered eight layers of Spirit Light Shields at once and drove Lee Hyun deep into the red rock.

Red stone dust erupted in every direction.

But when the dust settled, there was no one there.

"It's the Earth Escape Art!"

Cultivators also rushed out from Chiyao Island's other alchemy chambers. On one side of the island, alarm bells rang wildly as countless voice-transmission talismans flew into the air.

...

Lee Hyun moved rapidly northward beneath Chiyao Island.

The underground of Chiyao Island was tangled like a spiderweb with earth-fire veins and the restrictions binding them. Rather than burrow deeper through unfamiliar ground and risk being swept away by earth fire, it was safer to detour underground to the northern cliff and then head out to sea.

The Force-Dispersing Inner Armor had scattered the impact, but Lee Hyun could still taste a faint trace of blood in his mouth.

Today had been his first time fighting two Foundation Establishment cultivators. Lee Hyun had confirmed that his spiritual power and techniques were sufficiently effective even against them.

Yet what struck him even more strongly was the gap created by the ability to fly.

'So that's it. Is that why no one seriously discusses a fight between a grandmaster of the mortal martial path and a Foundation Establishment cultivator....'

Lee Hyun had wondered about it for some time. A Profound Realm martial artist should have been capable of threatening a Foundation Establishment cultivator, so why did no one seriously debate who would win between the two?

No matter how powerful a Profound Realm expert was, if a Foundation Establishment cultivator flew high into the air and rained down techniques, there was no way to counterattack. Conversely, a Foundation Establishment cultivator could simply fly away whenever the situation turned unfavorable.

...

The northern cliff of Chiyao Island.

Lee Hyun had already reached the island's northern end. His figure burst straight through the red cliff and shot toward the blue sea.

"Catch him!"

The two alliance elders circling above the cliff pursued him, wreathed in spirit light.

Lee Hyun's falling body touched the surface of the water.

Bang!

His body slapped the surface once and bounced upward again like a flat stone.

Bang! Bang!

Lee Hyun turned his body until he lay almost parallel to the water. In that position, every kick against the surface launched him dozens of zhang forward.

Bang! Ba-bang! Bangbangbang!

The intervals between each contact with the water grew shorter and shorter. White foam erupted in rapid succession as he sped away from Chiyao Island.

"What in the world...?"

An unbelievable sight unfolded before the eyes of the two men looking down from above. A Qi Refining cultivator who could not even fly was lying comfortably above the water, bouncing across it like a skipping stone while fleeing at a terrifying speed.

The wounded alliance elder clutched his flank and ground his teeth.

"Dammit! He can't fly, so he really does seem to be at Qi Refining. But how can he move at such a bizarre speed...?!"

"Stop talking and speed up!"

"Dammit, if it weren't for my side..."

The two alliance elders drew on even more spiritual power. Their speed briefly increased, but the distance between them and Lee Hyun ahead refused to shrink. If anything, it slowly widened.

Lee Hyun was even putting common knowledge from his past life to use. Using the Reclining Escape Art, he flattened his body parallel to the water to reduce frontal air resistance, then shaped a curtain of the Qi Sphere Barrier over his leading side in imitation of the pointed nose of a high-speed train.

Each time he touched the water, the Distance-Shrinking Step erupted and added more propulsion. As a result, Lee Hyun's speed surpassed 200 kilometers per hour in the units of his past life. The two alliance elders flew at around 150 kilometers per hour, so the distance could only continue widening.

The wounded alliance elder spoke urgently.

"Can't we contact the alliance elders living on the mainland ahead and have them surround him?"

"Can't you see how freakishly fast he is? He'll reach the mainland before a voice-transmission talisman does! Besides, do you think that guy is insane enough to enter the territory of a cultivation clan? Of course he'll slip through whatever gap he can find!"

The two continued pursuing Lee Hyun for some time. But the distance kept widening, and the wounded alliance elder's complexion grew increasingly pale. In the end, they were the ones to slow down first.

...

Even after confirming that the two alliance elders' presences were fading into the distance, Lee Hyun did not slow down.

In truth, he had no intention of prolonging his grudge with the two alliance elders. They had indeed tried to capture him, but it was not as though they had attacked him for no reason.

Most of the Qingchao Merchant Alliance's alliance elders were clan heads of cultivation clans that controlled Tier 2 spirit veins along Nanli Kingdom's southern coast and archipelagos.

For example, among the seven great Foundation Establishment cultivation clans of southern Nanli Kingdom, the clan heads of five also served as alliance elders of the Qingchao Merchant Alliance.

To be fair, it was true that the Qutian Society had secretly made use of spiritual qi leaking from their spirit veins.

Heaven-and-earth spiritual qi had no owner by nature, but from the perspective of the clans that had spent long years maintaining the formations and spirit fields, they had every reason to consider themselves the victims.

That was why Lee Hyun had never intended to fight the two alliance elders to the death in the first place.

Black Leopard Cat, on the other hand, could have driven every remaining member of the Qutian Society to their deaths, so Lee Hyun had been obligated to execute him as society head.

'A good day to retire...'

His body sped even faster toward the coast of Nanli Kingdom.

...

Two shichen (four hours) later.

An unnamed cliff on the southern coast of Nanli Kingdom.

A black stone slab rested inside a small underground cavern.

At its center was an engraving of a cicada shedding its shell.

Lee Hyun inserted eight low-grade spirit stones into the grooves surrounding the slab.

Hummm–

The formation inscriptions connected to the stone slab lit up one by one.

It was an emergency communication formation the Qutian Society had prepared long ago.

The Qutian Society had established several levels of emergency procedures in preparation for being discovered by cultivation clans or having their meeting sites compromised.

The highest level among them was the Shell-Shedding Order (脫殼令).

Abandon all meeting sites.

Remove the markings from the vein seats and destroy the assignment ledgers.

Members sever contact with one another and scatter.

Do not hold meetings under the name of the Qutian Society.

Lee Hyun placed his hand on the stone slab.

"I issue the Shell-Shedding Order."

The light split into eight streams and seeped into the slab.

Once the message reached a nearby base, its caretaker would relay the order to the next one. By repeating the process, every member would receive the news within four days at most.

...

Several days later.

Gumu Studio in Baipu Market closed its doors.

The masks, maps, and ledgers in the underground meeting room all disappeared.

At numerous residual-vein pockets, including Qingluo Mountain and Qianhe Valley, the Qutian Society's markings and concealment formations were removed.

The narrow passages leading to the vein seats collapsed, and the members scattered without asking after one another's whereabouts.

...

An underground cave near Baipu Market.

Lee Hyun placed the Badger mask on the ground.

After years of use, its edges and the areas around the eyeholes had worn down.

The tip of the Mountain-Suppressing Sword lightly tapped the mask.

Tap.

The mask split cleanly into two.

Lee Hyun burned the pieces with the Fireball Art, then washed even the remaining ashes away into an underground water vein.

He disposed of the identity token belonging to the guest alchemist Li Mo, along with miscellaneous objects bearing the emblem of the Qingchao Merchant Alliance, in the same manner.

"Take care, everyone."

One year later.

Tunnel No. 2.

After escaping Chiyao Island, Lee Hyun spent nearly two months wandering beneath Nanli Kingdom while repeatedly changing direction.

When no pursuers appeared, he returned to Tunnel No. 2. For the next ten months, he remained self-sufficient underground without once going to the surface, carefully watching his surroundings.

Over the past year, he had not sensed anything suspicious even once.

'At this point, I can assume Tunnel No. 2's location hasn't been exposed. There's no need to move. Moving is such a hassle....'

The situation was different from when he had killed a cultivator from the Azure Cloud Sect, which he suspected was a great sect.

The Qingchao Merchant Alliance had no Golden Core cultivators. Lee Hyun was not afraid of them.

Still, he planned to avoid operating in southern Nanli Kingdom for a while. Some of Badger's combat methods as society head had been exposed.

"But Lan Kingdom is vast. Who would recognize me if I operated outside Nanli Kingdom?"

Lee Hyun took out a small medicine packet. It was the last dose packet of Tier 1 Bone-Forging Powder he had set aside while working as a guest alchemist on Chiyao Island.

He had already taken several dose packets over the past year, so it seemed he had nearly reached the limit of how much Tier 1 Bone-Forging Powder could strengthen his skeleton.

He poured one-third of the packet's contents into a jade bottle filled with spirit spring water. When the ivory-colored powder dissolved into the water, he shook the bottle and drank its contents in one gulp.

"Haa...."

Lee Hyun lay comfortably on the floor of the cultivation chamber and circulated the Primordial One-Qi Art.

A short while later, warmth spread through his body.

The medicinal strength passed through his meridians and seeped into his bones.

The stimulation began in his fingers, wrists, elbows, and shoulders. Heat climbed along his spine, while deep within his pelvis and knees, he felt an itch like hundreds of tiny ants crawling around.

Crack.

Every time Lee Hyun breathed, a dull pain throbbed through his ribs and spine.

Two years later.

Qinglu Kingdom, Changchun Sect.

Qinglu Kingdom was a mortal kingdom located in the central-western region of Lan Kingdom, a Tier 4 cultivation nation.

It lay 20,000 li (about 7,840 km) north of Lee Hyun's Tunnel No. 2 in Nanli Kingdom.

The Changchun Sect had gained some renown for refining Essence-Raising Pills, which were used to aid breakthroughs from mid to late Qi Refining.

...

Inside a spacious hall of the Changchun Sect.

Twenty pill furnaces were arranged at regular intervals. In front of each sat a Qi Refining rogue cultivator seeking admission into the Changchun Sect.

Lee Hyun was one of them.

Hummm–

The pill furnace before Lee Hyun trembled slightly.

Today's examination task was the Spirit-Restoring Pill. It had almost no practical efficacy and was a test pill created by the Changchun Sect solely to assess alchemy.

The Changchun Sect provided three sets of medicinal ingredients and a pill recipe. Anyone who successfully produced at least two low grade Spirit-Restoring Pills within three attempts would be acknowledged as a Tier 1 alchemist.

Fwoosh–

Six fireballs of different sizes bloomed before Lee Hyun. Inside the pill furnace, the three kinds of medicinal ingredients underwent Refining one after another.

Blue medicinal liquid mingled with yellow spiritual qi, while the white energy extracted from the final ingredient gently enveloped the other two medicinal potencies.

Lee Hyun formed the Pill-Condensing Seal.

Hummm!

A short while later, round objects fell onto the bottom of the pill furnace.

Rattle.

When he opened the lid, three Spirit-Restoring Pills appeared.

One mid grade.

Two low grade.

The late Qi Refining cultivator supervising the examination inspected the pills one by one with a surprised expression.

"A mid grade pill on your very first attempt...."

Lee Hyun put on an appropriately pleased expression.

"I was lucky."

At that moment, an unfamiliar voice came from the entrance of the hall.

"Not bad for such a young Qi Refining rogue cultivator."

The supervisors hurriedly stood and cupped their hands.

"Greetings, Elder Gao."

An old man entered the hall. He examined Lee Hyun's pill furnace and the completed Spirit-Restoring Pills in turn.

"Your fire control is steady. Not bad. I am Gao Yuanhe, peak master of Pill Cauldron Peak and an Elder of the Changchun Sect."

He looked down at the paperwork the supervisor had filled out.

"Your name is... Li Dong'er?"

"Yes."

Gao Yuanhe stroked his beard.

"What a strange name. Why in the world were you given such a name?"

'Because I was near Tunnel No. 2....'

Lee Hyun gave a suitably vague explanation.

"My parents passed away when I was young, so I never had the chance to hear why they chose this name for me."

"Exactly! That is why we must always remain humble and seek enlightenment. Does not the wisdom of your parents, who lived and died as mortals, surpass even that of living cultivators? The name 'Dong'er' sounds like an affectionate pet name the moment one says it. What else could it be but a profound wish that their child be loved by those around him throughout his life? Now that you understand their intention, it is not too late. The path to learning can be found anywhere. With that in mind, would you become my nominal disciple and come to Pill Cauldron Peak? If you study alchemy at our peak, you could progress far beyond where you are now."

At that moment, an old man wearing clothes steeped in the scent of medicinal herbs approached from deeper inside the hall.

"Now, now! Elder Gao. What sort of conduct is it to poach talent in the middle of an examination?"

"Poach? I am merely showing a talented young man the path most suited to him."

"This entrance examination is being administered by our Hundred Herbs Peak, and we supplied both the medicinal ingredients and the pill furnaces. At the very least, should we not let him hear Hundred Herbs Peak's offer as well before he decides?"

Chapter 33

“Peak Master Zhu, aren't you supposed to be selecting a spirit-plant cultivator? This child made a Spirit-Restoring Pill.”

“And where do you think the ingredients for that Spirit-Restoring Pill came from, the sky? How could he make a pill like that without properly understanding medicinal ingredients?”

Hundred Herbs Peak Master Zhu Jinglin scraped a little of the residue from inside the pill furnace with his finger and examined it.

“Good fire control alone wouldn't produce a result like this. This is the work of someone who knows how to handle medicinal ingredients with care.”

“Which is why he should learn alchemy.”

“Which is why he should learn to cultivate spirit plants.”

Both men turned to Lee Hyun at the same time.

“.......”

Lee Hyun considered his options for a moment.

‘Which path would bring me closer to the pill recipe for the Essence-Raising Pill?’

The most direct route was, of course, to become an alchemist. The problem was that he had no idea when he would ever be entrusted with refining Essence-Raising Pills.

Even craftsmen in the mundane world did not readily reveal their family's secret formulas to outsiders. There was even less chance that a cultivation sect would entrust a newly admitted disciple with a pill recipe capable of breaking through the barrier between mid and late Qi Refining.

Perhaps it would actually be easier to infer the Essence-Raising Pill's recipe while working as a spirit-plant cultivator at Hundred Herbs Peak. After all, Hundred Herbs Peak would be the one supplying the spirit plants used to make Essence-Raising Pills.

‘But alchemy isn't something you can do just by knowing the ingredients. I also need to know the Refining sequence, fire control, and how to harmonize the medicinal potency. There's no reason to take the long way around.’

Lee Hyun spoke.

“I want to learn alchemy.”

A satisfied smile spread across Gao Yuanhe's face.

“You heard him?”

The Hundred Herbs Peak master looked disappointed.

“To learn alchemy properly, you must first understand spirit plants and medicinal ingredients. An alchemist who only starts paying attention to the ingredients after tossing them into the pill furnace will find it difficult to rise above second-rate, no matter how skilled he is with fire.”

“I'll remember that.”

“Even if you join Pill Cauldron Peak, the doors of Hundred Herbs Peak will remain open to you.”

The disciple overseeing the examination cautiously interjected.

“Elders, we still haven't checked the applicant's bone age or spiritual root.”

“Isn't that nothing more than a formality once they're checked?”

Gao Yuanhe turned to Lee Hyun.

“Finish the remaining entrance procedures, then come to Pill Cauldron Peak. Unless some unusual problem turns up, I will accept you as my nominal disciple.”

“Thank you.”

The Hundred Herbs Peak master spoke as he turned away.

“Don't become the sort of alchemist who burns his medicinal ingredients and then complains that he was unlucky. If you change your mind later, come to Hundred Herbs Peak.”

“Are you cursing someone else's disciple?”

“Advice as valuable as spirit stones.”

The two old men disappeared from the hall while bickering.

The rogue cultivators taking the examination looked at Lee Hyun enviously. It was exceedingly rare for a rogue cultivator from outside the sect to attract the interest of two peak masters before even being admitted.

Lee Hyun realized that he had underestimated his own alchemy skills.

‘There were three sets of ingredients. Going out of my way to succeed on the very first attempt and draw attention to myself wasn't very cautious....’

...

Once the alchemist examination was over, it turned out that Lee Hyun was the only person who had passed.

‘Good thing I succeeded on the first attempt....’

Under a disciple's guidance, Lee Hyun headed toward another hall.

Various magic tools and measurement formations had been arranged throughout the spacious hall.

More than twenty applicants had passed the first examination. Unlike the alchemist examination, the other fields seemed to have produced a fair number of successful applicants.

...

The line for the bone-age test gradually shortened.

A few places ahead of Lee Hyun stood a large, broad-shouldered young man.

Judging only by his sun-darkened face and thick forearms, he could have passed for a sturdy laborer from the mundane world, but the aura of Qi Refining Stage 5 flowed from his body.

“Place your right hand here.”

The man set his palm on the stone slab.

A silver pattern resembling the bones of a human hand was engraved into its surface.

The pattern soon brightened, and a pale light swept from the man's fingers past his wrist and up to his elbow.

Hummm―

Thin rings of light rose one by one above the stone slab.

The examiner studied the number and colors of the rings, then frowned.

“Your bone age reads eighty-three.”

“What? I'm twenty-seven.”

“Twenty-seven?”

The examiner looked back and forth between the man's face and the stone slab.

“You haven't taken a Rejuvenation Pill or Youth-Preserving Pill, have you?”

“No. How could I afford pills that expensive?”

“What about a body-refining art?”

“I've only practiced a little external martial arts in the mundane world.”

As though something had occurred to him, the examiner asked,

“Have you taken Bone-Forging Powder recently?”

“What? Yes. How did you know? I took one dose packet on my way here.”

“Did you buy it in the south?”

“I bought it at a cultivator market in Nanli Kingdom. It was mid-grade Bone-Forging Powder made by the Qingchao Pill Pavilion of the Qingchao Merchant Alliance.”

“That's the cause. The medicinal strength of Bone-Forging Powder seeps directly into the bones, and until it is fully absorbed, traces of the ingredients' medicine age remain in the bone tissue. The stone slab mistakenly counted even those traces as years you have lived.”

A troubled look appeared on the man's face.

“Then what should I do?”

“How long has it been since you took it?”

“About ten days.”

“We'll measure you again in a month. By then, most of the traces of the medicine age should have disappeared, and we'll be able to determine your bone age properly.”

“Then have I passed or failed?”

“I'll mark you as passed for now. Finish the other tests. However, if we test your bone age again in a month and discover that you lied, don't regret whatever punishment you receive.”

The man withdrew happily after hearing that he had passed for now. The examiner immediately called the next applicant.

Lee Hyun watched the man's retreating back.

‘Bone-Forging Powder can affect a bone-age test?’

It was unexpected information.

As the line gradually shortened, Lee Hyun asked the disciple standing nearby and guiding the applicants,

“If the bone-age test can be thrown off that easily, doesn't that cause problems?”

“What kind of problem?”

“Couldn't someone trying to enter the sect use Bone-Forging Powder to lie about their age?”

“It's the opposite. Taking Bone-Forging Powder only makes your bone age read older than it really is. It won't make you appear younger. Anyone trying to enter a sect would want to pass themselves off as younger. Who would deliberately make themselves look older? At the same realm, a younger disciple receives a better evaluation and is more likely to receive concentrated support from the sect. Increasing your bone age would only make you look less talented.”

“That certainly makes sense.”

Lee Hyun nodded as though convinced, but inwardly he was delighted.

‘So I can make my bone age read higher than it really is!’

It was a loophole that was utterly useless to anyone else.

But Lee Hyun was different.

‘The next time I enter another sect or faction, I can use Bone-Forging Powder to fake my age.’

At present, he could refine Tier 1 Bone-Forging Powder himself.

The main ingredient and supplementary spirit plants used in Bone-Forging Powder each had a range of medicine ages permitted by the pill recipe. The reading produced by the magic tool would also vary depending on the medicine age of the ingredients, the dosage consumed, and the amount of time remaining before the test. If he experimented a few times and figured out the pattern, it seemed possible to adjust things so that the stone slab displayed a bone age within whatever range he wanted.

On top of that, if he altered his appearance with a few disguise methods and adjusted his aura with the Spirit-Concealing Art and Aura-Concealing Art....

‘I could create a much more convincing identity.’

In truth, Lee Hyun had worried a great deal about his bone age even before entering the Changchun Sect.

Unlike the number of years he had actually lived, Lee Hyun's bone age remained nineteen. Combined with his realm of Qi Refining Stage 6, that made him seem far too outstanding for a rogue cultivator, which could attract unnecessary attention.

But because he had not known any way to fake his bone age, he had gone ahead and entered the sect anyway.

While they spoke, the applicants ahead of him completed their examinations one after another.

“Next.”

Lee Hyun stepped in front of the stone slab.

“Name?”

“Li Dong'er.”

“Place your right hand here.”

Lee Hyun placed his palm on the stone slab.

A pale light slowly swept from his fingers to his elbow.

Hummm―

Thin rings rose one after another.

Being the son of a missing rogue cultivator couple was a background that was difficult to verify without being particularly unusual.

The examiner studied Lee Hyun for a moment, then softened his voice slightly.

“They must have left you some pills and spirit stones.”

“You had good parents.”

“Still, there's no need to be discouraged. Becoming an inner disciple is already quite good. Besides, I heard Elder Gao said he would accept you as his nominal disciple?”

“If you contribute to the sect and accumulate contribution points, you'll eventually be able to exchange them for an Essence-Raising Pill. “When they're cheap, around 150 low-grade spirit stones. These days, they sometimes sell for 200. And that's the price inside the sect. Outside, they'll probably cost at least 250 each.”

“That's expensive. What about a Foundation Establishment Pill?”

“A Foundation Establishment Pill... Our Changchun Sect cannot refine Foundation Establishment Pills, so they aren't easy to obtain even if you have spirit stones. You'll have to seek an opportunity outside the sect. Still, you're only nineteen. Even after you reach Qi Refining Stage 9, you'll have plenty of time to search for one.”

‘Right. There's no need to obsess over the pill recipe. I'll just buy Essence-Raising Pills little by little and stockpile them.’

After completing all the entrance procedures, Lee Hyun received a green long robe, a new identity token, and a thin booklet containing the sect rules.

Outside the hall floated a broad flying boat measuring five zhang (about 16.5 m) in length.

Luo Jingwen raised his identity token.

Hummm―

In practice, the Changchun Sect was led by these nine peak masters.

BOOM!

Upper Pill Cauldron Peak.

At the end of a stone path running along the mountainside stood a small hall.

Bamboo mats for drying medicinal ingredients and pill furnaces of various sizes filled the courtyard. Beneath one of the eaves stood a row of black jars filled with failed pills, and the entire courtyard was steeped in an aged medicinal fragrance.

Gao Yuanhe sat at a table inside the hall.

On the wall behind him hung a portrait of a Daoist seated before a pill furnace. Beneath it stood a small incense altar enshrining the successive peak masters of Pill Cauldron Peak and its alchemy ancestral masters.

Two cups of tea and a small incense burner sat on the table.

“You've come?”

“Greetings, Elder Gao.”

“You should be calling me Master now, not Elder.”

Gao Yuanhe spoke to Luo Jingwen.

Luo Jingwen lit three sticks of incense and handed them to Lee Hyun.

“First, pay your respects to the ancestral masters of Pill Cauldron Peak. The ceremony for a nominal disciple is simple, but it must still mark that you've formally entered the sect.”

Lee Hyun bowed three times before the incense altar, then placed the incense into it.

Luo Jingwen handed Lee Hyun one of the cups of tea from the table.

Lee Hyun accepted the teacup with both hands, knelt before Gao Yuanhe, bowed three times, then offered him the tea.

“This disciple, Li Dong'er, pays respects to Master.”

“Good.”

Gao Yuanhe accepted the tea and took a sip.

He pulled a thick register from beneath the table. Its cover was dark red, as though scorched by fire, and the pages inside were densely filled with names and dates of admission.

Gao Yuanhe wrote the name ‘Li Dong'er’ and today's date in the final empty space of the register.

As though he had noticed Lee Hyun's subtle expression, Gao Yuanhe stroked his beard.

He pointed to the register.

“From now on, you may attend the lecture I give once each month, and you may use an alchemy library one level above Yang Fire Court's communal library. If you encounter a problem during alchemy that you cannot resolve, you may ask me about it directly once each season. However, medicinal ingredients, pill furnaces, and high-grade cultivation cave abodes must be obtained by accumulating contribution points, just as they are for any other inner disciple. If you try to use my name for personal advantage, you will lose your status as my nominal disciple.”

Lee Hyun actually felt more at ease. He preferred being left to his own devices.

When Luo Jingwen inserted Lee Hyun's identity token into an empty slot, a faint light traveled once around the gate and surrounding wall.

Hummm―

Inside the house were a bedroom, a small cultivation chamber, and a room for preparing medicinal ingredients. A Qi-Gathering Formation had been installed in the cultivation chamber, and one wall had slots for inserting spirit stones.

As Lee Hyun slowly looked around the interior, he noticed signs that someone had been using the place until recently.

“He died.”

“I see....”

Lee Hyun suddenly had an ominous feeling.

“By the way, Senior Brother.”

“...?”

Chapter 34

‘Almost all of the more than a hundred disciples died?’

At that moment, two people came down from higher up the mountainside.

“Senior Brother Luo believes there is someone’s conspiracy behind everything that happens in the world.”

“We haven’t met before. I’m Shen Yanzhu, one of Master’s nominal disciples.”

The scarred man introduced himself as well.

“I’m Pei Jingsong. Same here.”

“I’m Li Dong'er. Since both of you entered the sect before me... may I address you as Senior Sister Shen and Senior Brother Pei?”

Shen Yanzhu nodded.

“That’s right.”

Pei Jingsong looked slightly awkward.

“Junior Brother Li is one Stage above me, so it feels a little strange to have him call me Senior Brother.”

Luo Jingwen said,

“Among those under our master, seniority within the same major realm is determined by the order in which we entered the sect. If we counted every Stage within Qi Refining, we would have to change how we addressed each other whenever someone pulled ahead by a Stage, wouldn’t we? Once someone reaches Foundation Establishment and receives a position such as Elder or steward, we address them by that position from then on.”

Lee Hyun immediately cupped his hands.

“Greetings, Senior Brother Pei.”

“All right. Let us get along well from now on.”

Lee Hyun looked back and forth between the two of them.

“Then is it not true that most of Master’s nominal disciples have died?”

The expressions of the two shifted subtly.

Shen Yanzhu shot Luo Jingwen a sidelong glance.

“That’s why you should have explained it properly, Senior Brother.”

Pei Jingsong explained to Lee Hyun,

“Master began taking nominal disciples more than a hundred years ago. Including Junior Brother Li, one hundred and seven disciples have had their names entered on the rolls so far, and fewer than twenty are confirmed to still be alive.”

“So most of them really did die.”

“That is true. But there is nothing strange about it. Most nominal disciples were Qi Refining cultivators, so many of those who entered early simply reached the ends of their lifespans. Others left for different regions and were never heard from again.”

Shen Yanzhu said,

“Master doesn’t even take that many nominal disciples. Alchemists aren’t common, after all. On Chunjian Peak or External Affairs Peak, there are Elders with several hundred nominal disciples under them.”

“I see....”

Lee Hyun recalled Gao Yuanhe’s roster.

The red dots beside certain names and the ink lines drawn through others might have indicated whether those disciples were alive, dead, or missing.

“Then did Senior Brother Guo, whose residence I’m using, also reach the end of his lifespan?”

This time, no one answered immediately.

Pei Jingsong rubbed the scar on his chin.

“Senior Brother Guo died during the Qingmu Ridge Herb Robbery.”

“What is the Qingmu Ridge Herb Robbery?”

“It happened four years ago.”

Shen Yanzhu explained,

“Our sect has separate spirit fields at a place called Qingmu Ridge, more than a thousand li (about 392 km) north of here. The spiritual qi there is somewhat thin, but the soil is excellent, making it suitable for growing large quantities of spirit plants that need many years to mature.”

“Once every few decades, we harvest the mature spirit plants and transport them back to the main sect.”

Pei Jingsong continued,

“That year, we harvested several Tier 2 spirit plants as well. More than fifty disciples and one Foundation Establishment Elder from External Affairs Peak were assigned to escort the shipment.”

He paused briefly before adding,

“I was there too.”

“Don’t tell me... the convoy was attacked?”

“It was.”

The smile vanished from Pei Jingsong’s face.

“On the night we left Qingmu Ridge, dozens of masked cultivators appeared. There were even two Foundation Establishment cultivators among them.”

Shen Yanzhu spoke in a low voice.

“Twenty-three inner disciples died that night. Five of Master’s nominal disciples were killed too, including Senior Brother Guo.”

“.......”

“They were not only after the medicinal ingredients.”

Pei Jingsong said,

“They took the dead disciples’ identity tokens and long robes as well. Some disguised themselves as surviving disciples and infiltrated the main sect ahead of the convoy.”

“All the way here?”

“Yes. Those fellows made it through External Affairs Peak’s outer restriction, but their identities were exposed before the inner formation of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation. They fled immediately, and after a pursuit, we managed to capture several of them alive. But because of restrictions placed on their primordial spirits, we could not discover who was behind them.”

Luo Jingwen folded his arms.

“No matter how I look at it, this was not something a band of rogue cultivators could have pulled off.”

Shen Yanzhu sighed.

“Here we go again.”

“Think about it. Dozens of people, including two Foundation Establishment cultivators, knew both the harvest date and the transport route and lay in wait. The Crimson Flame Flying Sabers and Fire Cloud Formation they used also resembled Honglu Sect methods.”

“What kind of place is the Honglu Sect?”

Shen Yanzhu answered,

“It’s a sect ten thousand li west of Qingmu Ridge. They control a Tier 3 spirit vein rich in fire qi and are famous for crafting magic tools and magic treasures. We trade with them too, but we often clash over interests in nearby cultivator markets.”

Pei Jingsong looked at Luo Jingwen.

“But Crimson Flame Flying Sabers can be bought in cultivator markets, and the Fire Cloud Formation is not a rare formation either. We found no Honglu Sect emblems or identity tokens that day.”

Luo Jingwen said,

“Would you only believe it if Honglu Sect cultivators appeared in person and announced, ‘We did it’? If they were only after the medicinal ingredients, why steal the identities of dead disciples and try to enter our main sect? From the start, their target was not Qingmu Ridge’s spirit plants, but our Changchun Sect.”

“I won’t deny that possibility. But we still have no conclusive evidence.”

Luo Jingwen lowered his voice.

“The supreme sect master entered secluded cultivation and has not appeared before anyone for decades. It was around that time that the surrounding powers began testing the Changchun Sect’s strength. What happened at Qingmu Ridge was probably one of those attempts.”

Shen Yanzhu’s expression hardened.

“Do not speculate recklessly about the supreme sect master.”

“I was only saying that outside forces may think that way.”

“That amounts to the same thing.”

Pei Jingsong stepped between the two.

“In any case, Junior Brother Li should remember this as well. Our Changchun Sect generally is not the side that starts fights. But that does not mean this is a place without danger.”

He looked over the alchemy chambers lining the mountainside and the peaks of the Changchun Sect visible beyond them.

“We grow spirit plants and make pills. To other powers, that inevitably makes us look like a place with plenty worth stealing.”

Lee Hyun nodded slowly.

“I’ll keep that in mind.”

Luo Jingwen said with a satisfied expression,

“See? Was it not helpful that I put him on his guard beforehand?”

“It would have been more helpful if you had explained it properly from the beginning.”

“People remember what they hear after a shock for much longer.”

“Where did you hear that one?”

“It is a conclusion drawn from my own experience.”

Shen Yanzhu clicked her tongue.

“Junior Brother Li, whenever you hear something from Senior Brother Luo, always verify it yourself.”

“I understand.”

After that, Lee Hyun toured Yang Fire Court’s shared alchemy chambers, medicinal-ingredient storage, and lecture hall under the guidance of the three.

...

Rather than rushing to buy up Essence-Raising Pills, Lee Hyun decided to first familiarize himself with life in the Changchun Sect and the circumstances around it.

The atmosphere on Pill Cauldron Peak was relatively relaxed. As long as he had no assigned duties, he could even leave the sect for several days at a time and visit Tunnel No. 2.

Three months later.

The lecture hall of Yang Fire Court.

Around a dozen disciples had gathered inside the spacious lecture hall, where twenty pill furnaces were arranged.

Gao Yuanhe stood beside the pill furnace at the very front.

Three jade plates had been set before him, each holding a single green leaf.

“Who knows what these are?”

One disciple answered.

“Green Vein Leaves.”

“Correct.”

Gao Yuanhe pointed to the three leaves one by one.

“Their medicine ages?”

Several disciples used the Aura-Reading Art and techniques for examining medicinal ingredients.

A moment later, Shen Yanzhu answered.

“All three appear to have medicine ages of around eighteen years.”

“Correct. They are also the same variety and were taken from plants propagated from the same mother plant. Their sizes and coloration are similar as well.”

Gao Yuanhe swept his gaze over the disciples.

“Then if these three leaves undergo Refining in the same way, will they yield the same medicinal potency?”

No one answered readily.

Gao Yuanhe moved a finger, and three small bronze containers beside the jade plates floated into the air, settling at even intervals above the pill furnace.

When he touched a formation inscription on the floor, flames of identical size sprang up from the three burners.

Fwoosh―

Gao Yuanhe placed one Green Vein Leaf into each bronze container.

The three leaves slowly curled under the heat, and the green sheen on their surfaces deepened.

After about ten breaths, a clear green energy began flowing from the first bronze container.

The energy gathered at the center of the container and condensed like a tiny droplet of water.

In contrast, steam suddenly burst from the second container.

Hissss―

The green medicinal potency scattered in every direction with the steam.

The third Green Vein Leaf seemed unchanged at first, but then began blackening from inside its veins. Before long, only a sticky black liquid remained.

Gao Yuanhe extinguished the flames.

“The same fire was used. They were placed inside at the same time, and the bronze containers are identical in material and size. Yet all three results are different.”

One disciple raised a hand.

“Were they stored differently?”

“No.”

Gao Yuanhe pointed to the first container.

“This one was harvested at the Hour of the Horse (approximately 11 a.m.–1 p.m.) after three consecutive days of clear weather. Its medicinal potency was evenly distributed through the leaf and stem.”

Then the second container.

“This one was harvested immediately after the Spirit Rain Art was used. Too much water qi remained inside the leaf. Even if the water on the surface is wiped away and the leaf is dried, the water qi that seeped between the veins cannot escape in a short time.”

Black liquid remained in the final container.

“This one was harvested before sunrise. During the night, most of the Green Vein Leaf’s medicinal potency had sunk toward the roots, while a large amount of fine turbid qi remained in the leaf.”

Several disciples rapidly wrote down what he said.

Gao Yuanhe said,

“Suppose a pill recipe says to use one eighteen-year-old Green Vein Leaf. Would all three of these leaves count as suitable medicinal ingredients for that pill recipe?”

“No.”

“Then is the pill recipe wrong?”

“No, it is not.”

“Exactly.”

Gao Yuanhe pointed to the blackened medicinal liquid.

“Alchemy begins before the medicinal ingredients ever enter the pill furnace!”

Gao Yuanhe struck the central pill furnace with his palm.

Thunk―

“A pill furnace is a miniature heaven and earth. The burner serves as a formation station, while the restrictions engraved into the pill furnace serve as formation inscriptions. The flow of medicinal potency is no different from spiritual qi circulating within a formation.”

He spread both arms.

“They say a formation master can move heaven and earth across hundreds of li! Yet an alchemist also manipulates the heaven and earth within a pill furnace. Only the scale differs; the underlying principle is the same. Then let me ask you this. Do the principles of heaven and earth not exist elsewhere as well, beyond formations and alchemy?”

Gao Yuanhe continued,

“An alchemist who knows only alchemy will struggle to take even a single step beyond the pill recipes he has learned. Formations and spirit-plant cultivation techniques, artifact-refining art and talisman-crafting art, heavenly timing and earthly terrain, military strategy and music, divination, insect control, ghost control, beast control, illusion arts, poison arts, medicine, bedchamber arts, even the cooking methods of chefs from the mundane world! Learn and think wherever you can, and seek out principles you can bring back into alchemy. Only by learning to seek principles even where others fail to see them can you advance another step!”

One disciple asked,

“Don’t we need contribution points to access inheritances from so many different fields?”

“Hmph, that is an excuse. Do you have any idea how many books and jade slips in the Scripture Pavilion an inner disciple can read freely without spending a single contribution point? If you have read every last one of them, I will take you as my master.”

“My apologies. This disciple was shortsighted.”

Gao Yuanhe stroked his beard.

“If the door is open, there is no reason not to enter. Do not waste your time.”

“Yes!”

The disciples answered in unison.

...

After the lecture ended.

Lee Hyun left Yang Fire Court with the other disciples.

He had originally planned to return to his residence and rest, but after hearing Gao Yuanhe’s words, he suddenly wanted to visit the Scripture Pavilion.

‘I have nothing else to do anyway. Maybe I’ll read some books.’

...

Changchun Peak.

Situated at the center of the nine peaks, Changchun Peak was far taller and broader than Pill Cauldron Peak. Halls housing the Council of Elders and the sect’s administrative offices lined the mountain paths, and many disciples came and went.

The Scripture Pavilion stood halfway up Changchun Peak.

It was a five-story pavilion built from brown spirit wood, with small bronze bells hanging from every eave. Even without wind, the bells rang at differing intervals, sensing the surrounding spiritual qi and the presence of people nearby.

As Lee Hyun approached the entrance and took out his identity token, an invisible barrier parted to either side.

...

Inside the Scripture Pavilion, thousands of narrow slots lined the walls, each holding a jade slip. Books and stone tablets were arranged separately on long shelves beneath them.

A middle-aged cultivator at Qi Refining Stage 9 sat at a table just inside the entrance.

“Greetings, Senior Brother.”

“I certainly have not seen you before. Pill Cauldron Peak?”

“Yes.”

“I am Lin Daoqian, and I manage the first floor of the Scripture Pavilion. Since this is your first visit, I will explain the rules. Any inner disciple may freely read every book and jade slip on the open shelves of the first floor. However, nothing may be taken outside the Scripture Pavilion.”

“I understand.”

...

Lee Hyun first browsed the shelves related to alchemy.

《Twelve Variations of Fire Control》, 《Comprehensive Survey of Tier-1 Spirit Plants' Medicinal Potencies》, 《Essential Formulas for Distinguishing Pill Toxins》, 《One Hundred Cases of Conflicting Medicinal Strengths》, 《Record of Restoring Failed Pills》....

Many of the titles were unfamiliar to him.

Lee Hyun took out several jade slips, pressed them to his forehead, and skimmed their contents with his divine sense.

Some contained basic material, but they also held systematic classifications and countless records of failures that a rogue cultivator alchemist would have found difficult to obtain.

‘Joining a sect was definitely the right choice...’

After reading jade slips for a while, Lee Hyun looked through another section and discovered slips dealing with formations.

《Introductory Guide on Formation Inscriptions》, 《Record of the Eight Gates' Transformations》, 《Distinguishing Formation Devices from Formation Plates》, 《Treatise on Drawing Spiritual Qi through Earth and Water Veins》, 《Essential Formulas for Adapting within Mountain-Guarding Formations》, 《One Hundred Classes of Restrictions》, 《Thirteen Methods for Breaking Illusion Formations》....

An entire wall was filled with formation materials. Complete formation diagrams and methods for crafting high grade formation devices were omitted, but the material was quite detailed when it came to recognizing the structure of formations and operating formations that had already been installed.

Lee Hyun returned to Lin Daoqian.

“Senior Brother Lin, may I ask you something?”

“Go ahead.”

“There are far more materials on formations than I expected. Can we truly read all of these without contribution points?”

“Yes.”

“Aren’t formation inheritances normally precious?”

Lin Daoqian nodded.

“Inheritances for designing formations or crafting formation devices and formation plates are precious. But most of the materials over there concern recognizing and operating formations that have already been installed.”

He pointed toward the nine peaks visible through the Scripture Pavilion’s windows.

“If enemies attack and the formation master is injured, the remaining disciples cannot simply stand idle in front of the formation stations, can they?”

“Come to think of it, I heard formations also played a major role during the Qingmu Ridge Herb Robbery.”

“They did.... I was on External Affairs Peak at the time.”

Lin Daoqian’s expression grew somewhat heavy.

“Once their identities were exposed, those fellows ambushed the two formation masters on External Affairs Peak first. But the inner disciples who had learned basic formation inscriptions split up to man the auxiliary formation stations and held out until a formation master from Formation and Artifact Peak arrived.”

Lin Daoqian looked toward the formation section.

“That is about all the sect expects. We cannot make every disciple into a formation master, but in a crisis, they should at least know which formation station to stand at and what to do there.”

Lee Hyun nodded.

“So that’s what it means.”

...

From that day onward, Lee Hyun visited the Scripture Pavilion whenever he had spare time.

He first learned the forms of formation inscriptions and the four basic functions those inscriptions could produce.

Gathering, which gathered spiritual qi; Guiding, which directed its flow; Blocking, which prevented movement and passage; and Transformation, which altered properties.

A single formation inscription did not necessarily perform only one function. Even the same inscription could draw spiritual qi inward or, conversely, push it away depending on where it was placed within a formation diagram and how it connected to other formation inscriptions.

‘Now that I understand the principles, the formations I saw before look completely different.’

Of course, understanding formations and constructing them oneself were worlds apart. Lee Hyun had only just moved beyond complete ignorance of the subject.

...

About a month after he began regularly visiting the Scripture Pavilion,

Lee Hyun found an old jade slip on a shelf containing miscellaneous discussions of formations.

《Treatise on Formations and the Five Precelestial Stages》

‘What is this...?’

Lee Hyun took the jade slip from the shelf and pressed it to his forehead.

As his divine sense seeped into it, an enormous volume of text and diagrams unfolded within his consciousness.

「Formations are composed of postcelestial spiritual qi and spirit materials. Postcelestial matter cannot be returned to the precelestial, but by tracing the vestiges of its transformations, one can imitate certain images.

Thus, drawing upon the theory of the Five Precelestial Stages, this treatise discusses the origins of various restrictions.

What are the Five Precelestial Stages? The transformations before the creation of heaven and earth can be divided into five stages.

Great Change is the state before even qi has manifested.

Great Beginning is the state in which formless qi first appears.

Great Inception is the state in which fragments of form first begin to emerge within qi.

Great Simplicity is the state in which form acquires substance and begins to take on material reality.

Supreme Ultimate is the undivided state in which qi, form, and substance are all present but have not yet separated from one another.

Supreme Ultimate divides into the Two Modes, namely yin and yang.

Clear and light yang rises to become heaven, while turbid and heavy yin descends to become earth.

The Two Modes differentiate into the Four Images, and the Four Images into the Eight Trigrams. Meanwhile, the qualities of all things in heaven and earth manifest through the generation and overcoming of the Five Elements of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water...」

‘Great Simplicity....’

Lee Hyun reread that section.

‘Put in terms from my previous life, is this something like the stage where form acquires physical substance and mass?’

Lee Hyun moved on to the next section.

The later portions introduced various restrictions devised by referencing the transformations of the Five Precelestial Stages.

Most were closer to theories and records of failures than complete formation diagrams.

What caught Lee Hyun’s attention among them was the Earth-Origin Sky-Suppressing Treatise.

「There are several types of flight-suppressing restrictions.

Some disrupt wind qi to upset the balance of flight, while others interfere with the operation of flight magic tools or obstruct a cultivator’s use of spiritual power.

Among higher-level Flight-Suppressing Formations, some use an earth vein as an anchor to generate Earth-Origin Gravitational Pressure.」

‘Earth-Origin Gravitational Pressure?’

An illustration of a deployed Tier 2 Grand Flight-Suppressing Formation appeared within the jade slip. The formation devices placed in the eight directions were connected to the earth vein, and arrows pointing downward were drawn on the matter inside the formation.

Once the formation was activated, everything within its range was pulled toward the ground more strongly than usual. Flight magic tools consumed more spiritual power to maintain altitude, and even Foundation Establishment cultivators found it difficult to lift themselves into the air near the center of the formation.

「Earth Origin is not the Earth Element. The Earth Element merely serves as the anchor and medium that fixes Earth-Origin Gravitational Pressure to the earth vein.

When form acquires substance, weight arises, and whatever has weight sinks toward the center.

Trace that origin backward through the theory of the Five Precelestial Stages, and it reaches the substance of Great Simplicity.」

Lee Hyun’s gaze sharpened.

‘So it really is talking about gravity.’

According to the knowledge of his previous life, the force that pulled objects toward the ground was gravity. This world was incomparably larger than Earth, but people and objects still fell to the ground in the same way. Cultivators seemed to understand that force through an entirely different framework.

Lee Hyun continued reading the jade slip.

「Postcelestial Five-Element spiritual qi cannot reproduce the precelestial Great Simplicity.

However, by harmonizing Five-Element spiritual qi, one may temporarily return it to an image of primordial unity and use formation inscriptions to imitate the transformation by which form acquires substance and condenses. The force generated through this is called Earth-Origin Force.

To generate Earth-Origin Force through a formation, one must use an earth vein as an anchor, prepare formation devices of the Five Elements and a formation plate, and complete the transformations of Return to Unity and Materialization.

Among the mnemonic formulas for Return to Unity and Materialization that have been verified enough for use in a Tier 2 Grand Flight-Suppressing Formation, the most widely used are taken from the Foundation Establishment Section of the 《Primordial One-Qi Art》, a cultivation art that almost no one directly cultivates.」

“.......”

Lee Hyun’s divine sense stopped on that sentence.

He checked it once more to make sure he had not misread it.

The Foundation Establishment Section of the 《Primordial One-Qi Art》.

That was unmistakably what it said.

‘Foundation Establishment Section?’

Chapter 35

Lee Hyun returned the jade slip to its original place and headed for the entrance.

“Senior Brother Lin, may I ask you something?”

“Go ahead.”
