“Does the Scripture Pavilion also have the Foundation Establishment Section of the 《Primordial One-Qi Art》?”

Lin Daoqian’s brush stopped.

“The Primordial One-Qi Art?”

After thinking for a moment, he pulled a thick inheritance catalog from beneath the table.

Rustle. Rustle.

After flipping through several pages, his hand stopped at one entry.

“It does.”

Lin Daoqian pointed to a line in the catalog.

「《Primordial One-Qi Art》 Foundation Establishment Section.

One viewing inside the inheritance chamber.

40 contribution points.

External transmission and copying prohibited.」

Lee Hyun asked,

“It’s a Foundation Establishment cultivation art, yet it requires surprisingly few contribution points.”

“Because there isn’t much demand for it. The Primordial One-Qi Art may be famous as a mysterious cultivation art, but how many people would actually cultivate it all the way to Foundation Establishment? Even in our sect, it’s only occasionally sought out by disciples of Formation and Artifact Peak when they’re researching formations.”

“The Scripture Pavilion isn’t a business. Is there really any need to lower the price just because demand is low?”

“What are you talking about? The Scripture Pavilion is engaged in a very important business indeed. The sect needs to reclaim the contribution points its disciples have accumulated through books and jade slips. That way, it doesn’t have to hand out as many tangible rewards such as spirit stones and pills. Inheritances no one seeks out are priced lower so they’ll be read at least once, while popular inheritances are priced higher so they aren’t distributed too freely. Doesn’t Peak Master Gao often tell you to come study at the Scripture Pavilion? Reading is a habit. Once you start visiting regularly, you become curious about more things, and naturally spend more contribution points.”

‘...!? Wasn’t he sending me here to learn the principles of heaven and earth across different fields?’

Lin Daoqian looked at Lee Hyun.

“But why are you looking for the Foundation Establishment Section, Junior Brother Li?”

“I was reading the 《Treatise on Formations and the Five Precelestial Stages》 earlier and saw that mnemonic formulas from the Primordial One-Qi Art were used in formations, so I became curious. Master also told me to look for principles shared by alchemy and formations.”

“I see. There’s certainly no harm in researching it.”

...

Lee Hyun cupped his hands in farewell and left the Scripture Pavilion.

‘Forty contribution points... I can earn that soon.’

Two months later.

Pill Cauldron Peak, Yang Fire Court.

A rich, savory aroma filled the communal alchemy chamber.

Fwoosh–

A waist-high pill furnace stood before Lee Hyun.

Inside it, finely ground Qingya Rice slowly revolved, glowing a pale blue.

Qingya Rice was a Tier 1 spirit rice cultivated in large quantities by the Changchun Sect. Its medicinal potency was not particularly strong, but it was widely popular as a spirit food that could satisfy hunger without side effects regardless of which cultivation art a disciple practiced.

The Changchun Sect supplied some of it as food for its disciples and used the rest as an ingredient in Hunger-Warding Pills.

Unlike the Hunger-Warding Pills of the mundane world, those handled by cultivation sects were classified as spirit pills and were among the first pills alchemists learned to refine.

The pill recipe was not complicated and the ingredients were inexpensive, but that did not mean they could be refined carelessly.

The spiritual qi and grain essence within the Qingya Rice had to be refined together while separating out the small amount of turbid qi that was of no benefit to cultivators. If the fire was too strong, the grain essence would burn away. If it was too weak, moisture would remain, reducing the pills’ shelf life and causing them to spoil easily.

Lee Hyun’s fingers moved rapidly.

The flames at two of the six burners weakened.

Hummm–

The essence of the Qingya Rice revolving inside the pill furnace gradually gathered into one place.

Lee Hyun formed the final hand seal.

A moment later, the sound of small objects striking the bottom of the furnace rang out.

Clatter.

Lee Hyun extinguished the flames and opened the lid. A faint radiance bloomed within.

Then a savory fragrance surged out with warm steam.

Twelve pale-green pills rested at the bottom of the furnace.

Lee Hyun took them out one by one and checked their color and luster, aroma, medicinal strength, and remaining moisture.

Three mid grade.

Nine low grade.

There were no failed pills.

“I think I’m starting to get the hang of it.”

A voice came from behind him.

“I think you’re well past merely getting the hang of it.”

Luo Jingwen, Shen Yanzhu, and Pei Jingsong had entered the alchemy chamber without him noticing.

“Senior Brother Luo, Senior Sister Shen, Senior Brother Pei.”

Luo Jingwen inspected the pills before Lee Hyun.

“I heard you haven’t even been learning to refine Hunger-Warding Pills for two months yet, Junior Brother Li?”

“That’s right.”

“And yet you produced three mid grade pills in a single furnace batch without a single failed pill?”

Luo Jingwen exclaimed in admiration.

“Junior Brother Li, you’re an alchemy genius!”

Shen Yanzhu clicked her tongue.

“You’re already calling him a genius just because he made one good batch of Hunger-Warding Pills?”

“It wasn’t only once. According to the records, including this batch, he’s achieved successful pill formation in nine consecutive furnace batches. Even if they’re only Hunger-Warding Pills, that’s incredible.”

Pei Jingsong took samples from Lee Hyun’s previous batches out of a jade bottle on one side of the table and compared them one by one with the freshly completed Hunger-Warding Pills.

“There’s almost no difference in medicinal strength from batch to batch.”

“Is that impressive?”

At Lee Hyun’s question, Pei Jingsong nodded.

“Isn’t your control over spiritual power a bit too good? You’re better than I am.”

Shen Yanzhu examined the newly refined Hunger-Warding Pills as well.

“Huh? No, seriously, you really are good. Come to think of it, didn’t you say you’d been learning alchemy since your days as a rogue cultivator?”

“I only learned the basics.”

“Your fundamentals must have been incredibly solid.”

‘I did spend a very long time drilling the basics.’

Lee Hyun put on a suitably embarrassed expression.

Luo Jingwen folded his arms.

“I suppose we should tell Master. A remarkable talent has joined Pill Cauldron Peak. Who knows what schemes the other peaks might hatch to steal him away?”

Shen Yanzhu sighed.

“We’re the only peak that practices alchemy. What kind of scheme could there possibly be?”

“That simply means we haven’t discovered it yet. Think about it. How could a cultivation sect possibly not have hidden conspiracies? I’m sure there are another nine peaks underground... no, perhaps eighteen.”

“What kind of nonsense is that? You think the Changchun Sect has peaks we don’t know about? Even the sect’s grand formation is called the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation. And if they’re underground, how would they even be peaks?”

Lee Hyun let their conversation wash over him as he divided the finished Hunger-Warding Pills among several medicine bottles.

Refining Hunger-Warding Pills was one of the most common missions undertaken by disciples of Pill Cauldron Peak. The sect provided the ingredients and alchemy chamber, and once a disciple delivered at least the required quantity of pills, contribution points were awarded according to the yield and quality. Wasting medicinal ingredients reduced the reward, while producing many mid grade or better pills earned additional contribution points.

Over the past two months, Lee Hyun had refined several kinds of basic pills, including Hunger-Warding Pills. Once he turned in this batch, he would have 55 contribution points.

‘It’s about time.’

...

The next day.

Changchun Peak, Scripture Pavilion.

“Follow me.”

Lin Daoqian opened the door behind his desk and entered a narrow corridor.

Small stone chambers lined the far end of the passage.

When he inserted Lee Hyun’s identity token into a groove beside one of them, the engraved formation inscription glowed faintly.

Hummm–

“I’ll deduct 40 contribution points.”

The number on the identity token dropped to 15.

Lin Daoqian removed the identity token from the groove and returned it to Lee Hyun, and the stone door opened.

Inside were only a chair and a low stone dais. A gray jade slip floated above it, surrounded by a small restriction.

“The jade slip may only be viewed here. You must not record its contents or transmit them outside.”

“Understood.”

“When you’ve finished reading, press your identity token against the formation inscription on the inner wall. The door will open.”

Lin Daoqian withdrew, and the stone door closed.

Lee Hyun sat down and pressed the gray jade slip to his forehead.

Hummm–

Words, diagrams of the human meridians, and illustrations depicting the circulation of spiritual power flooded into his consciousness.

《Primordial One-Qi Art》 Foundation Establishment Section.

Lee Hyun had already circulated the Qi Refining Section for more than a thousand years. Thanks to that, the mnemonic formulas of the Foundation Establishment Section did not feel unfamiliar, and he committed its contents to memory one by one as he followed the flow of spiritual power.

Half a shichen (about one hour) later.

Lee Hyun lowered the jade slip and reviewed everything in his mind several times from beginning to end. There were no passages where he stumbled or found his memory blank.

‘I remember it all.’

He rose from his seat.

...

After leaving the stone chamber, Lee Hyun did not immediately leave the Scripture Pavilion.

‘Since I’m already here, I might as well look around a little more.’

He headed toward the section dealing with spirit plants and medicinal ingredients.

Although he had read a great deal in the Scripture Pavilion over the past two months, he suddenly realized he had barely read anything specifically about spirit plants.

Since the Changchun Sect primarily dealt in alchemy and spirit plants, the Scripture Pavilion naturally contained a great deal of related material.

《Harvesting and Storing Root and Rhizome Spirit Plants》, 《Three Hundred Cases of Incompatibility among Spirit Plants》....

Lee Hyun scanned the titles of books and jade slips one by one before suddenly pulling out a volume.

《Record of Medicinal Uses of Aquatic Spirit Plants》.

As Lee Hyun turned the pages, a familiar name caught his eye.

「Yin Water Lotus.

It grows in ponds rich in yin qi where water qi gathers evenly. The flowers and lotus leaves also possess medicinal potency, but the most widely used part is the seed found within a fully matured lotus pod. Consuming Yin Water Lotus seeds raw helps expel pill toxins with the breath. They are also used as a supplementary ingredient in certain pills.」

‘They can expel pill toxins?’

Despite having eaten them as snacks all this time, he had never imagined they possessed medicinal effects.

‘No wonder I always felt refreshed whenever I ate them.’

He suddenly thought of the Stone Honey Peach as well.

‘If Yin Water Lotus had a use like this, Stone Honey Peaches might have effects I don’t know about either.’

He searched through several more spirit-fruit reference books nearby, but the name Stone Honey Peach never appeared.

‘Maybe it has a different name depending on the region. I can look into it slowly later.’

...

That night.

His residence on Pill Cauldron Peak.

Lee Hyun closed the door to his cultivation chamber and lay comfortably on the floor.

He reviewed the Foundation Establishment Section of the 《Primordial One-Qi Art》 he had memorized in the Scripture Pavilion from beginning to end.

‘I see.... If I’d tried to force the breakthrough with only the Qi Refining Section, I would’ve gone through a great deal of trial and error while my spiritual power was liquefying. If I’d also mishandled the remaining medicinal potency of the Foundation Establishment Pill, it could have strained my meridians. Good thing I obtained this in advance.’

Lee Hyun was in an excellent mood. Foundation Establishment cultivation arts were precious to begin with, yet he had managed to obtain one in advance while he was only at Qi Refining Stage 6.

He might not have had some grand ambition to reach the very pinnacle as a cultivator, but becoming stronger brought an indescribable thrill. Cultivation was addictive in its own way!

‘But the Grand Flight-Suppressing Formation was said to use mnemonic formulas from the Foundation Establishment Section to return Five-Element spiritual qi to the image of primordial unity. In that case, since I possess Primordial True Qi from the beginning, couldn’t I skip the Return to Unity process?’

It seemed possible. However, producing Earth-Origin Force required the Materialization that came after Return to Unity, and the formation also employed an earth vein, formation devices of the Five Elements, and a formation plate. The Foundation Establishment Section alone was not enough to tell him which mnemonic formulas the formation masters had adapted or how they had done so.

‘I should look for more material related to the Grand Flight-Suppressing Formation later.’

Knowledge from his previous life suddenly came to Lee Hyun.

‘If Earth-Origin Force really is similar to gravity, could it affect space and time at the extreme?’

‘And Great Simplicity is the fourth of the Five Precelestial Stages, isn’t it? If the Supreme Ultimate divides into the Two Modes, the Two Modes into the Four Images, and the Four Images into the Eight Trigrams, while the qualities of all things in heaven and earth manifest as the Five Elements... then the transformation imitated by Earth-Origin Force comes before all of that differentiation! In terms of its theoretical roots alone, it’s much closer to the source.’

Of course, power related to the Five Precelestial Stages themselves was something the current him could not even dream of touching.

Even the 《Treatise on Formations and the Five Precelestial Stages》 stated that Great Simplicity itself could not be reproduced using postcelestial Five-Element spiritual qi. Primordial True Qi was merely created by refining the postcelestial heaven-and-earth spiritual qi of the human realm.

And just because Earth-Origin Force imitated the transformation of Great Simplicity did not guarantee that it would always be stronger than postcelestial Five-Element techniques. Perhaps it was merely a matter of the order in which things emerged. After all, couldn’t a child surpass their parents?

‘I’m still only at Qi Refining Stage 6. First I should gather Essence-Raising Pills and reach Stage 7, then reach the limit of Stage 9 again and obtain a Foundation Establishment Pill. I can research Earth-Origin Force slowly.’

...

Several days later.

Songxi Market, a little over 800 li (about 314 km) east of the Changchun Sect.

A stout middle-aged cultivator with a short beard was squatting in front of a street stall selling old magic tools.

It was Lee Hyun, his appearance altered with a disguise method.

After leaving the Changchun Sect, he had changed direction several times and altered both his clothes and appearance. He had also suppressed his apparent cultivation realm to Qi Refining Stage 3.

The stall was cluttered with cracked shields, ownerless flying swords, and old formation plates.

Lee Hyun rummaged through the magic tools and picked up a stone tablet about the size of his two palms placed together.

A silver pattern resembling the bones of a human hand had been engraved on its surface.

“Is this used to measure bone age?”

The old man tending the stall nodded.

“That’s right.”

“Does it work properly?”

“It works accurately on Qi Refining cultivators and mortals. The margin of error is at most about a year.”

Lee Hyun purchased two more bone-age measuring magic tools from other shops, each operating on a different principle. Buying all three cost him 50 low-grade spirit stones.

...

Two days later.

Tunnel No. 2.

Lee Hyun headed to the storeroom first.

He cleared one section of a shelf and placed the bone-age measuring magic tools he had purchased at the cultivator market on it. Beside them, he placed a small wooden plaque and engraved words into it with the Yang Metal Art.

「Three types of magic tools for bone-age disguise tests using Bone-Forging Powder.

Record the medicine age of the medicinal ingredients, dosage, elapsed time after consumption, measured readings, and the point at which medicine-age traces disappear.」

Lee Hyun placed his hand on the three magic tools in turn.

They gave readings of nineteen, twenty, and nineteen.

He soon left the storeroom and went to the test spirit field, where he planted some of the spirit plants needed for Tier 1 Bone-Forging Powder.

The Bone-Rot Flower was the primary ingredient in Bone-Forging Powder and also required the highest medicine age in the pill recipe. It was therefore likely to have the greatest effect on the medicine-age traces left in the bones, so he planned to prepare Bone-Rot Flowers of different medicine ages first.

After tending to the test spirit field, Lee Hyun headed to Spirit Field No. 1-6.

Rrrrumble–

As the stone door opened, cool, damp air flowed out.

Broad lotus leaves spread across the pond, while lotus pods drooped between them.

Lee Hyun picked a fully ripened lotus pod and split it open. He removed one of the neatly arranged seeds inside, peeled away its shell, and put it in his mouth.

Crunch.

As he swallowed the seed, his chest felt cool and his breathing seemed to clear slightly.

“Maybe it feels even more refreshing now that I know what it does. Should I dig another pond?”

He created a new pond, separated a few nodes of young lotus rhizome from the existing pond, planted them in the mud of the new one, and filled it with water using the Spirit Rain Art.

...

Spirit Field No. 1-7.

Lee Hyun selected one healthy branch from each of the three Stone Honey Peach trees and cut them off.

He cast the Germination Art on the cut ends, wrapped them in wet cloth and soil, then planted them in three spots in the newly expanded spirit field.

If the three new Stone Honey Peach trees took root properly, there would be six of them in the spirit field.

‘The Yin Water Lotus had an unexpected effect. Maybe the Stone Honey Peach has something too.’

Even if it possessed no special medicinal effects, that was fine. It tasted good.

...

After finishing the spirit-field expansion, Lee Hyun inspected all the facilities in Tunnel No. 2.

First, he enlarged the irrigation reservoir located one level above the spirit fields.

He left thick stone pillars at regular intervals between the ceiling and floor of the reservoir. They were there to support the ceiling and prevent a collapse.

He built low stone walls inside the expanded reservoir, dividing it into several sections. That way, even if one section developed a crack, all the stored water would not pour out at once.

He also checked the bamboo pipes leading to each spirit field and replaced the worn ones.

Finally, he cast the Spirit Rain Art with an enormous amount of spiritual power.

Rooooosh–

A brief downpour fell inside the reservoir. Soon, clear water filled with spiritual qi rose until it filled even the newly expanded area.

Lee Hyun checked the amount of water flowing toward each spirit field and nodded.

“Now there shouldn’t be any problem with the automatic watering even if I leave this place unattended for about two years.”

...

Lee Hyun inspected the remaining spirit fields in turn.

The Bone-Rot Flowers, Purple Poison Orchids, Yin Soul Grass, and Spirit-Storing Ginseng were all safe and sound.

The fuzzbees swarmed toward him as soon as he appeared.

Bzz– bzzbzzbzz– bzzbzz–

Squeak. Squeak squeak squeak. Squeak squeak.

Before he knew it, a year had passed since Lee Hyun joined the Changchun Sect.

Even five years after the Qingmu Ridge Herb Robbery, the Changchun Sect had yet to relax its vigilance. Disciples returning from outside missions had to present their identity tokens at both the outer formation and inner formation of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.

Routes for transporting spirit plants and pills were only disclosed immediately before departure, and disciples entrusted with important supplies formed teams with cultivators from different peaks. Foundation Establishment Elders took turns being stationed at the warehouse and Mission Hall of External Affairs Peak.

All those procedures had long since become routine, yet the identity of those responsible for the herb robbery remained unknown.

Lee Hyun paid little attention to the herb robbery. It was hardly something a nominal disciple who had joined only a year ago needed to worry about.

He only needed to do his assigned work well, learn alchemy and techniques, and gather the pills he needed.

During that time, Lee Hyun traveled through cultivator markets near the sect and purchased seven Essence-Raising Pills. He placed them in a jade casket, sealed it with a Tier 1 Spirit-Sealing Talisman, and stored it in his storage pouch.

‘Hmm... When am I ever going to buy all forty-three more? It seems I’m still a long way from being valued highly enough to be taught the Essence-Raising Pill recipe...’

Lee Hyun was slightly disappointed when he heard that even Senior Brother Luo, who was at Qi Refining Stage 9, had not been taught the Essence-Raising Pill recipe. Perhaps the recipe was only transmitted to Foundation Establishment Elders.

...

Then one day.

The lounge in Yang Fire Court.

Luo Jingwen dropped a mission token onto the table and grumbled.

“Damn it...”

Lee Hyun looked up from the book he was reading.

“What happened?”

“They say Essence-Raising Pills aren’t selling as well as they used to.”

Luo Jingwen folded his arms and leaned deep into his chair.

“Apparently, a merchant caravan from a cultivation nation on another continent recently released a large quantity of pills used for breaking through into late Qi Refining. Because of that, the market price of Essence-Raising Pills has fallen somewhat throughout the Lan Kingdom.”

“I see.”

Luo Jingwen tapped the mission token with one finger.

“The problem is that the sales mission issued by External Affairs Peak came up on my turn. They’ll give me a mission sales counter at the Changchun Pill Pavilion, and I’m supposed to sell thirty Essence-Raising Pills for at least 230 low-grade spirit stones each.”

“How much time do you have?”

“Three months.”

“Isn’t that plenty?”

“Until they’re all sold, I have to spend ten days each month sitting at the Changchun Pill Pavilion’s sales counter. I need to refine pills and figure out how to obtain a Foundation Establishment Pill. Wasting my time sitting in a shop just to sell Essence-Raising Pills is driving me mad.”

“Senior Brother Luo.”

“What is it?”

“I’ll do it.”

Luo Jingwen blinked.

“Do what?”

“The mission to sell the Essence-Raising Pills.”

“You, Junior Brother Li?”

“I’m fairly talented at selling things.”

“I thought alchemy was your only talent. You’re good at business too?”

“When you spend a long time as a rogue cultivator, one of the first things you learn is how to buy and sell what you need.”

Luo Jingwen’s expression brightened.

“You’d really take it off my hands?”

“Yes.”

“Perfect!”

Luo Jingwen rose from his seat and held out the mission token to Lee Hyun.

“I haven’t collected the Essence-Raising Pills from External Affairs Peak yet. Go to the steward at the Mission Hall, change the person assigned to the mission, then collect the Essence-Raising Pills and head to the Changchun Pill Pavilion on External Affairs Peak. The shop manager will give you a sales counter. That way, once the mission is complete, the contribution points will go to you as well.”

“Understood.”

“You just need to sell them all and bring back at least the required amount of spirit stones.”

“Do I also need to identify every buyer and submit their information?”

“Of course not. If we told people they had to reveal their identities before we’d sell to them, cautious cultivators would never buy anything.”

“I see.”

“The Changchun Pill Pavilion’s ledger only needs the quantity sold and the amount of spirit stones received. Whether the buyer is a rogue cultivator hiding his face or an agent from a merchant caravan, as long as they pay the proper price, that’s all that matters.”

Lee Hyun accepted the mission token.

“Thank you, Junior Brother Li. I’ll buy you some good wine later!”

Luo Jingwen hurried out of the lounge.

Chapter 36

The next day, Lee Hyun headed to the Mission Hall on the Changchun Sect's External Affairs Peak.

"I came to change the person in charge of the Essence-Raising Pill sales mission."

The steward at the Mission Hall checked Luo Jingwen's mission token and Lee Hyun's identity token in turn.

"Li Dong'er of Pill Cauldron Peak?"

"That's right."

"You're taking over the mission from Luo Jingwen?"

"Yes."

When the steward placed the mission token on a small formation plate, the name inscribed on its surface changed from Luo Jingwen to Li Dong'er.

Vmmm–

"The Essence-Raising Pills are at the Changchun Pill Pavilion. Sell all thirty pills and turn in at least 6,900 low-grade spirit stones, and the mission will be complete."

"Am I not allowed to take the Essence-Raising Pills outside the sect to sell them?"

"No. We can't very well entrust goods of that value to a Qi Refining disciple and send him outside, only for him to run off or encounter a bandit cultivator, can we? You must sell them inside the Changchun Pill Pavilion in the External Affairs Market."

"Understood."

...

Changchun Sect's External Affairs Market.

The External Affairs Market was situated between the outer formation and inner formation of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation. Outside cultivators and merchant groups could enter as far as the inside of the outer formation after undergoing a simple inspection at the Mountain Gate, but they could not pass through the inner formation surrounding the nine peaks.

Most of the shops dealing in pills, spirit plants, magic tools, and talismans produced by the Changchun Sect were gathered here.

There were shops and warehouses that purchased outside goods, stalls run by outside rogue cultivators with the sect's permission, and even inns for visiting merchant groups.

The taxes and stall fees were slightly higher than at other cultivator markets, but the place was quite safe thanks to the Changchun Sect maintaining order. As a result, the External Affairs Market was fairly prosperous, with a steady stream of outside cultivators passing through.

At the center of the External Affairs Market stood a large three-story pavilion.

「Changchun Pill Pavilion」

Long sales counters filled the first floor of the Changchun Pill Pavilion, where Changchun Sect disciples attended to customers with the goods assigned to them laid out in front.

Lee Hyun found the manager and presented his mission token.

"I've been assigned the Essence-Raising Pill sales mission."

"Follow me."

The manager led Lee Hyun to a storeroom behind the sales counters. Countless jade caskets and medicine bottles were stored inside formations set up throughout the room.

He took out a jade casket from deeper inside and opened it.

Click.

Ten small jade bottles were neatly arranged inside. Each bottle contained three Essence-Raising Pills, thirty in total.

Lee Hyun took one Essence-Raising Pill from each bottle and examined its color and fragrance. Using the Aura-Reading Art together with his divine sense, he even checked the medicinal strength within. There were slight differences in quality, but none were failed pills or pills with damaged medicinal potency.

'They're all normal low-grade pills.'

The manager spoke.

"The minimum selling price is 230 low-grade spirit stones per pill. If you sell them for more, the difference is your reward, but if you sell them for less, you'll have to make up the shortfall yourself."

"Understood."

Lee Hyun quickly calculated in his head.

'Thirty pills at 230 each makes 6,900.'

He currently had thirty mid-grade spirit stones and 320 low-grade spirit stones. Since he had already traveled around nearby cultivator markets buying seven Essence-Raising Pills and magic tools that measured bone age, he was nearly out of low-grade spirit stones.

Converted entirely into low-grade spirit stones, even including his mid-grade spirit stones, he had 3,320.

That was enough to buy fourteen Essence-Raising Pills and leave him with 100 low-grade spirit stones.

The ledger only required the number of pills sold and the spirit stones received. There was no need to record the buyers' identities.

'If I sell just sixteen pills to outside cultivators, I can buy the remaining fourteen myself.'

Still, if all thirty Essence-Raising Pills suddenly sold when there were barely any customers, it might attract unnecessary attention.

'Let's see how many actually sell first.'

...

Lee Hyun sat at the mission sales counter set up on one side of the Changchun Pill Pavilion.

Around noon, a Qi Refining Stage 6 rogue cultivator approached the counter. He examined the jade bottles containing the Essence-Raising Pills and asked,

"If I buy two, can you give me a small discount?"

"I'm afraid not."

"I hear those Essence-Unblocking Pills circulating outside these days don't even cost 200 low-grade spirit stones each."

"The Essence-Raising Pills are refined directly by the Changchun Sect, and both their medicinal potency and origin are guaranteed. Which one you choose is up to you."

"......."

The rogue cultivator gave Lee Hyun a strange look.

"Are you actually trying to sell these?"

"I don't have the authority to sell below the minimum price."

"Give me two for 220 each."

"The minimum price is 230."

"Hmph. We'll see how long the Changchun Sect can insist on that price."

The rogue cultivator turned and left.

Lee Hyun watched him walk away.

'Essence-Unblocking Pills.... If they have the same effect, I should look into them myself.'

Apparently, that was the name of a breakthrough pill released onto the market by a merchant group from another continent.

Not a single Essence-Raising Pill sold on the first day. On the second day, a middle-aged cultivator bought one, and on the tenth day, someone who looked like the steward of a cultivation clan bought two. Another one or two sold here and there in between, bringing the first month's total sales to seven pills.

'Seven a month. That's about right.'

...

The day after finishing his sales duty for the first month, Lee Hyun visited the Scripture Pavilion on Changchun Peak.

He was looking for information on Tier-1 Flight-Suppressing Formations that could be referenced even at the Qi Refining stage. Since he was still cultivating the Qi Refining Section of the Primordial One-Qi Art, it seemed he first needed to understand the Materialization mnemonic formula used in Tier-1 formations if he wanted to manifest Earth-Origin Force.

Lee Hyun first pressed a jade slip titled Explanation of Tier-1 Flight-Suppressing Formations to his forehead.

A Tier-1 Flight-Suppressing Formation was not powerful enough to drag down a Foundation Establishment cultivator. At most, it could knock Qi Refining cultivators using Tier-1 Flight Talismans or flight magic tools out of the air. However, the fundamental principle by which it generated Earth-Origin Force seemed no different from that of a Tier-2 Grand Flight-Suppressing Formation.

'As expected, Return to Unity is the most complicated part. But Primordial True Qi is already similar to energy that has completed Return to Unity. If that's the case, I should be able to use the Materialization mnemonic formula directly....'

The materials on the public shelves contained only part of the Materialization mnemonic formula. In the end, Lee Hyun spent ten contribution points to consult the Tier-1 Earth-Origin Flight-Suppressing Formation Diagram and studied its contents.

...

That night.

The cultivation chamber at his residence on Pill Cauldron Peak.

Lee Hyun stretched out a hand toward a small pebble.

Vmmm–

The pebble trembled faintly.

...

One month later.

Several merchant groups arrived at the External Affairs Market, bringing more outside cultivators through the market than the previous month.

Essence-Raising Pills continued to sell little by little at Lee Hyun's counter during the second month. Nine sold that month, and together with the seven from the previous month, the total came to exactly sixteen.

'That's enough.'

After finishing his sales duty, Lee Hyun checked the Essence-Raising Pills remaining at the counter. Exactly fourteen pills remained in the jade bottles.

He transferred the Essence-Raising Pills into his storage pouch. In their place, he put thirty mid-grade spirit stones and 220 low-grade spirit stones into the box containing the sales proceeds.

Converted into low-grade spirit stones, that came to 3,220.

Exactly the price of fourteen Essence-Raising Pills.

Lee Hyun divided the fourteen pills he had bought for himself among the ledger entries and added them to the recorded sales.

...

The manager of the Changchun Pill Pavilion checked the ledger and mission token in turn.

"You sold all thirty Essence-Raising Pills."

"That's right."

"And the proceeds are exactly 6,900 low-grade spirit stones.... Good work. You should receive your contribution points once you go to the Mission Hall."

"Thank you."

...

The lounge of the Yang Fire Court.

Luo Jingwen exclaimed in admiration after hearing that Lee Hyun had completed the mission.

"You really sold them all in just two months!"

"I was lucky."

"If I'd stayed in charge, I'd probably still be sitting at that sales counter. I suppose everyone has something they're good at."

Shen Yanzhu, who was drinking tea nearby, asked,

"I heard Essence-Raising Pills haven't been selling well lately because of the Essence-Unblocking Pills. You actually managed to finish the mission?"

"It seems so. I'm glad."

...

That night.

His residence on Pill Cauldron Peak.

Lee Hyun lined up several jade caskets on the floor of the cultivation chamber.

Seven Essence-Raising Pills he had previously accumulated.

Fourteen Essence-Raising Pills purchased during this mission.

Twenty-one pills in total.

"I should buy a few more jade caskets and Tier-1 Spirit-Sealing Talismans. But even sealed, it won't be good to store them for too long...."

Only then did Lee Hyun realize a problem he had overlooked when he first began stockpiling Essence-Raising Pills.

'I'm still only at the beginning of Qi Refining Stage 6. To cross the barrier to Stage 7 as efficiently as possible, I should first reach the absolute limit of Stage 6.'

Taking Essence-Raising Pills now would still raise the upper limit of his spiritual power. However, if he took them before reaching the barrier of his realm, the medicinal effect that loosened that barrier would likely go to waste.

'Then even if I take fifty Essence-Raising Pills, I might still fail to break through to Stage 7 and end up only increasing my spiritual power limit.'

Yet if he waited until reaching the absolute limit of Stage 6, there was no telling how long that would take because of the nature of the Primordial Body. In the meantime, the medicinal strength of the pills inside the jade caskets would continue to dissipate.

'I've already bought twenty-one....'

After thinking for a long while, Lee Hyun's gaze changed.

'Wait. Do I really have to reach the limit of Stage 6 first? If I take enough pills to fill my spiritual power limit and still have enough medicinal strength left over to push against the barrier of my realm, couldn't I finish both processes at once?'

'What if I take around a hundred similar pills?'

Lee Hyun checked one side of the storage pouch that had held his spirit stones. Only 100 low-grade spirit stones remained.

"I'll need to earn some spirit stones."

...

A few days later.

Tunnel No. 2.

Rrrrrumble–

As the stone door to Spirit Field No. 1-1 opened, a dense medicinal fragrance and poisonous pollen flowed out.

Lee Hyun walked along the field, checking the medicine age of the Bone-Rot Flowers.

"Three hundred forty-four years...."

When Lee Hyun used the Soil-Turning Art, one Bone-Rot Flower rose from the ground with its roots and surrounding soil intact.

After repeating the process, twenty Bone-Rot Flower mother plants stood in a row along one side of the spirit field.

'There are only eighty-one Bone-Rot Flowers left in Spirit Field No. 1-1 now. But there are another 433 from Spirit Field No. 1-2 through No. 1-5, so I still have plenty.'

All that remained was to sell the Bone-Rot Flowers. The problem was where.

'If I want a proper price, I'll need to go to southern Nanli Kingdom.'

The Qingchao Merchant Alliance refined Tier-2 Bone-Forging Powder and steadily purchased old Bone-Rot Flower mother plants.

'Even if I run into the Qingchao Merchant Alliance's alliance elders, they probably won't recognize me.'

When Lee Hyun had clashed with the Qingchao Merchant Alliance's alliance elders on Chiyao Island, he had been disguised as Li Mo, a guest alchemist in his fifties. This time, he planned to change not only his face and build, but also his manner of speaking and even the spiritual power he revealed.

Lee Hyun placed the twenty Bone-Rot Flowers into his storage pouch.

...

Fifteen days later.

Nanya Market, southern Nanli Kingdom.

A tall man in a black long robe entered the Qingchao Merchant Alliance's Spirit Materials Hall. Gray streaked the hair at his temples, and a long scar ran down his left cheek.

The cultivation realm he revealed was merely an ordinary Qi Refining Stage 6. Yet when the man silently swept his gaze across the interior, the clerks felt an inexplicable sense of intimidation. Whenever their eyes met his, their voices unconsciously grew quieter and their bodies trembled.

"I've come to sell Bone-Rot Flower mother plants."

"How many?"

"Three."

He tapped his storage pouch, and three flowerpots appeared one after another.

Whoosh–

Dense poisonous pollen billowed from the ivory petals, and the clerk hurriedly activated a formation.

Vmmm–

The poisonous pollen was trapped behind a transparent barrier.

The steward, who had been looking over a ledger farther inside, came over personally. He examined the patterns on the Bone-Rot Flowers' petals, stems, and roots one by one. He took a small amount of poisonous pollen and singed it over a flame, then inspected the medicinal potency flowing from the roots.

The appraisal continued for quite some time.

"All three have a medicine age of around three hundred forty years."

"Three hundred forty-four, I'd say."

"...You're exactly right. Were they grown in the same place?"

"Is there any reason I should tell you that?"

"No."

The steward immediately stepped away, worked an abacus for a moment, then said,

"We'll offer 860 low-grade spirit stones per plant."

The man gave no answer and merely looked at the steward in silence.

"Eight hundred eighty...."

"......."

The steward unconsciously swallowed.

Facing the man's presence head-on, a creeping fear crawled up his spine, much like the terror he had felt when encountering a bear or tiger as a child.

'Why am I so afraid of him? Could he be a powerful cultivator hiding his realm?'

"These are r-rare mother plants, and they're in excellent condition. Taking their scarcity into account as well, we'll offer 900."

"Fine."

Only then did the pressure weighing on the steward's chest lift.

The clerks brought over twenty-seven mid-grade spirit stones. The man checked their number and condition before placing them into his storage pouch.

"I've received them."

He turned and left the Spirit Materials Hall.

Only after the man had completely disappeared did the surrounding clerks quietly exhale.

One clerk asked,

"At a medicine age of three hundred forty-four years, wouldn't they be difficult to use even for Tier-2 Bone-Forging Powder?"

The steward replied,

"I don't know the pill recipe for Tier-2 Bone-Forging Powder either. In any case, they fall within the alliance's purchasing criteria."

"Didn't we pay a little too much?"

"If we considered only their inherent value, around 880 would have been appropriate. Still, mother plants this old and in such pristine condition aren't common."

...

Ten days later.

The Qingchao Merchant Alliance's Spirit Materials Hall.

Purchase ledgers sent in from branches across the southern region were piled on the table. At first, the steward of the Spirit Materials Hall flipped through them without much thought.

"Two Bone-Rot Flowers... medicine age, three hundred forty-four years."

"One plant... three hundred forty-four years?"

His hand stopped.

When he hurriedly opened the other ledgers, records of recent Bone-Rot Flower purchases from different branches appeared one after another.

Every one of them had a medicine age of three hundred forty-four years.

The sellers varied in appearance, sex, and cultivation realm.

A stooped old man.

A middle-aged man with a sword on his back.

A female cultivator with her face covered.

A sickly young cultivator.

A mute rogue cultivator.

Including them, nearly ten different sellers were recorded in the ledgers.

The steward ordered the purchased Bone-Rot Flowers brought to him personally.

The next day, Bone-Rot Flowers purchased at nearby branches and appraisal records sent from distant branches gathered at the Spirit Materials Hall. Their appearances differed slightly, but the flow of their medicinal potency and the properties of the soil clinging to their roots were almost identical.

They had clearly all been grown in the same spirit field.

"How many have we purchased so far?"

"Twenty plants, based on the reports we've received."

"Twenty?"

The steward slammed his palm down on the table.

Bang!

"Dammit! If I'd known this many Bone-Rot Flowers of the exact same medicine age were going to hit the market, I never would've paid 900 per plant!"

"They are perfectly normal mother plants, though...."

"I know that!"

The steward ground his teeth.

"If I'd known the quantity from the start, I would've lowered the price. After all, our alliance is the only place around here that produces Tier-2 Bone-Forging Powder in large quantities."

The steward let out a long sigh.

"We've been had."

...

Meanwhile.

A mountain range in northern Nanli Kingdom.

Lee Hyun sat on a rock counting spirit stones.

Selling twenty Bone-Rot Flower mother plants had earned him 180 mid-grade spirit stones. Converted into low-grade spirit stones, that was an astounding 18,000!

"They sold well. The Qingchao Merchant Alliance will have a bit of a headache over this."

Lee Hyun put the spirit stones into his storage pouch as he calculated the price of Essence-Raising Pills.

To purchase another eighty Essence-Raising Pills at the current price, he would need 18,400 low-grade spirit stones.

Even adding the 100 low-grade spirit stones he already had only brought him to 18,100. He was 300 short.

Moreover, there was no guarantee the price of Essence-Raising Pills would remain at 230 forever. If the supply of imported pills dwindled, the price could climb back above 250.

'Wait, imported pills....'

He remembered the Essence-Unblocking Pills he had heard about at the Changchun Pill Pavilion.

'They said large quantities had been released all across Lan Kingdom, didn't they?'

...

A few days later.

Lee Hyun purchased one Essence-Unblocking Pill at a nearby cultivator market. He immediately entered a secluded cavern in the mountains and began by analyzing the pill's medicinal potency.

'It's similar to an Essence-Raising Pill. Not bad.'

Lee Hyun began traveling among cultivator markets throughout Lan Kingdom, purchasing Essence-Unblocking Pills.

...

One month later.

His residence on Pill Cauldron Peak.

Lee Hyun lined up jade caskets on the floor.

Twenty-one Essence-Raising Pills.

Sixty Essence-Unblocking Pills.

The sixty Essence-Unblocking Pills had cost him 120 mid-grade spirit stones. After also purchasing new jade caskets and Tier-1 Spirit-Sealing Talismans, he had sixty mid-grade spirit stones and ninety low-grade spirit stones left in his storage pouch.

...

Afterward, Lee Hyun took on the Essence-Raising Pill sales mission one more time. Since there was already a record of him completing his first mission without incident, External Affairs Peak entrusted him with another thirty Essence-Raising Pills without any particular suspicion.

Perhaps because the supply of Essence-Unblocking Pills had dwindled, this time there were customers willing to buy Essence-Raising Pills even at 250 low-grade spirit stones apiece. Over the course of a month, Lee Hyun sold six pills to outside cultivators for a total of 1,500 spirit stones.

After examining the number of customers passing through the External Affairs Market and the Changchun Pill Pavilion's overall sales volume, Lee Hyun placed the remaining twenty-four Essence-Raising Pills into his storage pouch.

In exchange, he put 5,520 of his own spirit stones into the box containing the sales proceeds, then divided those twenty-four pills appropriately among the ledger entries and added them to the recorded sales as well.

The total sales came to 7,020 low-grade spirit stones.

After handing only the required 6,900 low-grade spirit stones over to the Mission Hall according to the rules, Lee Hyun was left with 690 low-grade spirit stones.

Three months later.

Pill Cauldron Peak.

Lee Hyun's residence.

Large and small jade caskets stood in rows across the cultivation chamber floor.

Forty-five Essence-Raising Pills.

Sixty Essence-Unblocking Pills.

Several dozen ripe Yin Water Lotus seedpods.

During that time, Lee Hyun had repeatedly checked whether the medicinal potencies of the two pills conflicted, but found no problems.

It was finally time to attempt his breakthrough.

Lee Hyun informed his fellow disciples on Pill Cauldron Peak that he was entering secluded cultivation, then closed the door to his cultivation chamber.

From deep within his storage pouch, he took out four old Sound-Isolating Talismans and Spirit-Concealing Talismans. They were elementary-grade Tier-1 talismans he had obtained from Wei Wendao, Peng Ziliang, and Han Xiaobai some five hundred years ago.

Almost all the spiritual power remaining in the talismans had faded away, but the spirit inscriptions and talisman inscriptions themselves were intact.

Lee Hyun recalled the basic talisman-crafting art he had read long ago as he examined the structure of the talismans. After confirming they were undamaged, he slowly infused them with his Primordial True Qi.

Vmmm–

The faded talisman inscriptions brightened one by one.

The Sound-Isolating Talismans blocked sound from entering or leaving the cultivation chamber, while the Spirit-Concealing Talismans prevented the spiritual-power fluctuations produced during the breakthrough from spreading beyond the residence.

Lee Hyun inserted low-grade spirit stones one by one into the grooves of the Qi-Gathering Formation installed in the cultivation chamber.

Click. Click.

Eight in total.

He would not have used spirit stones for ordinary cultivation. But with the success of his breakthrough uncertain, this was no time to be stingy.

Vmmmm–

As the Qi-Gathering Formation activated, the spiritual pressure inside the cultivation chamber rose noticeably. The dense heaven-and-earth spiritual qi within the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation flowed into the cultivation chamber along the Qi-Gathering Formation.

Lee Hyun placed the jade caskets within reach and lay comfortably on the floor.

First, he took out an Essence-Unblocking Pill.

Gulp.

As the pill slid down his throat, its medicinal strength spread through his meridians. Lee Hyun circulated the Primordial One-Qi Art, mixing the medicinal strength into his Primordial True Qi.

...

A day passed.

Seventeen Essence-Unblocking Pills were gone.

Lee Hyun's spiritual power had increased noticeably, but he was still far from the limit of Qi Refining Stage 6. Unrefined medicinal potency and pill toxins had begun to accumulate throughout his body.

Lee Hyun split open a seedpod from a Yin Water Lotus and removed the seeds inside. He peeled them and put them into his mouth.

Crunch.

A cool energy spread through his chest and into his meridians.

Lee Hyun slowly exhaled.

Haaaa–

Pale gray turbid qi flowed out with his breath. The qi that settled on the floor gave off a bitter, fishy medicinal odor.

Yin Water Lotus seeds could not eliminate all pill toxins. However, they were a considerable help to Lee Hyun, who needed to consume more than a hundred pills in succession.

After that, whenever the pill toxins grew too concentrated, Lee Hyun ate Yin Water Lotus seeds and expelled the turbid qi little by little.

...

The third day.

All sixty Essence-Unblocking Pills were gone.

Lee Hyun's Primordial True Qi had reached late Qi Refining Stage 6 and filled his entire body to the brim, but he still could not feel the barrier of his realm.

"Still not enough."

Lee Hyun opened the jade casket containing the Essence-Raising Pills. A steadier medicinal fragrance than that of the Essence-Unblocking Pills spread through the chamber.

When he swallowed one Essence-Raising Pill, even stronger medicinal strength surged throughout his body.

Whoooosh–

Primordial True Qi circulated violently through his meridians.

...

The fifth day.

Thirty Essence-Raising Pills were gone.

Lee Hyun's Primordial True Qi had risen to the absolute limit of Qi Refining Stage 6. There was almost no room anywhere in his body to accept new spiritual power.

Only then did he finally feel the invisible barrier.

Lee Hyun continued taking Essence-Raising Pills.

Thirty-one.

Thirty-two.

Thirty-three.

Each pill he consumed sent its medicinal strength pounding against the barrier of his realm.

Thump. Thump.

When the medicinal strength of the fortieth Essence-Raising Pill spread through him, a hairline crack finally appeared in the invisible barrier.

Crack.

Lee Hyun checked the remaining Essence-Raising Pills.

Five.

"Please work."

He took the forty-first Essence-Raising Pill, and the crack widened slightly.

When the medicinal strength of the forty-second Essence-Raising Pill spread through him, Primordial True Qi spun through his meridians like a storm.

Forty-third.

Gulp.

The Essence-Raising Pill dissolved. Powerful medicinal strength flooded throughout his body and mixed with his Primordial True Qi.

Lee Hyun circulated the Primordial One-Qi Art to its absolute limit.

Whoosh–

His Primordial True Qi surged all at once toward the barrier of his realm.

Crrrraaack!

The next moment.

Boom!

The barrier completely collapsed.

The suppressed Primordial True Qi surged violently into a new realm.

Woooooosh–

Dense heaven-and-earth spiritual qi rushed into Lee Hyun's body. The low-grade spirit stones inserted into the Qi-Gathering Formation rapidly lost their light, while the Spirit-Concealing Talismans and Sound-Isolating Talismans attached to the walls blackened as they endured the violent spiritual-power fluctuations.

The fluctuations that had continued for so long gradually subsided.

At last, Lee Hyun opened his eyes.

"It worked!"

Unconcealed joy filled his voice.

...

Lee Hyun spent the next day circulating the Primordial One-Qi Art and stabilizing his new realm. Two unused Essence-Raising Pills remained inside the jade casket.

He took a wooden board from his storage pouch and used the Yang Metal Art to revise the numbers on his handmade status screen.

【Age: 1,098】

【Realm: Qi Refining Stage 7】

【Spiritual Power: 517 → 733】

【Constitution: Primordial Body, 7th Stage】

His spiritual power had changed slightly not only in quantity, but in quality as well.

His Primordial True Qi was condensed to a higher density than before. Even when using the same technique, it seemed he could now produce greater power.

Lee Hyun stood and lightly stretched his body.

Crack. Crack.

His back and shoulders gave satisfying pops.

"Good."

He suddenly recalled the Earth-Origin Force he had been researching over the past several months.

Lee Hyun condensed Materialized Primordial True Qi in his palm to create a temporary anchor for the Earth-Origin Force, then extended his hand.

The moment Lee Hyun exerted his mental intent.

Fwoooosh!

A nearby wooden plaque, iron ball, and pebble shot toward Lee Hyun's palm.

Lee Hyun cast the Spirit Light Shield.

Clang-clang-clang!

The iron ball, pebble, and wooden plaque struck the Spirit Light Shield one after another. Unable to withstand the impact, the wooden plaque shattered into pieces.

"It really works?"

Chapter 37

After testing it for a while, Lee Hyun discovered that he could choose the target upon which the Earth-Origin Force acted.

When he raised his left hand, the blackened Spirit-Concealing Talismans and Sound-Isolating Talismans attached to the walls on all sides flew toward him in an instant.

He flicked a finger, and a small flame sprang to life, reducing the talismans to ash.

He put the jade caskets and medicine bottles he had laid out across the cultivation chamber floor into his storage pouch. Only after thoroughly cleaning away even the spirit stone powder left in the grooves of the Qi-Gathering Formation did he leave the cultivation chamber.

Creak―

The moment he opened the door, the fresh morning sunlight streamed into the cultivation chamber.

Lee Hyun narrowed his eyes and gazed at the light for a moment.

Perhaps because he had spent the past several days shut inside the cultivation chamber, or perhaps because of the joy of his breakthrough, even ordinary sunlight seemed exceptionally clear and bright.

He slowly adjusted the aura emanating from his body.

Once he activated the Aura-Concealing Art and Spirit-Concealing Art, all that could be sensed from him was the spiritual power of an ordinary Qi Refining Stage 7 cultivator.

‘There’s no real reason to hide my realm as well.’

He had already been at Qi Refining Stage 6 when he entered the sect, so it would not be strange for others to assume that he had already been close to the limit of that Stage back then.

The environment in the Changchun Sect was incomparably better than the outside world. It was common for disciples who had been in the sect only a few years to make breakthroughs using the dense spiritual qi or the sect’s pills.

...

Pill Cauldron Peak, Yang Fire Court.

Lee Hyun headed toward the lounge.

When he opened the door, he saw several familiar faces.

Luo Jingwen had several ledgers spread across the table and was writing something in them.

Shen Yanzhu was leaning back in a chair on one side, reading the contents of a jade slip pressed against her forehead, while Pei Jingsong sat across the table, placing medicinal ingredients one by one onto a small scale.

“You’re all here.”

Luo Jingwen was the first to look up.

“Long time no....”

His words stopped midway.

A faint spirit light flashed through Luo Jingwen’s eyes. At the same time, Shen Yanzhu lowered her jade slip, and Pei Jingsong stopped handling the medicinal ingredients.

Luo Jingwen shot to his feet.

“Junior Brother Li!”

“Yes.”

“What happened to your realm?”

“Is there a problem?”

“Not a problem, but....”

As though checking whether his eyes had deceived him, he looked Lee Hyun up and down several times.

“Aren’t you at Qi Refining Stage 7?”

“That’s right.”

Shen Yanzhu also studied Lee Hyun for a moment as though gauging his aura, then smiled.

“You really are at Stage 7. Congratulations, Junior Brother Li.”

“Thank you, Senior Sister Shen.”

Pei Jingsong also put down the medicinal ingredients and cupped his hands.

“Congratulations. Now that you’ve entered late Qi Refining, Foundation Establishment isn’t far off.”

“Thank you as well, Senior Brother Pei.”

Luo Jingwen looked suspicious.

“Strange.”

Shen Yanzhu shot him a sidelong glance.

“What’s strange about something worth celebrating?”

“It’s only been a year since he entered the sect. Junior Brother Li was definitely at Qi Refining Stage 6 when he first arrived.”

“It hasn’t been one year. It’s almost been two. And he might already have been close to the limit of Stage 6 back then.”

“Even so, isn’t this too fast? What if some other faction approached Junior Brother Li without us knowing?”

Shen Yanzhu let out a quiet sigh.

“Here we go again.”

Pei Jingsong touched the scar on his chin and asked,

“Junior Brother Li. Did you happen to take a breakthrough pill?”

“I did.”

“How did you obtain it?”

“I used my entire fortune from my days as a rogue cultivator to buy two Essence-Unblocking Pills from a nearby cultivator market and took them.”

“Essence-Unblocking Pills?”

Luo Jingwen blinked.

“You mean those foreign pills that have been circulating in Lan Kingdom recently?”

“That’s right.”

“Since you pushed your realm upward with pills, your body will need time to adjust. For the time being, you should cut back on pills and practice your cultivation art to consolidate your realm.”

“I’ll keep that in mind.”

Luo Jingwen suddenly seemed to remember something and slapped his palms together.

Clap!

“Right! I just remembered why I was waiting for Junior Brother Li.”

“For me?”

“That’s right.”

Luo Jingwen glanced around, then took a small talisman from inside his robe and stuck it beneath the table.

Hummm―

A faint light spread along the walls and door of the lounge.

“What are you planning to do that you even need a Sound-Isolating Talisman?”

“It could become troublesome if Master finds out we’re drinking in broad daylight.”

“Drinking?”

Luo Jingwen tapped his storage pouch.

Tap.

A wine bottle made of yellow clay appeared on the table.

A strip of red cloth was tied around the bottle’s neck, while the mouth was sealed with wax and a small sealing talisman. Blue ears of rice and clouds were painted across the rounded surface.

Even through the seal, a faint grain fragrance mingled with a medicinal aroma seeped out.

Shen Yanzhu’s eyes lit up.

“That’s Qingya Spring Wine!”

“Indeed. And Qingya Spring Wine aged for thirty years at that.”

Pei Jingsong also looked slightly surprised.

“Isn’t that quite a good one?”

Qingya Spring Wine was a Tier 1 spirit wine brewed from the Changchun Sect’s Qingya Rice and spirit spring water from Ganlu Peak.

“When I handed over the Essence-Raising Pill sales mission before, I promised Junior Brother Li that I would buy some good wine. I, Luo Jingwen, never forget a promise.”

He tapped his storage pouch again, and four drinking vessels appeared on the table.

Thunk.

One of them was closer to a bowl than a cup. The other three were small wine cups about two knuckles tall.

“.......”

Luo Jingwen placed the large bowl in front of Lee Hyun, then set one of the three small wine cups before himself, Shen Yanzhu, and Pei Jingsong.

Shen Yanzhu asked,

“Why is Junior Brother Li’s cup the only one that big?”

“Because I promised to buy Junior Brother Li wine.”

“Then what about us?”

“Aren’t you two simply getting free drinks? Are you really going to complain about the amount when you’re drinking someone else’s wine?”

Pei Jingsong looked down into his tiny wine cup.

“Even so, the difference seems rather excessive.”

“Why are you joining in too, Junior Brother Pei? Wine always tastes best when someone else pours you a cup.”

Shen Yanzhu picked up her small cup.

“Forget it. Good wine is better savored a little at a time than drunk in large amounts anyway.”

Lee Hyun looked at the enormous bowl before him.

“But is it really all right to hold a drinking party inside the sect in broad daylight?”

“What are you talking about?”

“Pardon?”

“This is not ordinary alcohol. It is spirit wine. It circulates spiritual power, warms the meridians, and even relieves fatigue in the primordial spirit. This is clearly part of cultivation. Junior Brother Li must have spent so long as a rogue cultivator that he is unfamiliar with the profound cultivation methods of a proper cultivation sect.”

“Just a moment ago, you clearly said it would be troublesome if Master found out....”

Ignoring him, Luo Jingwen peeled the sealing talisman from the wine bottle. When he broke the wax, a clean fragrance spread through the room.

The aroma drifted into the noses of all four people in the lounge.

Luo Jingwen tilted the bottle.

Glug, glug, glug―

Clear wine with the faintest hint of blue filled the bowl.

Only after filling the large bowl more than halfway did he pour wine into the smaller cups.

Luo Jingwen raised his own cup.

“To Junior Brother Li reaching late Qi Refining.”

Shen Yanzhu and Pei Jingsong also raised their cups.

“Congratulations, Junior Brother Li.”

“Congratulations once again.”

Lee Hyun lifted the bowl with both hands.

“Thank you.”

All four drank at the same time.

Lee Hyun swallowed a mouthful of Qingya Spring Wine.

Rather than sweetness, what he noticed first was the rich, nutty fragrance of well-ripened Qingya Rice and the refreshing energy of the spirit spring water.

A moment later.

Whoosh―

Warm energy spread outward from his stomach.

The medicinal potency of Qingya Spring Wine traveled along his meridians and spread throughout his body. It felt as though the minute imbalances that had accumulated from taking pills over the past several days were melting away.

The intoxication came a little later.

The surrounding sounds seemed to grow more distant, and his body relaxed.

“Spirit wine really is something different.”

Lee Hyun lowered the bowl.

Across from him, Luo Jingwen had emptied his small wine cup and was exhaling in satisfaction.

“Ahh....”

Shen Yanzhu also put down her cup. A very faint blush had already risen to her cheeks.

“I only had one cup, but the intoxication is quite strong.”

“Qingya Spring Wine tastes best when you accept the drunkenness instead of forcibly driving it away. Try not to detoxify it. Enjoy the lingering sensation. Isn’t this the very life of an immortal?”

Luo Jingwen refilled the three small cups. He also poured a little more Qingya Spring Wine into Lee Hyun’s bowl.

“Don’t hold back, Junior Brother Li. I brought that large cup for a reason.”

“Understood.”

Lee Hyun lifted the bowl again.

The medicinal strength of Qingya Spring Wine was considerable, but perhaps thanks to the Primordial Body, it was quickly absorbed and faded away.

The intoxication was the same.

Even though he was drinking from such a large bowl, it merely lifted his mood a little. His mind remained perfectly clear.

In contrast, Luo Jingwen and Shen Yanzhu were speaking a little louder than usual, while Pei Jingsong had also relaxed and was leaning deep into his chair.

Shen Yanzhu looked at Lee Hyun.

“Junior Brother Li doesn’t seem very drunk.”

“I suppose I have a high tolerance for alcohol.”

After the wine had gone around a few times, conversation naturally turned to alchemy, the Scripture Pavilion, and the missions they had been handling lately.

Pei Jingsong asked Lee Hyun,

“Now that you’ve entered late Qi Refining, what do you plan to do from here?”

“I intend to continue learning alchemy at the Yang Fire Court and look through more of the inheritances in the Scripture Pavilion whenever I have time. There’s no need to rush.”

Their conversation continued for quite some time before Luo Jingwen put down the empty wine bottle.

“Wait.”

Shen Yanzhu asked,

“What?”

“I’ve noticed another strange detail.”

“Again?”

Luo Jingwen lowered his voice.

“What is the name of our sect’s Mountain-Guarding Grand Formation?”

“The Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.”

“That’s right. The Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.”

Luo Jingwen emphasized each word.

“‘Nine Peaks’ refers to the nine peaks, including Changchun Peak, Pill Cauldron Peak, and Hundred Herbs Peak. There is nothing strange about that much.”

Pei Jingsong spoke.

“Then you’re saying the ‘Spring-Restoring’ part is strange?” [TL Note: The Korean term 회춘 can mean both the return of spring and rejuvenation, or regaining one’s youth.]

Luo Jingwen’s eyes narrowed.

“Exactly. An elderly Golden Core supreme sect master who no longer shows himself, and a Spring-Restoring Formation... Don’t you find that a little unsettling?”

Shen Yanzhu replied in disbelief.

“It was already called the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation when the previous Golden Core ancestral masters were still alive.”

Pei Jingsong asked carefully,

“Senior Brother Luo, do you think the supreme sect master is trying to regain his youth through the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation? If a mere Golden Core cultivator had access to a way to rejuvenate himself, why would Nascent Soul cultivators ever die of old age?”

“Is that so...?”

“There isn’t any wine left anyway, so let’s get up now.”

Shen Yanzhu tried to take the empty wine bottle away.

Luo Jingwen hurriedly grabbed it.

“Wait! I can still sell that bottle for spirit stones.”

“You only sober up at times like this.”

Luo Jingwen carefully tucked the wine bottle into his robe.

...

With empty cups sitting before them, their conversation continued for about another shichen (about two hours).

By the time the Sound-Isolating Talisman’s spiritual power was exhausted, the four of them had thoroughly cleaned the table and the lounge.

They all used the Detoxification Art to remove the remaining signs of intoxication from their faces. Pei Jingsong finished sorting the medicinal ingredients, then headed for the communal alchemy chamber.

Luo Jingwen patted Lee Hyun on the shoulder.

“Congratulations on your breakthrough once again. If I’d known Junior Brother Li could drink this well, I would have bought a larger bottle.”

“I had plenty.”

“The next time I reach Foundation Establishment, I’ll buy even better wine.”

“Sounds good.”

...

A few days later.

An unnamed valley more than five thousand li (about 1,960 km) southwest of the Changchun Sect.

Lee Hyun stretched his left hand toward a boulder the size of a house.

Hummm―

The boulder did not budge. Instead, the reaction force from the power he exerted on the house-sized boulder pulled Lee Hyun’s much lighter body toward it.

Whoosh!

Lee Hyun shot forward almost parallel to the ground.

The surrounding scenery streaked past.

‘This is too fast....’

Lee Hyun hurriedly activated the Qi Sphere Barrier.

The air ahead was pushed aside, slowing him down, but less than one zhang (about 3.3 m) remained between him and the boulder.

Hummm!

Three Spirit Light Shields appeared between Lee Hyun and the boulder.

Boom!

The Spirit Light Shields bent sharply, then rebounded and flung Lee Hyun backward.

Lee Hyun flipped himself around in midair and landed on both feet.

Skrrt―

He gave his left arm a light roll.

‘With the Earth-Origin Force, I can not only pull a target toward me, but also pull my own body toward the target.’

Lee Hyun looked toward one side of the valley.

A stone statue carved in the shape of a person stood there. The statue held up an iron shield with both hands.

Shing―

Lee Hyun drew the Mountain-Suppressing Sword.

Thump.

As he activated the Square-Inch Step, Lee Hyun’s figure vanished.

The next instant, he appeared directly in front of the statue.

The statue’s iron shield blocked the path of his sword.

Lee Hyun formed an anchor of Earth-Origin Force at the sword tip and latched onto one edge of the shield.

Hummm―

One side of the shield was abruptly pulled toward the sword tip.

Crack!

Stone fractured along one of the statue’s arms, causing the shield to tilt. At that instant, dazzling light burst from the tip of Lee Hyun’s sword.

Flash!

The sword light skimmed past the edge of the shield and pierced straight through the statue’s neck.

Crack!

The statue’s head flew backward.

Without withdrawing his sword, Lee Hyun swung it sideways.

Swish!

The sword light of the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art drew a perfectly straight line through the air.

The tilted iron shield moved as though pursuing the sword tip, shifting directly into the path traced by the sword light.

Slice.

The shield split cleanly into two pieces.

A moment later, the statue’s body also revealed a diagonal cut before collapsing.

Rumble―

Lee Hyun examined the severed shield and fallen statue.

‘This is more useful than I expected.’

It could pull an opponent’s body half a cun (about 1.7 cm) just before the sword struck, slightly twist the angle of a defensive magic tool, or disrupt the trajectory of an incoming flying sword for the briefest instant.

Each was only a minor interference, but even that momentary deviation was enough to create an opening for One Ultimate, Six Swords and the Boundary-Cleaving Saber Art to exploit.

...

Whenever Lee Hyun traveled between Tunnel No. 2 and the Changchun Sect, he sought out deserted mountains and valleys where he could practice the Earth-Origin Force.

At first, he frequently pulled his own body toward something only to crash into a boulder, or had an object he drew toward his sword tip fly at him faster than expected, forcing him to deploy a Spirit Light Shield.

Fortunately, as his failures accumulated, he was able to establish an appropriate method of using the technique.

If he wanted to use the reaction force of the Earth-Origin Force for movement, he needed some way to correct his posture and direction in midair.

For that reason, Lee Hyun devoted himself to learning the Wind-Riding Art he had found in the Scripture Pavilion.

The Wind-Riding Art was a technique that generated wind, allowing its user to move or change direction even in midair. When used together with the Lightness Art, it could even allow one to move as though flying for a short while.

Once he linked the Distance-Shrinking Step, Lightness Art, Square-Inch Step, Earth-Origin Force, and Wind-Riding Art together, Lee Hyun’s movements became both extremely fast and highly unpredictable.

The Wind-Riding Art was useful, but it was difficult to learn without a wind-aspect mutated spiritual root. Fortunately, just as he had with the Breath-Sealing Art and Air-Clearing Art, Lee Hyun could use Primordial True Qi to overcome the restriction of elemental affinity.

While studying the Wind-Riding Art, Lee Hyun also discovered that it could be combined to some extent with the Reclining Escape Art.

If he eventually brought the Wind-Riding Art to Major Attainment, perhaps the Reclining Escape Art would allow him to move freely over land and water and even ride the currents of the wind.

‘At this rate, am I going to start flying before I even reach Foundation Establishment...?’

...

In addition, whenever Lee Hyun visited Tunnel No. 2, he researched ways to manipulate bone age using Tier 1 Bone-Forging Powder.

At first, the results were completely unpredictable.

Every time he measured his bone age after taking Bone-Forging Powder, the readings jumped wildly between seventy-one, sixty-four, forty-three, fifty-seven, fifty-two, and forty-nine years old.

But as he repeated the experiments and gradually figured out which variables affected bone age, the margin of error steadily decreased.

Before he knew it, fifteen years had passed.

Lee Hyun’s life had not changed much during that time. He refined pills at the Yang Fire Court and read books and jade slips from the Scripture Pavilion whenever he had spare time. He accumulated only as many contribution points as he needed for cultivation and research and almost never participated in dangerous external missions.

Once every two or three months, he returned to Tunnel No. 2 to inspect the spirit fields and fuzzbees.

Because the Primordial Body required an enormous amount of spiritual power to fill a single Stage, Lee Hyun’s realm remained at Qi Refining Stage 7.

Shen Yanzhu, meanwhile, had advanced to Qi Refining Stage 9, while Pei Jingsong had reached Qi Refining Stage 7. Luo Jingwen was still at Qi Refining Stage 9.

Then, one day.

Several dozen disciples had gathered in front of the mission board at the Yang Fire Court.

In the center of the board, an unusual mission had been written on a large sheet of paper bordered in red.

「Harvest Spirit Plants at Qingmu Ridge and Transport Them to the Main Mountain.

Participants: 100 disciples at mid Qi Refining or above.

Four Foundation Establishment Elders will accompany the group.

Expected duration: fifteen days.

Specific rewards will vary according to role and realm.」

“Qingmu Ridge....”

Lee Hyun’s gaze stopped on the mission.

Luo Jingwen stood beside him, and his name had already been added to the participant list.

Shen Yanzhu asked,

“Are you really going?”

“This mission awards twice the usual contribution points. Four Foundation Establishment Elders are accompanying us, and there will be a hundred Qi Refining disciples. What is there to worry about? If we include the Elders stationed at Qingmu Ridge, no ordinary force would even dare approach us.”

Pei Jingsong stared silently at the mission.

The fingers touching the scar on his chin tightened.

Lee Hyun asked,

“There is one thing I don’t understand.”

“What is it?”

“Didn’t you say the attackers last time even knew Qingmu Ridge’s harvest schedule and transportation route?”

“They did.”

“If they knew that much, was there any need for them to wait for the transport group?”

The three of them looked toward Lee Hyun.

“Wouldn’t it have been easier to attack Qingmu Ridge directly under normal circumstances and dig up the mature spirit plants?”

Luo Jingwen shook his head.

“That would actually be more difficult. Qingmu Ridge is protected by a Tier 2 Field-Guarding Formation linked to its spirit vein. If the two Foundation Establishment Elders and the Qi Refining disciples stationed there operate the formation, they could hold off several Foundation Establishment cultivators for a long time.”

“And support from the main mountain would arrive in the meantime.”

“Exactly. Attacking Qingmu Ridge directly would not be like robbing a single spirit field. It would be like fighting an entire mountain. It would practically amount to declaring war on the Changchun Sect.”

Shen Yanzhu continued,

“Harvesting spirit plants is difficult too. Some have to be dug up while preserving their roots and growth points, and others must be harvested at the exact time when their medicinal potency rises into the leaves or fruit. Handle them incorrectly, and a two-hundred-year-old spirit plant could end up worse than a hundred-year-old one.”

Pei Jingsong spoke in a low voice.

“Furthermore, the spirit plants in the spirit fields are scattered across hundreds of mu (each about 667 square meters). Properly harvesting all of them would require occupying Qingmu Ridge for several days. But once we harvest and preserve them ourselves, all that wealth fits inside a few storage pouches. Those bastards were waiting for us to dig up and package decades’ worth of spirit plants for them. Then they only had to kill the transport group and flee immediately, and it would be easy enough to claim that the whole thing was simply a robbery committed by rogue cultivators.”

“I see.”

Luo Jingwen said,

“There truly shouldn’t be any problems this time. We have four Foundation Establishment Elders, a hundred disciples, and the forces permanently stationed at Qingmu Ridge. Mobilizing enough strength to deal with all of them would cost more than the spirit plants themselves are worth. If a force that large attacks us, it would no longer be about spirit plants. It would be a war between sects.”

Normally, Luo Jingwen would have been the first to suspect some conspiracy behind the situation, but he was optimistic about this particular mission. Having failed to obtain a Foundation Establishment Pill for more than fifteen years, he needed to earn as many contribution points and spirit stones as possible.

“Would Junior Brother Li like to come as well? At Qi Refining Stage 7, you’re certainly qualified...”

“I won’t go.”

“Think about it before answering.”

“I’m sorry.”

Luo Jingwen clicked his tongue.

“Junior Brother Li is strangely unhurried. A cultivator must sometimes risk danger to seize an opportunity.”

Shen Yanzhu cut in.

“Why do you keep trying to drag along someone who doesn’t want to go?”

...

Ten days later.

Three flying boats rested atop a broad stone platform on External Affairs Peak of the Changchun Sect.

The largest flying boat was over twenty zhang long. The Changchun Sect’s tree emblem was carved into the side of its hull, while formation inscriptions belonging to defensive formations ran around the deck and cabins.

One hundred Qi Refining disciples divided themselves among the three flying boats.

Four Foundation Establishment Elders hovered in the air, surrounded by spirit light.

The previously noisy stone platform gradually fell quiet as the departure time approached.

Before boarding the flying boat, Luo Jingwen turned back toward Lee Hyun, Shen Yanzhu, and Pei Jingsong.

“I’ll be back before long. I’ll bring back some good wine.”

Thrum―

A moment later, the three flying boats rose into the air one after another.

Hummm―

The inner formation and outer formation of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation opened in succession.

Escorted by the Foundation Establishment Elders, the flying boats headed north. Their enormous hulls grew smaller and smaller before disappearing beyond the mountain range.

...

That afternoon.

Clang! Clang! Clang!

The warning bell ringing from External Affairs Peak was amplified by the power of the formation, carrying all the way to Pill Cauldron Peak.

Lee Hyun, who had been about to refine pills at the Yang Fire Court, raised his head.

‘The warning bell?’

A warning bell sounding throughout the entire sect signaled an invasion by an outside enemy or an emergency of comparable severity.

Bang!

The door to the communal alchemy chamber flew open.

A Qi Refining disciple wearing the robes of External Affairs Peak rushed inside, gasping for breath.

“Where is Peak Master Gao?”

The disciples of the Yang Fire Court all turned toward him.

Shen Yanzhu asked,

“What happened?”

“Rogue cultivators have gathered at the External Affairs Market.”

“Rogue cultivators?”

“More than two hundred of them. Some are from cultivation clans, and there are six Foundation Establishment cultivators among them.”

He caught his breath once before continuing.

“They’re demanding compensation, claiming our sect deceived Lan Kingdom’s poor Qi Refining rogue cultivators by selling counterfeit Essence-Raising Pills!”

“Counterfeit Essence-Raising Pills?”

“Yes. Dozens of people suffered damaged meridians or failed their breakthroughs after taking Essence-Raising Pills. Some are even said to have died.”

“That’s impossible.”

Shen Yanzhu rose from her seat.

“Every Essence-Raising Pill sold by the Changchun Pill Pavilion undergoes pill inspection before it leaves the pavilion. There’s no way failed pills or pills with unstable medicinal potency could be mixed in.”

“External Affairs Peak also explained that they must be counterfeits. But....”

The disciple’s expression darkened.

“The medicine bottles and Spirit-Sealing Talismans they brought with them bear our sect’s pill-inspection seal.”

“What?”

Chapter 38

The disciples inside the communal alchemy chamber began murmuring among themselves.

“How could that be?”

“Could someone have forged the pill-inspection seal?”

“If they really were Essence-Raising Pills that came from us....”

Lee Hyun felt something was off.

‘Of all days, why today?’

It had not even been half a day since the three flying boats left the main sect.
