‘There’s no way this is a coincidence. But they couldn’t possibly attack the Changchun Sect with only six Foundation Establishment cultivators....’

Clang! Clang! Clang!

The warning bell rang again.

Gao Yuanhe descended from the sky in front of the communal alchemy chamber, enveloped in spirit light. Two Foundation Establishment Elders from Pill Cauldron Peak followed behind him.

“Greetings, Peak Master Gao!”

Gao Yuanhe raised a hand, cutting off the disciples’ greetings.

“Anyone in the middle of Pill Condensation, seal the medicinal strength and close your burner first! Disciples at late Qi Refining or above, board the flying boats. Everyone else, take the auxiliary formation stations!”

“Yes!”

The disciples moved as one.

...

Several flying boats hovered outside Yang Fire Court.

“Only disciples at late Qi Refining or above! Everyone else, get inside Yang Fire Court! Do not leave the peak without permission!”

Lee Hyun, Shen Yanzhu, and Pei Jingsong boarded one of the flying boats.

Hummm―

The flying boat made from spirit wood left Pill Cauldron Peak and sped toward External Affairs Peak.

At the same time, flying boats large and small rose one after another from the Changchun Sect’s other peaks.

More than ten streaks of Foundation Establishment spirit light flew ahead of the flying boats toward External Affairs Peak. The remaining Foundation Establishment cultivators stayed behind at vital locations such as the formation stations of the nine peaks, the storehouses, the Scripture Pavilion, and the Spirit Beast Garden.

Above Formation and Artifact Peak, an Elder holding a flag directed the flying boats along separate routes, while the blue mist filling the spaces between the nine peaks surged like violent waves.

‘Both the outer formation and inner formation are still intact...’

As the flying boat approached External Affairs Peak, the shouts of the crowd became audible.

“Changchun Sect Master, come out and apologize!”

“You killed people with fake Essence-Raising Pills, and now you’re locking your gates?”

“Compensate them for their ruined cultivation and their lives!”

...

The Changchun Sect’s External Affairs Market.

The broad street normally traveled by merchant-company wagons and cultivators was packed with people.

Most were Qi Refining cultivators, but among them Lee Hyun could sense six powerful auras belonging to Foundation Establishment cultivators.

The flying boat landed on a stone platform inside the inner formation that stretched between the External Affairs Market and the nine peaks. Lee Hyun, Shen Yanzhu, and Pei Jingsong took their places behind the blue barrier with the other disciples.

Dozens of stretchers lay in the middle of the street.

Every cultivator lying on them was deathly pale. Some had dried, dark-red blood around their mouths and beneath their noses, while others were trembling violently or had lost consciousness altogether.

Behind them stood seven coffins covered in black cloth.

The sounds of people sobbing could be heard.

“My Senior Brother’s meridians were completely severed immediately after he took an Essence-Raising Pill. The bottle bore the Changchun Sect’s pill-inspection seal!”

“The pills killed people!”

The anger and grief were genuine.

At the very least, the injuries and deaths before them did not look staged.

Inside the inner formation, more than ten Foundation Establishment cultivators, including the External Affairs Peak Master, had taken up defensive positions. Physicians from Ganlu Peak stood ready to receive the injured, while formation masters from Formation and Artifact Peak inspected the formation stations. Cultivators from Chunjian Peak formed a line at regular intervals, creating a buffer zone between the crowd and the disciples.

Including those guarding the main formation stations and the important halls of the main sect, more than thirty Foundation Establishment cultivators remained in the Changchun Sect.

The External Affairs Peak Master addressed the crowd.

“If you hand the pills and their bottles over to us, we will determine what happened.”

Someone outside shouted.

“How can we trust the culprits themselves to examine the evidence!”

A fat Foundation Establishment cultivator in blue robes stepped forward.

He held a small jade bottle in his hand.

A Tier-1 Spirit-Sealing Talisman was affixed over the mouth of the jade bottle, and a tree-shaped pill-inspection seal was clearly stamped on its surface.

“Look at this!”

The Foundation Establishment cultivator raised the jade bottle high.

“Is that not clearly the Changchun Sect’s pill-inspection seal!”

The murmuring grew louder.

“It’s real!”

“Even the Changchun Sect can’t deny it!”

“The sect master needs to come out himself!”

The External Affairs Peak Master infused his voice with spiritual power.

“Even if the pill-inspection seal is genuine, that does not prove the pills inside came from our sect! We will appraise them publicly in the presence of several peak masters and outside alchemists chosen by you yourselves, and the entire process will be recorded on an image-recording stone!”

“How is that any different from asking a cat to guard a fish!”

The Ganlu Peak Master stepped forward.

“Then let us discuss the pills later and treat the injured first. Our physicians will come outside the barrier and perform only emergency treatment in full view of all of you.”

An old woman holding a black staff sneered.

“Isn’t that just a scheme to erase the traces of poison left in their bodies first and then claim there’s no evidence?”

The Ganlu Peak Master’s expression hardened.

“You would refuse even treatment?”

This time, an old man dressed in mourning clothes shouted. With one hand resting on a coffin, he glared at the disciples of the Changchun Sect.

“My grandson died after taking an Essence-Raising Pill. I paid two hundred and sixty low-grade spirit stones for it! That was the wealth our family had accumulated over three generations!”

His voice trembled.

“That child was all I lived for. Yet all the Changchun Sect keeps saying is that you cannot admit anything until you inspect the pill!”

“I understand how you feel. That is precisely why we must determine the truth properly.”

“What more is there to determine!”

The old man slammed his hand against the coffin.

Bang!

“Are you saying you want to cut open the dead child’s stomach and dig the pill back out!”

Shen Yanzhu spoke softly.

“We’re not going to get anywhere talking like this....”

“It looks like someone is deliberately making sure we can’t.”

Shen Yanzhu looked at Lee Hyun.

“What do you mean?”

“Those Foundation Establishment cultivators.”

Lee Hyun swept his gaze over the fat cultivator who had spoken earlier, the old woman holding the black staff, and the remaining four who had yet to speak.

They appeared to be helping the victims, but each of the six had taken up a different direction, as though surrounding the External Affairs Market.

And that was not all.

More people who appeared to be concealing their realms with the Aura-Concealing Art were hidden among the crowd. From the way the nearby Qi Refining cultivators repeatedly made way for them or avoided getting too close, it was obvious they were no ordinary rogue cultivators.

At that moment.

One of the young cultivators lying on a stretcher suddenly convulsed violently.

“Urgh!”

Dark-red blood erupted from his mouth.

“Ming!”

The middle-aged woman beside him screamed and grabbed the young cultivator.

“Wake up! Ming!”

A physician from External Affairs Peak shouted.

“Bring him inside, quickly! He needs treatment immediately!”

The Ganlu Peak Master moved at once.

“Open the barrier!”

A gap barely wide enough for one person to pass through opened in the inner formation’s barrier. A streak of blue light shot from the Ganlu Peak Master’s sleeve and wrapped around the young cultivator’s wrist and chest.

But before the blue light could even seep into his meridians, the young cultivator’s chest heaved violently.

Crack.

The sounds of something snapping inside his body rang out one after another.

The young cultivator went limp.

The light faded from his eyes.

“Ming...?”

The middle-aged woman brought a trembling hand beneath her son’s nose, but felt no breath.

“Aaaaaagh!”

Her agonized wail spread through the External Affairs Market.

The already wavering mood exploded in an instant.

“Another one died!”

“Someone died even after coming right to the Changchun Sect!”

“Open the gate!”

“Drag out whoever’s responsible!”

Hundreds of cultivators surged toward the inner formation.

The disciples of External Affairs Peak hurriedly drew their magic tools.

“Stop!”

“Come any closer and we will consider it an attack!”

“Attack them!”

“Those bastards never intended to treat us in the first place!”

Someone in the crowd launched a fireball.

Whoooosh!

The red fireball slammed into the inner formation’s barrier.

Boom!

The blue barrier rippled like water.

“Disciples, do not retaliate!”

The Chunjian Peak Master’s voice cut across the battlefield.

“First squad, raise a barrier! Second squad, open an escape route! Foundation Establishment Elders, subdue only those in the crowd who cast techniques!”

Several Foundation Establishment cultivators moved simultaneously.

A fierce wind formed a low wall in front of the crowd.

Whoooosh―

The cultivators in the front row were knocked backward.

One of them struck his head against the stone pavement, spraying blood.

“The Changchun Sect is killing people!”

“They’re trying to silence all of us!”

The External Affairs Peak Master shouted again.

“Clear the eastern road! Let those who do not wish to fight and the injured leave first!”

Amid the sobbing and shouting, some people tried to escape the crowd while others did the opposite, pushing everyone toward the inner formation. Once the sounds of explosions joined the chaos, controlling the crowd became nearly impossible.

Then it happened.

“An ancient inscription upon the Red Furnace says this.”

An unfamiliar voice echoed throughout External Affairs Peak.

Though the voice was not particularly loud, the shouting and crying that filled the External Affairs Market subsided in an instant.

“A hundred herbs bear one grain of spring within the flames, and that grain of spring carries a person’s hundred years onward. Thus pill fire may burn the hundred herbs, but it must never burn away a person’s tomorrow.”

The old man clutching the coffin of his dead grandson raised his head.

Beyond the outer formation of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation, a patch of red cloud slowly approached.

The red cloud stopped in midair a little over a hundred zhang (about 330 m) from the External Affairs Market.

A tall, thin man stood atop the cloud.

He appeared to be around fifty years old and wore a golden crown. His broad robes were red, with golden flame patterns embroidered along the sleeves and hems.

Behind him floated a red pill furnace as tall as a man.

Nine fire dragons writhed across the surface of the pill furnace.

The External Affairs Peak Master’s face went pale.

“Red Furnace Adept....”

Someone spoke in a trembling voice.

“The sect master of the Honglu Sect!”

A Golden Core cultivator, Red Furnace Adept.

He looked down upon the Changchun Sect from the sky.

“And yet in the Changchun Sect’s pill furnaces, human lives burn instead of a hundred herbs, while spirit stones pile atop severed Dao paths.”

As his red sleeves fluttered slowly, the surrounding air grew hot.

“Dozens of Dao paths have been severed by a single poisonous pill, and eight lives now lie cold upon coffins and stretchers. Yet you lock your gates and speak only of verifying the seal upon the bottle and the pill itself....”

Red Furnace Adept clasped his hands and solemnly bowed to the dead.

“As a fellow practitioner walking the Dao path, this is a sight I cannot bear to witness.”

He slowly straightened.

“Today, I, Red Furnace, shall shatter Changchun’s pill furnaces and answer the extinguished flames of the dead.”

“That’s right!”

Someone shouted from the External Affairs Market.

“A venerable senior of the Honglu Sect has come here personally for our sake!”

“Changchun Sect Master, come out and admit your crimes!”

Lee Hyun stared at Red Furnace Adept.

‘Is this a technique too?’

His words carried the immense divine sense of a Golden Core cultivator, along with the imagery forged through a lifetime of working with fire.

Even some disciples of the Changchun Sect looked at one another with wavering eyes.

A Foundation Establishment Elder nearby immediately rang a bronze bell.

Chime!

As the clear sound spread, clarity gradually returned to the disciples’ eyes.

“Get a hold of yourselves!”

At that moment, gray-white ash began drifting down from the sky.

“Flesh lies down in the earth, and bone rests in ash.”

A woman’s voice drifted through the air.

“But a broken will borrows the wind to knock upon the doors of the living.”

A woman in gray robes walked through the air, one step at a time.

Her snow-white hair reached her ankles, yet her face bore almost no wrinkles.

She held a faded fan in one hand.

Each time the fan moved, white ash scattered like snowflakes.

“Lady White Ash....”

Pei Jingsong’s voice stiffened.

Another Golden Core cultivator of the Honglu Sect.

Lady White Ash.

She looked in turn at the seven coffins and the young cultivator who had just died.

“Earth and ash do not speak, but the wind cannot conceal injustice. Remember that every flake of ash-snow falling today carries a will that was broken halfway along its path.”

Lady White Ash’s voice washed gently over the External Affairs Market.

The families of the dead began sobbing again.

Even some Changchun Sect disciples unconsciously lowered their heads.

“Do not bewitch their primordial spirits with pretty words!”

Gao Yuanhe’s sharp shout jolted the disciples of Yang Fire Court awake.

He crushed a blue pill held between his fingers. As red pill fire wrapped around the powder, a medicinal fragrance that cleared the mind rapidly spread throughout the inside of the barrier.

The wavering looks in the disciples’ eyes gradually sharpened.

Red Furnace Adept spoke.

“Changchun Sect Master, hear me.”

His voice reverberated across External Affairs Peak and the neighboring peaks.

“Bow three times to the dead, and compensate the injured with spirit stones and pills. Send every person who refined these Essence-Raising Pills and every person who performed the pill inspection outside the Mountain Gate, so that we and the victims may jointly hold them accountable for their crimes.”

He paused briefly.

“Do that, and today I will stop short of tearing down the signboard over your Mountain Gate.”

Pill Cauldron Peak Master Gao Yuanhe infused his reply with spiritual power.

“Senior Red Furnace. They have refused a public appraisal, refused the presence of outside alchemists, and refused our offer to treat the injured. How can you demand that we hand over our sect’s disciples as criminals before the truth has even been established?”

He pointed at the jade bottle held by the Foundation Establishment cultivator.

“Give us the pill. If its pill markings, fire patterns, and the texture of its medicinal potency match our sect’s Essence-Raising Pills, then I, the peak master of Pill Cauldron Peak, will be the first to surrender my identity token and await judgment.”

Red Furnace Adept shook his head as if in sorrow.

“The guilty always claim there is insufficient evidence, while the powerless must always prove the truth with their own lives. What evidence could weigh more heavily than eight corpses?”

The rogue cultivators in the External Affairs Market glared angrily at the Changchun Sect disciples.

Listening to Red Furnace Adept, Lee Hyun became certain.

‘He never intended to establish the truth in the first place.’

“I will ask one final time.”

Red Furnace Adept’s red pill furnace slowly moved forward.

Hummm―

The nine fire dragons upon the furnace opened their eyes.

“Will the Changchun Sect Master come out and admit his crimes?”

No answer came.

Changchun Peak remained silent.

After a moment, Red Furnace Adept closed his eyes, then opened them again.

“So in the end, you answer with silence.”

Lady White Ash opened her fan.

“Then I suppose the two characters ‘Changchun’ must be covered in ash first.”

The instant Lady White Ash moved her fan, the six Foundation Establishment cultivators standing in the External Affairs Market stomped down in unison.

Boom!

Six red iron stakes burst through the stone paving. Their surfaces were densely covered in flame-shaped formation inscriptions flowing in opposite directions.

“Vein-Reversing Nails!”

The Formation and Artifact Peak Master shouted the moment he saw the six stakes.

“It’s the Six-Nail Vein-Reversing Formation! Do not pull out the Vein-Reversing Nails! If they’re disturbed incorrectly, all the spiritual qi in the outer formation will reverse at once!”

The six Foundation Establishment cultivators formed hand seals with both hands.

Hummmm―

The formation inscriptions on the Vein-Reversing Nails lit up one after another from the bottom upward.

At once, the existing formation inscriptions that made up the External Affairs Market’s formation rose above the stone pavement.

Crackle―

Red light flowing from the Vein-Reversing Nails spread backward along the blue formation inscriptions.

That very instant.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

Suppressed auras erupted one after another from within the crowd.

A female cultivator who had pretended to comfort a grieving family. An old man who had looked like a merchant-company clerk. Even those hiding on hall rooftops and in alleyways.

Thirteen newly revealed Foundation Establishment spiritual pressures appeared.

All of them drew magic tools and talismans at once and gathered around the six cultivators protecting the Vein-Reversing Nails.

The Changchun Sect’s cultivators moved as well.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

Techniques began colliding.

The Chunjian Peak Master drew his sword.

“First squad, pressure the Vein-Reversing Formation! Second squad, evacuate the uninvolved rogue cultivators! Do not chase those bastards into the crowd!”

Seven Foundation Establishment cultivators, including Gao Yuanhe, flew toward the Vein-Reversing Formation. The others moved between the victims and the attackers.

The Formation and Artifact Peak Master took out three formation plates and deployed them in midair.

“Sever the spirit veins at the three eastern formation stations and reroute them west! Do not feed the reversing spiritual qi back into the outer formation. Divert it into the earth vein!”

Responses immediately came from the main formation stations of the nine peaks.

Hummm―

Blue formation inscriptions beneath the External Affairs Market interlocked with the red lines.

As the two formations pulled upon the same earth vein in opposite directions, the ground rumbled faintly.

At that moment, nine fire dragons burst from Red Furnace Adept’s pill furnace.

Rooooar!

The nine fire dragons, each twenty to thirty zhang long, bit one another’s tails and spun, compressing themselves into an area roughly thirty zhang across.

As nine layers of flame merged into one, a single red dragon appeared, so dense that its interior looked black.

Each movement of the red dragon’s head distorted the surrounding space with heat.

The red dragon plunged headfirst toward the outer formation in front of the External Affairs Market.

BOOOOM!

The sky above the External Affairs Market turned crimson.

The blue mist tried to divert the flames in every direction, but the Six-Nail Vein-Reversing Formation reversed the spiritual qi in precisely that section.

Thousands of formation inscriptions appeared in overlapping layers across an area roughly forty zhang wide, holding the outer formation together.

But thin cracks formed between the inscriptions.

Crrrack!

Lady White Ash pressed her fan downward.

The ash falling west of the External Affairs Market gathered into a whirlwind thirty zhang wide.

Hissss―

Gray-white ash seeped into the cracks.

Each time the formation inscriptions touched the ash, they lost their spiritual qi and their light dimmed.

“Put more spirit stones into the formation stations!”

“Separate the External Affairs Market’s spirit vein from the inner formation!”

“Break the Six-Nail Vein-Reversing Formation first!”

The Changchun Sect’s Foundation Establishment Elders issued orders without pause while launching magic tools toward the Vein-Reversing Nails.

Dozens of flying swords and glowing ropes streaked across the External Affairs Market.

The thirteen cultivators who had revealed themselves simultaneously unleashed their techniques.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

Halls throughout the External Affairs Market exploded.

Hundreds of rogue cultivators screamed and scattered.

It became difficult to tell who was a victim and who was an attacker.

At least several dozen seemed to have followed the others here without knowing anything about what was going to happen.

“Save me!”

“We didn’t come here to fight!”

“Which way are we supposed to go!”

“Follow the blue flags!”

Three Foundation Establishment Elders from External Affairs Peak raised a broad curtain of water, dividing the crowd.

“Put your magic tools into your storage pouches and keep both hands visible! We will evacuate the injured first!”

Lee Hyun, Shen Yanzhu, and Pei Jingsong also dragged fallen rogue cultivators beneath the blue flags to safety inside the barrier.

The attackers tried to slip in among them.

The disciples of Chunjian Peak deployed a sword formation to stop them.

Dozens of streaks of sword light bloomed between the External Affairs Market and the inner formation.

Boom! Boom! Boom!

The fighting spread throughout the External Affairs Market.

CRAAACK―

The barrier covering an area more than forty zhang wide in front of the External Affairs Market shattered.

Fragments of light rained down.

Beyond the breach in the outer formation, the empty air began to ripple.

Hummm―

As the hazy barrier concealing the sky withdrew, dozens of small flying boats appeared.

The boats were packed with cultivators.

Every magic tool and formation they used radiated powerful fire qi.

More than ten Foundation Establishment auras could be glimpsed aboard the flying boats alone.

Combined with the nineteen cultivators among the crowd, the number of confirmed Foundation Establishment cultivators had already surpassed thirty.

The Chunjian Peak Master shouted.

“Deploy the inner formation!”

Hummmmm―

Green pillars of light surged from the nine peaks.

Hundred Herbs Peak. Ganlu Peak. Spirit Beast Peak.

Pill Cauldron Peak. Changchun Peak. Chunjian Peak.

Earth Fire Peak. Formation and Artifact Peak. External Affairs Peak.

The nine beams of light connected in the sky.

Light and mist formed the shape of a gigantic tree embracing the nine peaks of the Changchun Sect.

Its thick trunk stood upon Changchun Peak, while eight enormous branches cradled the other peaks.

Red Furnace Adept spoke again.

“Even after one gate of the outer formation has fallen, the Changchun Sect Master still refuses to show himself.”

He looked toward Changchun Peak.

“It seems the old tree has already rotted and fallen. Spring itself has died at the roots of Changchun.”

Lady White Ash calmly waved her fan.

Gray-white ash surged forward like a wave covering the area before External Affairs Peak.

“If this is an empty house without a master, then for the sake of those left behind, its doors should be opened.”

As the wave of ash washed over the inner formation, the leaves of the blue-green tree rapidly turned gray.

The disciples operating the formation groaned in unison.

Red Furnace Adept’s pill furnace rang.

Bong―

The nine fire dragons rose once more and fused into a single red dragon. The red dragon coiled around the blue-green branch embracing External Affairs Peak and breathed out a torrent of flame.

Rooooooar―

Flames spread along the thick branch and surrounding leaves.

A crack formed in the inner formation of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.

Crack.

Lady White Ash’s ash seeped through the gap.

Gray snow began falling inside the formation.

Lee Hyun hesitated.

‘Should I get ready to run?’

If the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation collapsed, he could escape underground.

If Lee Hyun were alone, getting away did not seem particularly difficult.

The problem was the two people before him, as well as the other fellow disciples of Yang Fire Court.

Shen Yanzhu and Pei Jingsong watched the attackers with grave expressions.

There was also no telling what had happened to Luo Jingwen, who had left for Qingmu Ridge.

‘Let’s watch a little longer.’

Crraaack!

The crack in the inner formation lengthened further.

Several formation inscriptions could no longer withstand Lady White Ash’s ash and began going dark.

Red Furnace Adept spoke toward Changchun Peak once more.

“Spring is over. The name Changchun ends today as well. Those who remain, open the Mountain Gate and admit your crimes. I will not burn those who lay down their weapons.”

Unease appeared on the faces of some disciples.

At that moment, an old voice came from Changchun Peak.

“Red Furnace.”

It was not a loud voice.

Yet it traveled along the trunk and branches of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation. As every blue-green leaf repeated the same voice, the words could be heard clearly even from far away.

“You loved fire even when you were young. Now that you’re old, it seems you’ve even taken up setting fire to other people’s homes as a hobby.”

For the first time, Red Furnace Adept’s expression changed.

The summit of Changchun Peak.

The doors of an ancient hall that had remained closed for decades slowly opened.

Creeeeak―

An old man in faded green robes walked outside, leaning on a staff.

His body was terribly thin.

His wrinkled skin resembled ancient tree bark, and only sparse strands of silver hair remained on his head. No unusual spiritual power could be sensed from the staff in his hand, nor did it bear any ornate decorations.

Then the old man lightly tapped the ground with his staff.

Tap.

Blue light blossomed atop Changchun Peak and seeped into the roots of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.

The light flowed along the formation channels before converging upon the damaged branch of External Affairs Peak.

Whoooosh―

Dense life force erupted from the damaged area of External Affairs Peak.

New shoots sprouted from grass scorched by the flames. Broken branches rejoined, and leaves smothered beneath ash regained their blue-green hue.

Crack! Crraaack!

The cracks that had formed across the External Affairs Peak section of the inner formation began healing at astonishing speed.

The enormous branch that had been wrapped in the red dragon straightened once again.

Red Furnace Adept’s flames and Lady White Ash’s ash were pushed back dozens of zhang.

“Supreme Sect Master!”

The disciples of the Changchun Sect all raised their heads.

“He’s alive!”

“The Supreme Sect Master has emerged from seclusion!”

The supreme sect master regarded Red Furnace Adept and Lady White Ash with clear eyes.

“You must have been waiting all this time for this old tree to fall and return to the earth. But you have come far too early to offer your condolences.”

As though he had been waiting for those words, Red Furnace Adept flicked his red sleeve.

“So you truly are still drawing breath. But do you believe one decrepit Golden Core cultivator can stop the two of us and all the disciples of the Honglu Sect? Even children in the Lan Kingdom know that Fellow Daoist has little lifespan remaining.”

Lady White Ash sighed softly.

“How unfortunate. A man who once dominated an era intends to carry his sect’s faults to the very end and turn to ash alongside it.”

Then it happened.

Another person walked out of the hall on Changchun Peak.

The neat-looking man, who appeared to be in his mid-forties, was the sect master of the Changchun Sect.

He took a single step forward.

Boom.

In an instant, all the heaven-and-earth spiritual qi within roughly thirty zhang tilted toward his body.

Before the sect master’s dantian, a circular halo mingling golden and blue-green light appeared.

The perfectly complete ring of light was tranquil and stable.

Within it, the image of a single tree passing through the four seasons repeated endlessly.

New shoots emerged.

Flowers bloomed.

Fruit formed.

Leaves fell.

And spring came again.

Whoooosh―

Another Golden Core spiritual pressure erupted from Changchun Peak and connected with the trunk of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.

A powerful pulse ran through the blue-green tree of the inner formation, as though it had gained a second heart.

“Spring always returns to the Changchun Sect.”

Chapter 39

The current sect master of the Changchun Sect had been known to be at Foundation Establishment Great Perfection.

He, too, was a Golden Core cultivator.

It wasn't that the Changchun Sect had no Golden Core cultivators. It had two!

WHOOOOOM!

The inner formation of the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation expanded in an instant.

The blue barrier stretched all the way to the External Affairs Market, forcing the attackers back, while the six Vein-Reversing Nails embedded in the ground were ripped free amid streams of reverse-flowing red energy.

CRACK!

The Foundation Establishment cultivators operating the Six-Nail Vein-Reversing Formation coughed up blood, and the Elders of the Changchun Sect did not let the opening slip by.

SWISH-SWISH-SWISH!

Dozens of streams of sword light rained down on the Foundation Establishment cultivators disguised as rogue cultivators.

The tide of the battlefield reversed in an instant.

“The sect master has reached the Golden Core realm!”

“Our sect has two Golden Core seniors!”

The cheers of the Changchun Sect disciples shook all nine peaks.

Meanwhile, the rogue cultivators gathered in the External Affairs Market fell into confusion, while the attackers disguised among them were thrown into disarray.

Magical light flickered through Red Furnace Adept's eyes as he stared at the Changchun Sect's sect master.

“You deceived us. You didn't just enter the Golden Core realm.”

A moment later, his voice, infused with magical power, thundered across the battlefield.

“Good! Now we have yet another piece of evidence that the Changchun Sect has deceived the cultivators of Lan Kingdom.”

The cheers of the Changchun Sect disciples briefly subsided.

The rogue cultivators in the External Affairs Market looked at one another as well.

“How utterly devious! The Changchun Sect concealed the birth of a new Golden Core cultivator. It wore the guise of a sect led by a Foundation Establishment sect master while selling Essence-Raising Pills and taking the spirit stones of Lan Kingdom's rogue cultivators!”

Red Furnace Adept spread both arms.

“Now that you've been caught selling defective pills, are you flaunting your strength and telling everyone not to get uppity because you're a Golden Core cultivator?”

The Changchun Sect's sect master answered calmly.

“Nonsense. There is nothing wrong with our pills. Besides, I have no obligation to announce my realm.”

Red Furnace Adept shouted.

“The pill-inspection seal is real, and the victims are real! Even the sect master's golden core is real, so why do you insist the Changchun Sect's crimes are false!”

Murmurs once again spread among the rogue cultivators in the External Affairs Market.

There was a leap in his logic.

The existence of the pill-inspection seals and the victims was not proof that the Changchun Sect had produced counterfeit Essence-Raising Pills, and concealing the sect master's realm had nothing to do with the Essence-Raising Pills either.

Yet the powerful divine sense carried in Red Furnace Adept's empowered voice made the Qi Refining cultivators perceive those unrelated facts as parts of one enormous deception.

Lady White Ash also spoke quietly.

“The Changchun Sect took spirit stones from Lan Kingdom's rogue cultivators while concealing its own strength. You shared in the profits, yet when the time came to take responsibility, you hid behind your Mountain Gate.”

With sorrowful eyes, she looked at the seven coffins.

“Is that righteous conduct?”

“You've always been good at spouting nonsense.”

The supreme sect master casually rested his staff across his shoulder.

He glanced at the coffins and injured people in the External Affairs Market.

“I wonder how many of these people are truly rogue cultivators. Those youngsters do not even seem to be from Qinglu Kingdom, but from Nanli Kingdom. Who are you trying to fool? The stench of the sea hangs all over them.”

The supreme sect master pointed his staff toward the scattered remains of the Vein-Reversing Nails throughout the External Affairs Market.

“Did the victims prepare the formation devices that made up that formation as well? And the flying boats and cultivators hidden outside the outer formation, were they all mourners brought along to help with the funeral?”

The rogue cultivators in the External Affairs Market stared at the shattered iron stakes and flying boats in alarm.

“We didn't know those things were there!”

“Did the Honglu Sect use us?”

“Come to think of it, why am I even here?”

The crowd began to split.

Red Furnace Adept did not waste any more words.

“It seems I'll have no choice but to teach you through force.”

THOOOM―

Nine fire dragons emerged from the pill furnace floating behind him.

The supreme sect master raised his staff.

“That's better. You look much more agreeable when you're honest, Red Furnace.”

THUD.

The moment the supreme sect master's staff touched the ground, the forests of the Changchun Range reared up as one.

Hundreds of trees and roots intertwined in midair, intercepting the flames.

Beside him, the young sect master of the Changchun Sect held a single tree branch. It looked ordinary, but the waves of magical power emanating from it were anything but.

Four leaves grew from the branch.

A pale green leaf.

A deep blue-green leaf.

A golden leaf.

A pure white leaf.

Across from him, Lady White Ash opened her fan.

“A magic treasure containing the transformations of the four seasons...”

When Lady White Ash swept her fan, white ash blanketed the air like a blizzard.

That marked the beginning of the battle.

Every time one of the fire dragons twisted its body, dozens of ancient trees burned, but wherever ash fell, even more roots burst from the ground.

BOOOOM!

A massive ancient tree covered in green roots smashed into the red pill furnace. Red Furnace Adept was driven back dozens of zhang (at least several dozen meters) together with his red cloud, and a hairline crack appeared across the surface of the furnace.

Lady White Ash's ashen wind withered the life force of the pale green leaf and rotted the golden leaf, but the instant frost scattered from the pure white leaf froze the ash, hundreds of seeds burrowed through the opening.

All those transformations overlapped within the span of only a few breaths.

...

On the ground, magic tools and techniques wielded by dozens of Foundation Establishment cultivators flew back and forth without pause.

The Foundation Establishment and Qi Refining cultivators had to keep an eye on the sky even as they continued the battles before them.

Every time the Golden Core cultivators unleashed techniques, the entire Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation shook.

BOOOOOM!

Every stray aftershock from the Golden Core cultivators' techniques carried enough power to kill dozens of Qi Refining cultivators.

The Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation blocked most of those aftershocks, but the burden on the disciples operating the formation stations rapidly increased.

As Lee Hyun watched the battle, Pei Jingsong spoke.

“We're pushing them back.”

He was right.

Red Furnace Adept and Lady White Ash were powerful, but this was the Changchun Sect's home ground, protected by the Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.

Red Furnace Adept's long robe was torn in several places, and a thin crack had appeared in the red pill furnace floating behind him. A green leaf was embedded in Lady White Ash's faded fan.

The Changchun Sect disciples cheered.

But Lee Hyun felt that something was off.

Red Furnace Adept and Lady White Ash did not look hard-pressed.

‘Strange.’

Their initial decision to attack the Changchun Sect could be considered reasonable. If the sect had no Golden Core cultivator, or only one so old and frail that he could no longer fight properly, this would have been an ideal opportunity to seize a newly formed Tier 3 spirit vein.

As long as they had a suitable pretext, the great sects of Lan Kingdom that possessed Nascent Soul cultivators would probably not interfere too heavily.

But that was only true if they could win. In a Tier 4 cultivation nation, Golden Core cultivators stood above virtually everyone except Nascent Soul cultivators. There was no reason to risk such precious lives by continuing a battle in which they were at a disadvantage.

That was when it happened.

‘Hm?’

Lee Hyun raised his head.

The direction of the wind had changed.

Amid the battlefield wind thick with the smell of mountains, fire, and blood, he caught a faint salty scent.

SPLASH.

The sound of waves came from somewhere.

The cultivators of the Changchun Sect looked around.

SPLASH.

This time, it was closer.

Clear water began seeping between the shattered buildings of the External Affairs Market, then rapidly rose.

Ankles.

Knees.

Waists.

But there was something strange about it.

The halls and people's bodies were submerged, yet no one struggled to breathe. Their clothes did not even become wet.

A small fish with silver scales passed beside them as though swimming through open air.

Dozens of blue fish followed behind it.

Before long, the entire External Affairs Market looked as if it were beneath the sea.

It was not real seawater, but the vast illusion created from water qi and divine sense felt half real.

There was only one kind of existence that could casually display such might.

Shen Yanzhu spoke with a pale face.

“Another Golden Core cultivator.”

Sunlight vanished from the sky.

Everyone looked up.

The southern sky above the Changchun Range had transformed into a blue ocean surface.

Waves rolled where clouds should have been.

The shadow of a whale passed beyond the blue sky.

Its body seemed dozens of zhang long.

FWOOOOOSH―

When the whale blew a column of water, blue rain poured over the Changchun Range.

Then a man came walking across the inverted sea.

One step.

Silver ripples spread beneath his feet.

Another step.

The distance contracted, bringing the man's figure rapidly closer before their eyes.

His hair was bound beneath a crown woven from white jade and coral, while waves and unknown sea beasts had been embroidered in silver thread across his long, flowing robe.

Each time his sleeves moved, the embroidered fish and sea beasts seemed to swim as if alive.

A circular ring as tall as a man floated behind his back.

Its outer rim was silver, while endless blue waves revolved within. Unfamiliar formation inscriptions were engraved across its surface.

The moment Lee Hyun saw the token hanging from the man's waist, his expression changed.

‘Qingchao Merchant Alliance?’

The Qingchao Merchant Alliance had never possessed a Golden Core cultivator. At least, not by the time Lee Hyun left Nanli Kingdom.

A Foundation Establishment Elder from External Affairs Peak recognized the man and groaned out his name.

“Azure Sea Wanderer.... The Golden Core guest retainer the Qingchao Merchant Alliance recruited from beyond Nanming Sea.”

Azure Sea Wanderer.

He was a figure whose name had begun spreading through southern Nanli Kingdom only recently.

Azure Sea Wanderer glanced over Red Furnace Adept's and Lady White Ash's wounds before looking down at the Changchun Sect.

“The sea accepts ten thousand rivers.”

His voice rolled across the Changchun Range like a wave.

“It embraces both clear water and muddy water without distinction. But it cannot accept water laced with poison.”

Waves rose across the blue sky.

Those who heard his empowered voice felt as though they stood alone before an endless horizon. Disciples with weak divine sense unconsciously stepped half a pace backward.

“I came from the distant sea, but the Dao knows no borders, nor does the grievance of those unjustly slain belong to any one homeland.”

He gave a quiet sigh.

“The Qingchao Merchant Alliance has distributed pills and spirit plants throughout Lan Kingdom for many years. How could I, as its guest retainer, remain silent after witnessing the suffering of Lan Kingdom's rogue cultivators?”

The supreme sect master looked at Azure Sea Wanderer.

“I didn't realize the duties of the Qingchao Merchant Alliance's guest retainers extended to attacking other people's sects.”

“If I were to turn away after witnessing injustice, would I not be ashamed before my juniors, not as a guest retainer, but as a cultivator who has formed a golden core?”

“Well said.”

The supreme sect master nodded.

“But how strange. If you merely heard of this injustice and rushed here afterward, how did you know the exact moment the outer formation would collapse?”

Azure Sea Wanderer smiled.

The Changchun Sect's sect master asked.

“Was it you, fellow Daoist, who brought the Essence-Unblocking Pills into Lan Kingdom?”

“The distribution of pills is a matter the juniors handle themselves. I do not know the particulars.”

“Is that truly so?”

Lee Hyun did not miss Azure Sea Wanderer's brief silence.

‘He's involved.’

Azure Sea Wanderer studied the Changchun Sect's sect master for a moment, seemingly curious about his realm, then shifted his gaze to the supreme sect master's withered body and the staff in his hand.

“To think Golden Core cultivators here are this weak... It seems this level of strength is enough to occupy a Tier 3 spirit vein in Lan Kingdom.”

The faces of the Changchun Sect cultivators hardened at Azure Sea Wanderer's insulting words.

Red Furnace Adept spoke.

“Fellow Daoist Azure Sea Wanderer. It seems the Changchun Sect has no intention of admitting its crimes willingly.”

Lady White Ash quietly added,

“For the sake of the dead as well, the Mountain Gate must be opened.”

Azure Sea Wanderer nodded.

“Then this is as far as I will go in explaining reason with words.”

He raised his right hand.

The silver ring floating behind him began to rotate.

WHOOOOOOOM―

The sea hanging in the sky poured down in its entirety toward Changchun Peak.

“...!”

The supreme sect master and the Changchun Sect's sect master formed hand seals at the same time. The forest surged upward, and a ring of the four seasons appeared to support the descending sea.

BOOOOOOM!

The shockwave from the collision spread across all nine peaks. Countless spirit stones socketed into formation stations were pulverized at once, while the disciples operating those stations coughed up blood.

Yet the sea did not stop.

Even with two Golden Core cultivators joining forces, the surface of the sea continued to descend little by little.

Taking advantage of the opening, Red Furnace Adept's fire dragons and Lady White Ash's ashen wind once again struck the inner formation.

CRACK-CRACK-CRACK!

Azure Sea Wanderer stood atop the inverted sea and looked down at the Changchun Sect.

“The tides of the great ocean do not count how many peaks stand before them.”

The shadow of a gigantic whale emerged behind Azure Sea Wanderer.

When the whale swimming through the sky opened its mouth, layers of blue waves gathered within.

“Let me see just how profound the Daoist arts of Lan Kingdom are....”

The Golden Core cultivator from the southern sea lowered his hand.

“Allow this Azure Sea Wanderer to witness them firsthand.”

A dark blue wave collapsed toward the Changchun Sect.

Changchun Peak looked like nothing more than a tiny reef.

At that exact moment,

“The character zhi (止), ‘stop’.”

A calm voice rang out, as though someone were writing a character across paper with a brush.

A purple stroke appeared in the middle of the dark blue sea. Vertical and horizontal lines joined together, completing one enormous character.

【止】

RUUUUUMBLE―

The descending sea froze in place above the Changchun Range. Even the droplets flung from the tips of the waves and the fish swimming within were fixed motionless in the air.

Azure Sea Wanderer's gaze turned north.

Purple clouds were slowly rolling in from that direction. A middle-aged scholar in a crane cloak stood atop them.

He wore a simple crown on his head and held a white-jade ruler one chi (about 33 cm) long in one hand. With his three strands of beard and tranquil eyes, he resembled a scholar from the mundane world.

“Master Purple Cloud!”

“It's Master Purple Cloud of the Taihe Sect!”

Murmurs spread throughout the entire Changchun Sect.

Taihe Sect.

It was a great sect that occupied a Tier 4 spirit vein in central Lan Kingdom, with a Nascent Soul supreme ancestral master and a sect master above several Golden Core cultivators. The names of the Taihe Sect or Ziwei Sword Sect appeared in most of the large-scale covenants formed among the sects and clans of Lan Kingdom.

It was one of the powers that led the cultivation world of Lan Kingdom.

Master Purple Cloud raised his white-jade ruler.

“Trying to destroy another country's beautiful mountains... Is this what they teach as proper etiquette beyond Nanming Sea?”

Azure Sea Wanderer laughed.

“I simply cannot tolerate injustice.”

“You speak of the Changchun Sect's Essence-Raising Pills?”

“I do.”

Master Purple Cloud withdrew a thin golden ledger from his sleeve. When he tapped it with the white-jade ruler, the recorded characters floated into the air.

「770 Essence-Unblocking Pills and 80 jin (about 48 kg) of Meridian-Severing Grass.

Received into Qingchao Merchant Alliance inventory.

Purchased Changchun Sect Essence-Raising Pill bottles and damaged Spirit-Sealing Talismans.

Total: over 1,100.」

The cultivators in the External Affairs Market looked up at the records in the air.

Master Purple Cloud pointed his jade ruler toward the final portion of the ledger.

The movement of Essence-Unblocking Pills and spirit stones through the Qingchao Merchant Alliance's various warehouses had been split along complicated paths. But when traced backward by location and date, most converged upon a single maritime route.

It began in southern Nanli Kingdom and extended deep into Nanming Sea.

At the route's end was stamped a wave-shaped emblem unknown in the cultivation world of Lan Kingdom.

Master Purple Cloud spoke.

“These are records from an investigation by the Taihe Sect's Patrol Court. The ones who brought in the Essence-Unblocking Pills and the ones who purchased the Changchun Sect's empty pill bottles both crossed paths in warehouses belonging to the Qingchao Merchant Alliance.”

An uproar spread among the rogue cultivators of the External Affairs Market.

“They bought that many Essence-Raising Pill bottles?”

“What could they possibly want with empty bottles and Spirit-Sealing Talismans?”

“So the Essence-Unblocking Pills came through the Qingchao Merchant Alliance too!”

Master Purple Cloud continued.

“The Essence-Unblocking Pill itself is a perfectly normal pill. However, the pills recovered from the victims retained both the fire patterns left by melting down Essence-Unblocking Pills and putting them through Pill Condensation again, as well as the poison of Meridian-Severing Grass. During the same period, the Qingchao Merchant Alliance purchased Essence-Unblocking Pills, Meridian-Severing Grass, empty Changchun Sect pill bottles, and Spirit-Sealing Talismans. The necessary materials came together far too precisely for this to be mere coincidence.”

Master Purple Cloud's gaze moved across Red Furnace Adept, Lady White Ash, and Azure Sea Wanderer.

“You disguised poison pills as Essence-Raising Pills, killed people with them, then carried their corpses all the way here and used them as shields. Hearing people like you speak of righteousness is enough to make even me ashamed.”

The rogue cultivators erupted in anger.

“They deliberately killed people and tried to pin the crime on the Changchun Sect!”

Red Furnace Adept's face hardened.

“Fellow Daoist Purple Cloud. Do you intend to slander even the Honglu Sect without conclusive evidence?”

“Fellow Daoist? Since when did the likes of the Honglu Sect dare question a cultivator of the Taihe Sect? After joining hands with an overseas power, you still have the face to speak to me?”

“...”

Master Purple Cloud closed the ledger and extended his white-jade ruler.

“Even if the Changchun Sect were guilty, the matter would be judged according to the laws of Lan Kingdom. I will not allow a blade from beyond the southern sea to sit in judgment over one of Lan Kingdom's sects.”

The smile vanished from Azure Sea Wanderer's eyes. A crescent-shaped wave sprang from inside the silver ring, attempting to cleave through both the floating ledger and Master Purple Cloud.

SWOOOOOSH!

Before it could, a single black bamboo leaf brushed across the center of the wave.

SLICE.

The silver wave, dozens of zhang long, split cleanly in two.

RUSTLE.

A white scroll unfurled in midair. At the tip of the ink-black bamboo painted upon it stood a woman who appeared to be around twenty-five.

She wore a simple black-and-white robe, and her waist-length hair was held in place by a single ink-black bamboo hairpin. A slender brush rested in her hand.

Azure Sea Wanderer spoke.

“And what technique is this?”

Someone among the rogue cultivators shouted.

“It's Senior Su Zhuyan of the Taihe Sect!”

Su Zhuyan was a renowned talisman maker in Lan Kingdom and an extraordinary cultivator who followed the Dao of Painting.

When she painted a single wave into an empty section of the scroll, the sea pressing down on the Changchun Range began to be sucked into the painting. The whale's shadow, the schools of fish, and even the droplets frozen in the sky formed a tremendous vortex and streamed into the scroll.

Azure Sea Wanderer exclaimed in admiration.

“Lan Kingdom does have a few techniques worth seeing.”

Master Purple Cloud spoke.

“If you turn back even now, the Taihe Sect will not pursue your discourtesy any further.”

“...”

“Do you intend to face the two of us alone?”

Azure Sea Wanderer looked back and forth between Master Purple Cloud and Su Zhuyan.

Not a trace of fear appeared on his face.

“If there are two, so what? If there are three, what of it?”

The sea within the silver ring began revolving even faster.

Twelve lights appeared within its depths.

They were twelve dark blue beads.

Each bead contained the scenery of a different sea.

It was a magic treasure forged from spirit materials and an artifact-forging method never seen in Lan Kingdom.

“Then allow me to witness the Daoist arts of you two as well.”

Su Zhuyan's eyebrow twitched.

“No, wait....”

At that moment, the horizons of the different seas contained within the twelve beads brightened simultaneously.

The light extended from the beads and connected to somewhere beyond the southern sky.

Master Purple Cloud's expression hardened. Su Zhuyan also looked toward the southern sky before rapidly moving her lips.

No sound could be heard, yet the gazes of the Changchun Sect's sect master and supreme sect master immediately turned toward the two of them. The lips of all four Golden Core cultivators moved almost simultaneously.

The next moment, the Foundation Establishment Elders' expressions grew solemn.

Soon, the identity token hanging from Lee Hyun's waist trembled ever so slightly.

[Yanzhu, Jingsong, Dong'er. Listen carefully, and don't be alarmed.]

It was Gao Yuanhe.

[Return to Yang Fire Court. Pack your belongings within half a ke (about seven or eight minutes), then head to North Gate Three.]

Shen Yanzhu asked,

[Has something happened?]

[A Nascent Soul cultivator may be approaching. Don't show any reaction. Nothing good will come of them realizing we're evacuating.]

Gao Yuanhe's voice transmission was swift and firm.

[Take charge of ten disciples at mid Qi Refining or below.]

[What will you do, Master?]

[A Foundation Establishment cultivator accompanying you would only make you a target. The Elders and stewards will split up and travel separately, each carrying a portion of the core inheritance. Do not take a large flying boat. Do not rise above the forest canopy. Run through the valleys and between the trees, or fly low. Once you're two hundred li (about 78 km) away, divide the group again, and do not stop until you reach territory controlled by the Taihe Sect or Ziwei Sword Sect.]

The voice transmission ended.

The three hurried toward Pill Cauldron Peak.

In the sky behind them, the battle between the seven Golden Core cultivators resumed.

...

Pill Cauldron Peak, Yang Fire Court.

By the time the three returned, Yang Fire Court had already fallen into chaos.

The seals on the medicinal-ingredient warehouses were being released one after another. The stewards, who normally would have scrutinized every last line in the ledgers, swept pill recipes, pills, and medicinal ingredients into storage pouches.

Lee Hyun headed straight for his residence.

Most of his core assets were in Tunnel No. 2, so there was almost nothing he needed to take.

As he passed the communal alchemy chamber, a steward in charge of the medicinal-ingredient warehouse spotted him and beckoned. At the steward's feet stood one of the better-maintained communal pill furnaces in Yang Fire Court, a Tier 1 supreme-grade pill furnace.

“Dong'er, you don't seem to have much luggage. Is there room left in your storage pouch?”

“Yes.”

“Then put this in too. If we leave it behind, it'll only become loot for those bastards.”

The steward pushed the pill furnace toward him.

Still somewhat bewildered, Lee Hyun reached out and stuffed the waist-high bronze pill furnace directly into his storage pouch.

...

Before even half a ke had passed, dozens of disciples had gathered in front of North Gate Three.

Thirteen of them from Yang Fire Court formed a single group.

Shen Yanzhu and Pei Jingsong stood at the front, while Lee Hyun took the rear. The remaining ten were disciples at Qi Refining Stage 6 or below.

A Green Leaf Boat a little over five zhang in length emerged from the emergency storehouse beside them. It was a Tier 1 mid-grade flight magic tool shaped like a broad leaf, with a sleek hull and little noise, making it easy to pass through dense woodland.

A Foundation Establishment Elder sent a voice transmission only to the three of them.

[Take turns operating it. Do not rise above the forest, and do not travel in the same direction as any other Green Leaf Boat.]

Without another word, he opened North Gate Three.

HUUUUM―

The Green Leaf Boat carrying all thirteen passed through the blue barrier.

Shen Yanzhu lowered their altitude, bringing the Green Leaf Boat beneath the treetops. At times it glided along valleys, and at others it slipped diagonally between thick tree trunks.

Once they left the Mountain Gate, another gate behind them briefly opened and then closed. Disciples from the various peaks were quietly scattering at different times and along different routes.

Lights from techniques still flashed across the sky. Red flames, purple characters, blue waves, and ink-black radiance alternately dyed the forest as though day and night were flickering back and forth. Even as the distance increased, the explosions continued to shake the Green Leaf Boat beneath their feet.

...

A forest a little over sixty li northeast of the Changchun Range.

Just as the Green Leaf Boat was about to leave a narrow valley, six bronze streaks flashed between the trees ahead.

SWISH-SWISH-SWISH!

Ten layers of Lee Hyun's Spirit Light Shield unfolded in front of the Green Leaf Boat.

BOOM-BOOM-BOOM-BOOM!

The six outer Spirit Light Shields shattered at once, but the inner shields tilted at an angle and deflected the trajectories of the flying swords outward. The bronze flying swords barely skimmed past the edges of the Green Leaf Boat before piercing the cliffs and trees on either side.

When the Green Leaf Boat shook violently from the impact, Shen Yanzhu immediately changed direction and brought the flight magic tool down into a clearing in the forest.

“Everyone, off!”

Before the disciples could even leap from the Green Leaf Boat, two waves of Foundation Establishment spiritual pressure crushed down over the clearing.

A cultivator in a dark gray robe stood among the shadows of the trees ahead. At a gesture from him, the six scattered bronze flying swords swiftly returned and began revolving above his head.

Another Foundation Establishment cultivator appeared atop the cliff behind them, dressed in a dark blue robe. He held a black-iron spear longer than a man was tall.

The two Foundation Establishment cultivators had blocked their escape from both front and rear.

Shen Yanzhu and Pei Jingsong immediately drew their magic tools, while the ten Junior Brothers also formed up.

Lee Hyun drew the Mountain-Suppressing Sword.

SHING―

A wondrous light quietly wreathed the blade.

The instant the cultivator controlling the bronze flying swords saw the sword wrapped in that light, his body went rigid.

“You....”

As though unable to believe his eyes, he tore off his mask. Beneath it appeared a face that seemed vaguely familiar.

“Badger!”

‘Is he one of the alliance elders I fought on Chiyao Island before?’

The cultivator in the dark blue robe asked with a puzzled expression.

“You know that guy?”

“Don't underestimate him. We need to kill him immediately!”

Chapter 40

The alliance elder shouted as he pulled a blue voice-transmission talisman from his sleeve.

“Hold him off while I call for reinforcements!”

The cultivator in the dark blue robe thrust out his black iron spear.

Whoooosh―

The spiritual power coiling around the spearhead converged into a single point. The moment he twisted the shaft, three spear shadows as thick as a man’s torso fanned out and swept across the clearing. Two of them surged mercilessly toward the Changchun Sect disciples behind Lee Hyun, as though intending to slaughter them all at once.

At the same time, the gray-robed alliance elder’s six bronze flying swords scattered.

Three targeted Lee Hyun, while the other three blocked the Changchun Sect disciples from the left, right, and above. Thin strands of bronze light connected the flying swords, cutting off their escape routes.

The ground caved in, and fallen leaves and stones were swept into the air by the violent gale.

“Ten-Direction Yin Wood Formation!”

At Shen Yanzhu’s shout, the Qi Refining disciples of Pill Cauldron Peak scattered in all directions and raised their formation plaques.

Hummm―

Green spirit light connected the ten disciples. A thin, rounded barrier of light blossomed outward, enveloping all twelve of them.

Pei Jingsong stood at the front of the formation and pressed both hands toward the ground.

Rrrrumble!

Three earthen walls rose at an angle. Four red talismans flew from Shen Yanzhu’s sleeve.

Fwoooosh!

Four fireballs shot out along crossing trajectories toward the spear shadows and flying swords.

Yet even when the fireballs struck, they barely weakened the spear shadows’ momentum. At this rate, the earthen walls and light barrier would both be shattered the instant the spear shadows reached them.

At that moment, Lee Hyun moved.

Hummm―

An explosive suction force erupted from Lee Hyun’s left hand. His target was the blue voice-transmission talisman glowing between the alliance elder’s fingers.

At the same time, the Mountain-Suppressing Sword in his right hand chopped downward through the air twice at a speed too fast to see.

Flash!

Two dazzling sword lights shot forth, precisely cutting through the middle of the two spear shadows charging toward the disciples. The heavy spear shadows of a Foundation Establishment cultivator were severed in half and exploded in midair.

At the same moment, the voice-transmission talisman tore free of the alliance elder’s grip and flew into Lee Hyun’s left hand.

“What―”

Lee Hyun clenched his fist as his figure blurred and scattered. The instant the blue talisman crumbled, the final spear shadow and three bronze flying swords aimed at him sliced through empty air.

Almost simultaneously, the weakened remnants of the other two spear shadows and the remaining three flying swords crashed into the disciples’ defensive line.

Boom! KABOOM!

The first earthen wall cracked, and the second collapsed.

Fortunately, the third earthen wall finally stopped the remnants of the two severed spear shadows.

But when the three bronze flying swords punched through the fireballs and bore down on the green light barrier, all ten disciples coughed up blood and groaned at once.

Crack!

Fractures spread across the barrier.

Even so, not one of them let go of their formation plaque.

When one disciple was hurled sideways, the two beside him grabbed his waist and arm. The severed strand of green light immediately reconnected.

Taking advantage of that opening, the dark-blue-robed cultivator rushed after Lee Hyun.

The black iron spear pierced straight through Lee Hyun’s chest.

“Junior Brother Li!”

Shen Yanzhu screamed.

But Lee Hyun’s body wavered and scattered.

It was Form and Position Shift!

Boom!

Lee Hyun had already closed to within a step of the dark-blue-robed cultivator.

The cultivator twisted the spear shaft and swept it upward.

Screeeech!

Three black iron rings fitted around the shaft of the black iron spear scraped harshly against the metal as they shot off past the spearhead.

The launched rings swelled to the size of wagon wheels in midair and began spinning violently.

They curved in along three different trajectories, hurtling toward Lee Hyun’s neck, waist, and legs.

Whoosh!

Lee Hyun’s body, which had been shooting forward in a straight line, traced a semicircle through the air. The first iron ring grazed beneath the hem of his robe, while the second swept past his back. When the third blocked his path, the Mountain-Suppressing Sword slashed diagonally.

Crack!

The black iron ring split in two, its halves smashing into trees on either side.

Lee Hyun’s left hand turned toward the black iron spear.

Humm!

The spear shaft was dragged a little over a handspan to the side.

‘What!?’

The dark-blue-robed cultivator forced the spear back onto its original trajectory through sheer strength.

But the Mountain-Suppressing Sword had already slipped inside his guard.

Lee Hyun’s sword emitted an unfathomable light as it carved a bold diagonal line.

──!!

The dark-blue-robed cultivator looked down at the thin line running from one shoulder to the opposite side of his waist.

Behind him stood five thick, ancient trees.

Shhk.

The upper halves of the trees tilted at exactly the same angle.

A moment later, the cultivator’s upper body also slid down along the cut.

The instant the alliance elder witnessed his companion being severed in a single strike, extreme terror flashed through his eyes.

‘That bastard’s a monster!’

He had no chance in close combat. Without a moment’s hesitation, the alliance elder shot into the air while forming hand seals with both hands.

Fwish-fwish-fwish-fwish-fwish!

The six bronze flying swords formed an enormous sword net over the Changchun Sect disciples’ heads and plunged downward like lightning.

He intended to slaughter the disciples to keep Lee Hyun occupied while he fled high into the sky.

“Block them!”

At Shen Yanzhu’s shout, the disciples poured out all their spiritual power and talismans.

KABOOM!

Fireballs, earthen walls, and stone spikes slammed into the sword net, but they could not withstand the savage power of a Foundation Establishment cultivator.

Just as the light barrier of the Ten-Direction Yin Wood Formation tore apart and the six flying swords were about to shred the disciples’ bodies―

Lee Hyun, having cut down the dark-blue-robed cultivator, spun around and executed a stomping step.

Boom!

Using the recoil to launch himself upward, he reached his left hand toward the alliance elder in the air.

Before the fragments of the falling ancient trees could even strike the ground, Lee Hyun’s body shot skyward.

“Guh!?”

The alliance elder’s ascending body suddenly bent backward as though it had caught on an enormous invisible anchor, then was dragged down toward Lee Hyun at terrifying speed.

As the alliance elder screamed, the flying swords forming the sword net all lurched and scattered.

With his own life now in imminent danger, the alliance elder completely forgot about killing the disciples.

He pulled a blue pearl from his sleeve and crushed it.

Splash―

The water sealed inside the pearl spread outward like a circular wave, forming a watery barrier around him.

At the same time, the six bronze flying swords abandoned the space above the disciples’ heads and hurtled frantically back toward their master.

Fwish-fwish-fwish!

The flying swords formed a hexagon once more.

All six began rotating in different directions.

The sword wheel surrounded Lee Hyun from every side.

The alliance elder clenched his fist.

The sword wheel contracted.

Lee Hyun assumed an opening stance.

The streak of sword light that had pierced the alliance elder’s side on Chiyao Island flashed through his mind.

‘It’s that technique from before!’

He concentrated the watery barrier in front of his chest. Two additional layers of light also covered the center of the sword wheel.

At that moment, the Mountain-Suppressing Sword in Lee Hyun’s hand trembled faintly.

In an instant too brief for the eye to follow, its tip pointed in six different directions.

Sixth Move of One Ultimate, Six Swords.

Six Blossoms in Riotous Bloom.

Six streaks of pure white sword light blossomed from a single point.

Clang! CLANGGG!

The six collisions overlapped into one long, crystalline ring.

The bronze sword wheel burst wide open.

Between the trajectories of the flying swords being knocked away, the white sword lights curved and crossed. They looked like six flower petals blooming one after another in midair.

The alliance elder’s entire vision was drowned in light.

He could not decide which sword light to block first.

No, from the very beginning, not one of the six sword lights had been aimed at him.

They were merely petals that had blossomed to conceal the single point of the Mountain-Suppressing Sword.

The center of the wide-open sword wheel.

Light flashed.

A narrow hole appeared in the watery barrier.

Lee Hyun swept past the alliance elder, then used the Wind-Riding Art to flip himself in midair. His feet stepped upon the wind and landed atop the stump of a severed ancient tree.

The alliance elder remained motionless in the air for a moment.

Only then did a red dot appear in the center of his chest.

“Stronger... than before....”

A thin stream of blood spurted from the red point.

The alliance elder fell from the sky.

Thud.

Shen Yanzhu stood frozen with her red flying sword raised.

Pei Jingsong had not even released the hand seal maintaining the cracked light barrier. The ten disciples also kept hold of their formation plaques as they stared at Lee Hyun.

In the span of only a few breaths, two Foundation Establishment cultivators had died.

Only then did the sound wash over the clearing.

Rrrrumble―

The severed ancient trees crashed down, and the six deflected bronze flying swords struck rocks and earth one after another. The forest shredded by the sword net collapsed in a shower of debris, while the green light barrier that had endured until the very end dissolved into motes of light.

A fierce wind swept away the leaves and dust.

Lee Hyun stood at the center of it all.

Swish.

Lee Hyun flicked the blood from his sword.

...

The forest clearing fell silent.

The Changchun Sect disciples looked back and forth between the two fallen Foundation Establishment cultivators and Lee Hyun.

Pei Jingsong opened his mouth.

“Two Foundation Establishment cultivators....”

Shen Yanzhu swallowed hard.

“Junior Brother Li.”

“Please wait a moment. You two should tend to the injured junior brothers. I’ll erase our traces first.”

Lee Hyun first approached the corpses of the two cultivators.

Identity tokens hung at both cultivators’ waists.

The Mountain-Suppressing Sword flashed once, splitting both identity tokens apart.

Lee Hyun melted the identity tokens with the Fireball Art until they lost their shape, then used the Soil-Turning Art to scatter the remaining fragments deep underground.

Next, he examined their two storage pouches.

Using the formation knowledge he had learned while staying at the Changchun Sect and the Aura-Reading Art, he checked the formation inscriptions inside and out. There were no hidden restrictions, nor any signs of spiritual-power fluctuations being transmitted outward.

He removed every unidentified talisman, jade plaque, and anything resembling a directional instrument or otherwise likely to be used for tracking, then destroyed them in the same manner as the identity tokens.

He kept only the spirit stones, pills, general-purpose talismans, and ordinary spirit materials.

After quickly sorting what to discard and what to keep, Lee Hyun waved his hand. The six bronze flying swords scattered around the area, the black iron spear, the two remaining iron rings, and even the severed fragments were all pulled toward him in an instant.

The magic tools of the two Foundation Establishment cultivators were extraordinary even at a glance.

Ripple-like patterns flowed along the blades of the flying swords, and when all six were placed side by side, those patterns connected into one.

The black iron spear had no visible seam from shaft to spearhead, and dense formation inscriptions could be seen beneath its black, gleaming surface.

Either one was something a Qi Refining cultivator would struggle to obtain even after saving spirit stones for an entire lifetime.

‘They’re definitely high-grade magic tools! It looks like Tier-2 low-grade or mid-grade spirit materials were used... It’d be a shame to throw them away.’

Lee Hyun repeatedly examined both magic tools with the Aura-Reading Art. For the moment, there did not appear to be any suspicious restrictions or formation inscriptions.

‘The Qingchao Merchant Alliance is less a unified sect than a merchant alliance founded by the heads of several Foundation Establishment clans. Each of them would have learned the inheritance of their own clan, so they probably had no standardized system for bonding magic tools. It’s highly unlikely that every individual magic tool would have some kind of tracking method engraved into it.’

Lee Hyun put the flying swords, spear, iron rings, and even the fragments into a storage pouch.

Then he burned the corpses and spilled blood with the Fireball Art.

Fwoosh―

He buried the black ashes beneath soil overturned with the Soil-Turning Art.

Only then did Lee Hyun turn around.

Shen Yanzhu asked,

“That man called you Badger. What did he mean?”

“It was an alias I used a long time ago.”

“An alias....”

Pei Jingsong looked at Lee Hyun as though gauging his aura all over again.

“Then was your realm of Qi Refining Stage 7 a lie as well?”

“No. My realm really is Qi Refining Stage 7.”

“.......”

That answer only confused the two of them further.

One of the disciples behind them muttered without realizing it.

“A Qi Refining Stage 7 cultivator did that to two Foundation Establishment cultivators....”

Shen Yanzhu looked as though she had many questions she wanted to ask.

For the past seventeen years, they had refined pills together, carried out missions together, and talked over tea and wine. The Li Dong’er they knew was a quiet, cautious alchemist from a rogue cultivator background.

Yet the junior brother before them had killed two Foundation Establishment cultivators in moments.

Shen Yanzhu asked cautiously,

“Did you join the Changchun Sect to deceive us?”

“That was never my intention.”

Lee Hyun thought for a moment before answering honestly.

“I wanted to cultivate at a good spirit vein and learn alchemy and formations. I never once intended to harm the Changchun Sect.”

Pei Jingsong helped one of the fallen disciples back to his feet.

“I believe you, Junior Brother. If you meant us harm, you would have had no reason to save us just now.”

Shen Yanzhu slowly nodded as well.

Gratitude came before wariness. Without Lee Hyun, not one of those standing here would have survived.

“Thank you.”

Shen Yanzhu spoke softly.

Lee Hyun briefly lowered his head.

“I learned a great deal from both of you as well.”

“You’re leaving?”

“I’ll travel separately from here.”

Shen Yanzhu’s expression hardened.

“You mean you’re leaving us now?”

“They recognized me from my past. With even a Golden Core cultivator from overseas attacking the Changchun Sect, traveling with me could put all of you in even greater danger.”

Lee Hyun removed his Changchun Sect identity token, then took off his green robe, folded it neatly, and handed both to Shen Yanzhu.

“I suppose I can no longer use the name Li Dong’er either.”

“What is your real name?”

Pei Jingsong asked.

“It’s better if you don’t know.”

Pei Jingsong looked regretful, but did not ask again.

Lee Hyun cupped his hands toward the two of them and the disciples behind them.

“May all of you survive this safely.”

Pei Jingsong cupped his hands as well.

“Junior Brother Li... no. Fellow Daoist, may you remain safe as well.”

Shen Yanzhu never changed how she addressed him.

“Take care, Junior Brother Li.”

Lee Hyun looked at them one last time before turning away.

Shhhk―

His body sank into the earth.

A short while later, only the Changchun Sect disciples remained in the clearing.

...

A little over two shichen (about four hours) later.

Qingmu Ridge, more than a thousand li (about 392 km) north of the Changchun Sect.

Lee Hyun slowed down when he was about twenty li from Qingmu Ridge. He circled around deep underground to determine the range of the Field-Guarding Formation, then cautiously rose toward the surface.

Hummm―

A blue barrier surrounded the entirety of Qingmu Ridge.

There were no signs that it had suffered a surprise attack. The resident disciples and those who had come to harvest spirit plants were hurriedly transferring supplies from the storerooms into storage pouches, while flying boats stood lined up on stone platforms, already loaded with spirit stones so they could depart at a moment’s notice.

Amid the commotion, Lee Hyun heard a familiar voice.

“How many boxes did you say there were?”

It was Luo Jingwen.

He was packing boxes alongside the Qi Refining disciples. He looked busy preparing for evacuation, but did not seem to be injured.

Lee Hyun watched him from a distance for a moment.

‘He’s safe.’

The people of Qingmu Ridge were already preparing to evacuate.

There were Foundation Establishment cultivators here as well, so there was nothing more Lee Hyun needed to do.

He quietly turned away.

...

After leaving Qingmu Ridge, Lee Hyun continued downward.

Three li underground.

Ten li underground.

Twenty li underground.

The deeper he went, the less soil there was and the more solid bedrock he encountered. The air grew hotter, and he could sense fire qi flowing along the earth veins in many places.

When he finally reached roughly twenty-five li underground, Lee Hyun slowed down.

‘I’ll travel at this depth.’

Even if it was somewhat inconvenient, Lee Hyun decided to prioritize safety.

Tunnel No. 2 was roughly twenty-one thousand li south of his current position.

Lee Hyun cautiously began moving south.

...

Fifteen days later.

He sensed the familiar flow of earth fire ahead.

Shhhk―

A small, artificially carved cavern appeared between layers of solid bedrock.

On the floor was a Nine-Fire Flame-Storing Formation formed from nine red formation stones, and at its center stood the bronze pill furnace he had purchased from the Fengtian Bureau long ago.

Everything was exactly as he had left it.

Lee Hyun placed a hand on the pill furnace.

“Whew... I made it!”

He packed the red formation stones and pill furnace into his storage pouch, erased the traces of formation inscriptions on the floor, then immediately ascended ten li.

...

Fifteen li underground.

A human head suddenly poked out of the earth.

「Tunnel No. 2」

Plip.

Somewhere in the silent passageway, a drop of water fell.

“Good. Time to get ready to move.”

The first thing he did was organize the space in his storage pouches.

Lee Hyun lined up his three storage pouches and the two he had obtained from the Qingchao Merchant Alliance’s Foundation Establishment cultivators on the storeroom floor.

After consolidating their contents into one storage pouch, the other four were completely empty.

Lee Hyun started with the items in the storeroom.

Pills and talismans, books recording changes in the spirit fields and the results of his alchemy, samples of medicinal ingredients and soil, paper and lumber, tools and equipment... one after another, everything disappeared into his storage pouches.

Next, his gaze fell on the popular novels covering an entire wall of the lounge.

He had bought a set or two every time he visited a cultivator market or mortal city, and before he knew it, his collection had grown to several thousand volumes.

“There’s no need to take all of these.”

Lee Hyun looked through the books and established a few criteria.

Books he had not yet read.

Masterpieces worth reading again and again.

And books that one reading had been enough for.

“Most of them fall into the third category....”

In the end, only a little over a hundred of the several thousand volumes went into his storage pouches.

Next came the spirit fields.

Lee Hyun went through Spirit Field No. 1-1 to Spirit Field No. 1-7 and placed the spirit plants into his storage pouches in much the same way as before.

Then he lifted the Spirit-Storing Ginseng from Spirit Field No. 2-1 through No. 2-5 together with entire slabs of soil and neatly stacked them inside the storage pouches.

The test spirit field came last. He separately marked and transferred each spirit plant he had planted at a different medicine age to measure traces of bone age.

...

As he moved the spirit plants, the fuzzbees flew frantically around Lee Hyun.

Bzz-bzz-bzz―

Squeak. Squeak squeak.

They seemed anxious at the sight of entire spirit fields disappearing.

“We’re moving again.”

Squeak?

“Let’s find somewhere better this time.”

Lee Hyun went through the spirit fields, hunting tunnel, and natural fissures one by one, gathering the fuzzbees into his spirit-insect pouch.

Bzz― Bzz-bzz-bzz―

It took half a day to get the very last fuzzbee into the spirit-insect pouch.

He also dismantled the irrigation facilities and any useful components, packing them into his storage pouches.

...

In the end, Tunnel No. 2 was empty.

More than five hundred years had passed since he first created this place.

This was where he had returned after his time as society head of the Qutian Society, where he had hidden after escaping Chiyao Island, and where he had tended his spirit plants and fuzzbees while traveling back and forth to the Changchun Sect.

“.......”

Lee Hyun closed his eyes and listened to the silence for a while.

There was no sound at all.
