Over four thousand li (about 1,570 km) east of the Danxiao Range.

Baihe Market, eastern Kun Kingdom.

A faint medicinal fragrance drifted from a small alchemy chamber in the Huoyuan Pill Pavilion.

Fwoosh―

A Tier-1 mid-grade pill furnace glowed red with heat.

A man who appeared to be around thirty-five sat before the pill furnace.

He had a short beard on his chin, and his skin was somewhat rough and dark, like that of someone who frequently went into the mountains to gather medicinal ingredients.

His name was Li Dongsan.

When he had first appeared in Baihe Market five years earlier, he had introduced himself as a thirty-year-old Qi Refining Stage 7 rogue cultivator.

He said that after his master, an unknown rogue cultivator alchemist, died several years earlier, he inherited the man’s teachings and pill furnace. Short on spirit stones, he wandered for a time before eventually settling in Baihe Market.

For five years, Li Dongsan worked as an alchemist at Huoyuan Pill Pavilion, making various pills in high demand, including Hunger-Warding Pills.

He traded with medicinal ingredient merchants in Baihe Market and occasionally ventured outside with nearby rogue cultivators to hunt demon beasts.

Three years ago, he broke through to Qi Refining Stage 8.

The owner of Huoyuan Pill Pavilion congratulated him on his breakthrough with a bottle of cheap spirit wine, and the nearby rogue cultivators also came to remember the name Li Dongsan.

...

Crackle.

Li Dongsan extinguished the fire, opened the pill furnace, and divided the Blood-Staunching Pills between two jade bottles.

When he left the alchemy chamber, the owner of Huoyuan Pill Pavilion was waiting for him.

The Huoyuan Pill Pavilion owner was a gray-haired Qi Refining Stage 9 cultivator. He had failed to reach Foundation Establishment and was already over seventy, but with his talent for business and his eye for people, he steadily operated a small pill pavilion in Baihe Market.

He accepted the jade bottles, checked the quantity and quality of the pills, then clicked his tongue.

“Your talent is wasted here...”

“Haha, I like it here.”

“...”

The pill pavilion owner put the jade bottles containing the Blood-Staunching Pills into his storage pouch.

“You know the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners will be opening soon, don’t you?”

“The Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners?”

“That’s right. It’s also called the Special Selection for Rogue Cultivators. It’s an examination held by the Danxiao Sect to recruit outside rogue cultivators...”

Two months later.

Lee Hyun stopped walking and looked toward the distant sky.

Faintly glowing clouds stretched across the horizon.

The clouds drifted slowly along the mountain range, swirling here and there. At times they rose like flames, and at others they spread in circles like smoke billowing from an enormous pill furnace.

Beneath them, the outlines of peaks both high and low could be seen faintly.

It was the Danxiao Range.

‘There’s still a thousand li to go...’

Spirit light flickered in Lee Hyun’s eyes.

Numerous energies mingled intricately among the clouds. The spiritual qi of the mountain range was already exerting a subtle influence even this far away.

“So this is a Tier-4 spirit vein.”

...

The closer he drew to the Danxiao Range, the more people appeared on the road.

A mortal couple holding their child’s hand.

An elder from a cultivation clan leading more than a dozen juniors.

A small sect with a flying boat packed with children.

Qi Refining rogue cultivators carrying all sorts of low-grade magic tools.

Flying boats of every size also moved through the sky in the same direction.

Some carried entire pavilions dozens of zhang (well over 100 m) long, while others were shaped like enormous birds or fish.

Different patterns and flags fluttered from every flying boat.

When a cultivation clan’s flying boat with jade railings passed by, guard cultivators wearing matching robes flanked it on cloud-shaped magic tools. There were rogue cultivators sitting cross-legged atop enormous red gourds, and Lee Hyun even saw two people riding together on a single streak of sword light.

Lee Hyun walked among the ordinary rogue cultivators.

From a little over a hundred li away from the Danxiao Range, shops and inns began appearing on both sides of the broad road.

A little farther on, enormous city walls came into view.

Danxiao Immortal City.

The walls towered far higher than those of any mortal city.

Thousands of people passed through the gates.

There were mortals among them, but most were cultivators, members of cultivation clans, or outer disciples from various sects.

Pill pavilions and Spirit Materials Halls lined the streets inside the city.

‘Looks like a cultivator market managed by the Danxiao Sect.’

The main avenue ran straight toward the Mountain Gate, while carts piled high with medicinal ingredients traveled back and forth without pause. Flying boats belonging to outside merchant groups landed one after another on a broad stone platform on one side of the city.

...

North of Danxiao Immortal City.

Countless people had already gathered in the broad plaza leading to the Mountain Gate.

In the largest central area, children under fifteen stood in lines, more than a thousand of them in total.

Rogue cultivators who had already entered Qi Refining were directed to a broad section on the eastern side of the plaza.

Hundreds of Qi Refining cultivators were lined up there as well.

A large signboard hung above the entrance.

「Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners」

Beneath it hung smaller signboards for each field.

「alchemy」

「spirit plant」

「formation」

「artifact refining」

「talisman crafting」

「beast control」

「medical arts」

「insect control」

「combat」

The signboards for insect control and combat in particular looked newly made.

‘Has demand for insect control and combat increased? Maybe it’s because of the Wangu Sect in Cang Kingdom to the south.’

Most of the applicants were at early Qi Refining, but Qi Refining Stage 6 was not uncommon, and there were quite a few at Stages 7 and 8 as well. Lee Hyun could even see more than ten cultivators openly displaying the aura of Qi Refining Stage 9.

‘I suppose applicants to a great sect really are on another level.’

Just then, a small commotion arose near the front of the alchemy section.

A young female cultivator in pale vermilion robes parted from her guard cultivators and joined the line. Her stable Qi Refining Stage 8 aura and refined appearance stood out.

“That’s Chen Xiaoying of the Danxia Chen clan.”

“I heard she refined a Tier-1 high-grade Clear Spirit Pill at twenty-six?”

“First place in the alchemy field is already decided, then.”

Hearing the whispers around her, Chen Xiaoying took her place without the slightest change in expression.

Soon, Foundation Establishment cultivators wearing the robes of the Danxiao Sect flew over the Mountain Gate.

Dozens of streaks of spirit light scattered across the plaza.

They all wore ivory robes. Rising golden flames were embroidered along their sleeves and collars. With their robe hems wrapped in spirit light and fluttering through the air, they looked exceptionally dignified. Even the cultivation clan attire that had seemed so splendid moments ago suddenly appeared dull by comparison.

One of them descended in front of the entrance to the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners.

Thud.

The Foundation Establishment cultivator raised the flag in his hand.

As the pattern on the flag lit up, his voice spread across the entire plaza.

“Those taking the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners, line up according to your field!”

The murmuring rogue cultivators hurried into motion.

“We will first examine your bone age, realm, and spiritual root! Anyone found with traces of a demonic cultivation art, blood sacrifice, unauthorized Life-Bound Gu, or parasitic spirit insects will be detained immediately!”

The expressions of several rogue cultivators stiffened.

The Foundation Establishment cultivator continued.

“Today, we will only confirm your qualifications! The skill examinations will begin tomorrow and proceed separately by field!”

The lines for each field gradually lengthened.

Lee Hyun walked beneath the signboard marked alchemy.

Dozens of rogue cultivator alchemists stood ahead of him.

...

The line steadily moved forward.

A mirror taller than a person stood atop a broad stone platform.

Two Foundation Establishment cultivators sat in front of it.

Before long, it was Lee Hyun’s turn.

“Next!”

He stepped onto the stone platform.

‘That mirror looks pretty impressive...’

Lee Hyun was rather nervous.

“Name.”

“Li Dongsan.”

“Raise your right hand.”

Lee Hyun pressed his palm against the mirror.

A cold sensation seeped into his fingertips.

Hummm―

The silver patterns on the mirror brightened.

A hazy light slowly swept from his fingers, past his wrist and elbow, and up to his shoulder.

Thin rings appeared over the mirror.

The examiner studied them.

“Thirty-five. Qi Refining Stage 8. Triple spiritual root: Wood, Fire, and Earth.”

‘Phew...’

“Your spiritual power is quite stable.”

“Thank you.”

...

The second screening checked for traces of demonic cultivation arts, blood sacrifice, and parasitic spirit insects.

The applicants walked one by one between twelve stone pillars.

A different formation inscription was engraved on each pillar.

While Lee Hyun waited to be examined, green flames suddenly surged up ahead.

Fwoosh!

The face of the young cultivator standing among the stone pillars stiffened.

“Stop.”

The Foundation Establishment cultivator managing the formation rose from his seat.

“You hid a spirit insect in your dantian.”

“I wasn’t hiding it!”

The young cultivator hurriedly protested.

“I heard that in the Special Selection for Rogue Cultivators, all you have to do is prove your skill. I’m a gu warrior comparable to late Qi Refining. I can perform alchemy as well.”

The Foundation Establishment cultivator shook his head.

“The Danxiao Sect does not accept gu warriors.”

The surrounding applicants whispered among themselves.

“So he was a gu warrior.”

“Creepy fellows.”

“Why has someone from Qianyang Kingdom come all the way to the Danxiao Sect?”

...

Lee Hyun’s turn came.

He walked between the twelve stone pillars.

Hummm―

The formation inscriptions lit up one after another.

“Pass.”

...

The final stage was a question-and-answer session to verify each applicant’s identity and activities.

The applicants entered a small hall one at a time.

“Li Dongsan... You worked as a guest alchemist at Huoyuan Pill Pavilion for five years.”

“Yes.”

“And you never caused any trouble in Baihe Market...”

...

A total of eighty-three alchemist applicants passed the qualification screening.

Half a shichen (about one hour) later.

Several large leaf-shaped flight magic tools landed one after another atop a broad stone platform.

Once the applicants had divided themselves by field and boarded the flight magic tools, the vessels passed through the northern gate of Danxiao Immortal City and headed toward the mountain range.

The clouds surrounding the mountains drew closer and closer.

Beneath the clouds stretched an enormous formation barrier. Made of mist and light, it enveloped the entire mountain range, while countless formation inscriptions appeared and vanished like stars.

An outer disciple standing at the front of the flight magic tool raised his identity token.

Hummm―

A long passage opened through the barrier.

The instant the flight magic tool entered it.

Whoosh―

Dense heaven-and-earth spiritual qi surged in from every direction.

Soft exclamations rose among the applicants.

“The spiritual pressure is already this strong on the outskirts?”

“It’s several times better than the cave abode where I cultivated.”

Lee Hyun slowly sensed the spiritual qi around him as well.

The moment they entered the barrier, the spiritual pressure already rivaled that within the inner formation of the Changchun Sect’s Nine Peaks Spring-Restoring Formation.

The farther they traveled into the mountains, the denser the spiritual qi became.

The flight magic tool passed between the clouds.

A short while later, the scenery of the Danxiao Range unfolded before them.

Peaks of every height stretched endlessly into the distance.

Clear streams wound between the mountains.

On one peak, terraced spirit fields covered the entire mountainside. Small clouds moved along the spirit fields, scattering rain.

Whenever the disciples guiding the clouds moved in formation and formed hand seals, the drizzle ceased and sunlight poured down. The countless spirit fields brightened one after another before falling into shade again.

Thick columns of smoke rose into the sky from another peak.

Hundreds of alchemy chambers were embedded into the cliffs and mountainsides like a honeycomb. Firelight flashed ceaselessly from the windows and burners of the alchemy chambers.

Boom!

An explosion erupted from a distant alchemy chamber.

As black smoke burst outward, the disciples standing by activated a formation and instantly contained the smoke and fire qi.

Above them, a black pill furnace dozens of times taller than a person was half embedded in the cliff.

One applicant stared with his mouth hanging open.

“Is that a pill furnace too?”

The Danxiao Sect outer disciple piloting the flight magic tool beside him answered.

“That is the Hundred-Chamber Fire-Distributing Furnace. It can produce dozens of furnace batches of Tier-1 pills at once.”

“Dozens of furnace batches at the same time....”

The flight magic tool continued onward.

Cranes and flying boats crossed the sky without pause.

There were enormous cranes carrying medicine chests on their backs, as well as flying boats carrying dozens of disciples. Bridges made of chains and spirit trees stretched between mountain peaks, and a broad lake filled the valley below.

A red-crested white crane swept past the flight magic tool. Laden with medicine chests on both sides, it turned its head and shouted with startling human clarity.

“Watch where you’re going!”

Several applicants jumped in surprise, but the outer disciple did not even glance at it.

The crane quickly vanished among the clouds.

At the summit of one peak stood a tower a hundred zhang tall.

Lee Hyun watched the scenery of the Danxiao Range with interest as well.

He had lived for nearly fourteen hundred years, but this was his first time entering the main grounds of a great sect with Nascent Soul cultivators.

If the Changchun Sect was a single sect made up of nine peaks, this place looked like a small nation formed from dozens of peaks and ten thousand disciples.

The flight magic tool descended into a broad valley on the outskirts of the mountain range.

Dozens of halls, independent alchemy chambers, and residences for the applicants were arranged neatly throughout the valley.

Three characters were written on the signboard at the entrance.

「Guest Reception Court」

...

The applicants in the alchemy field were assigned two to each residence.

Lee Hyun was placed in the same room as Lü Wende, a round-faced cultivator in his forties.

The moment Lü Wende entered the room, he exclaimed in admiration.

“To give a room like this to applicants for nothing....”

Lü Wende sat on the bed and took several deep breaths of the surrounding spiritual qi.

“Ten days of cultivation here would be like a month outside.”

“It certainly seems that way.”

“The fact that they deliberately put two strangers together in each residence must be to prevent someone from causing trouble or doing something strange. It’s not as though a sect like this could be short on lodgings. This must all be part of a great sect’s careful calculations, don’t you think?”

“Maybe so.”

“Tch... You’re no fun.”

A booklet containing the rules of the Guest Reception Court and two small jade bottles rested on the table.

Each jade bottle contained three Hunger-Warding Pills.

Lü Wende took out one Hunger-Warding Pill and examined it.

“A Tier-1 high-grade Hunger-Warding Pill...?”

He looked slightly dumbfounded.

The two went over the examination rules and the next day’s schedule once.

The first examination was ingredient identification. That would be followed by pill inspection and fire control, with actual alchemy coming last.

Lü Wende’s expression grew serious.

“I will definitely pass the pill inspection.”

“Did you prepare extensively for it?”

“For the past two years, I studied nothing but failed pills. At first, I bought failed pills at cultivator markets. Later, I couldn’t bear wasting the spirit stones, so I deliberately made failed pills myself.”

“You intentionally failed at alchemy?”

“That’s right.”

Lü Wende nodded proudly.

“With the same pill recipe, I varied the fire control, changed the order of the medicinal ingredients, and even damaged the restrictions on the pill furnace little by little. The results are all in here.”

He tapped his head with a finger.

“That’s impressive.”

“Fellow Daoist Li Dongsan, you should stay on your guard as well. The Danxiao Sect has plenty of monstrous alchemists.”

Lü Wende lowered his voice.

“And with Chen Xiaoying here, even the ingredient identification examination won’t be easy. A young lady from a cultivation clan like her is taking the examination alongside rogue cultivators like us just to obtain a better inheritance. Isn’t that unfair?”

...

The next day.

The Ingredient Identification Hall of the Guest Reception Court.

The enormous semicircular hall had one entire wall open. Eighty-three broad tables were arranged in a fan shape, each more than five zhang apart.

Every applicant received a set of samples prepared under identical conditions, but the plate numbers and arrangements differed at each seat. Even if someone saw which plates another applicant selected from afar, it would not reveal their own answers.

Lee Hyun sat at the seat marked with plaque number 37.

On the table were forty-eight jade plates covered with white cloth, a jade slip containing the questions, a blank answer sheet, and a fine brush loaded with ink.

Several rows ahead, Chen Xiaoying sat at table number 12. Seemingly oblivious to the gazes around her, she kept her eyes closed and waited for the examination to begin.

‘A little worse than her should be about right...’

A middle-aged female cultivator at late Foundation Establishment stood at the front of the hall.

Several more Foundation Establishment cultivators stood behind her. Judging by the pill furnace emblems on their robes, they all appeared to be alchemists.

The middle-aged female cultivator looked over the applicants.

“The Danxiao Sect has no shortage of alchemists who can memorize pill recipes and light fires in a prescribed sequence. This ingredient identification examination is not testing who can make familiar pills better. We will see how you judge when faced with unexpected changes.”

Her gaze slowly passed over all eighty-three tables.

“I call that talent.”

The middle-aged female cultivator raised a hand.

The white cloths covering the tables were lifted at the same time.

Rustle―

Forty-eight jade plates were revealed.

Each plate held either a leaf, root, stem, fruit, or seed.

Several of the materials looked almost identical.

“The jade slip lists twelve medicinal ingredients, along with the required medicine age and the part to be used. Choose the samples among these forty-eight that meet the conditions and record their numbers.”

She continued.

“There is no guarantee that there are exactly twelve correct answers.”

The applicants furrowed their brows.

“If none of the materials meet the conditions, write that there is none. If a material requires special processing, write down the method as well. You may use any means you wish to examine the samples, so long as you do not damage them.”

The middle-aged female cultivator lit a small stick of incense.

“When the incense burns out, time is up.”

Fwoosh.

Smoke rose from the tip of the incense.

Lee Hyun first pressed the jade slip to his forehead.

The names and conditions of the twelve medicinal ingredients flowed into his consciousness.

...

A while later, the incense burned down to the end.

Tinkle―

The middle-aged female cultivator rang a small bell.

“Everyone, hands off.”

The examiners standing behind her each extended a hand.

The samples and answer sheets on the tables floated up and flew before them, stacking themselves neatly.

The applicants waited at their seats.

After about one shichen, the examiners finished grading and gathered the answer sheets together. The murmuring applicants gradually fell silent.

The middle-aged female cultivator accepted the score sheet and looked at the applicants.

“I will now call out your numbers and scores. Anyone below sixty points is eliminated.”

The numbers were called one after another.

“Number 1, 71 points.”

“Number 2, 58 points.”

“Number 3, 56 points.”

“Number 4, 76 points.”

...

“Number 12, 88 points.”

Small exclamations broke out throughout the hall.

“As expected of Chen Xiaoying.”

“Hardly anyone even scored above eighty....”

Chen Xiaoying calmly cupped her hands in salute to the examiners. The middle-aged female cultivator also gave the slightest nod.

...

“Number 29, 63 points.”

That was Lü Wende’s number.

From his distant seat, Lee Hyun could almost hear Lü Wende releasing a long breath of relief.

The numbers continued.

“Number 37.”

Lee Hyun raised his head.

The middle-aged female cultivator paused for a moment before speaking.

“91 points.”

‘Huh...?’

Chapter 44

The Ingredient Identification Hall fell quiet for a moment.

“91 points?”

“That’s higher than Chen Xiaoying.”

“What’s that fellow’s name?”

“Wasn’t he a rogue cultivator alchemist?”

Chen Xiaoying, seated several rows ahead, also turned her head.

Her gaze lingered on Lee Hyun for a moment.

Lü Wende, seated at position 29, had his mouth hanging half-open.

“Quiet.”

The middle-aged female cultivator lightly shook the score sheet.

The murmuring applicants fell silent.

“Number 38, 74 points.”

“Number 39, 55 points.”

“Number 40, 68 points.”

...

The scores continued to be called, but no one else reached 91. No one even surpassed 88.

Lee Hyun had placed first in the first examination.

Of the eighty-three applicants, forty-seven had scored at least 60 points.

The middle-aged female cultivator said,

“Those who failed must leave the Guest Reception Court by the end of today. Those who passed will gather at the Pill Inspection Hall by the Hour of the Dragon (approximately 7–9 a.m.) tomorrow. Do not grow complacent simply because you scored highly on the first examination. The Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners is judged by the combined results of all four examinations.”

...

Lee Hyun left the Ingredient Identification Hall and returned to the Guest Reception Court.

As he walked along the path, several people’s gazes followed him.

Then a familiar voice came from behind.

“Fellow Daoist Li!”

Lü Wende hurried over. His round face held a peculiar mixture of delight and grievance.

“91 points! We share a room, yet you never said a word!”

“What was I supposed to say?”

“That you were so confident in ingredient identification.”

“I didn’t know I would score 91 points either.”

“.......”

Lü Wende’s eyebrows twitched.

“You say that even though you know I barely managed 63 points?”

“At least you passed. That’s fortunate.”

“It is. Frankly, I was on pins and needles worrying I might score below 60.”

...

As the two approached their residence, Chen Xiaoying came walking toward them.

Lü Wende was the first to cup his hands.

“Fellow Daoist Chen.”

“Fellow Daoist Lü.”

After a brief greeting, Chen Xiaoying looked at Lee Hyun.

“Fellow Daoist Li. Congratulations on placing first in the first examination.”

“Thank you. I was fortunate.”

Chen Xiaoying did not seem to believe him.

“Since childhood, I have been free to come and go through the Danxia Chen clan’s spirit fields and medicinal-ingredient warehouses. I had already seen most of the specimens used in this examination. I do not believe that falling three points behind you was merely a matter of luck.”

“There are still three examinations left.”

“That is true.”

Chen Xiaoying gave a small nod, then walked past the two without another word.

Lü Wende watched her receding figure before whispering to Lee Hyun.

“Did you hear that?”

“Hear what?”

“Fellow Daoist Chen has acknowledged us as rivals.”

“Didn’t she mean me?”

“Do you really have to draw the line so sharply and hurt my feelings?”

...

The next day.

The Pill Inspection Hall was filled with small jade bottles.

Within the allotted time, the applicants had to determine the condition of the pills inside the jade bottles and, if anything was wrong, record the cause as well.

Lee Hyun filled out his answers far more cautiously than he had the day before.

‘Let’s avoid placing first.’

Placing first in an entrance examination for outside Qi Refining rogue cultivators was hardly a significant matter in a great sect like this. But it would be a different story if, through sheer bad luck, he attracted the attention of a Nascent Soul cultivator.

At that level, they might possess ways to see through the Spirit-Concealing Art and Aura-Concealing Art.

Of course, Lee Hyun was an old monster who had used both techniques for longer than a Nascent Soul cultivator’s entire lifespan. When he deliberately employed the Spirit-Concealing Art, not even a trace of spiritual power appeared. Even the Golden Core cultivators of the Changchun Sect had shown no sign of noticing that he possessed a Primordial Body. Still, he could not presume to know what methods a Nascent Soul cultivator might possess.

On the other hand, it would also seem unnatural for someone who had placed first in the initial examination to suddenly produce a terrible result.

‘I’ll stay near the top, but I won’t place ahead of Chen Xiaoying.’

Lee Hyun deliberately left several questions blank despite knowing the answers for certain.

...

The results were announced.

“Number 12, 92 points.”

Chen Xiaoying had scored highly once again.

“Number 29, 95 points.”

Lü Wende clenched both fists.

“Yes!”

‘Impressive. He said he’d spent two years preparing for pill inspection, and apparently he wasn’t exaggerating.’

“Number 37, 81 points.”

Lee Hyun nodded.

It was a sufficiently good score without attracting as much attention as the first examination.

...

Lü Wende could not wipe the smile from his face the entire way out of the Pill Inspection Hall.

“Did you see?”

“Congratulations.”

“Didn’t I tell you that pill inspection, at least, was something I was confident in?”

“You did.”

“95 points. Three points higher than Chen Xiaoying.”

...

On the third day came the examination on fire control.

Lee Hyun played the part of a reasonably competent Tier 1 alchemist.

...

The final day’s examination required them to perform actual alchemy.

‘This should be about right.’

As Lee Hyun opened the lid of the pill furnace, a medicinal fragrance spread through the air.

The examiner inspected the pills one by one.

“Stable.”

“Thank you.”

All the examinations were over.

...

The next morning.

The applicants who had participated in the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners gathered in the broad plaza before the Guest Reception Court.

The examinations for all nine fields, including alchemy, had concluded, and a considerable number of the hundreds who had originally filled the plaza had already left the Danxiao Range.

Thirty-two applicants had completed the final examination in the alchemy field.

The middle-aged female cultivator stood at the front of the plaza with the Foundation Establishment examiners.

“We will now announce the results of the alchemy field for the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners.”

Tension appeared on the applicants’ faces.

“Twenty-four applicants have passed. The remaining eight have failed this examination.”

The middle-aged female cultivator unfolded the list of successful applicants.

“First place, Chen Xiaoying.”

For the first time, a smile appeared on Chen Xiaoying’s face.

“Second place, Wei Xiaotian.”

An elderly Qi Refining Stage 9 cultivator who looked to be around sixty stepped forward.

“Third place, Li Dongsan.”

Lee Hyun walked forward.

Chen Xiaoying looked at him and gave a small nod.

The names of the successful applicants continued to be called.

“Seventeenth place, Lü Wende.”

Lü Wende stepped forward with a relieved sigh.

“Whew....”

At last, the twenty-fourth name was called.

Once the eight unsuccessful applicants had left, the middle-aged female cultivator spoke again.

“As a rule, those who pass the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners become outer disciples of our sect.”

The middle-aged female cultivator turned her gaze toward Chen Xiaoying.

“However, considering Chen Xiaoying’s dual spiritual root aptitude, her young age, and her performance in this Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners, she has been selected as an inner disciple.”

“This disciple thanks the sect for its grace.”

Chen Xiaoying bowed respectfully.

Envious gazes poured from the other successful applicants.

...

Chen Xiaoying followed a Foundation Establishment cultivator and boarded a flight magic tool first.

Hummm–

Lü Wende watched Chen Xiaoying recede into the distance and said,

“An inner disciple.... A dual spiritual root truly is different.”

“Is being an outer disciple so bad?”

“Of course not. I’ve spent my whole life as a rogue cultivator, and now I’ve become an outer disciple of a great sect. How could I complain? Besides, I can accumulate contributions in the Outer Gate and perhaps receive a Foundation Establishment Pill. If I succeed in reaching Foundation Establishment, even becoming an inner disciple may not be out of reach.”

After gathering their belongings from the Guest Reception Court, the successful applicants other than Chen Xiaoying also rode the Foundation Establishment cultivators’ flight magic tools to their next destination.

...

External Affairs Court.

“Li Dongsan?”

A steward of the External Affairs Court handed over two sets of Danxiao Sect outer-disciple robes, an identity token, and a small storage pouch.

Inside the storage pouch were a bottle of Hunger-Warding Pills, ten low-grade spirit stones, and a booklet containing the rules for outer disciples.

Lee Hyun checked the identity token.

「Outer Craft Disciple Li Dongsan.

Outer Alchemy Court.」

“As stated on your identity tokens, you will be assigned to the Outer Alchemy Court. The Outer Alchemy Court will explain your specific schedule and duties.”

“Understood.”

A young disciple standing toward the back cautiously raised his hand.

“Steward. Which Elder will we become disciples of?”

The steward of the External Affairs Court looked at him.

“Has someone accepted you as a disciple?”

“Not yet....”

“Then where would a master suddenly come from?”

“.......”

Quiet laughter spread through the surrounding crowd.

The steward explained calmly.

“Outer disciples do not belong to any particular master’s lineage. If you wish to enter an Elder’s lineage, either catch that person’s eye first or rise to the Inner Gate.”

“I will remember that.”

“Still, craft disciples who passed the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners have more opportunities than ordinary outer disciples. Perform your assigned duties diligently, and there will be plenty for you to learn.”

...

Lee Hyun and Lü Wende changed into their new robes.

Lü Wende looked down at his sleeves several times.

“They suit me rather well, don’t they?”

“They do.”

“They don’t suit me very well, do they?”

“They don’t.”

“Do you know where we are?”

“I do.”

“Don’t you think Chen Xiaoying might be interested in me?”

“No.”

“...”

At that moment, several disciples wearing dust-covered robes walked up from farther down the mountain.

The man in front handed his identity token to the steward at the entrance of the External Affairs Court.

“We have returned from the Immortal Veneration Court in Anling Kingdom. We wish to submit the tribute and hand over the account books for the kingdom garrison assignment.”

Lee Hyun’s gaze shifted slightly.

It was a familiar voice.

‘White Owl?’

White Owl glanced over the new disciples once. His gaze briefly passed over Lee Hyun as well, but he showed no unusual reaction.

“It seems the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners has ended.”

The steward of the External Affairs Court replied,

“The results came out today. They’re new disciples headed for the Outer Alchemy Court.”

“I see.”

White Owl gave the newcomers a slight smile.

“Congratulations on joining the sect.”

Lü Wende cupped his hands.

“Thank you, Senior Brother.”

Lee Hyun greeted him as well.

“Thank you.”

Even after hearing Lee Hyun’s voice, White Owl showed no reaction.

The voice Lee Hyun used as Society Head Badger at the meetings and Li Dongsan’s voice differed completely, from pitch to manner of speaking. This was thanks to Lee Hyun having reached Major Attainment in the Seven-Aspect Disguise Method he had obtained long ago from the Fengtian Bureau in Yunze Kingdom.

A short while later, a Foundation Establishment steward from the Outer Alchemy Court arrived to guide the new disciples.

“I am Yang Jinping of the Outer Alchemy Court.”

“Greetings, Steward Yang.”

After checking everyone’s identity tokens, Yang Jinping took out a red, leaf-shaped flight magic tool measuring ten zhang (about 33 m) long.

“Everyone, get aboard.”

The twenty-three new disciples boarded the flight magic tool one after another.

Whoosh.

The red leaf slowly rose into the air.

...

The flight magic tool flew between the peaks along the outskirts of the mountain range.

Every time they rounded another peak, new halls and spirit fields came into view.

Lü Wende kept looking around.

“Just how many disciples are there?”

Yang Jinping answered,

“Even excluding mortal laborers and those dispatched here by cultivation clans, there should be well over ten thousand. I don’t think there are as many as twenty thousand... though I don’t know the exact number myself.”

Yang Jinping pointed toward the towering peaks in the distance.

“Most of those high peaks belong to the Inner Gate. If you approach without permission, the formations will block you, so don’t go wandering over there out of curiosity.”

The peaks thrusting their heads above the white clouds looked profoundly mysterious.

At times, flashes of light flickered between the clouds, seemingly produced by the techniques of Golden Core cultivators. Even from such a great distance, they carried an aloof, imposing majesty.

...

After roughly half a shichen (about one hour), a broad valley surrounded by three gently sloping peaks appeared.

Hundreds of alchemy chambers dotted the mountainsides and cliffs.

Flying boats of various sizes and cranes flitted through the air.

Dozens of warehouses and halls stood in orderly rows below the valley.

The flight magic tool descended in the center.

The moment they stepped off, dense spiritual qi mingled with the scents of countless medicinal ingredients and washed over them.

“Everyone, follow me.”

Yang Jinping led the new disciples toward a hall in the center of the valley.

Three characters were written on the signboard.

「Outer Alchemy Court」

...

A long-faced, thin Foundation Establishment cultivator was waiting inside the Outer Alchemy Court.

Yang Jinping addressed him.

“Steward Quan, I’ve brought the new disciples who passed this year’s Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners.”

“You’ve worked hard.”

Steward Quan opened a ledger and checked the names and scores of the new disciples one by one.

“For the first three months, you will rotate through the medicinal-ingredient room, pill inspection room, and alchemy chambers. Afterward, your primary duties will be decided with consideration for your individual skills and preferences.”

He looked over the new disciples.

“Being on probation does not mean we will only give you menial work. You entered after proving your skill in alchemy, so you will be assigned alchemy work appropriate to your level. Once you deliver the required number of pills each month, your basic duties are complete. If your yield and quality exceed the standard, you can earn additional contribution points. Once your duties are finished, you may cultivate, visit the Scripture Pavilion, or take on separate missions.”

One of the new disciples asked,

“Are we permitted to leave the sect grounds?”

“For the first three months of your probation, you may not leave the Danxiao Range without permission. After that, provided you have completed your assigned work, you may apply for leave. If you intend to be absent for more than a month, take an external mission from the External Affairs Court or obtain a steward’s permission.”

‘No problem, then.’

Before entering the Danxiao Sect, Lee Hyun had filled the reservoir in Tunnel No. 3 to capacity and inspected all of its water-supply facilities.

Steward Quan said to Yang Jinping,

“Show them their residences and alchemy chambers, and have them begin the medicinal-ingredient room’s basic training tomorrow. Don’t forget the ranking rewards for the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners.”

He turned back toward the new disciples.

“Wei Xiaotian, who placed second in the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners, will receive fifty contribution points. Li Dongsan, who placed third, will receive forty contribution points. The rest of you can ask Steward Yang about your rewards.”

...

The residences assigned to the new disciples by the Outer Alchemy Court stood on a gentle slope on the eastern side of the valley.

Small stone houses were spaced evenly apart.

Each residence contained a bed, a table, and a cultivation chamber, with a small clearing behind it large enough for one person to practice techniques.

By the standards of the mundane world, they were quite luxurious, and they were more than adequate for a Qi Refining cultivator.

Lee Hyun chose a quiet stone house near the edge of the slope.

It stood a little farther from the other residences, and a small rock wall behind it kept the interior from being easily visible even with the door open.

After closing the door and activating the restriction, Lee Hyun drew on the formation knowledge he had acquired at the Changchun Sect and carefully inspected the interior. There were no additional formation inscriptions on the walls or floor, and the residence’s restriction was a simple structure designed only to block outside intrusion and noise.

‘Not bad.’

A Qi-Gathering Formation had been installed in the cultivation chamber. It contained more formation inscriptions than the one in his Changchun Sect residence, and their structure was more complex.

‘A better Qi-Gathering Formation, perhaps.’

Lee Hyun lay comfortably on the floor and stared at the ceiling.

When he had entered the Changchun Sect, not much time had passed since the Qingmu Ridge Herb Robbery. He had been anxious that the sect might be attacked, and that was exactly what had happened.

This time was different.

At the very least, there was no force within Kun Kingdom capable of openly attacking the Danxiao Sect. Nor was there any reason for anyone to take an interest in the individual outer disciple Li Dongsan.

All he had to do was make pills, read the inheritances he needed in the Scripture Pavilion, and accumulate contribution points.

Even in such a peaceful environment, the other new disciples had to push themselves relentlessly to achieve a breakthrough to Foundation Establishment before their lifespans ran out, but Lee Hyun felt as though he had come to the Danxiao Sect on a sightseeing trip.

‘Is this what a temple stay feels like? Not that I ever tried one in my past life...’

After lying comfortably for a while, Lee Hyun sat up and took the six bronze flying swords from his storage pouch.

Hummm–

The flying swords all rose into the air at once.

With a slight movement of Lee Hyun’s finger, they began circling as though each were chasing the tail of the one ahead.

Clatter.

When he opened his palm, the flying swords neatly stacked themselves and descended onto it.

This time, he took out the black-iron longspear.

Lee Hyun gave a light thrust, and the single black spearpoint suddenly split into three, piercing three different points in the air.

Whoosh–

He then twisted his waist and swung the longspear, sending a heavy gust of wind around the cultivation chamber.

It had been nearly three hundred years since he obtained the bronze flying swords and the black-iron longspear. By now, no trace of their former owners remained within the restrictions of the two high-grade magic tools. The two magic tools had become extensions of Lee Hyun’s own limbs.

Finally, he took out the fist-sized Protective Bell.

Hummm–

As the Protective Bell absorbed Primordial True Qi, it suddenly expanded until it was as large as a person.

“Hmm... this one still feels awkward.”

He returned the magic tools to his storage pouch.

At that moment, the spirit-insect pouch at his waist trembled slightly.

Lee Hyun took out a fuzzbee.

Buzz–

The fellow flew once around the cultivation chamber before landing on the back of Lee Hyun’s hand.

“You can’t wander around carelessly here. There are some very frightening cultivators in this place. I’ll let you out once we’re back at the tunnel.”

Lee Hyun put the fuzzbee back into the spirit-insect pouch.

He still did not know what fuzzbees truly were. They might be spirit insects that other cultivators would covet, so it seemed better to keep them hidden.

...

The next day.

The new disciples gathered in the Outer Alchemy Court’s medicinal-ingredient room.

Tier 1 medicinal ingredients were piled like mountains throughout the medicinal-ingredient room, which was connected to dozens of warehouses.

Each medicinal ingredient had a wooden tag listing its variety, medicine age, harvesting season, and place of origin.

‘The scale is incredible...’

A considerable portion of the medicinal ingredients had not even come from the Danxiao Sect’s own spirit fields.

Medicinal ingredients arrived every day from cultivation clans throughout Kun Kingdom, kingdoms of the mundane world, and outside merchant companies. Some had come from Cang Kingdom to the south or even from cultivation nations across the sea.

The Foundation Establishment steward of the medicinal-ingredient room said,

“All medicinal ingredients used by the Outer Alchemy Court must be recorded in the ledgers. Take only what you need for alchemy, then return the completed pills together with any remaining medicinal ingredients.”

...

The medicinal-ingredient room’s training ended after half a day.

Yang Jinping led the new disciples to another nearby hall.

“This is the Mission Hall under the Outer Alchemy Court.”

Yang Jinping spoke as he entered the building.

“Most work that arises within the Outer Alchemy Court is assigned here, and the results are inspected before contribution points are awarded. Each of the other courts has its own Mission Hall as well. Matters involving several courts or long-term external assignments are handled separately by the Mission Hall of the External Affairs Court.”

The new disciples nodded.

Hundreds of mission tokens hung from the walls of the Mission Hall.

The tasks varied widely, including pill alchemy, medicinal-ingredient appraisal, spirit-field management, supply escorts, inspections for outside merchant companies, and short-term assignments to cultivation clans.

On the opposite side hung a list of pills, magic tools, spirit stones, alchemy materials, and other items that could be exchanged for contribution points. Applying through the Mission Hall would send a request to the warehouse responsible for the item.

The first thing Lee Hyun looked for was the Foundation Establishment Pill.

「Foundation Establishment Pill.

Outer disciples at Qi Refining Great Perfection may apply for exchange after passing the Foundation Establishment qualification assessment.

Priority is determined each year according to the Outer Gate’s allotted quantity, contribution points, and length of service.

Repeat applicants additionally require records of previous consumption and a steward’s recommendation.」

The required contribution points were considerable.

But the larger problem was the limited supply.

‘As expected, getting several will be impossible. Through the official exchange alone, one or two pills will probably be the limit.’

The pill recipe for the Foundation Establishment Pill was nowhere to be seen in the Mission Hall.

It was exactly what he had expected.

While scanning the lists, Lee Hyun asked Yang Jinping,

“Steward Yang, if I want to view various cultivation arts and inheritances, should I go to the Scripture Pavilion?”

“That’s right.”

Yang Jinping pointed north.

“The Scripture Pavilion is on Book Repository Peak. Outer disciples may only use the Outer Pavilion.”

Fifteen days later.

Once he had some free time, Lee Hyun left the Outer Alchemy Court, crossed several peaks, and arrived at Book Repository Peak.

Two tall halls stood one above the other on Book Repository Peak.

The signboard on the lower hall read 「Outer Pavilion」, while the hall above, nearly touching the clouds, bore the words 「Inner Pavilion」.

A stone staircase stretching more than a hundred zhang ran between the two halls, but a translucent barrier blocked its entrance.

Several disciples wearing outer-disciple robes naturally gave the barrier a wide berth as they passed.

Lee Hyun entered the Outer Pavilion.

The interior was several times larger than the Changchun Sect’s Scripture Pavilion, filled with countless bookshelves and stone chambers.

Jade slips were sealed behind restrictions along the walls.

From outside, one could only see the name of each inheritance, a brief description, and the required contribution points.

Lee Hyun headed toward the section containing insect-control inheritances.

One Hundred Kinds of Tier-1 Spirit Insects, Spirit-Insect Feed and Medicinal Baths, Essentials of Spirit-Insect Recognition...

Even basic inheritances cost anywhere from two contribution points to several dozen. Higher-level inheritances listed low-grade or mid-grade spirit stones in addition to contribution points.

Lee Hyun stopped in front of Essentials of Spirit-Insect Recognition.

「Contains several basic methods for establishing a master-servant relationship with spirit insects. 20 contribution points.」

Lee Hyun returned to the disciple in charge and said,

“I would like to view Essentials of Spirit-Insect Recognition.”

The disciple placed Lee Hyun’s identity token on a formation plate.

Hummm–

The forty contribution points he had received from the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners appeared, and twenty of them vanished.

The disciple took out a palm-sized blue tablet and handed it to Lee Hyun.

“Go to inheritance chamber seventeen. Hold the tablet against the door, and the restriction will open. You have two shichen to view it.”

“Where is the jade slip?”

“Once the inheritance chamber’s restriction closes, it will be delivered inside. It will be retrieved automatically when your viewing time ends.”

Lee Hyun accepted the tablet and headed toward inheritance chamber seventeen.

When he pressed the tablet against the groove beside the stone door, it opened without a sound.

Inside were only a cushion and a small stone pedestal.

Once Lee Hyun entered, the stone door closed, and dozens of golden patterns along the walls lit up one after another.

Click.

The center of the stone pedestal opened, and a jade slip slowly rose from within.

Lee Hyun picked up the jade slip and pressed it to his forehead.

Countless words and images flowed into his mind.

As its description stated, Essentials of Spirit-Insect Recognition recorded several methods for establishing a master-servant relationship with spirit insects.

They varied greatly in nature and risk, from contracts that linked a spirit insect’s life to its master’s through essence blood, to restrictions that branded obedience onto the soul, to imprinting that taught spirit insects to recognize their master through shared food and qi.

With some contracts, the master suffered backlash if the spirit insect died. With certain restrictions, the spirit insect would die as well if its master perished.

Lee Hyun read through them one by one without rushing.

At one passage, his consciousness stopped.

「Swarm Shared-Seal Art.

A technique that places a Spirit-Nurturing Seal upon every spirit insect in a swarm.

Its binding force is weak. It cannot compel complex commands that defy a spirit insect’s instincts, nor can it force them to obey orders that would drive them to their deaths.

In exchange, it places almost no burden on either the spirit insects or their master, and there is no need to form a separate contract with each individual insect. Once the Spirit-Nurturing Seal takes hold, the spirit insects will recognize their master and can carry out several simple commands.」

‘This should work well enough for the fuzzbees.’

Chapter 45

Lee Hyun examined the mnemonic formula of the Swarm Shared-Seal Art and the structure of the Spirit-Nurturing Seal in turn.

From the basics of inscribing a Spirit-Nurturing Seal on an individual spirit insect, to choosing the core members of a swarm and splitting their imprints into hundreds or thousands of branches.

‘I'll need a few months of practice.’

Click.

His two shichen (about four hours) of reading time came to an end.

When he stepped outside, the disciple on duty took back the blue token.

Lee Hyun left the Outer Pavilion of the Scripture Pavilion and looked up toward the Inner Pavilion.

A translucent barrier still hung across the entrance to the stairs leading up to the Inner Pavilion, which seemed to touch the clouds.

‘If I become an inner disciple, I'll be able to see the inheritances in there too...’

Two and a half months later.

The probationary period at the Outer Alchemy Court ended.

After completing all the basic duties assigned to him in the medicinal-ingredient room, pill inspection room, and alchemy chamber, Lee Hyun applied for leave.

“Twenty-five days of leave?”

Yang Jinping asked as he looked over the ledger.

“Yes.”

Yang Jinping checked the quantity and quality of the pills Lee Hyun had submitted over the past three months.

“You've submitted more than the required amount and haven't caused any trouble, so I'll approve it.”

“Thank you.”

...

Nine days later.

「Tunnel No. 3」

Thud.

Lee Hyun dropped from the ceiling into the cavern.

“It's too... far!”

Lee Hyun had traveled a staggering 58,000 li (about 22,700 km) northwest from Danxiao Immortal City!

That was because Tunnel No. 3 lay at the far northwestern edge of Kun Kingdom, while Danxiao Sect was situated east of the kingdom's central region.

‘The water-supply system can last three years, so from now on, I'd better stretch out the interval between visits a little more.’

Lee Hyun opened the spirit-insect pouch.

Bzzz– Bzzzzzz–

Around a hundred fuzzbees poured out like a golden cloud.

After finally emerging into a wide-open space again, the fellows flew frantically around the tunnel.

The fuzzbees living around the hunting tunnel and spirit field heard the beating of wings and came swarming over as well. Once the two groups mingled, the number of fuzzbees drifting through the cavern swelled to over a thousand.

Chirp! Chirp chirp!

“Have you been well?”

Chirp.

“All you've done is eat and sleep, so of course you have.”

Instead of answering, the fuzzbees circled around his body and head.

A few of them began tugging on Lee Hyun's hair.

“Don't pull on it.”

...

Lee Hyun led the fuzzbees into the largest cavern.

A shallow stone bowl he had prepared beforehand sat on the floor.

He filled the bowl with water created using the Spirit Rain Art, then dissolved a spoonful of Hundred-Flower Honey he had bought at the cultivator market into it. Following the mnemonic formula of the Swarm Shared-Seal Art, he then released a thin stream of Primordial True Qi from his fingertip.

Hummmm–

A faint glow seeped into the sweetened water in the bowl.

Catching the sweet scent, the fuzzbees crowded around the stone bowl.

Bzzzzzzzz–

“Don't eat yet.”

Chirp?

The fellows did not understand Lee Hyun's words.

Lee Hyun blocked the fuzzbees rushing toward the stone bowl with a Spirit Light Shield, then called over the three mutated ones first and placed them on his palm.

As he formed a hand seal with his left hand, thin strands of spiritual power gathered above his right.

The strands connected and overlapped, forming a small seal. Within a hollow circle, patterns resembling leaves and antennae intertwined.

It was the Spirit-Nurturing Seal.

Hummmm–

Lee Hyun turned his palm over.

The Spirit-Nurturing Seal split into three and descended onto the heads of the mutated fuzzbees.

Chirp!

All three spread their wings at once.

One of them tried to fly off in surprise, but the faint light passed through its fur and head before naturally seeping into its body.

The fuzzbees' spiritual-power fluctuations wavered chaotically for a moment.

Lee Hyun immediately withdrew his Primordial True Qi.

‘There's almost no strain.’

Identical marks appeared inside all three fuzzbees.

Lee Hyun set the three mutated fuzzbees down in front of the stone bowl.

“Eat.”

They had not actually understood the command, but as soon as the Spirit Light Shield disappeared, the three began drinking the water mixed with Hundred-Flower Honey as if they had been waiting for the chance.

Chirp chirp.

The rest of the fuzzbees rushed in all at once.

Once the three bearing Spirit-Nurturing Seals mixed into the center of the swarm, over a thousand fuzzbees jostled against one another as they drank the sweetened water.

When Lee Hyun formed another hand seal, the Spirit-Nurturing Seals inscribed on the three mutated fuzzbees lit up simultaneously.

Hummmm–

Thin rays of light extending from the imprints split again and again. The divided strands connected one by one to the fuzzbees drinking the sweetened water from the same bowl.

Faint Spirit-Nurturing Seals appeared one after another on the ordinary fuzzbees.

One.

Ten.

A hundred.

The same form of imprint spread across the entire swarm of more than a thousand.

Bzzzzzzzz–

The fuzzbees all took flight at once.

The golden swarm filled the ceiling of the cavern.

Lee Hyun slowly lowered his hand as he examined the state of the imprints.

‘Looks like it worked.’

When he raised his right hand, several nearby fuzzbees gathered around it.

“Come here.”

Bzzzzzz–

Around ten landed on the back of his hand and his arm.

The rest were still flying around the cavern or licking up the sweetened water left in the stone bowl.

“I said all of you come here.”

Chirp.

Lee Hyun sent his mental intent through the Spirit-Nurturing Seals and repeated the same command.

A moment later, more than a thousand fuzzbees densely covered Lee Hyun's arms, shoulders, and head. His vision filled with golden fur and wings.

Bzzzzzzzz–

The fuzzbees even covered his face.

“Back away.”

The fellows did not move.

“Back away.”

Chirp?

“....”

...

The next day.

“Gather.”

Bzzzzzz–

The scattered fuzzbees gathered in front of Lee Hyun and formed a round swarm.

“Scatter.”

The golden sphere dispersed in every direction.

“Stop.”

More than a thousand fuzzbees froze in midair.

“Not bad.”

The fuzzbees had become quite adept at following basic commands.

They still could not understand complicated instructions.

‘That's probably a problem with their intelligence rather than a limitation of the Spirit-Nurturing Seal.’

Lee Hyun packed only some of the fuzzbees into the spirit-insect pouch. They could detect Life-Bound Gu and alert him to the approach of gu warriors.

He left the remaining fuzzbees to live around the hunting tunnel and spirit field.

After checking the water-supply system, spirit field, and storeroom as well, Lee Hyun finished everything he needed to do and left Tunnel No. 3.

...

The day he returned to Danxiao Immortal City.

While walking along one of the city's main avenues, Lee Hyun spotted a newly opened bookstore.

A table at the entrance was piled high with novels bearing colorful illustrations.

A general wielding a long spear.

A man and woman falling from a cliff.

Two martial artists crossing swords before an imperial palace.

Among them, a thick set of books caught his eye.

《A Slave Soldier Rebuilds a Fallen Kingdom》

‘I can tell what it's about just from the title.’

The bookstore owner spoke.

“It's the best-selling new novel in Danxiao Immortal City these days.”

“How many volumes are there?”

“Twelve have been released so far. The next volume should come out in two months.”

Lee Hyun thought for a moment.

Buying an unfinished popular novel meant having to wait for the next volume, but the atmosphere suggested by the title and cover was not bad.

“I'll take them all.”

“Thank you!”

...

The Outer Alchemy Court residences.

Lee Hyun lay comfortably on his bed and read the popular novel.

The protagonist was the last prince of a fallen kingdom.

After losing his homeland as a child and being sold into slavery in an enemy nation, he drifted between mines and military camps along the front lines. He survived battle after battle while learning martial arts, gathered slave soldiers who were willing to follow him, and eventually came to command three thousand iron cavalry.

After hiding his identity for more than ten years, the prince finally revealed who he was and began reclaiming his homeland. When he seized the first fortress on the border, former retainers and displaced subjects flocked to him, and by the time he reclaimed the second city, his forces had doubled.

But every city he reclaimed required soldiers to defend it and food to distribute among the people. The prince tried to retake the seventy-two cities stretching from the border to the royal capital one by one, and by the time he reached the seventh city, fewer than a thousand of his original three thousand iron cavalry remained.

Lee Hyun clicked his tongue as he turned the page.

‘He was clever at first, but suddenly he's become frustratingly stupid. If he leaves people behind every time he captures a city, when does he expect to reach the royal capital?’

The protagonist's strategist had thought the same thing.

Near the end of the tenth volume, the iron cavalry fled the enemy's massive army and hid in a ruined mountain fortress.

As the protagonist stared bitterly at the cities marked on the map, his strategist spoke.

“Your Highness is trying to become king only after reclaiming all the territory you have lost.”

“How could I call myself king when I have recovered neither my people nor my land?”

The strategist pointed at the royal capital in the center of the map.

“Reverse the order.”

“The order?”

“Do not try to become king after reclaiming all your territory. First seize the royal capital and become king. Then reclaim the rest of your territory by royal decree.”

In the end, the protagonist abandoned every city he had reclaimed, gathered his forces into a single army, and launched a surprise attack on the royal capital along a route no one had anticipated.

Lee Hyun nodded and was about to turn the next page.

‘...Reverse the order?’

Lee Hyun's gaze slowly shifted before coming to rest on the map.

In the middle of the vast kingdom was a single red dot marking the royal capital.

‘Wait....’

‘Do I really need to raise my entire body to the level of Foundation Establishment all at once?’

‘Just like taking the royal capital first, what if I choose a single dantian as the center and advance only that to Foundation Establishment first...?’

He sat upright.

A memory from more than a thousand years ago surfaced.

It was something Wang Jin had said in a lecture hall at Qinghe Valley.

- There is no separate organ inside the human body called the dantian. A dantian is simply an area designated by a cultivation art for storing spiritual power. Following the guidance of the cultivation art, you designate a certain area below the navel and repeatedly gather refined spiritual power there until it becomes a dantian.

Lee Hyun placed a hand near his Sea of Qi Acupoint.

‘The later version of the Primordial One-Qi Art was modified to use only the area around the Sea of Qi Acupoint as the dantian. If so, couldn't I begin Foundation Establishment the same way?’

He would create a small lower dantian centered on the Sea of Qi Acupoint within his whole-body dantian.

He would leave the rest of his body at the early phase of Qi Refining Stage 9 and temper only the lower dantian to the limit of Qi Refining Great Perfection. Then he would take a Foundation Establishment Pill and concentrate its medicinal strength within that narrow area.

If it worked, he could advance the lower dantian to the Foundation Establishment realm first, just like an ordinary cultivator. It would be worth attempting this method with only one or two Foundation Establishment Pills.

‘Why did I assume I had to liquefy fifty times as much spiritual power as another cultivator in the same realm all at once?’

‘Back then, I wasn't particularly interested in advancing my realm, and I thought being stronger than my realm suggested would make me safer. But that doesn't mean I have to stay in Qi Refining until I can get fifty Foundation Establishment Pills.’

‘I see. Ever since I turned my entire body into a dantian, I've been trapped by the assumption that I had to advance the whole thing at once.’

Lee Hyun was now a disciple of Danxiao Sect. Within the safety of the sect, there was no need to obsess over becoming fifty times stronger than other cultivators in the same realm.

‘Besides, if I succeed in Foundation Establishment and become an inner disciple, I'll gain access to better inheritances.’

‘If I establish myself as a Tier 2 alchemist, I'll also have a better chance of coming into contact with the ingredients and alchemy process for Foundation Establishment Pills. If I'm lucky enough to obtain the pill recipe for the Foundation Establishment Pill, I could take Foundation Establishment Pills I refined myself and gradually raise the rest of my body, aside from the lower dantian, to the level of Foundation Establishment as well....’

...

Lee Hyun immediately entered the cultivation chamber and decided to try circulating the mnemonic formula of the later, modified Primordial One-Qi Art.

When he filled the Qi-Gathering Formation with low-grade spirit stones, the formation inscriptions on the floor lit up one after another.

Hummmm–

The surrounding spiritual qi gathered inside the cultivation chamber.

For the first time in a long while, Lee Hyun assumed the lotus position instead of lying down.

‘Since it's my first time, let's do it the proper way.’

Three years later.

Outer Alchemy Court.

Rattle.

When the lid of the pill furnace opened, round brown pills rolled out onto a jade tray.

Lee Hyun divided the pills among jade bottles, then placed them in the return box along with the remaining medicinal ingredients.

For the past three years, Lee Hyun had quietly refined pills at the Outer Alchemy Court while accumulating contribution points. Once a year, he visited Tunnel No. 3 to inspect its facilities.

The fuzzbees whose Spirit-Nurturing Seals had fully stabilized were much easier to handle than before.

...

“It's about time I pretended to break through to Qi Refining Stage 9.”

When he entered the sect, he had made his realm appear to be Qi Refining Stage 8, but there was no reason to maintain the disguise indefinitely. Raising Li Dongsan's apparent realm to Stage 9 now would make it seem more natural when he eventually reached Great Perfection and sought a Foundation Establishment Pill.

‘Now that I've limited my cultivation to the lower dantian, it doesn't seem like it'll even take ten years to reach Qi Refining Great Perfection....’

Lee Hyun loosened the aura he had been concealing with the Spirit-Concealing Art just enough to make it appear as though he had broken through to Qi Refining Stage 9.

...

The next day, the stewards of the Outer Alchemy Court noticed that Li Dongsan's realm had risen, but thought little of it. There was nothing strange about a diligent alchemist who had already been at Qi Refining Stage 8 when he entered the sect reaching Stage 9 after three years in Danxiao Sect's excellent cultivation environment.

...

Fifteen days later.

A small pavilion in the woods near the Outer Alchemy Court.

A stream carrying the fragrance of medicinal ingredients flowed beneath the pavilion.

This was where purified water from the Outer Alchemy Court's alchemy chambers and medicinal-ingredient room merged with the mountain stream. It was not dirty, but faint traces of various medicinal ingredients remained, so the fragrance changed whenever the wind blew.

When Lee Hyun arrived, three people were already seated in the pavilion.

The round-faced Lü Wende.

Tang Yanfei, her black hair tied high and her sleeves neatly fastened.

Wen Xiaohe, with a small wooden box for medicinal ingredients resting on her lap.

Lü Wende was at Qi Refining Stage 7.

Tang Yanfei had passed the Special Selection for Skilled Practitioners alongside Lee Hyun and Lü Wende and entered the sect on the same day. She had been at Qi Refining Stage 7 when she entered and had broken through to Stage 8 a year ago.

Her family ran a small medicinal-ingredient trading company in southern Kun Kingdom.

Wen Xiaohe was a Senior Sister at Qi Refining Stage 8 who had entered the Outer Alchemy Court ten years before the other three. She was more skilled in medicinal-ingredient appraisal and spirit-plant cultivation than alchemy, so whenever medicinal ingredients arrived from outside trading companies, she helped the stewards identify their varieties and medicine ages.

Over the past three years, the four of them had naturally grown close while working together on alchemy and medicinal-ingredient appraisal. Whenever their schedules aligned, they gathered at this pavilion to discuss cultivation and exchange news from inside and outside the sect.

Wen Xiaohe handed Lee Hyun a cup of tea.

“Congratulations on breaking through to Qi Refining Stage 9, Junior Brother Li.”

“Thank you, Senior Sister Wen.”

Tang Yanfei spoke.

“You were already at Stage 8 when we entered, so I knew Fellow Daoist Li would be the first to reach Stage 9. Still, three years is quite fast.”

“I was fortunate.”

...

For a while, they talked about alchemy and cultivation.

A rumor that the number of Foundation Establishment Pills allotted to the Outer Gate this year had decreased by one compared to last year.

A story about a Foundation Establishment alchemist in the Inner Gate who ruined three consecutive furnace batches of Tier 2 pills and entered secluded cultivation.

A story about a crane raised in the Spirit Beast Garden that escaped and set fire to the medicinal-ingredient room.

Then Tang Yanfei brought up news from the south.

“I received word from my family's trading company not long ago. They said things have been rather unsettled in southern Cang Kingdom lately.”

Lü Wende asked.

“Has something happened in Cang Kingdom?”

“They say the overseas cultivators who took over Lan Kingdom have started appearing in the cultivator markets of Cang Kingdom as well.”

It was already widely known that Lan Kingdom had fallen to forces from beyond the Nanming Sea. After a war that had dragged on for hundreds of years, many of Lan Kingdom's great sects had collapsed, while the surviving sects had submitted to the overseas forces.

Wen Xiaohe said.

“I heard the war only ended completely around a hundred years ago.”

“That's right. That's why everyone assumed they had settled down in Lan Kingdom.”

Tang Yanfei continued.

“But recently, overseas cultivators have been spotted in several cultivator markets throughout southern Cang Kingdom. It isn't just Qi Refining cultivators accompanying trading companies. There are supposedly also Foundation Establishment cultivators and above whose origins no one knows.”

Lü Wende asked.

“Now that they control Lan Kingdom, aren't they simply trying to trade with Cang Kingdom?”

“That could be it. But I also heard that some have become guest retainers of local cultivation clans, while others have been asking about Cang Kingdom's spirit veins and sects.”

Wen Xiaohe's expression grew slightly tense.

“Has Wangu Sect made no move?”

“They may already be moving. But my family's trading company has only picked up a few rumors.”

Lee Hyun's fingers stopped against the rim of his teacup.

He remembered the twelve dark blue-black orbs produced long ago by the Azure Sea Wanderer when he attacked Changchun Sect, and the light that had stretched beyond the southern sky.

‘So that force eventually took over Lan Kingdom.’

A great deal of time had passed since Lee Hyun left Changchun Sect.

He had no idea how Lan Kingdom's great sects, including Taihe Sect and Ziwei Sword Sect, had responded at the time.

By now, there was almost no chance that anyone Lee Hyun had known was still around.

‘And now they're crossing into Cang Kingdom....’

They were a force that had crossed the vast Nanming Sea, so crossing the thirty thousand li of sea between Lan Kingdom and Cang Kingdom would hardly be difficult for them.

The problem was that Kun Kingdom, where Lee Hyun now lived, lay directly north of Cang Kingdom.

It had nothing to do with Danxiao Sect for the moment, but their movements were drawing too close for him to dismiss them as mere rumors from some distant country.

If the overseas cultivators invaded, Cang Kingdom's cultivation world would be the first to respond, followed by the martial world of Qianyang Kingdom. Kun Kingdom's cultivation world would be third.

Lee Hyun said nothing.

Nothing was certain yet. The overseas cultivators might simply be moving for trade and the expansion of their influence.

Tang Yanfei cautiously added.

“My family still considers it nothing more than rumors circulating among trading companies. But considering what happened in Lan Kingdom, it's probably worth remembering.”

...

When the conversation lapsed for a moment, Wen Xiaohe placed the wooden box from her lap onto the table.

“There's something I'd like to ask the three of you about.”

Lü Wende asked.

“What is it, Senior Sister Wen?”

“Rather than a medicinal ingredient, it's a seed.”

Wen Xiaohe opened the wooden box.

Inside lay a single seed about the size of a thumbnail.

The seed was nearly ink-black.

Its surface was not smooth, but wrinkled like old tree bark. Upon closer inspection, several thin silver lines spread across it like cracks.

Tang Yanfei used the Aura-Reading Art to examine the seed.

“It looks like a dead seed. I can barely sense any life force.”

“Barely, yes, but it isn't completely dead.”

Wen Xiaohe took out a thin needle and brought it close to the seed.

The blue light at the needle's tip trembled ever so slightly.

“I've checked it several times with the medicinal-ingredient room's Vitality-Detecting Needle. Its reaction is extremely slow, but there is definitely life force remaining.”

Lü Wende peered at the seed.

“What spirit plant is it?”

“Have you ever heard of the Ringless Divine Tree?”

None of the three answered.

As though she had expected as much, Wen Xiaohe continued.

“I only learned about it after obtaining this seed myself. It's a tree recorded only in a fragment of an extremely old spirit-tree compendium.”

Tang Yanfei asked.

“By ‘Ringless’, do you mean it has no growth rings?”

“That's right.”

Wen Xiaohe picked up the seed.

“Ordinary trees grow little by little each year as sap and spiritual qi circulate through them, right? The flow of sap and spiritual qi through the Ringless Divine Tree is said to be so slow that it barely grows even after being cultivated for hundreds of years. And because it has no growth rings even when cut down, you can't determine its medicine age either.”

Lü Wende asked.

“What use is a tree that grows that slowly?”

“They say it becomes worthwhile if you grow it long enough.”

“How long?”

“At least two thousand years.”

Lü Wende froze.

“...Two thousand years?”

“Once it passes two thousand years, dark blue lightning markings supposedly appear on its trunk and leaves. After reaching five thousand years, it can release a form of lightning called Profound Nether Frost Lightning.”

“Profound Nether Frost Lightning?”

Only then did Lee Hyun speak.

Wen Xiaohe looked at him.

“Is this your first time hearing of it too, Junior Brother Li?”

“Yes. What kind of lightning is it?”

“I only know what's written in the fragment.”

Wen Xiaohe searched her memory for a moment.

“It said it doesn't possess the power to shatter or burn its target like ordinary lightning. When Profound Nether Frost Lightning touches someone, it supposedly freezes magical power and even slows the primordial spirit's thoughts.”

Tang Yanfei's gaze changed.

“It can even affect the primordial spirit?”

“There was a line in the record saying that even a cultivator's streak of light would freeze in midair. I don't know whether that's exaggeration or truth.”

Lü Wende looked at the seed again.

“If that's genuine, isn't it an incredible treasure?”

“Only if you can prove it's genuine.”

Wen Xiaohe gave a bitter smile.

“They say the life force in a Ringless Divine Tree seed is so faint that it's difficult to distinguish from an ordinary dead seed. It can take anywhere from several decades to a hundred years just to sprout, and even after it does, you have to grow it for two thousand years before the first lightning markings appear.”

“Even the Foundation Establishment stewards couldn't determine whether it was genuine?”

“They told me it was very likely authentic. But since it would take far too long to cultivate, they said they could only value it as the seed of some ancient spirit plant.”

“How much?”

“Three low-grade spirit stones.”

Lü Wende asked.

“How much are you hoping to get for it, Senior Sister Wen?”

“Shouldn't I receive at least twenty low-grade spirit stones?”

Tang Yanfei looked at the seed as she spoke.

“If it's genuine, that would be cheap. But to an ordinary cultivator, a harvest two thousand years in the future might as well not exist. It's no wonder no one wants to buy it.”

Wen Xiaohe sighed.

“It was mixed among some seeds I received a few years ago as payment for appraising medicinal ingredients from an outside trading company. It feels wasteful to hand it over to the sect for next to nothing, but there's no point in growing it myself either.”

Wen Xiaohe was about to return the seed to the wooden box.

At that moment, Lee Hyun spoke.

“I'll buy it.”

Chapter 46

Wen Xiaohe’s hand stopped.

“Junior Brother Li, are you sure?”

“Yes.”

Lee Hyun took a small pouch from his storage pouch.

Clatter.

Twenty low-grade spirit stones spilled onto the table.

Lü Wende looked from the spirit stones to Lee Hyun and back again.

“...You reached Qi Refining Stage 9, and suddenly you’ve become quite free-handed.”

Tang Yanfei asked,

“Does fellow Daoist Li have a cultivation clan?”

“No.”

“Then who do you plan to pass it down to?”

“There’s someone I know who collects unusual spirit plants.”

Even after counting the spirit stones, Wen Xiaohe did not immediately take them.

“Think it over again. I believe it’s genuine, but I really don’t know whether it’ll ever sprout. Even if you change your mind later, I won’t be able to return the spirit stones.”

“It’s really fine.”

Twenty low-grade spirit stones were nothing to Lee Hyun.

In the end, Wen Xiaohe put the spirit stones into her storage pouch.

After taking the wooden box, Lee Hyun asked Wen Xiaohe,

“If you happen to get more seeds like this in the future, ones that are cheap because they take a very long time to grow, or that won’t sell because their identity is difficult to determine, could you let me know?”

“You want to buy more?”

“I’ll decide after seeing the price.”

A faint smile appeared on Wen Xiaohe’s face.

“If that happens, I’ll let you know.”

...

Outer Alchemy Court residence.

Lee Hyun placed the wooden box on the table.

When he opened the lid, the seed of the Ringless Divine Tree came into view.

Lee Hyun touched the seed with the tip of his finger and used the Aura-Reading Art, followed by his divine sense.

Only after examining it for a long while did he sense the faintest trace of life force deep within.

‘It isn’t dead. She said it produces Profound Nether Frost Lightning after five thousand years.’

Lee Hyun recalled Wen Xiaohe’s words.

- I heard that when Profound Nether Frost Lightning touches someone, it supposedly freezes magical power and even slows the primordial spirit's thoughts.

‘The primordial spirit....’

His thoughts naturally turned to the news Tang Yanfei had just shared.

The overseas cultivators who had seized the Lan Kingdom.

Lee Hyun remembered the red clouds that had once covered the skies above the Changchun Sect, the gray-white ash falling like snow, and the sea hanging upside down overhead.

The Red Furnace Adept’s empowered voice had carried the divine sense of a Golden Core cultivator and an image of fire. When Lady White Ash’s voice flowed through the air, even those burning with anger were swept up in the sorrow of the dead. And when the Azure Sea Wanderer spoke of the Dao of the sea, the Qi Refining cultivators felt as though they stood alone before a boundless ocean.

When the gazes of some Changchun Sect disciples began to waver, a Foundation Establishment Elder rang a bronze bell, while Gao Yuanhe released a medicinal fragrance that cleared the mind.

‘I wasn’t affected much back then, but...’

Perhaps it was because his entire body, including his brain and spinal cord, had been bathed in spiritual power while he formed the Primordial Body. Still, the empowered voices at the time had been wide-range methods directed at the entire External Affairs Market. No one had focused a divine-sense attack specifically on Lee Hyun alone.

‘The Changchun Sect’s Foundation Establishment cultivators were barely affected. But Qi Refining cultivators had their thoughts influenced merely by Golden Core cultivators carrying magical power and divine sense in their words.’

Lee Hyun realized what his weakness was.

The amount of spiritual power he possessed was incomparable to that of cultivators in the same realm.

But he had never specifically cultivated his primordial spirit.

‘If it’s a technique, I can counter it with spiritual power. But if my mind is bewitched, I might not even realize that I’m being attacked.’

‘What I need now is a way to defend against divine-sense attacks.’

...

The next day.

Outer Pavilion of the Scripture Pavilion.

Lee Hyun stood in the section containing inheritances that protected the primordial spirit.

Names and brief descriptions floated over the jade slips embedded along the wall.

《Mind-Clearing Spirit-Nurturing Art》, 《Delusion-Breaking Mind-Clearing Art》, 《Three Soul-Calming Tones》...

None of them were bad inheritances. But each differed slightly from what Lee Hyun wanted.

The Mind-Clearing Spirit-Nurturing Art consumed little spiritual power, but its effects were correspondingly weak.
