The Delusion-Breaking Mind-Clearing Art required him to first realize that he had been bewitched, while the Three Soul-Calming Tones was well suited to freeing several people from delusion but could not directly block a powerful divine-sense attack.

Lee Hyun slowly walked through the section until he stopped before one jade slip.

《Spirit-Guarding Essence-Protecting Method》.

「A secret art that forms an Essence-Protecting Seal within the sea of consciousness to protect the primordial spirit from another’s divine sense. Spiritual power is continuously consumed while maintaining the Essence-Protecting Seal, and consumption increases in proportion to the strength of the impact inflicted upon the primordial spirit. 90 contribution points.」

‘Hm?’

Lee Hyun read the description again.

Continuously consuming spiritual power while the secret art was active was a major drawback for an ordinary Qi Refining cultivator, but Lee Hyun was different.

‘If spiritual-power consumption is its only drawback, then it practically has no drawbacks for me, does it?’

The Spirit-Guarding Essence-Protecting Method was a secret art in which the Essence-Protecting Seal was formed in advance. Once formed, as long as it was maintained, the Essence-Protecting Seal would automatically react and protect the primordial spirit even if he failed to notice that he had been bewitched or attacked by divine sense.

It was precisely the inheritance he had been looking for.

Lee Hyun immediately went to the disciple in charge.

“I would like to study the Spirit-Guarding Essence-Protecting Method.”

The disciple placed Lee Hyun’s identity token on the formation plate.

Hummm―

The 368 contribution points remaining on the identity token appeared, and 90 of them vanished.

“Go to inheritance chamber eleven. Your study time is two shichen (about four hours).”

“Understood.”

...

Even after memorizing every detail from the jade slip in inheritance chamber eleven, Lee Hyun did not immediately leave the Scripture Pavilion. Instead, he looked around a little more.

This time, he headed toward the artifact refining section.

‘I have too many magic tools now...’

The high-grade magic tools he currently possessed were his six bronze flying swords, the black-iron longspear, and the Protective Bell. His mid-grade magic tools were the Mountain-Suppressing Sword and the Force-Dispersing Inner Armor.

Before he knew it, he had accumulated five different types of magic tools.

It was inconvenient to take them to an artifact refiner every time one suffered minor damage or a restriction developed a problem. At the very least, he needed to be able to inspect them and carry out simple repairs himself.

After checking several jade slips, Lee Hyun chose 《Essentials of Magic-Tool Nurturing and Refining》.

「Contains methods for inspecting a magic tool’s restrictions, nurturing it with spiritual power, and repairing minor damage. 42 contribution points.」

He paid the contribution points and studied the Essentials of Magic-Tool Nurturing and Refining as well.

...

After studying both inheritances, Lee Hyun finally searched for records concerning the Ringless Divine Tree.

An illustrated guide to ancient spirit trees that cost 10 contribution points to study contained only a short entry.

「The Ringless Divine Tree leans toward Water among the Five Elements, and yin among yin and yang. It grows over long periods of time in damp places untouched by sunlight.

Forcing its growth with powerful spiritual qi instead causes it to shrink back. Only time can nurture a Ringless Divine Tree.」

‘So the concentration of spiritual qi isn’t important? And judging from its nature, it doesn’t seem like a bad choice to grow in a tunnel....’

Lee Hyun felt pleased.

If it took nearly three times as long to grow somewhere without a spirit vein, as other spirit plants did, then he would have to wait fifteen thousand years rather than five thousand to see Profound Nether Frost Lightning.

‘Even for me, waiting fifteen thousand years would be a bit much....’

After memorizing everything he had studied, he left the Scripture Pavilion.

After studying the Spirit-Guarding Essence-Protecting Method, the Essentials of Magic-Tool Nurturing and Refining, and the illustrated guide to ancient spirit trees, 226 contribution points remained on his identity token.

Other outer disciples did not usually spend as many contribution points at the Scripture Pavilion as Lee Hyun did. After all, contribution points could also be exchanged for pills, spirit stones, magic tools, and cultivation resources.

But Lee Hyun was not short on spirit stones.

Most ordinary items could be bought with spirit stones, but verified inheritances preserved by the Danxiao Sect were another matter. Having lived as a rogue cultivator for many years, Lee Hyun understood their value better than anyone.

‘There’s still quite a while before my lower dantian reaches Qi Refining Great Perfection. I can always earn more contribution points in the meantime....’

...

A few days later.

After completing all his assigned alchemy work, Lee Hyun requested permission to leave the sect.

...

Nine days later.

Tunnel No. 3.

After inspecting the water supply facilities and spirit fields, Lee Hyun headed toward an empty cavern far from the existing caverns.

The cavern was cold and damp.

Groundwater seeped slowly through the rock.

‘This should be suitable for planting the Ringless Divine Tree.’

Lee Hyun moved earth and stone with techniques, reshaping the cavern.

Considering the possibility that the Ringless Divine Tree would one day grow into a towering giant, he raised the ceiling and spread a broad layer of black soil and fine sand brought from another region across the floor. He also dug a shallow channel so groundwater would not pool on one side.

...

One shichen later.

Spirit Field No. 3-1 was complete.

At the center of the wide spirit field was a small hole less than a handspan deep.

Lee Hyun removed the seed of the Ringless Divine Tree from the wooden box.

He placed the seed in the hole and covered it lightly with soil. After gently pressing down the surface with his palm, he moistened the earth with a little groundwater seeping from the rock.

“Do I just wait now?”

He smoothed the soil once more. If there was one thing he was good at, it was waiting.

After filling the water tank one last time, Lee Hyun left Tunnel No. 3 and returned to the Danxiao Sect.

Nine years later.

The cultivation chamber in the Outer Alchemy Court residence.

Lee Hyun sat in the lotus position, circulating the Primordial One-Qi Art as improved by later generations.

Spiritual qi gathered inside the cultivation chamber along the Qi-Gathering Formation.

Whoooosh―

The spiritual qi entered his body through his skin and with each breath, then was refined into Primordial True Qi.

When he had moved away from evenly cultivating his entire body and begun focusing cultivation on his lower dantian, Lee Hyun had worried that the two methods might conflict.

However, the mnemonic formula improved by later generations and the mnemonic formula of the Primordial Body differed only in the area treated as the dantian. They were fundamentally the same cultivation art. No problems had arisen afterward.

‘Now I know for certain. A cultivator’s realm isn’t determined by the amount of spiritual power stored inside the body.’

Even if cultivators exhausted all their spiritual power, their realm did not fall, and recovering it took only a few shichen. What determined their realm was the cultivation state of the physical body and dantian that absorbed spiritual qi, refined it into spiritual power, and stored it.

Each time repeated cultivation raised the upper limit of his spiritual power, the minute structures of his flesh, blood, and meridians underwent subtle transformations. To put it in terms from his past life, it was as though each cell that handled spiritual qi was changing into some mysterious existence of a higher level.

‘It’s possible to break through to Foundation Establishment with only the lower dantian. But even if I circulate the liquefied spiritual power from my lower dantian throughout my body afterward, it doesn’t seem like the rest of my body will automatically reach the Foundation Establishment realm.’

‘Only if I separately cultivate the rest of my body until it can refine heaven-and-earth spiritual qi into liquid spiritual power on its own, then break those regions through to Foundation Establishment as well, will I truly possess a Foundation Establishment-level Primordial Body.’

Hummmm―

Waves of spiritual power rippled around Lee Hyun’s Sea of Qi Acupoint.

Both the density and purity of the spiritual power there had reached the absolute limit possible within the Qi Refining realm.

His lower dantian had reached Qi Refining Great Perfection!

The inflow of spiritual qi into the cultivation chamber gradually subsided.

After examining the changes around his Sea of Qi Acupoint, Lee Hyun took out the wooden board he used as his handmade status screen from his storage pouch.

【Spiritual Power: 1,333 → 1,340】

His spiritual power limit had increased only by the amount contributed by the breakthrough of his lower dantian.

‘If my whole body had advanced from early Qi Refining Stage 9 to Qi Refining Great Perfection, it would have increased by 350 rather than 7.... Anyway, now I can attempt Foundation Establishment as soon as I have a Foundation Establishment Pill.’

Lee Hyun rose from his seat.

“I should find out where I stand in the queue for a Foundation Establishment Pill first.”

...

A few days later.

Mission Hall under the Outer Alchemy Court.

Lee Hyun stopped after entering the hall.

One wall, normally covered with mission tokens, was filled with red.

Dozens of red wooden tokens had pushed aside the ordinary mission tokens and taken their places.

Outer Alchemy Court disciples gathered in front of them, speaking in low voices.

“There are even more than last month.”

“How many bottles of Blood-Staunching Pills is that?”

“We’re not talking a few bottles. We’re talking hundreds.”

Lee Hyun examined the nearest red mission token.

「300 bottles of Tier-1 mid-grade Blood-Staunching Pills.

Deadline: two months.」

Similar missions continued beside it.

「200 bottles of Qi-Restoring Pills.」

「150 bottles of Mind-Clearing Pills.」

「200 bottles of Detoxification Pills.」

They were all pills normally produced by the Outer Alchemy Court, but both the quantities and deadlines were completely different.

“They expect us to make all of this within two months?”

One of the Outer Alchemy Court disciples gathered before the red mission tokens spoke in a horrified voice.

The disciple beside him shook his head.

“There are smaller batches too. Look below.”

A row of small blue wooden tokens hung beneath the red mission tokens.

「10 bottles of Blood-Staunching Pills.」

「20 bottles of Blood-Staunching Pills.」

「30 bottles of Blood-Staunching Pills.」

“Didn’t we make about this much last month too?”

“That’s exactly why it’s strange. Just how much are they planning to stockpile....”

Lee Hyun examined the red mission tokens again.

Pills used for staunching blood, restoring spiritual power, detoxifying poison, and stabilizing the primordial spirit. It was a selection meant to prepare for a situation in which hundreds of cultivators were injured or exhausted their spiritual power all at once.

‘Is the Danxiao Sect preparing for war?’

...

Lee Hyun entered the Outer Alchemy Court hall at the center of the valley.

Steward Quan noticed him and briefly swept him with divine sense.

“You’ve reached Qi Refining Great Perfection.”

“Yes.”

“Congratulations.”

“Thank you.”

Lee Hyun asked,

“Steward Quan, may I ask you something?”

“You came because you’re wondering about the Foundation Establishment Pill, I assume.”

“That’s right. What do I need to do to receive one?”

Steward Quan examined the ledger for a moment.

“Based on your current length of service and accumulated contribution points, your turn is still seventy or eighty years away. If more candidates are added in the meantime, it could be pushed back as far as ninety years.”

‘Ninety years!?’

It was longer than he had expected.

Li Dongsan’s current identity was that of a forty-seven-year-old Qi Refining Great Perfection Tier-1 alchemist. A Qi Refining cultivator’s lifespan was at most around one hundred and fifty years, and normally closer to one hundred and twenty.

“If I’m lucky, I might receive one before I die.”

Steward Quan shook his head.

“That’s only a calculation based on mechanically applying the current criteria. Long before your turn comes, you’ll be passed over because of your age and declining chances of a successful breakthrough. Would the sect hand a precious Foundation Establishment Pill to a Qi Refining Great Perfection cultivator over ninety years old? The chances of a successful breakthrough fall with age.”

“Then...”

“At this rate, it will be difficult for you to obtain a Foundation Establishment Pill. It’s a problem faced by most outer disciples, not just you.”

Steward Quan closed the ledger.

“That is why they take dangerous or unpopular external assignments in addition to their regular duties and use them to move themselves up the queue.”

He thought for a moment before continuing.

“As it happens, there is one option available right now. If you’re willing to take a posting in the Anling Kingdom as a resident cultivator, you could shorten your wait for a Foundation Establishment Pill by roughly fifty years.”

“A resident cultivator?”

“There will be a briefing at the External Affairs Court tomorrow. You can attend even if you don’t intend to apply, so go see for yourself.”

Steward Quan handed Lee Hyun a notice.

“I don’t understand. Why would simply serving as a resident cultivator in a mundane kingdom let me receive a Foundation Establishment Pill sooner?”

“I don’t know the exact circumstances either. They’ll explain it at the briefing.”

...

The next day.

A small meeting hall under the External Affairs Court.

Around twenty late Qi Refining outer disciples interested in the posting sat at a long table.

A map of northwestern Kun Kingdom was spread out at the front.

To the south of the Anling Kingdom stretched the long border of the Qianyang Kingdom, marked by a thick black line. All the territory that had once belonged to the Yunze Kingdom now lay within that line.

The person leading the meeting was a Foundation Establishment steward from the External Affairs Court.

The steward began.

“First, let me make one thing clear. The Danxiao Sect is not at war with the Qianyang Kingdom.”

His finger moved along the border on the map.

“Over the past several hundred years, the Qianyang Kingdom has annexed the Yunze Kingdom to the north along with several smaller kingdoms. As a result, it now shares a long border with the Anling Kingdom.”

The steward first placed three red markers over the Tier-2 spirit veins in the north.

“Over the past five years, the Qianyang Kingdom has steadily increased the number of gu warriors stationed at three northern spirit veins.”

He placed another marker on the highway leading toward the Anling Kingdom.

“They have also renovated their border checkpoints and begun strictly controlling the movement of cultivators and gu warriors who lack royal authorization.”

The final marker was placed on a small cultivator market near the border.

“Two months ago, three rogue cultivators from the Anling Kingdom disappeared near the border. One of them had been assisting the Immortal Veneration Court.”

The atmosphere inside the meeting hall grew somewhat heavier.

One disciple asked,

“Were they killed by gu warriors from the Qianyang Kingdom?”

“That has not been confirmed. It could have been the work of bandit cultivators, or they may have disappeared of their own accord.”

The steward pointed south on the map, toward the Cang Kingdom.

“Some of you may have heard rumors that cultivators belonging to the overseas faction that seized the Lan Kingdom have appeared in southern Cang Kingdom.”

Several disciples nodded.

“We do not know how the Wangu Sect will respond to them. Nor do we know why the Qianyang Kingdom is strengthening its northern border at the same time.”

The steward paused briefly.

“The two matters may be unrelated. But ours is not a sect that waits until a threat becomes reality before taking action. After discussions with the Biluo Sect, we have decided to reinforce the forces stationed at Immortal Veneration Courts throughout Kun Kingdom as a precaution. The Immortal Veneration Court in the Anling Kingdom is one of them.”

Another disciple asked,

“Wouldn’t it be better to send Foundation Establishment cultivators?”

“Foundation Establishment cultivators are valuable. More importantly, deploying a large number of them to the border could be interpreted by the Qianyang Kingdom as preparation for war.”

The steward’s finger pointed first to the Qianyang Kingdom, then to the Cang Kingdom.

“Our sect hopes those two kingdoms will block the overseas faction’s northward advance. We have no desire to provoke the Qianyang Kingdom or the Cang Kingdom excessively, nor do we want relations with them to deteriorate. That is why, for now, we intend to reinforce the existing resident cultivators and the forces of the mundane kingdoms with Qi Refining disciples.”

Lee Hyun roughly understood the situation.

“There is no war at present, so there is no need to worry too much. However, because this assignment requires you to accept risks that have not yet fully revealed themselves, suitable compensation will be provided. The posting lasts twenty years. If you complete your term, your place in the Foundation Establishment Pill queue will be advanced by fifty years. Even if nothing happens during those twenty years, the reward will remain unchanged.”

A quiet stir ran through the meeting hall.

One disciple raised his hand.

“What duties will the dispatched disciples actually perform?”

“You will divide up the existing resident cultivator duties. The basics include supervising rogue cultivators employed by the royal family, receiving tribute, selecting children with excellent spiritual roots, and mediating disputes between cultivation clans. Craft disciples will also take charge of matters related to their specialization. For example, an alchemist would manage the Immortal Veneration Court’s pill reserves and handle the refining and inspection of pills needed locally.”

“How strong are the Immortal Veneration Court’s defenses?”

“There is a Tier-2 defensive grand formation that can be activated in an emergency. In addition to resident cultivators from the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect, Qi Refining rogue cultivators hired by the Anling royal family and martial-path experts of comparable strength are also stationed there.”

The steward swept his gaze across the meeting hall.

“But the existence of a formation does not guarantee absolute safety. If the Immortal Veneration Court is attacked, you will have to fight as well.”

He added one final point.

“If you successfully reach Foundation Establishment, you will qualify to enter the Inner Gate and may even gain the opportunity to become a disciple under a Golden Core Elder. Whether that opportunity is worth taking this level of risk is for each of you to decide.”

...

The explanation continued for one shichen.

Judging solely by the conditions offered, it was not a bad assignment. Yet as soon as the briefing ended, more than half the disciples immediately left the meeting hall. Apparently, they all felt that something about the situation was off.

Lee Hyun, however, remained seated, staring at the map before him.

The Anling Kingdom.

It was the country where Tunnel No. 3 was located.

He was familiar with the surrounding terrain and local powers as well.

More importantly, he was the society head of the Two Heavens Society. It seemed a shame to continue neglecting the organization he had spent nearly three hundred years building. If he remained in the Anling Kingdom, he could keep an eye on the Two Heavens Society and gradually resume its activities.

‘Besides, even if I don’t volunteer now, if the situation worsens, the Danxiao Sect will probably start conscripting outer disciples.’

At that point, he would have to face the same risks without any guarantee that his place in the Foundation Establishment Pill queue would improve. And if he were sent to a different kingdom instead of the Anling Kingdom, he would be farther from both Tunnel No. 3 and the Two Heavens Society.

If he volunteered now, the duration, location, and duties of the assignment were all clearly defined.

‘Better to choose the post I want while I still have a choice.’

Lee Hyun looked at the Anling Kingdom on the map.

‘From my experience in my past life, shortening your commute improves your quality of life tremendously.’

Chapter 47

Three days after applying for assignment as a resident cultivator in Anling Kingdom.

Lee Hyun received notice of his final selection from the External Affairs Court.

The assignment period was twenty years.

There was one month left before departure.

‘Is there anything I should prepare in advance?’

After thinking for a moment, Lee Hyun recalled one type of magic tool he did not own.

“I’ll need a flight magic tool.”

Until now, Lee Hyun had shown little interest in flight magic tools.

That was because using the Reclining Escape Art was faster than most low-grade or mid-grade flight magic tools. Besides, flying through the sky made him visible from far away, so the cautious Lee Hyun had never bought one.

But things would be different once he became a resident cultivator.

Whenever he visited the royal family or a cultivation clan, suddenly popping out of the ground or arriving on foot would hardly inspire much dignity. He might also need to transport children with spiritual roots or injured people.

‘I’ll just buy one.’

...

The Artifact Court in the Danxiao Range.

It was where disciples of the Danxiao Sect purchased various magic tools that had been inspected and approved by the sect.

When Lee Hyun presented his outer disciple identity token, the disciple in charge asked,

“What are you looking for?”

“I’m looking to buy a flight magic tool.”

“Will you be the only one riding it?”

“I’d prefer something that can carry around five to ten people.”

The disciple in charge led Lee Hyun to the section where the flight magic tools were displayed.

Small leaves, jade plates, and magic tools modeled after boats and birds rested atop wooden shelves and stone pedestals.

The disciple picked up a palm-sized blue leaf.

“The Wind-Riding Leaf is an inexpensive low-grade flight magic tool and is easy to control. However, it slows down when carrying three or more people, and its formation inscriptions also heat up easily if it is operated for too long.”

“Please show me something a little better.”

“Then how about this?”

The disciple opened a wooden box beside him. Inside lay a round plate made of white jade. It was about the size of two palms placed together, and silver formation inscriptions resembling clouds and wind ran around its edge.

“This is the Flowing Cloud Disc. It is among the better mid-grade magic tools.”

The disciple placed the Flowing Cloud Disc on a demonstration formation plate and channeled spiritual power into it.

Hummm–

The white jade plate rapidly expanded.

A moment later, an oval flight magic tool about three zhang (about 9.9 m) long floated in the air. Its surface had recessed seats for eight people in addition to the operator, and a translucent barrier formed around its edge.

“It can comfortably carry up to nine adults, including the operator. It is about twice as fast as the Wind-Riding Leaf, and thanks to the Wind-Warding Formation, you will barely feel the wind even at high altitude.”

“Can it defend against attacks?”

“The barrier created by the Wind-Warding Formation can easily block something like the crossbows used in mortal kingdoms. However, it has no defensive formation capable of blocking a cultivator’s techniques.”

Lee Hyun stepped onto the Flowing Cloud Disc.

The magic tool beneath his feet barely trembled. When he fed a little spiritual power into it, it moved smoothly forward, backward, left, and right according to his thoughts.

“How far can it travel in a day?”

“If the operator has enough spiritual power, it should manage around five thousand li (about 1,960 km). But if it is carrying many passengers, even a late-stage Qi Refining cultivator would find it difficult to operate for an entire day.”

‘It’s a little slower than running there myself... but it should do.’

“How much is it?”

“This is considerably more expensive than the low-grade flight magic tool I showed you earlier. One hundred ninety low-grade spirit stones.”

“I’ll take it.”

Lee Hyun paid the price and placed the Flowing Cloud Disc into his storage pouch.

...

One month later.

A flying boat, a high-grade flight magic tool, rested on a broad stone platform at the outskirts of the Danxiao Range. Three late-stage Qi Refining outer disciples, including Lee Hyun, were scheduled to board it and head for the Immortal Veneration Court in Anling Kingdom.

The flying boat was communal property of the Danxiao Sect. Its formation inscriptions were far more complex than those of personal flight magic tools, allowing it to fly using spirit stones alone, and it was also equipped with a defensive formation capable of blocking basic techniques.

Lee Hyun exchanged brief farewells with the people he had lived alongside in the Outer Alchemy Court.

Lü Wende spoke first.

“Fellow Daoist Li makes choices that are difficult to understand from time to time. To volunteer for a dangerous place of your own accord...”

Wen Xiaohe also spoke.

“I still haven’t found any unusual seeds. Sorry. There should be old merchant groups or small cultivator markets in Anling Kingdom too, so don’t forget to keep an eye out.”

Tang Yanfei handed him a map of Anling Kingdom used by her family’s merchant group.

“The routes used by merchants should be marked in a little more detail than on an ordinary map. It’s an old map, though, so it would be best not to trust the information near the borders.”

“Thank you.”

Hummm–

The flying boat rose from the stone platform.

Piercing through the clouds, it left the peaks of the Danxiao Range behind and headed northwest.

...

Ten days later.

The royal capital of Anling Kingdom.

Inside the towering city walls, straight avenues and tiled rooftops stretched densely into the distance.

A low hill within the royal palace grounds was shrouded in faint mist.

When the flying boat appeared in the sky and stopped before the mist, cultivators emerged from within.

“The reinforcement disciples from the Danxiao Sect have arrived.”

A passage opened through the mist.

The flying boat descended halfway up the hill.

A large hall stood ahead, with the three characters for Immortal Veneration Court written on its signboard.

Beneath it waited cultivators wearing the long robes of the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect, along with people dressed in the official robes of the Anling royal court.

Lee Hyun recognized the Danxiao Sect disciple standing at the very front, and his gaze changed slightly.

A middle-aged cultivator with eyes that drooped slightly at the corners.

The steady aura of Qi Refining Great Perfection.

‘White Owl.’

It was a face he had seen once, thirteen years ago, in front of the External Affairs Court.

At the time, the man had just returned from the Immortal Veneration Court in Anling Kingdom and was handing over ledgers concerning tribute and resident cultivator duties.

And now he was stationed in Anling Kingdom again.

‘Does he like being a resident cultivator that much?’

The middle-aged cultivator checked the identity tokens of the newly arrived disciples.

“I am Zhang Jingyi. I am in charge of our sect’s resident cultivator duties in Anling Kingdom.”

The newly appointed resident cultivators, Lee Hyun among them, clasped their hands.

“Greetings, Senior Brother Zhang.”

Zhang Jingyi’s gaze settled on Lee Hyun.

“Fellow Daoist Li Dongsan, you’re at Qi Refining Great Perfection...”

“That is correct.”

“We’re at the same realm, so there’s no need to be so formal with me. Frankly, what does the order in which we entered the sect matter? It’s not as though we have masters, and among the countless outer disciples of the Danxiao Sect, we’re practically strangers anyway...”

“It’s fine. I’m more comfortable this way.”

Zhang Jingyi nodded, seemingly pleased.

“Then I’ll show you to your quarters first.”

...

Eighteen disciples of the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect were staying at the Immortal Veneration Court in Anling Kingdom.

Most were at the mid or late stages of Qi Refining, and four of them, including Zhang Jingyi and Lee Hyun, had reached Qi Refining Great Perfection.

Near the Immortal Veneration Court stood a separate hall where rogue cultivators and martial artists hired by the royal family resided. The Tier 2 defensive grand formation surrounding the entire hill was connected to a weak spirit vein, but the power of the spirit vein alone was insufficient to activate it, so the mid-grade spirit stones stockpiled in the Immortal Veneration Court also had to be used.

Lee Hyun was assigned quarters in the area used by Danxiao Sect disciples.

Zhang Jingyi showed him his quarters, the pill storehouse, and the alchemy chamber in turn.

“You’re an alchemist, so you can use this place whenever you need it... There aren’t many rules at the Immortal Veneration Court. When dealing with the royal family or cultivation clans, simply consider matters from the standpoint of the Danxiao Sect.”

“Understood.”

“Keep an eye out to ensure unauthorized rogue cultivators do not interfere in royal affairs, and if a dispute arises, verify the facts first. Suppressing people by force is easy, but you must also consider what happens afterward.”

“Senior Brother Zhang, have you been stationed in Anling Kingdom for a long time?”

“I have returned to the main mountain for periods in between, but altogether it has been more than fifty years...”

“Why have you served here for so long?”

“For a Foundation Establishment Pill, of course. In fact, I returned to the main mountain before and received one Foundation Establishment Pill.”

He added calmly,

“But I failed to reach Foundation Establishment. So I continued working as a resident cultivator to raise my priority for receiving another Foundation Establishment Pill.”

“...I see.”

“Fortunately, my body was not severely damaged. It did take several years to recover, though. In any case, if I want a second Foundation Establishment Pill, I need to make even more contributions.”

One month later.

Having grown somewhat accustomed to his resident cultivator duties, Lee Hyun left the royal capital of Anling Kingdom, passed through a quiet valley, and sank into the ground.

Sssrk.

Three li underground.

Ten li underground.

Eighteen li underground.

He moved rapidly toward the northwest.

...

「Tunnel No. 3」

“It’s close.”

From the Danxiao Sect, it had taken nine days to reach this place, but from the Immortal Veneration Court in Anling’s royal capital, he could arrive in less than two days.

Lee Hyun first inspected the water tank, water supply facilities, and spirit fields. The Spirit-Storing Ginseng, Bone-Rot Flowers, and Yin Soul Grass were all growing without issue.

The oldest group of Spirit-Storing Ginseng currently had a medicine age of 279 years, while the Bone-Rot Flowers, Purple Poison Orchids, Yin Soul Grass, and Earth Vein Flowers in Spirit Field No. 1-1 had reached an average medicine age of 448 years.

‘Weren’t spirit plants classified as Tier 3 once their medicine age reached five hundred years? What are Tier 3 spirit plants worth on the market? I can’t even get a sense of how much my assets are worth anymore.’

Nothing was visible in Spirit Field No. 3-1.

The spot where he had buried the Ringless Divine Tree seed remained silent.

Lee Hyun examined beneath the soil with his divine sense. The seed still retained its vitality.

Chirp! Chirp chirp!

Golden, fluffy fuzzbees flew over and circled around his head and shoulders.

“I can come more often now.”

Bzzzz–

As though they understood his words, the fellows flew about even more busily.

...

Fifteen days later.

Huiyan Market, Baiwu Shop.

In the underground stone chamber, Black Crow, Gray Mountain Goat, Mole, Blue Snake, and White Owl sat apart from one another.

It had been eighteen years since the last central gathering.

Tap.

The floor of the stone chamber rippled like water, and a cultivator in purple robes slowly appeared.

His face was hidden behind a Badger mask.

The five rose from their seats.

“Greetings, Society Head.”

Zhang Jingyi, who had calmly led the Danxiao Sect’s resident cultivators at the Immortal Veneration Court, now wore the White Owl mask and respectfully bowed his head.

Lee Hyun showed no outward reaction.

“Sit.”

The members sat down.

Black Crow first reported on the Two Heavens Society’s finances and contact points.

“Use has been less frequent than before, but the contact points are operating without issue. While the central gatherings were suspended, we accepted no new members and only permitted existing members to use the vein seats.”

Gray Mountain Goat reported on the condition of the vein seats in Kun Kingdom.

“There have been no major changes. However, over the past few years, the patrol ranges of the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect have gradually expanded.”

Mole also gave a brief report that nothing unusual had occurred at the vein seats under his supervision.

Blue Snake explained the situation toward Qianyang Kingdom.

“We have found no further signs that the Black Sun Office is specifically tracking the Two Heavens Society.”

Finally, White Owl spoke.

“The Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect have recently sent additional disciples to the Immortal Veneration Court in Anling Kingdom. For the time being, it would be safer to reduce travel in and out of the royal capital and nearby cultivator markets.”

It had been a long time since their last gathering, but Lee Hyun had not given them any particular assignments in the meantime, so the reports soon came to an end.

“Yellow Field Mouse?”

“He died of old age. None of the Two Heavens Society’s secrets were leaked in the process.”

“I see...”

The Two Heavens Society had existed for a very long time, and the fate of members who failed to break through to Foundation Establishment was always the same. Lee Hyun had long since grown accustomed to it.

“From now on, I will resume the central gatherings. However, they will not be held often. Until you receive separate instructions, simply continue with your assigned duties.”

The five lowered their heads.

“We will keep that in mind.”

Three months later.

A broad training ground south of the Anling royal palace.

Clang! Claang!

Clear metallic clashes rang out one after another.

Two martial artists wielding long spears moved swiftly back and forth through the center of the training ground.

One was a towering man who appeared to be around sixty. His long beard was half white, and the spear held in both hands was two chi (about 66 cm) longer than a man was tall.

The other martial artist was a thin man in his forties. He gripped his spear shaft short and slipped inside his opponent’s reach.

Both were grandmasters of the martial path who had reached the Profound Realm.

Each time their feet struck the ground, the solid stone slabs gave a low rumble.

Boom!

The two spears collided.

A streak of force extending from the towering man’s spear tip tore through his opponent’s clothes. The thin man twisted his body, guided the spear shaft aside, then spun low as though skimming the ground and aimed for the other man’s legs.

Whoosh!

The towering man raised his spear vertically and blocked the attack.

The two retreated almost simultaneously.

“Let’s stop here.”

“Very well.”

More than ten Transformation Realm martial artists watching around the training ground called out.

“That was most instructive!”

Several resident cultivators from the Immortal Veneration Court were also seated to one side, watching the spar.

They were Zhang Jingyi and Lee Hyun of the Danxiao Sect, Su Buyi, a Qi Refining Stage 9 cultivator from the Biluo Sect, and Lin Ruolan, a female cultivator at Qi Refining Stage 8.

Lee Hyun watched the two men in the center of the training ground with interest.

The towering man was Lu Jingtian, commander of the Anling Kingdom’s Royal Guard, while the thin man was Ruan Qingzhao, the royal martial instructor.

Since coming to share a border with Qianyang Kingdom, the Anling royal family had made considerable efforts to improve the abilities of its martial artists. Methods for dealing with gu warriors and cultivators had gradually been incorporated into the royal martial arts as well.

After taking a sip of water, Lu Jingtian approached Lee Hyun.

“Immortal Li, are you versed in the spear?”

“A little.”

“I asked because you seemed to understand the sparring match well.”

Lu Jingtian glanced at Lee Hyun’s storage pouch.

“If you would be willing, might you exchange some martial learning with us without using magic tools?”

Zhang Jingyi spoke.

“Commander Lu. Junior Brother Li is an alchemist.”

“I know. I’m not asking him to spar at full strength.”

Lu Jingtian respectfully clasped his hands.

“I only wish to exchange a few moves.”

Zhang Jingyi looked at Lee Hyun.

“If you do not feel like it, Junior Brother Li, you may refuse.”

“It’s fine.”

Lee Hyun rose from his seat.

“I’ve also been curious about martial arts.”

Joy appeared on Lu Jingtian’s face.

“Thank you.”

A royal martial artist retrieved an iron spear a little over one zhang long from the weapon rack at the side of the training ground.

“This is a training spear.”

Lee Hyun accepted the spear and lightly swung it several times.

Whoosh. Whum.

The spear shaft’s center of gravity was shifted slightly toward the front. It seemed designed to put more force behind thrusts and downward strikes, taking into account situations where the royal martial artists fought in armor.

Lee Hyun held the spear upright in one hand, then adjusted his grip and took it in both hands.

Lu Jingtian also took up his own spear and stood in the center of the training ground.

“Then I ask for your guidance.”

Lu Jingtian’s entire presence changed.

Whooo–

The surrounding air seemed to settle in time with his breathing.

The spear tip pointed at Lee Hyun’s chest.

In contrast, Lee Hyun’s stance looked somewhat awkward.

His lead hand was far too loose, and the butt of his spear shaft hung so low it nearly touched the ground. Even his center of balance leaned slightly to one side.

Several young Transformation Realm martial artists around the training ground glanced at one another.

“That doesn’t look like the stance of someone who has trained with a spear for long....”

“The Immortal probably only learned techniques.”

However, Ruan Qingzhao, the grandmaster of the martial path second only to Lu Jingtian in Anling Kingdom, studied Lee Hyun’s feet and hands, and his expression became extremely grave.

Lu Jingtian moved first.

Thud!

The instant Lu Jingtian kicked off the ground, a silver-white flash tore through the air and surged forward.

Lee Hyun raised his spear half a beat late.

Clang!

A piercing metallic crash rang out, and sparks scattered.

Lee Hyun’s lead hand was shoved aside, making his spear tip swing sharply to the side.

Lu Jingtian’s eyes flashed.

He twisted at the waist, sending his spear in a broad arc toward Lee Hyun’s side.

Lee Hyun awkwardly stepped back and blocked the attack with his spear shaft.

Clang!

He was pushed back again.

Disappointment appeared on the faces of the younger martial artists.

But Lu Jingtian narrowed his eyes, while Ruan Qingzhao’s gaze grew even sharper.

‘Something’s strange.’

Immortal Li Dongsan was clearly half a beat late every single time. And yet Lu Jingtian’s spear tip had not so much as brushed the edge of his clothes.

The third attack.

The fourth attack.

The fifth attack.

Clang-clang-clang-clang!

Thrusts, slashes, and sweeping blows overlapped within a single breath. The silver-white spear blade left afterimages as it relentlessly pressed every part of Lee Hyun’s body.

Swish!

The spear tip split into several streaks, simultaneously targeting Lee Hyun’s throat, chest, and dantian.

At the instant the air-splitting shriek left his ears ringing, Lee Hyun’s spear shaft moved diagonally.

Clang-clang-clang–

Three collisions merged into a single explosive crash.

Lee Hyun was pushed back a step once again.

But Lu Jingtian’s brow furrowed even more deeply.

‘Why does he keep returning to the same spots?’

He was clearly the one pressing the attack.

Yet each time Immortal Li Dongsan retreated, he returned to a spot he had already stepped on. Before Lu Jingtian realized it, he alone had been tracing a small circle around Lee Hyun.

Lu Jingtian changed his spear art.

The spear tip that had been thrusting straight ahead suddenly dropped.

Boom!

The iron spear smashed diagonally into the stone slab at Lee Hyun’s feet. The instant fragments of stone flew upward, Lu Jingtian used the rebound to twist his waist and shoulders.

Shwaaaak–

The rebounding iron spear swept in a huge arc and came crashing down toward Lee Hyun’s head with enough force to split a boulder in one blow.

Lee Hyun’s lead hand loosened again.

The spear shaft seemed to slip within his grasp.

“...!”

Lu Jingtian’s eyes flashed.

He twisted the descending spear tip, intending to knock away the spear shaft slipping from Lee Hyun’s grasp and immediately thrust at his shoulder.

That was the moment.

Tap.

Crrrk–

The two spear shafts locked together as though entangling one another.

The instant Lu Jingtian poured his strength into his spear shaft, that force was twisted completely off course. The tremendous power slid along Lee Hyun’s spear shaft and changed direction as though being sucked into empty space.

‘What is this....’

The moment Lu Jingtian lost his balance and pitched forward, Lee Hyun stepped forward on an unexpected beat.

Lu Jingtian instinctively tried to retreat.

But Lee Hyun’s spear shaft lightly tapped the back of Lu Jingtian’s neck.

Tap.

The fierce wind pressure whipping across the training ground vanished in an instant.

Lu Jingtian froze.

Lee Hyun withdrew his spear.

“That was an excellent spear art.”

Lu Jingtian touched his neck once.

“What kind of method was that? I couldn’t understand it.”

“Ha ha, I suppose I was lucky.”

Lu Jingtian looked down at the traces left by their movements.

The stone slabs in the center of the training ground were gouged and cracked in numerous places. More than a hundred of his own heavy, forceful footprints overlapped along the path of a small circle.

And in the middle of that chaos, the footprints left quietly behind by Li Dongsan numbered–

Only four.

‘...!’

Lu Jingtian trembled as though struck by lightning.

‘Against me, the foremost grandmaster of the martial path in Anling Kingdom, he fought while stepping on only four spots?’

At that moment, Ruan Qingzhao, who had been standing at one side of the training ground, stepped forward with a grave expression.

“Immortal Li.”

He clasped his hands.

“May I also ask you to exchange a few moves with me?”

Lee Hyun looked at the spear Ruan Qingzhao was holding.

It was shorter than Lu Jingtian’s.

“Very well.”

Lu Jingtian immediately stepped forward, unwilling to be outdone.

“Wait! Immortal, our spar isn’t over yet, is it?”

Lu Jingtian hurriedly readjusted his grip on his spear.

“Please give me one more chance. May I use my full strength this time?”

Author's Note:

Many readers requested one, so I made a simple map.

I don’t have any experience making maps, so it may be lacking, but I did my best to put it together ㅠ

The proportions and distances do not perfectly reflect the novel’s setting, and the map is only intended as a reference to help with understanding.

If anything in the setting conflicts with the map, I would appreciate it if you considered the details in the novel itself, rather than the map, to be canon.

I hope it helps even a little with your enjoyment of the story. Thank you, as always!

Chapter 48

“By ‘full strength’...?”

“I would like you to permit us to use aura as well.”

Lu Jingtian lightly tapped his chest.

“You may use spiritual power as well, Immortal.”

Ruan Qingzhao stepped forward too.

“I would also like to request your guidance under the same conditions.”

Lee Hyun looked back and forth between them.

“I have no objection, but... what if you get hurt?”

Lu Jingtian’s eyes widened for a moment before he burst into hearty laughter.

“Hahaha!”

His laughter rang across the training ground.

“You may not know this, Immortal, but the two of us are grandmasters of the martial path who have reached the lofty realm commonly known in the mundane world as the Profound Realm. Instructor Ruan and I have even faced a Tier 2 gu warrior on the border with Qianyang Kingdom. The two of us joined forces and fought him for over a hundred exchanges, eventually injuring his left arm. Though we failed to take his head, we did force him back across the border.”

Lu Jingtian set his spear upright.

Thud.

The heavy end of the spear shaft rang against the stone paving.

“We are not so frail that you need to worry about injuring us, Immortal.”

Ruan Qingzhao calmly added,

“If it becomes dangerous, we will withdraw first.”

Lee Hyun nodded.

“Very well. Let’s do that.”

Their expressions brightened.

Lee Hyun, meanwhile, looked down at the iron practice spear in his hand.

‘They still don’t know I’m a monster, though... I’ll have to control my strength.’

Lu Jingtian and Lee Hyun set down their iron practice spears.

Two royal martial artists then brought over a pair of silver longspears from the weapon rack. The spearheads and shafts had each been forged as a single piece, and the marks left by repeatedly folding and hammering refined iron remained on their surfaces like silvery grain.

Lu Jingtian and Lee Hyun each took one.

Lee Hyun sent an extremely fine thread of Primordial True Qi through his new longspear.

Hummm–

A translucent glow seeped into the spearhead and shaft.

It was so faint that it would be difficult to notice without looking closely.

“Are you ready?”

“Yes.”

Lu Jingtian adjusted his grip on the longspear.

“Then I ask for your guidance once more.”

He drew a deep breath.

Lu Jingtian’s energy flowed down both arms and into his longspear. The aura that had bloomed from the tip of the spearhead at only one cun (about 3.3 cm) long rapidly expanded.

At last, spear aura stretching more than one zhang (about 3.3 m) completely enveloped the actual spearhead.

Every tremor of the spear aura made the surrounding air sizzle, while blade-like waves of hot wind spread in every direction. The nearby Transformation Realm martial artists held their breath.

Su Buyi and Lin Ruolan also watched the training ground with more serious expressions than before.

Thud!

Lu Jingtian kicked off the ground.

His figure became a streak of silver light.

CLAAANG!

The two longspears collided head-on.

A circular blast of air pressure erupted from the point of impact.

Whoooosh–

Dust and fragments of stone were swept away across the training ground.

Lee Hyun slid back one step.

As though he had been waiting for that exact moment, Lu Jingtian twisted his waist.

The silver longspear swept through a huge arc toward Lee Hyun’s waist.

Swooosh–

Aura extending from the spearhead carved a thin line across the stone paving.

Lee Hyun raised his spear shaft and pushed diagonally upward against the base of the spear aura.

Screeech!

The two spear shafts ground violently against each other.

The instant Lu Jingtian’s longspear was knocked upward, Lee Hyun’s spearpoint drove toward his chest.

The corners of Lu Jingtian’s mouth rose.

“Excellent!”

Protective Aura enveloped his upper body.

At the same time, the longspear that had been knocked upward spun around and slammed down onto Lee Hyun’s shaft.

Clang!

Lee Hyun’s spearpoint was knocked aside just before it touched the Protective Aura.

Lu Jingtian stepped forward.

The butt of his spear shot toward Lee Hyun’s flank like a lightning bolt.

Whoosh!

Lee Hyun twisted his body.

The spear shaft barely grazed past the front of his waist.

Lu Jingtian did not stop attacking.

Clang-clang-clang-clang!

Aura swept across the entire training ground.

During their previous spar, a minuscule opening had appeared at Lu Jingtian’s spearpoint whenever he transitioned between moves. But after he unleashed his aura art, even that opening vanished.

Lu Jingtian’s breathing, body, and longspear became one. The force that began at his toes passed through his waist and shoulders without the slightest interruption before flowing into the spearhead.

Every attack carried enough weight to bring down a fortress wall.

Clang! Clang-clang!

Aura swept relentlessly around Lee Hyun.

Yet once again, the spearhead failed to cut even the hem of his clothes.

Lu Jingtian’s gaze sharpened.

‘Is he going to return to the same places again?’

He watched Immortal Li Dongsan’s feet.

But his opponent was no longer moving only between the same four spots he had stepped on earlier. Instead, he slid like flowing water through the gaps between the shockwaves created by the aura.

‘As expected! This time he won’t have it so easy.’

Lu Jingtian’s confidence gradually solidified.

Immortal Li Dongsan’s spear art was unfathomable, but perhaps it was merely an intricate technique that did not hold up in real combat.

‘There are some powers that technique alone cannot overcome!’

Lu Jingtian drew a deep breath.

Aura surged explosively through both arms and into his longspear.

Huuummm–

The aura surrounding the spearhead began to rotate.

One layer.

Two layers.

Three layers.

Circular aura rings unfolded one after another around the tip of the longspear.

Each aura ring rotated in the opposite direction from the one beside it. The interlocking rings ground apart the surrounding air and dust alike.

Ruan Qingzhao’s expression stiffened.

‘Is it really all right to use that?’

It was the technique Lu Jingtian had used to injure the Tier 2 gu warrior from Qianyang Kingdom.

If the opponent blocked the spearpoint, the three aura rings would grind apart both their weapon and their body-protecting spirit light. If they dodged sideways, Lu Jingtian could expand the aura rings around the spearhead and sweep the surrounding area.

The Transformation Realm martial artists instinctively retreated several steps.

Lu Jingtian stepped forward.

Boom!

Three layers of aura rings surged toward Lee Hyun.

The entire training ground was engulfed in dazzling light.

At that moment, Lee Hyun’s spearpoint slipped into the narrow gaps between the three aura rings.

Ting–

A clear ring cut across the training ground.

The three aura rings, each fiercely counter-rotating against the others, swallowed one another’s rotational force and twisted all at once.

Screeeech! Crunch!

Lu Jingtian’s face turned deathly pale.

The aura he himself had released could no longer withstand its own power. It collapsed inward, then spiraled along Lee Hyun’s spear shaft and was drawn into a massive vortex.

‘Four Ounces Deflect a Thousand Jin!?’ [TL Note: 1 Jin is about 500 grams ]

Lee Hyun slowly rotated his spear shaft half a turn, and the triple aura rings wrapped around it were thrown completely off course and shot into the air.

BOOOOM!

The storm of aura rings burst harmlessly above their heads.

The resulting blast pressure sent Lu Jingtian pitching uncontrollably forward.

Before he could regain his balance, Lee Hyun’s spearpoint had already come to a quiet stop directly before the space between his brows.

“...!”

Cold sweat trickled down Lu Jingtian’s forehead.

Lee Hyun withdrew his spear and spoke calmly.

“The rotation you used to interlock those three aura rings was excellent.”

“No.... It was hardly... excellent....”

Lu Jingtian lowered his longspear with trembling hands. An overwhelming thrill ran down his spine.

‘What kind of supernatural technique was that...? I still have so far left to climb!’

This time, Ruan Qingzhao stepped forward.

“I would also like to request your guidance.”

A fierce competitive spirit burned in Ruan Qingzhao’s eyes.

‘Brother Lu’s spear and mine are different.’

Ruan Qingzhao adjusted his grip on the short spear in his hands.

A moment later, Lee Hyun and Ruan Qingzhao stood in the center of the training ground.

“Are you ready?”

“Yes.”

Aura rose from Ruan Qingzhao’s body.

It was neither as large nor as spectacular as Lu Jingtian’s.

Instead, it clung to his arms, legs, and the surface of his short spear like a thin membrane less than half a cun thick.

Ruan Qingzhao shortened his grip on the shaft.

His front hand rested less than two chi (about 66 cm) from the spearhead, while his rear hand held the middle of the shaft.

Ruan Qingzhao moved.

Tap.

His footstep was far quieter than Lu Jingtian’s.

Yet with that single step, three streaks of spear aura attacked Lee Hyun from different directions.

Clang-clang-clang!

Ruan Qingzhao’s spear immediately changed course.

Pivoting around his front hand, the spearhead traced a small circle and slashed toward Lee Hyun’s chest.

When Lee Hyun bent backward, the butt of the spear surged upward from below.

Clack!

Lee Hyun’s spear shaft blocked it.

Ruan Qingzhao used the recoil of the collision to spin his body.

Spear aura targeted Lee Hyun’s back, waist, and knee in rapid succession.

Clang-clang-clang!

It was a spear art utterly different from Lu Jingtian’s.

The next attack began before the previous one had even ended.

There was no distinction between spearhead and butt, nor any boundary between thrusting, slashing, and striking.

Ruan Qingzhao slipped inside Lee Hyun’s reach.

Before anyone realized it, less than one zhang separated them.

Lee Hyun’s long spear no longer had enough room to move.

Ruan Qingzhao’s eyes gleamed.

‘Got you.’

He twisted the spear shaft.

The aura at the spearhead split into dozens of strands.

Thin streaks of spear aura stabbed simultaneously toward the acupoints across Lee Hyun’s upper body.

At that moment.

Lee Hyun let go of his spear.

Ruan Qingzhao’s pupils trembled.

‘He abandoned his spear?’

In the very next instant, Lee Hyun’s entire body wavered like a mirage before Ruan Qingzhao’s eyes.

Swish!

Instead of retreating, Lee Hyun charged straight into the very center of the dozens of converging strands of spear aura.

‘Is he insane?!’

Ruan Qingzhao reflexively twisted the spear shaft, attempting to pierce Lee Hyun through the solar plexus.

At that exact moment, Lee Hyun’s two hands unleashed a dazzling display of skill that erased the boundaries between fist technique and palm technique, finger flick and grappling.

Ting! Tang!

Lee Hyun’s index and middle fingers shot out like lightning, flicking the flat of Ruan Qingzhao’s spearhead twice in succession.

They were only two finger flicks, yet the trajectories of the dozens of spreading strands of spear aura scattered through the air like raindrops.

At the same time, Lee Hyun’s left hand slid around Ruan Qingzhao’s elbow joint and seized it.

Ruan Qingzhao felt the strength vanish from the arm holding his spear.

The instant the startled Ruan Qingzhao tried to smash his other fist into Lee Hyun’s jaw–

Tap-tap-tap-tap!

Ruan Qingzhao’s vision filled with dozens of afterimages.

Lee Hyun’s right hand swept across Ruan Qingzhao’s entire body with endlessly shifting techniques.

The Shoulder Well Acupoint on his shoulder, the Chest Center Acupoint on his chest, the Sun and Moon Acupoint on his flank, the Crooked Pool Acupoint on his arm....

Lee Hyun’s fist, palm, and fingertips struck in rapid succession, grazing the acupoints all over Ruan Qingzhao’s body.

Finally, Lee Hyun’s right fist tore through the air and stopped dead one cun before Ruan Qingzhao’s face.

Bang!

The blast of air pressure released when the fist stopped violently whipped Ruan Qingzhao’s hair.

The entire exchange had unfolded without even enough time to draw a single breath.

Clang.

Only then did the spear Lee Hyun had released fall onto the floor of the training ground.

“That was an excellent spear art.”

“.......”

Silence filled the area around the training ground.

The Transformation Realm martial artists had failed to properly understand what had just happened. To their eyes, Lee Hyun had merely moved his hands a few times, and Ruan Qingzhao’s spear had simply stopped dead.

After a moment, Lu Jingtian was the first to clasp his hands and bow deeply to Lee Hyun.

“I have received valuable guidance.”

Ruan Qingzhao followed suit, still breathing heavily.

“Thank you for your guidance.”

The Transformation Realm martial artists around the training ground also clasped their hands in unison.

“Thank you for your guidance!”

Zhang Jingyi approached Lee Hyun.

“I had no idea Junior Brother Li was this accomplished in martial learning as well.”

“Apparently, one of my family’s ancestors was a mortal who reached the level of a grandmaster of the martial path. Several martial arts and mnemonic formulas were passed down to his descendants. I also learned our family martial arts when I was young.”

“So that was the reason.”

Zhang Jingyi readily accepted the explanation.

Among cultivators from rogue cultivator backgrounds, quite a few had ties to martial clans or royal families in the mundane world.

Moreover, Li Dongsan was a cultivator at Great Perfection of Qi Refining.

Zhang Jingyi thought it was entirely possible for him to overwhelm a Profound Realm grandmaster of the martial path if he incorporated spiritual power into mortal martial arts.

Su Buyi seemed to think the same.

“As expected of someone at Great Perfection of Qi Refining.”

He murmured in admiration.

“Since he handles spiritual power like aura, it seems even Profound Realm experts would have difficulty dealing with him.”

Lin Ruolan said,

“Isn’t his skill with the spear itself extraordinary as well?”

“Compared to mortal martial learning, I suppose it is.”

Su Buyi’s expression showed sincere admiration.

“I knew the Danxiao Sect was a sect devoted primarily to alchemy, but I never expected even one of its outer alchemists to be this capable in close combat. The Senior Brothers of my sect would find this quite interesting if they saw it.”

Lee Hyun showed no particular reaction.

Su Buyi was not trying to insult him. He genuinely believed what he was saying.

It was Lu Jingtian who frowned instead.

‘They can witness such profound martial learning with their own eyes and still feel nothing? What complete fools!’

Ruan Qingzhao’s thoughts were no different.

‘Aside from being born with spiritual roots, they’re hopelessly untalented fools. They have no idea how extraordinary this man truly is....’

In truth, Lu Jingtian and Ruan Qingzhao did not think particularly highly of the resident cultivators.

They had their reasons.

A child with a spiritual root was born roughly once in every ten thousand people, which was certainly a rare gift.

But only one martial artist in several million reached the Transformation Realm.

Profound Realm experts were rarer still. Ordinarily, a population of around one hundred million was needed to produce a single Profound Realm expert in a generation.

So in terms of sheer rarity of talent, Qi Refining cultivators with spiritual roots could not compare to Lu Jingtian and Ruan Qingzhao. Their particular kind of talent simply happened to be better suited to this world.

Lu Jingtian and Ruan Qingzhao had vaguely sensed that Immortal Li Dongsan’s explanation was not entirely true. His martial learning was far beyond anything that could be explained merely by having learned family martial arts.

Neither of them pressed him, however. They simply assumed Li Dongsan had circumstances he did not wish to reveal.

...

From that day onward, the martial artists of Anling Kingdom treated Li Dongsan differently.

They had already shown him proper respect as a resident cultivator of the Danxiao Sect, but now they sincerely revered him as a Senior who had walked farther along the martial path.

Lu Jingtian and Ruan Qingzhao occasionally visited the Immortal Veneration Court to ask him about spears and footwork.

Lee Hyun taught them a few things within the limits of what he knew.

That did not mean Lee Hyun’s daily life changed.

Most of the time, he inspected the pills and medicinal ingredients at the Immortal Veneration Court, and occasionally visited the royal family or nearby cultivation clans to mediate disputes.

Once every two or three months, he returned to Tunnel No. 3 to check the spirit fields and fuzzbees.

At times, he also donned the Badger mask and held meetings of the Two Heavens Society.

Fortunately, Qianyang Kingdom’s forces never crossed Anling Kingdom’s border.

However, the number of gu warriors stationed around the northern spirit vein did not decrease.

Five years later.

The Immortal Veneration Court, Anling Kingdom.

Lee Hyun lay comfortably on the floor of his quarters.

A complex seal floated within his sea of consciousness.

Several layers of patterns surrounded a hollow circle at its center, while two streams of light revolved in opposite directions around the outside.

The Essence-Protecting Seal.

It had already been fourteen years since he obtained the 《Spirit-Guarding Essence-Protecting Method》.

Befitting a secret art related to the primordial spirit, the Essence-Protecting Seal was more abstruse than any technique Lee Hyun had learned thus far.

Even so, he had steadily studied the Essence-Protecting Seal, and today, he had finally achieved a major breakthrough!

Huuummm–

The Essence-Protecting Seal, which used to disperse unless he consciously held it together, settled into place within his sea of consciousness on its own. Now, even without Lee Hyun consciously maintaining it, the Essence-Protecting Seal could preserve a stable form while gradually consuming Primordial True Qi.

If external divine sense or a bewitching force approached his sea of consciousness, it would consume more Primordial True Qi than usual and automatically protect his primordial spirit.

‘This should be enough to call Minor Attainment!’

Lee Hyun took out the wooden board he used as a handmade status window from his storage pouch.

【Technique: Spirit-Guarding Essence-Protecting Method (Minor Attainment)...】

Just as he put the wooden board back into his storage pouch,

Knock, knock.

Someone knocked on the door to his quarters.

“Junior Brother Li. Are you inside?”

It was Zhang Jingyi’s voice.

Lee Hyun got up and opened the door.

“What is it?”

“It is time to prepare for the Immortal Ascension Selection.”

“The Immortal Ascension Selection?”

“We select children with spiritual roots and send them to the main sect. This is your first time since becoming a resident cultivator, isn’t it?”

“Yes.”

Zhang Jingyi gestured.

“Come to the Conference Hall. We need to decide our assigned regions and schedule.”

...

The Conference Hall of the Immortal Veneration Court.

Resident cultivators from the Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect sat on opposite sides of a long table.

A map of the entire Anling Kingdom was spread across the table.

Every six years, Anling Kingdom gathered children between the ages of six and thirteen who had not yet undergone a spiritual root test and examined their aptitude.

The Danxiao Sect and Biluo Sect divided the recruitment regions according to a prior agreement.

Zhang Jingyi pointed toward the western side of the map.

“This time, our sect is responsible for Shuoning Circuit, Baihe Circuit, and Yunling Circuit. All three are sparsely populated western frontier regions of Anling Kingdom.”

Lee Hyun’s gaze settled on Pingling County in Shuoning Circuit.

It was close to Tunnel No. 3.

Zhang Jingyi continued.

“First, the royal court gathers all children of eligible age in each county, grouping them by locality. We travel along a predetermined route, test their spiritual roots, and take any children with aptitude back to the royal capital.”

“We don’t send them directly to the main sect?”

“The Danxiao Sect is simply too far away. We cannot keep them aboard the flying boat while we finish the selection in every region.”

Zhang Jingyi spoke with an extremely serious expression.

“Children are different from us. They need meals and proper sleeping arrangements at the right times, and they easily fall ill from the cold at high altitudes.”

“Even with a Wind-Warding Formation?”

“Blocking the wind does not make the cold disappear completely. Disciples handling the Immortal Ascension Selection for the first time have underestimated that before and ended up making the children sick.”

Zhang Jingyi folded down his fingers one by one.

“They also need a balanced diet of the grains, meat, and vegetables mortals eat. You cannot carelessly feed them difficult-to-digest spirit food or pills just because they are good for the body. A mortal child can easily die after going without food for only a few days. Remember this well. Mortals are extremely fragile, so they must be handled as carefully as tender sprouts.”

“Ah... I suppose that’s true.”

‘I’ve been a cultivator for too long. I’ve lost touch with how fragile mortals are.’

Zhang Jingyi said,

“That is why we first bring the selected children to the Immortal Ascension Villa in the royal capital and have them stay there. Once the selections in every region are complete, we put them aboard the Crimson Firmament Immortal Ferry all at once and take them to the main sect.”

“Understood.”

...

After the meeting ended, Zhang Jingyi led the Danxiao Sect disciples to a broad stone platform behind the Immortal Veneration Court.

A large warehouse stood there.

Zhang Jingyi placed his identity token on the formation plate.

Huuummm–

The warehouse doors opened to either side.

Inside rested a flying boat more than twenty zhang long.

Its hull was made from white spirit wood, with golden alchemical flames and clouds painted along both sides. The deck and cabins were densely covered with the Wind-Warding Formation and defensive formation inscriptions.

“That’s quite a flying boat.”

“It is the Crimson Firmament Immortal Ferry.”

Zhang Jingyi lightly tapped the hull.

“It is a high-grade flight magic tool entrusted to the Immortal Veneration Court by the main sect. We rarely have occasion to use it, but whenever we recruit disciples, we must use this flying boat.”

“Because we need to carry so many children?”

“That too, but....”

Zhang Jingyi paused for a moment.

“We also need to display the majesty of the sect to mortals.”

“Majesty?”

“Sending a child with a spiritual root to an immortal sect can change the fate of an entire family. It will be a moment the mortals remember for the rest of their lives. We can hardly arrive in some shabby wagon, can we?”

One of the Danxiao Sect disciples beside him nodded solemnly.

“If their first sight of a cultivator is unimpressive, the children’s parents may begin to doubt our sect.”

“I see.”

Zhang Jingyi asked Lee Hyun,

“Do you own a flight magic tool?”

“I do.”

Lee Hyun took the palm-sized Flowing Cloud Disc from his storage pouch.

“A Flowing Cloud Disc. Its size and color are unobtrusive enough. It should do nicely.”

“If we already have the Crimson Firmament Immortal Ferry, why do we need personal flight magic tools?”

“If we land this enormous flying boat in the middle of a village and a crowd of cultivators comes pouring out, it looks rather undignified.”

“.......”

“First, we leave the Immortal Ferry hovering overhead. Then the resident cultivators descend one by one on their personal flight magic tools. That better conveys the majesty of the immortal sect to the mortals watching below.”

Zhang Jingyi took a small flying sword from his storage pouch.

Huuummm–

The finger-length flying sword expanded to more than one zhang long.

He stepped onto the sword.

“Watch carefully. First, you need to stop about ten zhang above the ground.”

The flying sword rose into the air.

Zhang Jingyi did not descend immediately upon reaching a height of ten zhang.

He waited there until the disciples standing on the stone platform were all looking up at him.

“First, make sure the mortals are looking your way.”

His voice drifted down from above.

“We can survey our surroundings at once with divine sense, but mortals cannot. Even turning their heads and moving their eyes takes them time. If we descend too quickly, they may miss us entirely.”

Zhang Jingyi gently stirred the hem of his long robe with the Wind-Riding Art.

Rustle–

His broad sleeves and robe hems caught the wind and billowed just enough.

Only then did the flying sword slowly descend.

“Come down neither too quickly nor too slowly.”

When he reached a height of around three zhang above the ground, Zhang Jingyi stopped in midair again.

“Pause once more here. The mortals need enough time to see your face.”

A moment later, the flying sword landed on the stone platform.

Zhang Jingyi neither bent his knees nor swayed.

Not even a speck of dust rose.

Rustle.

The hem of his long robe settled a moment later.

“Like this.”

He stepped down from the flying sword.

“Use the Wind-Riding Art to stir your robe slightly as well. But pay attention to the direction of the wind. It does not look good if your clothes flap over your face.”

Zhang Jingyi was perfectly serious.

“And be careful not to bend your knees when landing. It ruins the effect.”

“Understood.”

“Give it a try.”

Lee Hyun infused spiritual power into the Flowing Cloud Disc.

Huuummm–

The round disc of white jade expanded to nearly three zhang in length.

Lee Hyun stepped onto the Flowing Cloud Disc and followed the exact sequence Zhang Jingyi had demonstrated. At a height of ten zhang, he waited until everyone was watching him, then descended while using the Wind-Riding Art to make his long robe billow appropriately. At three zhang, he paused long enough for everyone to get a clear look at his face, then landed on the stone platform without stirring so much as a speck of dust.

Zhang Jingyi nodded.

“Well done.”

“It isn’t difficult.”

“In practice, there will be hundreds of people below looking up at you. Just do exactly what you did now.”

Zhang Jingyi studied Lee Hyun’s face for a moment.

“Though you should wear a slightly more imposing expression. Not so frightening that they are terrified, but solemn enough that no one would dare approach you casually. Avoid unnecessary words, and when you do need to speak, make every word suitably impressive.”

Chapter 49

Five days later.

The Crimson Firmament Immortal Ferry left the royal capital of Anling Kingdom and headed first for Shuoning Circuit.

In each county and town, royal officials had already gathered children of eligible age who had yet to undergo a spiritual root test.

Whoooom–

Whenever the massive immortal ferry emerged beneath the clouds, people throughout the villages and cities stopped what they were doing and looked up at the sky.

“Immortals!”

“They’ve come from the immortal sect!”

The children’s parents knelt along both sides of the road.

The resident cultivators mounted their respective flight magic tools in the order Zhang Jingyi had taught them.

Lee Hyun also rode the Flowing Cloud Disc down from the deck of the Crimson Firmament Immortal Ferry and paused ten zhang (about 33 m) above the ground.

After confirming that hundreds of eyes were fixed on him, he slowly descended.

Even the wind cooperated, making his Danxiao Sect Outer Gate robe flutter just enough.

At a little over three zhang above the ground, he paused once more.

Whish.

The Flowing Cloud Disc settled onto the clearing without stirring so much as a speck of dust.

At the sight, everyone pressed their foreheads to the ground in unison.

“We greet the Immortals!”

The children stared up at Lee Hyun with their mouths hanging open.

‘It certainly works.’

...

The spiritual root tests were conducted in spacious government compounds or open grounds throughout the towns.

The children came forward one by one and placed a hand on the transparent spiritual-root testing orb.

When a child without a spiritual root touched it, nothing happened.

Most of them touched the spiritual-root testing orb again and again before taking their parents’ hands and leaving.

Every so often, light bloomed inside the spiritual-root testing orb.

Hummmmm–

Red, yellow, white, and black light mingled together.

“Fire, Earth, Metal, Water. A quadruple spiritual root.”

A resident cultivator recorded the child’s name, place of origin, and parents’ status.

The parents wept with joy.

The child looked around, unable to understand what had happened to them.

Some children burst into tears in front of the spiritual-root testing orb when told they would have to part from their parents.

“Can’t I go with Mama?”

The child’s mother was crying too, but she forced herself to smile as she gently pushed the child forward by the shoulders.

“You must listen carefully to the Immortals.”

“No. I want to go home.”

Zhang Jingyi did not hurry the child.

He simply waited in silence until the parents had soothed their child and said their farewells.

...

Starting with Shuoning Circuit, they traveled through Baihe Circuit and Yunling Circuit in turn.

All three were mountainous, sparsely populated regions even by the standards of Anling Kingdom.

Although the royal officials had gathered the children beforehand, news reached some remote mountain villages so late that a few families did not arrive until the final day.

Near sunset, a man came running down a distant mountain road with a child on his back.

His straw sandals were worn through, and blood ran from both feet.

“Is... is the test still going?”

Lee Hyun took out the spiritual-root testing orb he had already put away.

“Set the child down.”

The little girl on the man’s back placed her hand on the spiritual-root testing orb.

No light appeared.

Deep disappointment crossed the man’s face.

Lee Hyun handed him some healing ointment and silver.

“Take the child home. The mountain roads will be dark, so it would be best to spend the night at the government office before leaving.”

“Thank you, Immortal. Thank you.”

The man bowed again and again.

The children selected in this manner boarded the Crimson Firmament Immortal Ferry and headed for the royal capital.

...

Immortal Ascension Villa in the royal capital of Anling Kingdom.

Within its broad walls stood halls and courtyards of various sizes.

The nineteen children who would be taken to the Danxiao Sect lived here together.

The royal household provided them with clean clothes, warm food, and beds, as well as physicians and maidservants to attend to them.

At first, the children cried every night after being separated from their parents, but after a few days, they gradually began to adjust to their new lives.

Some were even delighted by the lavish foods they had never tasted before.

...

Two days before their departure for the main sect.

Zhang Jingyi handed Lee Hyun a ledger.

“Take a look.”

It was the Immortal Ascension Selection register, listing the names, spiritual roots, and origins of the children selected from each region.

Beside it lay a list of the tribute that the royal household would offer to the Danxiao Sect.

Lee Hyun checked the children’s names and numbers one by one.

“There are no problems.”

“I’ll take the children back to the main sect. I plan to settle the contribution points I’ve accumulated from my duties as a resident cultivator and stop by the sect’s cultivator market.”

“Very well.”

“Four of us, including me, will escort the children. Junior Brother Li, take charge of the Immortal Veneration Court while we’re gone.”

Like Zhang Jingyi, Lee Hyun was a Qi Refining Great Perfection cultivator, and his combat prowess was great enough to overwhelm Lu Jingtian and Ruan Qingzhao. As such, he was already regarded within the Immortal Veneration Court of Anling Kingdom as one of the resident cultivators representing the Danxiao Sect.

“Understood.”

“The round trip shouldn’t take even a month.”

...

The next day.

Dozens of carriages flying the banners of the Anling royal household stopped in front of Immortal Ascension Villa.

Royal kin and officials led twenty-three royal scions between the ages of six and twelve inside, all dressed in splendid clothing.

The King of Anling had come in person as well.

He was an old man nearing seventy, but for a mortal, he was remarkably robust. His back was straight, and there was no trace of illness on his face.

The King of Anling bowed deeply to Zhang Jingyi and the other resident cultivators.

“Greetings, Immortals of the Danxiao Sect.”

It happened at that moment.

Brrr.

The spirit-insect pouch hanging from Lee Hyun’s waist trembled ever so slightly, and the fuzzbees inside suddenly grew restless.

‘What is it?’

Without changing his expression, Lee Hyun placed a hand on the spirit-insect pouch.

The three that had mutated after eating the Meridian-Linking Jade Silkworm were especially agitated.

It was the same reaction they showed whenever they discovered a spirit insect they could prey upon.

‘There’s a spirit insect here?’

Everyone in the nearby royal party appeared to be an ordinary mortal.

A few rogue cultivators hired by the royal household had accompanied them, but they remained far away near the courtyard wall.

The King of Anling spoke.

“I have one request I would like to make of the Immortals.”

“Speak.”

“These are children of eligible age from the royal household whose spiritual roots have not yet been examined. Would you be willing to see whether any of them possess an immortal affinity as well?”

“That can be done.”

The royal scions came forward one by one to the spiritual-root testing orb.

Each time a child placed a hand on it, they stared nervously into the transparent sphere.

Yet nothing happened.

Meanwhile, Lee Hyun watched the fuzzbees’ reactions rather than the children.

Whenever the children moved, the royal kin and officials shifted positions as well.

But the fuzzbees’ reactions remained unchanged.

All three faced the same direction.

Toward the King of Anling.

‘Hmm...’

The final child removed their hand from the spiritual-root testing orb.

Not a single thread of light had appeared within it.

Zhang Jingyi said,

“Regrettably, it seems none of the children in this generation possess a spiritual root.”

The King of Anling replied with disappointment.

“It appears the royal household has once again failed to encounter an immortal affinity.”

Behind the royal scions dressed in splendid silk stood the children who, until only a few days ago, had lived in mountain villages and farming settlements.

Among them was even a child who had entered Immortal Ascension Villa without proper shoes.

Yet they were the ones who would become disciples of the Danxiao Sect.

No matter how exalted the status into which the royal children had been born, that path remained closed to them.

The King of Anling gazed at the nineteen children for a long while.

Meanwhile, Lee Hyun quietly shifted two steps to the side.

Three royal officials now stood between Lee Hyun and the King of Anling.

The fuzzbees continued pressing themselves toward the king’s direction.
